༄ /mdo sde/a
ji ga rjo(/smo nga
(72)krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

mdo sde/ spyosaspyi (72)0319 mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo/ 3rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya dharma shrī bha dra dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(294) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(336)0320 dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo zhes bya ba/ 337bsdur mchan/(341) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(342)0321 tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo/ 343bsdur mchan/(345) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(346)0322 nyung ba sde lnga'i dge ba dang mi dge ba'i 'bras bu bstan

pa'i mdo/ 347rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya dz+nyā na shrī gub ta dang bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(354) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(355)0323 mchog tu gdags pa'i mdo/ 356bsdur mchan/(358) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(359)0324 rnam par grol ba'i lam las sbyangs pa'i yon tan bstan pa/ 360rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(378) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(388)0325 che1re mtha'i mdo/ 389rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud dha sing ha dang lots+tsha ba ban de dge ba'i dpal gyis bsgyur/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra sing ha dang zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(405) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(407)0326 tshe 'pho ba ji ltar 'gyur ba zhus pa'i mdo/ 408bsdur mchan/(430) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(433)2

0327 mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo/ 434rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de zhang ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus nas skad gsar chad kyis kyang bsnan nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(436) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(436)0328 mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo/ 437bsdur mchan/(441) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(442)0329 'phags pa 'du shes bcu gcig bstan pa'i mdo/ 443bsdur mchan/(444) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(445)0330 'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo chen po/ 446bsdur mchan/(456) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(458)0331 'phags pa mtshan mo bzang po zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 459bsdur mchan/(465) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(466)0332 myun gyi nags tshal gyi sgo zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 467bsdur mchan/(480) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(482)

0333 pha ma'i mdo/ 483bsdur mchan/(485) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(485)0334 'phags pa bden pa bzhi'i mdo/ 486bsdur mchan/(488) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(489)0335 don rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ ga0rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang pradz+nyā bza dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(490) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(534)0336 'phags pa don rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ 535bsdur mchan/(548) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(549)0337 'phags pa rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ 550rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang su ren dra bo dhi dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(558) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(559)0338 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhag 4

pa'i phan yon yang dag par berjod pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ 560rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes snying pos bsgyur/ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(565) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(566)0339 mchod rten bskor ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ 567bsdur mchan/(573) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(574)0340 gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 575bsdur mchan/(582) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(584)0341 tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa/ 585bsdur mchan/(586) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(586)0342 tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ 587bsdur mchan/(588) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(588)034 klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs su bcad pa/ 589bsdur mchan/(599) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(601)5

0344 ched du brjod pa'i tshoms 602dang po/ mi rtag pa'i tshoms 602gnyis pa/ 'dod pa'i tshoms 606gsum pa/ sred pa'i tshoms/ 608bzhi pa/ bag yod pa'i tshoms 610lnga pa/ sdug pa'i tshoms 614drug pa/ tshul khrims kyi tshoms/ 617bdun pa/ legs par spyad pa'i tshoms 618brgyad pa/ tshig gi tshoms/ 620dgu pa/ las kyi tshoms/ 621bcu pa/ dad pa'i tshoms 623bcu gcig pa/ dge sbyong gi tshoms/ 625bcu gnyis pa/ lam gyi tshoms/ 626bcu gsum pa/ bkur sti'i tshoms/ 629bcu bzhi pa/ 'khu ba'i tshoms 630bca lnga pa/ dran pa'i tshoms/ 632bcu drug pa/ sil bu'i tshoms/ 635bcu bdun pa/ chu'i tshoms/ 637bco brgyad pa/ me tog gi tshoms/ 638bcu dgu pa/ rta yi tshoms/ 641nyi shu pa/ khro ba'i tshoms 643nyi shu gcig pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshoms 645nyi shu gnyis pa/ thos pa'i tshoms 647nyi shu gsum pa/ bdag gi tshoms/ 649nyi shu bzhi pa/ bsgre ba'i tshoms 6516

nyi shu lnga pa/ mdza' bshes kyi tshoms/ 654nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshoms 657nyi shu bdun pa/ mthong ba'i tshoms 661nyi shu brgyad pa/ sdig pa'i tshoms 665nyi shu dgu pa/ phrugs kyi tshoms/ 669sum cu pa/ bde ba'i tshoms 675sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ sems kyi tshoms/ 681sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ dge slong gi tshoms/ 687sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ bram ze'i tshoms 695rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā pra bha ka ra dang lots+tsha ba ban de rin chen mchog gis bsgyur/zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(705) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(718)0345 'phags pa skyes bu dam pa'i mdo/ 719rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang lots+tsha ba ban de bzang skyong gis bsgyur/ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhu chen bgyis/bsdur mchan/(722) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(723)0346 dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i mdo/ 724rtsangs de ben dra rak+ṣi tas zhus chen bgyis/bsdur mchan/(731) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(732)7

0347 lha:re myo/cardo/ 733bsdur mchan/(737) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(738)0348 lha'i mdo nyung ngu / 739zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(741) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(742)03ga zla ba'i mdo/ 743bsdur mchan/(745) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(745)0350 khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo/ 746zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba rad na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(755) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(756)0351 'phags pa gnas 'jog gi mdo/ 757rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dz+nyā de ba dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(767) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(769)0352 'phags pa dga' ba can gyi mdo/ 7708

rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya sing ha dang /lots+tsha ba ban de byin gyi snying pos bsgyur te zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(788) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(788)0353 'phags pa 'khar gsil gyi mdo/ 789bsdur mchan/(792) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(793)0354 'khar gsil 'chang ba'i kun tu spyod pa'i cho ga 794bsdur mchan/(799) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(800)0355 chos kyi 'khor lo'i mdo/ 801bsdur mchan/(806) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(807)0356 las kyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu'i mdo/ 815sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa rgya'i lots+tsha ba thang sam tsang zhes bya bas rgya gar dngos las rgya nag tu legs par bsgyur/phyis gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa las rab tu byung ba rgya nag chen po'i lha btsun chos kyi rin chen gyis dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen por bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab/9

bsdur mchan/(806) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(807)0357 las rnam par 'byed pa/ 808bsdur mchan/(859) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(866)0358 las kyi rnam par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi gzhung / 867bsdur mchan/(895) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(899)0359 las rnam par 'byed pa/ 900rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shī la dang / mu ni bza dang /zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(944) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(945)10

nga(ri ༷ (5ri—la la ma che ji te sgo ṇi ci ri ske r+ha ma cir rtsi ga ’ mo sku sa 1 39dung /la tri thogaXsgro — ge'ipha 5 —— —— — — — sgro ge — ste / — — me snyo rta 6 stos/3— tsam sa ma sa zu nga 1) sgo'i༄r+sha6 tsha na phugs44 76 ga sgror+sha'i —— — sgo— 1 — — —— rtson r+sā tsā rdzo ji ci khu ru napa byugazi 61 la nga —bye ri/ sha sdu 0 3 4 la nga rdo // /ji —3 9 kho /ye shes 'od kyis sgrib gsum mun/ /mthar mdzad rgyal sras 'od dpas med/ /
'o nyo mo gotshog sa da sa bgasamaman ga/ / / / na ngas sa gdung 'a gas la/ /ga ga'o na si 'idza 'o 'omathar ma da rgyal sras da dpag da// zla da ltar ba la zla ba da/ /

༄༄gi /rgya gar skad du/ a bhi niṣ+ka ma ṇa ②su tra/ bod skad du/mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyid kyi dbu ni rin chen 'od ldan dang / /btsun mo pad ma kha bye ma nyis mdangs ldan pas/ /slong ba dga' mdzad sangs rgyas go 'phang brnyes gyur cing —/ /chos rnams ston mdzad zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig rnyed pas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las 'das gyur cing / /srid pa'i 'ching ba thams cad zad byed zhir gyur la/ /sdug bsngal mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las rgal ③ba'i / /zam pa gcig pu bde gshegs chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la yon tan phul byung la gnas sbyin pa'i gnas/ /mchod pa cung zad byas kyang rgya che nyid 'gyur ba/ /bde bar gshegs pas rab bsngags gang zag mchog brgyad kyis / /rab brgyan 'phags pa'i dge 'dun de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub gsung 72—3

rnam par brtags na dad pa mi skyed pa'am/ /phan pa mi 'byung gang de ci yang yod min la/ /tshig btu ba dang 'dzin pa'i nus dang rnam bral ba/ /rnam par g.yengs phyir 'bras rtsol (1ni'adi bdag nyung zad cig /ji ltar pad ma kha bye'i dbus gnas bung ba ni/ /'khor zhing pad ma la ni chung zad sogs (snyepar byed / /de bzhin thub pa'i zhal gyi pad ma'i tshal nang nas/ /rang yid rab tu dga' byed chung chazad bsdu bar bya/ /thub pa'i gsung ni ma lus shin tu rtogs dka' ba/ /dad ldan mi la nyin re'ang rgyas par nyer 'gro ste/ /rnam par dpyad na tshigs bcad phyed mtha'ang mi dpogs na/ /rin chen mdo brgya bsdu ba 'di ni smos ci dgos/ /phyogs go 4)rnams su snyan (5)dang grags pa'i snang bas khyab/ /rab gsal zhes bya sa yi nerabadag por gyur pa na/ /bsod nams stobs kyis dgra las rgyal bas rgyal phran gyis/ /btud pas nor bu'i cod ri dpan 'od kyis zhal gtsang byas/ /glang po'i dbang po rgyags 'khrig (gyi'adod chags kyis chags pa/ /'phral du bcos pa'i thabs med nyon mongs skabs gyur la/ /gzigs nas tsho)'gro ba'i chags sogs nyes pa zhi bzhed pas/ /thugs brtan thub dbang gyur par des ni smon lam btab/ /de nas brtsams te sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang / /brtson 'grus bsam gtan mi g.yo blo gros rnon po rnams / /nyid tsobade'i ltos med shin tu yun ring yang dag spel/ /'gro la phan phyir shin tu dka' ba brgya phrag mdzad4te/ /thugs rje cher ldan drang srong mchog 'di tshe gzhan du/ /nyid kyis 'gro phan don mdzad mi skyo ji snyed de/ /brjod par 8'di na shā ri'i bus kyang mi nus na'ang / /gang dag phyir ni chung (da zad yongs su brjod par bya/ /stag mo shi bi geglang po spre'u tshudaka' thub dbang / /72—4

tshangs sogs sku tshe brgya phrag du mar dge mdzad nas/ /don kun sgrub brtson bdag nyid chen po tshe gcig thogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gnas su skye ba bzhes/ /der bzhugs nas ni 'gro ba kun la legs gzigs nas/ /skyabs med g.yo zhing phongs pa du mas yongs khyab la/ /thugs rje chen pos thugs ni spro ba bskyed gyur te/ /gzhan gyi don mdzad thugs dam nyid kyi rgyud dgongs gyur/ /de bas 'di ni ①ji ltar mi yul nyer gshegs te/ /skye dang rga shi na ba'i 'jigs pa gzigs nas ni/ /rab byung blo ②gos des mdzad byang chub yang dag brnyes/ /de bzhin chos ston mdzad pa bshad kyis ②mnyan par gyisal/ /de nas dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bskal pa mang por bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa rnam pa du mar nye bar bsags pas byang chub kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa/nyon mongs pa'i chu bo stobs dang ldan pas shin tu chod pa rnams la thugs rjes yongs su bskul ba/ gzhan gyi don mdzad pa'i phyir rtag tu brtson par mdzad pa de byathugs la dgongs pa 'di lta bu mngon sum du mdzad de/ gang ngas skye ba mang por yongs su 'khor ba na rang gi sha dang khrag dang mgo dang mig dang bu dang chung ma rnams gtong ba dang shin tu gtong bas yongs su btang ba dang /dka' ba'i tshul khrims la gnas pa dang / gzhan gyis sbyar ba'i bsnyen bkur ma yin pa sna tshogs pa bzod par byas pa dnge / rtag tu lhod pa med pa'i spro ba dang / 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bde ba la ma chags pa dang /yod pa dang med pa'i don la rnam par dpyod pa dang ldan pas gzhan gyi don la brtson pa'i blo gros kyis shin tu mi bzad pa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rnam pa mang 72—5

pos sems la gdungs pa'i sdug phongs zhu)pa'i srog chags rnams la mchog tu snying rje bskyed nas byams pa'i stobs dang / zla 'od dang shi bi dang glang po dang thams cad sgrol dang bzod par smra ba dang spre'u'i ②bdag po dang mig bzangs ⑧dang sman chen po la sogs pa skyes pa'i rabs stong phrag snyed tu smon lam byas shing bsags pa/ e ma'o kye ma bdag gis 'jig rten long ba 'dren pa med pa/yongs su 'dren pa med pa/ chos ma yin pa/ 'dod chags kyi godabang du 'gro ba / log pa'i chos kyis yongs su khyab pa/ sems la mi bzad pa'i chags pas zil gyis non (nyapa/ khro ba mang ba/ lta ba ngan pa'i tshang tshing gis rnam par brlag pa/ phrag dog dang ser snas kun tu bcings pa/ legs par spyod pa la 'jug pa la rgyab kyis phyogs shing nyes par spyod pa la kun tu gzhol bar gyur pa rnams la bdag sangs rgyas su gyur nas sems can ma rgal (7ba rnams ni bsgral bar bya'o/ /ma grol ba rnams ni dgrol bar bya'o/ /dbugs ma phyin pa rnams ni dbugs dbyung bar bya'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams ni yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bya'o zhes ngas yun ring du mngon par 'dod pa yin na da ⑦ni don (kyede bya ba'i dus la bab pa yin gyis6nye/ ma la bdag gis 'jig rten gyi gnas skabs ci zhig yin pa bltas na gdul bar nus so/ /gdul bar nus so zhes de ltar rnam par dgongs nas 'jig rten 'di dag thams cad la gzigs pa 'jug ste/ su ni 'grib/ su ni dge ba'i chos rnams kyis 'phel/ su ni gnod par gyur/ su ni nyam 7thag par gyur/ su ni sdug bsngal bar gyur/ gang la ni ngas ma 'jigs shig /ma 'jigs shig ces mi 'jigs pa sbyin pas dbugs dbyung bar bya/ su ni ngan song la gzhol/ su ni 72—6

ngan song la 'bab/ su ni ngan song la bab/ su ni ngas ngan song las bton te / mtho ris dang thar pa'i 'bras bu la gzhag 6)par bya/ su ni 'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba la lag nas drang bar bya/ su ni 'phags pa'i nor dang bral ba rnams la 'phags pa'i nor gyi dbang phyug gi bdag po la gzhag (5)par bya/ gang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa dag ni bskyed par bya/ gang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dag ni yongs su smin par bya/ gang gi yongs su smin pa rnams ni rnam (cipar grol bar bya zhes ye shes kyi ④gzigs pa 'jug par mdzad pa na srog chags brgya stong dpag tu med pa la la (5)ni dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed par (6)bskyed par 'os pa dang / la la dge ba'i rtsa ba (7)ma smin pa yongs su smin par nus (shepa dang ske/ la la dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin pa bde 'gror 'gro bar gzhol ba dang ske/ la la 'bras bu dang po thob par gzhol ba dang / la la lan cig po)phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang phyir mi 'ong ba dang dgra bcom pa nyid dang rang byang chub 'thob par gzhol ba dang / la la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa dang / la la ni sngon gyi smon lam rnams nye bar bsags pas rkyen la rag (7las pa gang zhig ma thos pas dam pa'i chos las yongs su nyams par gyur par gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang 'di snyam du dgongs te/ kye ma'o bdag gis yun ring po nas yang dag par rtogs pa rdzogs par gyur cing nga'i ngal ba 'bras bu dang bcas par gyur to zhes dgyes shing (nyangs bya ba ni byas so/ /ngas khur bskur (rtebar dka' ba ni mthar phyin te/gang nga'i yongs su dag pa'i rgyud dang ldan pa'i zhing du gyur cing gdul bya'i skye bo rnams yun ring por mi thogs par pad ma'i tshal yongs su smin cing kha bye la ma 72wa 7

reg 0)pa'i nyi ma shar bas rgyas par 'gyur ba lta bur gyur gyis phyiphyi bshol mi bya'o//'dir gnas bzhin du yang ⑧dngos po thams cad rdzogs par bya bar nus pa ma yin pas na gzhes pa'i dus (geni ma yin gyis ⑤ma la bdag mi'i 'jig rten du song la der phyin nas brtson 'grus kyi grogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bla na med pa'i ye shes rtogs par byas te/ 'di rnams skal ba ji lta ba ⑥bzhin du 'di rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed cing yongs su smin la ⑦rnam par grol bar bya zhing skye ba dang rga ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba dang mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa dang sdug bsngal ba (8)dang yid mi bde ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhung ⑨ba/skyabs med pa/ yongs su skyob pa med pa'i srog chags rnams dam pa'i chos bstan pa'i lag pa brkyang bas gdon par bya'o/ /thog ma med pa'i dus nas rjes su 'brel pa'i 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang gti mug gi mes kun tu gdungs pa rnams la 7'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i chu'i rgyun blugs pas sdug bsngal ma lus pa bsal bar bya'o zhes de lta bu'i thugs la dgongs pa nges par bskyed nas/ 'dzam bu'i 57gling du 'jug par mdzad pa na 8rigs dang yul dang nyunyedus dang rgyud dang bud med de gzigs pa rnam pa lngas gzigs par mdzad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyu gang gis rigs la gzigs par mdzad ce na/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa ni 8'di snyam du dgongs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams rigs ji lta bu zhig tu ⑫nying mtshams sbyor ba len snyam na/ bram ze'i rigs sam/ rgyal rigs su yin la / de la res 'ga' ni bram ze'i rigs btsun par bkur/ res 'ga' ni rgyal rigs te/ da ⑩lta na ni rgyal rigs btsun par bkur bar gzigs nas/72—8

ma la bdag la gzhan dag byang chub sems dpas 6)rigs ngan par nying mtshams sbyor ba blangs so/ /zhes gzhi 'dis kha zer bar ②mi 'gyur bar bdag gis rgyal rigs su nying mtshams sbyor ba blang bar bya'o snyam mo/ /'di ltar byang chub sems dpas ②thog ma med pa'i dus nas smad par mi 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags ④pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos bshad pa 'bras bu med pa ma yin pas rgyu 'dis na byang chub sems dpa' rnams rigs la gzigs par mdzad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyu gang gis yul la gzigs par mdzad ce na/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa ni 'di snyam du dgongs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams (geyul ji lta bu duzhig tu nying mtshams sbyor ba len ④snyam na/ 'bras dang bu ram shing dang ba lang dang ma ho phun sum tshogs pa/ slongs (nyamo pa brgya 'du ba/ mtha' 'khob dhikyi skye bo med pa/ dbus pa'i skye bo gnas pa gang du skye bo gcig btul bas skye bo'i 0tshogs chen po 'dul bar 'gyur ba'i yul gang yin pa gzigs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ dbus 67kyi yul 'di ni bu ram shing gi phreng 6)ba dang 'bras dang ba lang dang ma he phun sum tshogs pa/slongs tsomo pa brgya 'du ba/ mtha' 'khob kyi skye 8bo med pa/ dbus pa'i skye bo gnas pa/ gang du skye bo gcig btul bas skye bo'i tshogs chen po btul bar 'gyur ba yin gyis8/ ma la bdag la gzhan dag byang chub sems dpas 7yul mtha' 'khob ⑩rnams su nying mtshams sbyor ba blangs tsoso zhes gzhi 'dis kha zer bar mi 'gyur bar bdag gis yul dbus spyisu nying mtshams sbyor ba blang bar bya'o snyam mo/ /'di ltar byang chub sems dpas thog ma med pa'i dus nas smad par 72—9

mi 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos bshad pa 'bras bu med pa ma yin pas rgyu 'dis na byang chub sems dpa' yul la gzigs par mdzad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyu gang gis na dus la gzigs par mdzad ce na/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa ni 'di snyam du dgongs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dus ji lta bu zhig tu 'dzam bu'i gling du nying mtshams sbyor ba len snyam na/ skye dgu'i tshe lo yar skye ba na brgyad khri thub pa yan chad nying mtshams sbyor ba mi len la0ri / mi rnams kyi tshe lo mar 'grib pa na brgya thub pa man chad ②nying mtshams sbyor ba mi len no/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyu gang gis mi rnams kyi tshe lo brgyad khri (5)thub pa yan chad nying mtshams sbyor ba len par mi mdzad ce na/ mi rnams kyi tshe (4)lo brgyad khri thub pa na yid 'byung bar dka' zhing skyo bar bya bar dka' la blun zhing dbang po rtul ba dang / bag med cing bde ba mang bas bden pa rnams kyi snod du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /mar 'grib pa lo brgya man chad du yang snyigs ma lnga po 'di lta ste tshe'i snyigs ma dang / nyon mongs pa'i snyigs ma dang / sems can gyi snyigs ma dang / lta ba'i snyigs ma dang /dus kyi snyigs ma shas che ba (deyin pas bdag la gzhan dag byang chub sems dpas snyigs ma lnga shas che ba'i dus su nying mtshams sbyor ba blangs so zhes gzhi 'dis kha zer bar mi 'gyur ro snyam moskyo/ /'di ltar byang chub sems dpas thog ma med pa'i dus nas smad par mi 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags ⑦pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos bshad pa 'bras bu med pa ma yin pas rgyu 'dis na byang chub sems dpa' rnams dus la gzigs pa yin no//72—10

byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyu gang gis rgyud la 0)gzigs par mdzad ce na/byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa ni (ge'adi snyam du dgongs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyud ci 'dra ba zhig tu nying mtshams sbyor ba len snyam na/ rigs gang zhig btsun par bkur zhing ma mes godang /pha mes zung bdun gyi bar du spyod pa la skyon med par ligazigs nas/ de 'di snyam du dgongs te shākya'i rigs rgyud 'di ni btsun par bkur ba yin zhing mang pos bkur ba nas bzung ste spyod pa skyon med pa yin gyis(ge/ ma la bdag la gzhan dag byang chub sems dpas (6)rgyud ngan pa las nying mtshams sbyor ba blangs so zhes gzhi ⑦'dis kha zer bar mi 'gyur bar bdag gis rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i rgyud du nying mtshams sbyor ba blang ngo snyam mo/ /'di ltar byang chub sems dpas ⑧thog ma med pa'i dus nas smad par mi 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags dzonyanapa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos bshad pa 'bras bu med pa ma yin pas rgyu 'dis na byang chub sems dpa' rgyud la gzigs par mdzad do//byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyu chagang gis bud med la gzigs par mdzad ce na / byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa ni (nya'adi snyam du dgongs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams bud med ci 'dra ba zhig gi rum du nying mtshams sbyor ba len snyam na de 'di snyam du 7dgongs te/ bud med gang zhig gzugs bzang mo dang ldan pa/ rigs dang ldan pa/ rigs 'phel bar 'gyur ba/ khro bag can ma yin pa/ phra ma can ma yin pa/ ngag rtsub pa ma yin pa/ dad pa dang ldan pa/ rang bzhin bzang ba/ bsam pa dge ba/rgyud phun sum tshogs pa/ rigs mtho ba/ nye du'i rigs dang ldan pa/ shes 72—11

rab phun sum tshogs pa/ gtong ba phun sum tshogs pa/ mtshan nyid mi g.yo ba/rang bzhin brtan la rgod bag can 0)ma yin pa ⑤khengs pa med pa/ byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sdug cing yid du 'ong ba/ 'jig rten thams cad la chos dang ldan pa/ bud med thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams la e ma'o bdag sangs rgyas kyi yum du gyur cig ces smon lam btab pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' zla ba bcu rum du 'dzin nus pa dang rang gi don yang nyams par mi byed pa yin par gzigs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo cha'adi ni ma mes dang pha mes zung bdun (gegyi bar du spyod pa la skyon med cing gzugs dang ldan pa dang /rigs dang ldan pa dang / tshul dang ldan zhes bya ba nas bud med thams cad kyi (5)mchog tu gyur ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin te/ khro bag can ma yin pa dang /rigs 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rum du zla ba ⑥bcur 'dzin nus pa dang / rang gi don yang mi nyams pa yin la 'di ltar sgyu 'phrul chen mos sngon sangs rgyas rnams la kye ma bdag sangs rgyas kyi yum du gyur cig ces smon lam btab pa yang ⑦yin pas bdag la gzhan dag byang chub sems dpas 58)mtshan ngan pa dang ldan pa'i bud med kyi rum du nying mtshams sbyor ba blangs so zhes kha zer bar mi 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /'di ltar byang chub sems dpas smad par mi 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 6)chos bshad pa 'bras bu med pa ma byayin pas rgyu 'dis na byang chub sems dpa' bud med rnams la gzigs par mdzad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' gzigs pa lngas gzigs nas dga' ldan na spyod pa'i 72—12

lha'i ris rnams la gsungs pa/ grogs po dag shes par gyis shig /nga 'dzam bu'i gling du babs nas yul dbus su nying mtshams sbyor ba len gyis zhi)khyed cag golas gang dag bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba de ①phal cher yul dbus kyi grong khyer chen po drug po 'di lta ste/ mnyan ④yod dang sā (7ke ta dang yangs pa can dang tsam pa dang rgyal po'i khab dang bā rā ṇa sīr 6)nying mtshams sbyor ba long (7shig(nya /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / dga' 6)ldan gyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhyen par mdzod cig /da ⑩ltar 'jig rten ni sdig pas gos pa/ skye dgu ni ma rungs pa'i bsam pa can/ 'dzam bu'i gling na rtog ge pa drug dang / rjes su sgrogs pa drug dang / snyoms par 'jug pa drug gis dkrugs (7pa lags so/ /de la rtog ge pa drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'od srung rdzogs byed dang /kun tu rgyu gnag lhas kyi bu dang / smrang 8'don gyi bu mo'i bu yang dag rgyal ba can dang / mi 'pham 0skra'i la ba can dang / kā t+yā'i 8bu rnag can dang /gcer bu pa gnyen gyi bu'o/ /rjes su sgrogs pa drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/bram ze sgyus 8rgal dang / bram ze rnas ⑩deg dang / bram ze bzang ldan dang /bram ze tshangs pa'i tshe dang / bram ze pad ma'i snying po dang / bram ze dmar po'o / /snyoms par 'jug pa drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rangs byed kyi bu ⑩lhag spyod dang / sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur dang / kun tu rgyu rab bzang dang —/ bram ze'i khye'u kun rgyal dang / drang srong nyon mongs med (snyepa dang /lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can no/ /'dir ni chos mnyan ⑩pa'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' khyed kyi gdan dpag tshad bcu gnyis pa bsham pa bgyi zhing 72—13

bdag cag zhi)'di snyam du bdag cag la dga' ldan gyi gnas na byang chub sems dpa' 9babazhugs pas chos bshad de chos de bdag cag gis thos nas ci nas kyang bdag cag gi ( nayun ring po'i don dang / sman pa dang / bde bar 'gyur ba de lta de (4)ltar bsgrub par bgyid par sems lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / byang chub sems dpas (5)dga' ldan gyi lha rnams la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /grogs po dag de'i phyir rol mo'i cha spyad thams cad rdungs yi shig /dga' ldan gyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis rol mo'i cha spyad thams cad brdungs pa dang / byang chub sems dpas kyang dung bus te gsungs pa/ grogs po dag 'di la lhag par sgra gang che/ bcom ldan 'das dung gi sgra lags so/ /grogs po dag 57)ji ltar dung gi sgras rol mo'i cha spyad thams cad zil gyis mnan te gnas pa de bzhin du ngas kyang 'dzam bu'i gling du song la rtog ge pa drug dang /rjes su sgrogs pa drug dang / snyoms par 'jug pa drug zil (nyegyis mnan lanas bdud rtsi rtogs par bya ste/ bdud rtsis 'gro ba tshim par bya'o/ /mi rtag ⑩pa'i dung bud par bya'o/ /stong pa nyid kyi rnga brdung bar bya'o/ /bdag med pa'i seng ge'i sgra bsgrag nyu1 par bya'o zhes gsungs nas tshigs su bcad de yang gsungs pa / seng ge gcig gis gcan gzan mtshogs ni du ma 'joms/ /rdo rje gcig gis brag gi rtse mo du ma 'jig /brgya byin gcig gis lha ma yin dbang du ma 'joms / /nyi ma gcig gis mun pa du ma rnam par sel/ /grogs po dag khyed cag las gang bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba de yul dbus kyi grong khyer chen po drug tu nying mtshams sbyor ba long 8shig /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems te byang chub sems dpa' 'di ni btsun tsomo sgyu 'phrul chen 72—14

mo'i lhums su nying mtshams sbyor ba len par bzhed kyis stim la de la bdag gis gzi brjid bsgrub par bya/ lhums kyang sbyang bar bya'o snyam nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis btsun (7mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo la gzi brjid bsgrubs shing lhums kyang gtsang mar byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa rigs dang / yul dang / dus dang / rgyud dang /bud med la gzigs pa ste/ gzigs pa lngas gzigs nas nam gyi gung la glang po cher bstan te dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris nas 'phos nas yum gyi lhums su zhugs so / /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris nas shi 'phos te yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa de'i tshe zhus chen po 'di shin tu g.yos par gyur 'jig rten 'di thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos gsal bar gyur cing 'jig rten na pya'ajig rten gyi bar gyi mun pa mun gnag smag tu gyur pa/ gang du nyi ma dang zla ba 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/ 'di ltar 75)mthu che ba dag gis kyang 'od kyis snang bar mi nus pa de dag kyang de'i tshe snang ba chen pos gsal bar gyur to/ /der sems can gang dag skyes pa de dag rang gi lag pa brkyang ba mi mthong ba las/de rnams snang ba des gcig gis gcig mthong nas shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so/ /shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so zhes bya bar shes so/ /ji ltar sprin ni rgya chen legs 'dus pa/ /chu mang bsags zhi)pa rlung gis bskyod pa ltar/ /de bzhin blo ldan de ni lhums 'jug pa / /ston ku'i sprin rum zla rgyas ji bzhin no/ /gang tshe rtsal ldan mnyam (7med nyer gshegs la/ /de tshe 'jig rten so so'i gling bar na/ /mun gyis khebs bsal phyogs kun shin tu ni/ /gsal snang byung gyur 'di 'dir chos nyid do/ /72—15

gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris nas 'phos te yum gyi lhums su zhugs par mdzad pa de nyid kyi mtshan mo btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mos 0)rmi lam bzhi mthong ste glang po che'i phru gu dkar po zhig bdag gi rum g.yas pa dral nas zhugs pa dang / steng gi nam mkha' la skyil mo krung gis 'chag (snyepa dang / seng ge'i gdan la 'dug nas skye bo'i ①tshogs chen po la chos ston pa dang / lha dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten bdag la phyag byed pa'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang mas btsun mo las de thos pa dang / mtshan mkhan rnams la rmi lam 'di ji ltar ston pa yin dris pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha mkhyen par mdzod cig /gang btsun mos rmi lam du mthong ba glang po che'i phru gu dkar po zhig bdag gi rum g.yas pa dral nas zhugs pa zhes bya ba ni ④'khor los sgyur (5)ba'i sras bltam par 'gyur ro/ /steng gi nam mkha' la 'chag go zhes bya ba ni rdzu 'phrul che ba dang mthu che bar 'gyur ro/ /seng ge'i gdan la 'dug ste chos ston to zhes bya ba ni de yang seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs te 'khor bzhi la chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten bdag la phyag byed do zhes bya ba nas yigal te de rab tu byung bar gyur na lha dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mchod cing rjed la mngon par bstod ci par 'gyur ro/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris nas 'phos te yum gyi lhums na zhugs (7pa de'i tshe/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis de la mi'am mi ma ⑧yin pa sus kyang 'tshe bar mi 'gyur bar / lha'i bu bzhi yum gyi srungs 6)mar 'jog pa ni lag na ral gri dang /lag na mdung dang / lag na mdung thung tsodang / lag na mda' bo che'o de 72—16

la 'di skad ces bya ste/ lha mchog bzhi la brgya byin gyis smras pa/ /khyed rnams song la lha mi ①rnams kyi ni/ /shin tu mchog (7gyur yum de ji ltar su'ang / /gnod mi byed par gus pas yongs su srungs(mi/ /de rnams shin tu 'bad byas dga' ba dang / /brgya byin lung ni spyi bos mnos nas su/ /rnam kun mda' mdung ral gri lag na thogs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yum ni srung bar byed/ /g.yul du rgyal gyur lha bzhis sbas pa dang / /de ni nyin mtshan sna tshogs rgyan 'chang ④zhing / /lha mo rang khyim nang nas rnam rol pa/ /dga' ba'i tshal na spyod pa lta bur spyod/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo 'di lta bu'i 'dod pa skyes te/ kye ma'o lha btson thams cad thar bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang mas kyang btsun mo'i tshig mnyan nas btson thams cad thar bar byas so/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na btsun mo 'dod pa skyes pa/ kye (2ma'o lhas grong khyer gyi shar phyogs kyi dbus su dman pa dang / long ba dang /bkren pa dang / sdug phongs pa dang / slongs (6)mo pa rnams la sbyin pa byin la bsod nams dag byas pa dang / lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / sum mdo'i dbus su dman pa dang / long ba dang (7/ bkren pa dang / sdug phongs pa dudang / slongs khyimo pa rnams la sbyin pa byin/ bsod nams ni bgyi'o / /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis btsun mo'i tshig ⑩mnyan nas grong khyer gyi shar phyogs su dman pa dang / long ba dang / bkren pa dang / sdug phongs pa dang / slongs 7mo pa rnams la ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa dang /ji ltar bslangs pa bzhin du sbyin pa ni byin/ bsod nams ni byas pa dang /de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / sum mdo'i dbus su dman 72—17

pa dang / long ba dang / bkren pa dang / sdug phongs pa dang / slongs 6)mo pa rnams gang mngon par 'dod pa dang / ji ltar bslangs pa bzhin du sbyin pa ni byin bsod nams ni byas so/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris nas 'phos te yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa na mdzod kyi nang du rdzas bzhag pa bzhin du mngal gyi dri ma dang / sha ma'i dri ma dang /khrag gi dri ma dang / mi gtsang ba gang yang rung ba sna tshogs kyis ma sbags so / /dper na nor bu rin po che ka shi'i ras kyis (gemi gos pa dang / ka shi'i ras ( nakyang nor bu rin po ches mi gos pa de bzhin du gang gi stim byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa na mdzod kyi (5)nang du rdzas (6)bzhag pa bzhin du mngal gyi dri ma dang / sha ma'i dri ma dang / khrag gi dri ma dang / mi gtsang ba gang yang rung ba sna tshogs kyis ma sbags so/ /ji ltar nor bu tshon shel (ne'od gsal dang / /rab (8༄gtsang ka shi'i (9)ras kyang gos pa med/ /de bzhin thub chen lhums na bzhugs pa na/ /mngal gyi dri ma cis kyang gos pa med/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris nas 'phos nas yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa de'i tshe yum gyi lhums na de thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /dper na nor bu be+e drur+ya 0zur brgyad pa tunyebazang po/rigs dang ldan pa/ dang ba gsal ba/ dri ma med pa/ tshon skud sna lnga sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / le brgan tsol brgyus tsho/snyel de skyes bu mig dang ldan pas mthong na 'di ni skud yipa'o/ /'di ni nor bu'o/ /skud pa 'di la nor bu brgyus pa yin no zhes 7shes pa de bzhin du/gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'phos te 72—18

yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa de'i tshe/ de'i yum gyi lhums na rnam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par lhums kyi nang na bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /ji ltar dri med nor bu be+e drur+ya0)/ /'od gsal lag par bzhag pa snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin thub chen yum gyi lhums bzhugs pa/ /shes shing sems pas (9yum ni yang dag lta / /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa dga' ldan nas 'phos nas yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa de'i tshe/ de'i yum 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa' 'dzin pas lus ngal ba 'am lus dub par 'gyur ba med do / /las kyi rnam smin zad pas mtho ris 'phos/ /gang tshe 'di ni lhums zhugs bzhugs pa na/ /de'i yum ngal bas 'dzin par mi byed par/ /de tshe gyur pa 'dir de chos nyid do/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'phos nas yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa de'i tshe yum de phan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du brtul zhugs lnga'i gzhi blangs par gyur (5)te/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te srog gcod pa las slar ldog go/ /ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs pa spyod pa dang / brdzun 4)du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / sbyar ba'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas spangs te/ 'bru'i chang dang / (nyasbyar ba'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas las slar ldog par byed do/ /srog mi gcod dang ma byin mi len dang / /brdzun (6)mi smra dang chang la mi brkam dang ske/ /'khrig pa'i mi tshangs spyod pa spong ba 'di/ /'di ni don grub (7)yum gyi chos nyid yin/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'phos nas yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa de'i tshe de'i 72—19

yum 'di lta ste/ skyes pa rnams la 'dod pa dang ldan pa'i yid gtod pa med do//nyon mongs rnams la chags par mi 'gyur zhing / /de ni 'dod rgyus sems gdungs mi 'gyur la/ /de yum 'dod pa'i yon tan ldan pa yil/ /skyes pa rnams la (5)sems ni gtod 'apa med/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo 'dod pa skyes pa kye ma bdag gis rgya mtsho chen po bzhi'i chu btung ngo snyam nas des rgyal po zas gtsang skyil smras pa dang / rgyal po zas gtsang gis mtshan mkhan rnams la smras pa/ ci'i phyir btsun mo 'di lta bu'i 'dod pa skyes/ mtshan mkhan rnams kyis lha btsun mo la sras skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis (5)sku brgyan pa zhig bltam par 'gyur te de rab tu byung nas shes bya'i rgya zhinamatsho mtha' dag 'thung bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ gal te 'di la mtsho chen po'i chu ma blud na cir 'gyur / de rnams kyis smras pa/ sras yan lag ma tshang ba zhig btsa' bar sti'agyur ro/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ nga'i ming zas gtsang zhes bya ba'i bu yan lag ma tshang bar bya'am/ de'i tshe grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi (kyen kun tu rgyu mig dmar zhes bya ba mig 6)'phrul la byang ba zhig 'dug pa de rgyal pos bkug nas rgya mtsho chen po las chu myur bar khug shig ces bsgo ba dang / des de 97nyid na 'dug bzhin du rgya mtsho chen po bzhi'i chu drangs te de rnams la btsun mo 'thung du bcug pa dang / de'i 'dod pa skyes pa gang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur to/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo tshul 'di lta bu'i 'dod pa skyes te / kye ma'o bdag lus lum bi nī'i phonyetshal du zhugs la shing gi rtsar yal ga'i ⑫mthar 'dug par bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas btsun mo sgyu 72—20

'phrul chen mo tshul de lta bu'i 'dod pa skyes par rig nas rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa'i khyogs bshams te glang po'i tshogs dang / rta'i tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs te dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa go bskon ①nas skye bo'i tshogs chen pos yongs su bskor te/ btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo dang lhan cig tu chas ②nas lum bi nī'i tshal (bdu phyin to/ /de nas btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mos lum bi nī'i ④tshal mthong ba na sems rtse gcig par gyur pa dang / de khyogs las babs te/ shing mya ngan 'tshang me tog yang dag par rgyas pa mthong bas dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes te de der song nas me tog dang / 'dab ma'i g.yur gyis dud pa'i yal ga 95)la 'jus te/ bud med rgan pas bskor yinas gnas so/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems te btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo sras bltam par nye bar gnas kyis ⑦ma la bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' de dang po bltam pa na blang bar bya'o/ /de nas yang bsams pa/ btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo ni ngo tsha shes pa dang ldan pa yin pas bdag gi mdun du bltam mi phod kyis (8)thabs shig bsham par bya'o snyam nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin bud med rgan mo zhig gi cha byad du sprul te/ des gang gis bud med rgan mo de rnams phyogs bcur 'bros ⑨par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i rlung dang char drag po zhig sprul nas de rnams bros pa dang / bdag nyid ma ma rgan mo'i cha byad du mngon par sprul nas btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i ⑩mdun du 'dug (7go/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' ni mkhyen bzhin du yum gyi lhums su 'jug pa dang / mkhyen bzhin du gnas pa dang / mkhyen bzhin du 'byung ba yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de 'di snyam du dgongs te 72—21

gang bdag skyes bu tha mal pa bzhin du mngal gyi sgo nas 'byung ba ni tshul dang 'thun ri(pa ma yin gyis (tsam la bdag gis yum gyi dku (5)g.yas pa brtol la 'byung bar bya'o zhes de nas byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi dku (4)g.yas pa brtol te byung ba dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis lag pa gnyis kyis blangs pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te brgya byin 'di bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' 'di blangs so zhes dregs pa skye bar 'gyur bar mkhyen nas ngo bo nyid kyi rdo rje'i snying po can gyi skur rin byin gyis brlabs te lhums su ni yum 'dzin pas nyon mongs par ma gyur cig snyam du dgongs nas yang bar mdzad de bzhugs pa yin no/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis 'dzin par ma nus pa dang 'dar bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpas bka' stsal pa/ kau (6)shi ka thong thong / de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' sa la bzhag go/ /bzhag pa tsam gyi mod la sus kyang ma bzung bar phyogs bzhir gzigs nas gom pa bdun bdun bor zhing tshig tu yang gsung ba/ kau shi ka phyogs 'di gang yin/ byang chub sems dpa' shar phyogs lags so/ /byang chub sems dpas ri3)bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka sems can thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ /phyogs 'di gang yin/ lho phyogs lags so / /'gro ba thams cad (8)kyi yon gnas su gyur par bya'o/ /phyogs 'di gang yin / byang phyogs lags so/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho las brgal (9)bar bya'o/ /phyogs 'di gang yin/ nub phyogs lags so/ /nga'i skye ba tha ma ni 'di yin par 'gyur ro/ /skye 'chi mthar byed de ni bltams pa na/ /sa la gom pa bdun ni bzhud nas su/ /'di nga'i skye ba tha mar gyur yin zhes/ /'jig rten gsum 72—22

gyi bla ma gcig pus gsungs/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa yum gyi lhums nas byung ba de'i 6)tshe sa chen po 'di shin tu g.yos par gyur/'jig rten 'di thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos gsal bar gyur cing 'jig rten na 'jig rten gyi bar gyi mun pa mun gnag smag tu gyur pa gang du nyi ma dang zla ba (mi'adi ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/ 'di ltar mthu che ba dag gis kyang 'od kyis (5)snang bar mi nus pa de dag kyang de'i tshe snang ba chen pos gsal bar gyur to/ /der sems can gang dag skyes pa de dag rang gi lag pa brkyang ba yang mi mthong ba las de rnams snang ba des sems can gcig gis gcig mthong nas/ shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so/ /shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so zhes bya bar shes so/ /gang tshe rnam 'dren bltam ④par gyur pa na/ /de tshe sa ni rir bcas shin tu g.yos/ /gang gis 'jig rten par yang skad cig gis/ /snang byed 'od gsal de yang byung bar gyur/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas sa g.yos pa chen po dang snang ba rgya chen po mthong ba dang —/ byang chub sems dpa' la bskor ba byas te zhabs gnyis la phyag byas nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul che ba 957dang mthu che ba'i bu skyes pa ni bdag gis rnyed 6)pa legs par rnyed do/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi (7)tshe byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa yum gyi lhums nas bltam (8)pa na ral gri shubs ponyenas phyung ba bzhin du mngal gyi dri ma dang / sha ma'i dri ma dang / khrag gi dri ma dang / mi gtsang ba gzhan dang gzhan sna tshogs kyis ma gos so/ /ji ltar 'od gsal tshon shel bzang po dang / /ka shi ras khugatsang phan tshun gos mi 'gyur / /de bzhin thub de lhums nas byung ba na/ /gser sbyangs me chen nang 72—23

nas bton pa 'dra/ /chos nyid kyis ①byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa yum gyi lhums nas bltam (gepa de'i tshe de'i yum mi 'dug mi nyal te 'greng bzhin du rgyal rigs ma des rgyal rigs bltam par byed do/ /de ni mi 'dug nyal ba'ang ma yin te/ /yan lag lnga ldan tshul khrims kyis brgyan pas/ /de ni 'greng bzhin shin tu dge ba yi/ /gzhon nu de 'dir brgya byin dag gis blangs/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa yum gyi lhums nas bltam pa de'i tshe de'i dbu'i steng nas lha rnams gdugs dkar po nor bu'i yu ba can dag 'dzin to/ /dri med zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'dra'i gdugs/ / lha yi 'dagatso bos pyidabu yi steng nas 'dzin/ / gdub 'khrol ⑤'od zer gyis 'bar ⑥lag pa dang / /rnga yab bzang gis 'di la g.yob par byed/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa bltam 9)pa'i mod (kyil bar snang las chu bsil ba gcig dang / chu dron mo gcig ste/ chu gnyis kyi rgyun spyi gtsug gi steng du 'bab cing des byang chub sems dpa' khrus mdzad do/ /dri med rab dag bsil dang de bzhin dro'i/ /chu yis rkang gnyis gtso bo khrus mdzad de/ /rigs rgyud gang du byang chub sems dpa' 'khrungs/ /klu rnams de la'ang mchod pa byed par gyur/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam 6)pa'i mod (1 )la skrun nyunyepa'i yum gyi mdun du chu mig chen po byung nas 'babs par gyur te de la de'i yum khrus chu'i bya ba byed do/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo gzhon nu bltam (shepa na/ /lha de rnams ni shin tu yid dga' bas/ /der ni chu bzang phyung bar gyur pa la/ /de yum der ni chu yis bya ba byed/ /lha yi rol mo shin tu sgra snyan rnams/ /shin tu dga' ba mchog tu rdung bar byed/ /de rnams gos 72—24

dang phreng ba 6)'thor byed cing (mi/ /gzhan dag rab tu 'dud cing de bzhin bstod / /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam (0pa'i mod rgyal lhas bar snang las lha'i ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dang / a ga ⑤ru'i phye ma dang / rgya spos kyi phye ma dang / tsan (6)dan gyi phye (7)ma dang / ta ma la'i 'dab ⑧mas 'thor ro/ /lha'i me tog man dā ra bas kyang 'thor ro/ /lha'i sil snyan rnams kyang sgra 'byin to/ /gos dag kyang 'thor bar byed do/ /mkhas pas btud pa'i sangs rgyas bltam 4)pa na/ /dri zhim dri mchog char ni phab 7pa dang / /de dang hunyedes na rang spobs tshul 'thun pa'i/ /rab dga'i sems kyis bstod pa rjod tunyepar byed/ /'dis ni byang chub mchog dag thob 'gyur zhing / /sdug bsngal zad pa'i 'gro phan mdzad (stegyur la/ /'gro ba mi shes rab rib 8mig sdongs 7la/ /sman pa mchog 'di mig ni rab stsol 'gyur/ /'di ni rmongs pas mig khebs long ba yiyi/ /'gro ba'i sgron ma chen po nyid du 'gyur/ /lta ngan gyis brlag tu log pa'i lam zhugs la/ /ma tso'atshol drang ba'i ⑩lam ni ston par 'gyur/ /ngan 'gro'i lam ni ma lus 'gog 'gyur zhing / /lha yi gnas kyi sa ni 'byed 'gyur zhes/ /'og min bar na gnas pa'i lha rnams ni/ / lha yi 6 )gnas su yang yang sgrogs ( nyepar byed/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa bltam 9 nyapa de nyid kyi tshe mnyan yod du rtsibs kyis 'phur tshangs byin bu btsas pa na tshangs byin 'di snyam du sems te/bdag gi bu btsas pa na yul gsal ba gsal ba bzhin du snang bas de bas na 'di'i ming gsal rgyal zhes bya bar gdags so zhes btags so/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer na rgyal po pad ma chen po bu btsas pa na pad ma chen po 'di snyam du 72—25

sems te/ bdag gi bu btsas pa na 'jig rten nyi ma'i gzugs shar ba ltar snang zhing gzugs can ma'i bu yin pas 'di'i ming gzugs can snying po zhes bya bar gdags so zhes btags 6)so/ / ko'u shām bī (snyen rgyal po dmag brgya pa bu btsas pa na dmag brgya pa 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi bu btsas pa na 'jig rten nyi ma shar ba ltar snang bar gyur pas 'di'i ming shar ba zhes bya bar gdags so zhes btags so/ /grong khyer 'phags rgyal du rgyal po mu khyud mtha' yas bu btsas (5)pa na de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi bu btsas pa na 'jig rten sgron mas (4༄snang ba lta bur gyur pas 'di'i ming rab snang zhes bya bar gdags so zhes btags te/ de ni de lta ma yin no/ /'on kyang de thams cad ni byang chub sems dpa'i mthu (geyin no/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa bltam (6)pa de nyid kyi tshe dga' bo la sogs pa shākya'i gzhon nu lnga brgya btsas pa dang / grags 'dzin ma la sogs pa shākya'i gzhon nu ma lnga brgya btsas pa dang / 'dun pa la sogs pa rim gro pa 9)lnga brgya btsas pa dang /bsngags ldan la sogs pa rta lnga brgya 'brangs so/ /lha rnams kyis gter lnga'i kha yang nye bar bstan to/ /khams kyi rgyal phran rnams dang / mkhar gyi rgyal po rnams kyis rab tu btud cing thams cad kyis kyang dpya phul lo/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi bu btsas pa na 'dod pa thams cad grub pas na 58)gzhon nu 'di'i ming don thams cad grub pa zhes bya'o zhes byang chub sems dpa' la thog mar mtshan btags so/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa bltam 9)pa'i mod tsol yab yum gyis mtshan mkhan dang / ltas mkhan gyi bram ze rnams la nye bar ston pa yin pas/ shes ldan 72—26

dag cig gzhon nu gang dag dang ldan na 'gro ba gnyis su 'gyur gyi gzhan du ni ma yin te gal te khyim pa (1)khyim na gnas par gyur na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhir rnam par rgyal ba/ chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de'i rin po che sna bdun ni 'di lta bu dag 'byung ste(snye/ 'di lta steg/ 'khor lo rin po che dang / glang po rin po che dang ske/ rta rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che (4)dang / bud med rin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / bdun pa ni blon po rin po che'o/ /bu dpa' ba/ rtul phod pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms pa stong 'byung ba (5)de rgya mtsho la thug pa'i sa chen po ma lus par gnod par sdo ⑥ba med cing 'tshe (7ba med pa 'di nyid chad pa med cing mtshon gyis 'debs pa med pa/ chos dang 'thun pas legs par phab ste gnas par 'gyur ro(8)/ /gal te skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos te / dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya bar 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ba skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu 6)rtsa gnyis dang ldan nas lha mad lags te/ gzhon nu skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa ni 'gro ba gnyis su 'gyur gyi gzhan du ni ma yin te zhes bya ba nas 7yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya bar 'jig rten du gdags par 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ snga ma bzhin du 'di ni 'dir nyunyachos nyid yin no/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ rgyal pos gzhon nu bltam yinas skyes bu yi/ /mtshan shes bram ze la dris de tshe smras/ /rgyal bu 3272—27

gal te khyim na gnas gyur na/ /nges par 'di ni mi dbang dag ①tu 'gyur/ /brtul bar ldan zhing rgyal po gzhan rnams kyi(mi/ /spyi la dbang ba'i ①'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur/ /'di ni gling rnams kun tu mngon rgyal ba'i/ /chos kyi rgyal srid dag ni byed par 'gyur/ /rin chen gyur pa 'di ni rin chen bdun/ /mi mchog bsod nams las kyis 'thob par 'gyur/ /gang gi mthu yis sa ni ma lus pa/ /'di ni lung mi gcog par spyod par 'gyur/ /gser las legs byas lte ba shin tu zlum/ /rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu byakhyud ma nyams bzang / /dang por sa la rnam par rgyal 'gyur gang / /'khor lo de 'dis dang por thob bupar 'gyur/ /yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ /rab gnas gangs can rtse 'dra'i glang po'i mchog /rgyal po la 'os mkha' la 'gro ba yi/ /rin chen mchog ni gnyis pa 'dis 'thob 'gyur/ /tho rangs dus su phyogs kun ma lus pa'i/ /sa rnams bskor nas slar ni ldog ④gyur gang / /rma bya'i mgrin 'dra spu ni yid 'ong ba'i/ /rin chen rta ni 'di yis 'thob ⑦par 'gyur/ /rin chen dri med bai drur+ya (8)rang bzhin/ /kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed pa//dri med mtshan mo ci 'dra nyin de bzhin/ /rin chen mchog ni bzhi pa 'thob par 'gyur / /gang zhig reg dri gzugs dang mdangs ldan pa'i/ /bud med dam pa dregs ldan rnams kyi mchog /lha mo bzhin du yon tan kun ldan pa/ /bud med rin chen (9)de 'dir tshu'athob par 'gyur/ /gang yang 'di na yirgyal la mu tig dang / /gser sogs shin tu mang po 'bul 8ba yi/ /nor ldan mtshungs par nor mang khyim bdag ni/ /rin chen thob nas rnam par spyod par 'gyur/ /'gro nyusnyedang kun tu gnas dang rnam ldog dang / /ma lus dpung la mkhas par 72—28

byed pa yi/ /dpa' 6)ldan bdun pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba ni(kye/ / mi yi (7rin chen blon po zhes bya yin/ / dpa' zhing rtul ri4)phod yan lag mchog gzugs ldan / /bu stong dag ni 'di la 'byung 'gyur zhing / /gang gi gzi brjid shin tu stobs che zhing / /sa bdag gzhan dag 'dud par byed pa 'byung / /gal te khyim ⑤ni nyes mang gis dkrugs pa/ /rab 'bar shing ni bya yis spong ba ltar/ /nye bar zhi phyir nags su nges song na/ /de 'dir ring por mi thogs sangs rgyas 'gyur / /khyod kyi sras 'di deng ni 'di 'dra ba/ /gzhon nu 'gro ba'i rin chen gcig bltam dupa/ /'gro ba gnyis las gzhan du mi 'gro ba/ /de ltar sngags kyi tshig las mthong ba lags/ /shes ldan dag gang dag dang ldan pa'i skyes bu chen po ⑦'gro ba gnyis su 'gyur gyi gzhan du ma yin zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du 'jig rten gyi sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar gyi skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis po ni ⑧gang dag yin/ lha gzhon nu'i zhabs shin tu gnas pa lags so/ /zhabs gnyis shin tu gnas pa nyid kyis sa la mnyam par 'bab ste/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /de'i zhabs kyi mthil gyi ngos gnyis la 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa lte ba dang mu yo)khyud du bcas pa rnam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa mchis te/ lha 'di ni ⑩gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu'i sor mo ring ba dang / zhabs kyi rting pa yangs pa dang / de'i phyag dang zhabs 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa lags te/ phyag dang zhabs 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa ni dper na/ shing bal gyi 'da' ba 'am/ ras bal gyi 'da' ba bzhin no/ /lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i 72—29

mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu'i phyag dang zhabs dra bar 'brel pa lags te / de'i phyag dang zhabs dra bar 'brel pa ni dper na ngang pa'i rgyal po gzhon nu bzhin no/ /lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu'i zhabs long mo'i tshigs mi mngon pa dang / byin pa ri dgas 0)e na (gyiya'i lta bu dang / sku mdud pa dang / sku bzhengs bzhin du ma btud par phyag pus mo'i lha nga gnyis slebs shing reg pa ste/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu ②ni mdoms (4)kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa lags te/ de'i mdoms (gekyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa ni dper na glang po che cang shes kyi'am/ rta cang shes byung ma thag gi bzhin no/ /lha 'di ni (6)gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu'i sku ci srid par 'dom yang de srid la/ 'dom ci srid par sku yang de srid pas shing n+ya gro dha (7)ltar chu zheng gab pa lags te/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu'i 98)ro stod kyi ri9༄spu re re nas skye 7zhing de'i sku la spu re re nas skye ba yang mthing ga /mel g.yas phyogs su 'khyil bar skye tsolags te/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu ni yogemadog gser 'dra ba dang / 'od 'dom gang ba dang / pags 8pa slab cing mdog gser gyi 'dra ba lags te/ pags 8pa srab pa nyid kyis rdul dang dri mas sku la mi mgos pa ste/rte/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu'i sku ni bdun tsomatho ba ste sku bdun 47mtho bar 'khrungs pa ni phyag gnyis dang / zhabs gnyis dang / dpung mgo gnyis dang 72—30

ltag pa lags te/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu ni thal gong rgyas pa dang / sku ro stod seng ge'i 'dra ba dang / sku drang zhing kho lag che ba dang / dpung mgo shin tu zlum pa dang / tshems bzhi bcu mnga' ba dang / tshems mnyam pa dang / tshems thags 6)bzang ba dang / mche (geb shin tu dkar ba dang / 'gram pa (guseng ge'i 'dra ba rgyadang / ro bro ba'i mchog dang ldan pa lags te(5)/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu ni ljags shin tu ring zhing srab pa lags te/ ljags shin tu ring ba nyid dang /srab pa nyid kyi phyir ljags zhal nas phyang (7bas skra mtshams nas bzung ste/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bar du yog par mdzad pa ste/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang / ka la ping ma'i skad ltar yid du 'ong ba dang / rnga'i dbyangs can lags te/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu'i spyan mthon mthing (pel ba'i rdzi ma lta bu dang ske/ gtsug tor dang ldan pa dang / smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu dung ltar dkar zhing g.yas su 'khyil ba lags te/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /lha 'di dag ni gang dang ldan pa'i 'gro ba gnyis su 'gyur gyi gzhan du ni ma lags pa zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gyi skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis lags so/ /bdag nyid legs bsgoms sku la ni/ /sku yi tha ma 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /thub pa chen po'i mtshan rnams ni/ /de ni 72—31

bdag gis brjod par bgyi/ /'di zhabs shin tu gnas pa ste/ /sa la mnyam par 'bab pa yin/ /'di zhabs phyag gi mthil la ni/ /'khor lo shin tu dbyibs legs skyes/ /'di zhabs rting ①pa yangs pa dang / /de ni sor mo ring zhing mdzes/ /phyag zhabs dra bar 'brel pa dang / /shing bal lta bur 'jam pa dang / /'di'i zhabs long bu'i tshigs mi mngon/ /byin pa e ne ya dang mtshungs/ /mi mchog sku yang ma btud par/ /phyag gis pus mo'i lha nga slobasal/ /mdoms ②kyi sba ba sbubs su nub/ /n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab/ /ro stod spu ni re re nas/ /skye zhing de spu g.yas su 'khyil/ /mdog ni gser sbyangs 'dra ba dang / /kun nas 'dom gang 'od dang ldan/ /bcom ldan de ni pags ①srab cing / /'di sku bdun ④ni mtho ba ste/ /bcom ldan thal gong rgyas pa dang —/ /sku stod seng ge 'dra ba dang / /sku drang kho lag che ba dang / /dpung mgo shin tu zlum pa dang / /bcu phrag bzhi yi tshems durnams ni/ /yongs su rdzogs shing ma tshang med/ /mnyam dang thags bzang nyid du ni/ /de yi tshems ni legs par gnas/ /rab dkar 'gram pa seng ge 'dra/ /ro bro mchog dang ldan pa dang / /ljags ni shin tu srab pa dang / /bcom ldan tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan/ /rdzi ma ba 'dra spyan mthon mthing ⑥/ / smin ma'i ⑦mtshams kyi mdzod spu ni/ /dung ltar dkar zhing g.yas su 'khyil/ /mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis 'di/ /gang zhig la ni 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de ni 'gro ba gnyis 'gyur gyi/ /gsum par 'gyur ba ma lags so/ /'di ni dugal te khyim gnas na / /'khor los sgyur rgyal nyid 'gyur te/ /dran ldan bu ni mang ba ⑨dang /gnod pa chung zhing mkhas par 'gyur/ /gal te rab byung rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /72—32

gang zag mnyam pa med par 'gyur/ /bshos dang btung dang na bza' 0)dang / /gzims cha rnams kyang rnyed ②'gyur la/ /'di yi 'khor ni mi phyed cing / /lus can kun gyi yid du 'ong / /lha rnams rjes su 'brang ba skyodang / /mi rnams kyang ni de bzhin te/ /chos kyi bdag po mchog 'gyur zhing / /mi yul dag tu'ang de bzhin 'gyur/ /mnyam pa med cing 'dra ba med/ /rnam 'dren mtshungs pa med par 'gyur/ /lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags te/ gang dang ldan na 'gro ba gnyis su 'gyur gyi gzhan ni ma lags zhes bya ba ni snga ma bzhin no/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa bltam dunas zhag bdun lon pa dang / de skrun ⑤pa'i yum nongs par gyur te/nongs ma thag tu sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i ris gya yinom par skyes so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas byang chub sems dpa' ma ma rnams la gtad nas ma ma khyed kyis gzhin nu 'di dus dus su sku mnye byos shig /dus dus su khrus byos shig /dus dus su zas byin cig /dus dus su yang dag pa'i bde bas bsnyen bkur byos shig /ma ma dga' ba'i lag pa gnyis kyis de blangs nas ⑦dus dus su sku mnye byed/ dus dus su khrus byed/ dus dus su zas byin/ dus dus su yang dag pa'i bde bas bsnyen bkur byed do/ /yang de'i tshe dri shin tu yid du ⑧'ong ba'i ngo bo gang yin pa de rnams byugs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan ⑨nas yab zas gtsang la phul ba dang / rgyal po zas gtsang gis de blangs te dga' bas pang du bzhag ⑩nas yang dang yang du rtog cing dga' ba skyed do/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa ni gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa / blta yin sdug ⑩pa/ mi'i kha dog las yang dag par 'das la lha'i kha dog 72—33

ma thob pa/ skyes pa dang / bud med rnams kyis bltas pa na ngoms mi shes shing dga' ba 'thob ste/ dper na 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser la mgar ba mkhas pas/ rgyan brdungs pa/ la ba dkar po sar pa'i steng du bzhag na shin tu gsal zhing 'bar la rnam par 'tsher ba de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa blta ①na sdug pa/ mi'i ②kha dog las 'das shing lha'i kha dog ni ma thob pa yin no/ /chos nyid kyis ③byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i ④snying du sdug pa dang yid du 'ong bar 'gyur te⑤/ yang 'di skye bo'i tshogs chen pos de phrag pa nas phrag par spo bar yibyed pa ni dper na ston ma'i pad ma skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i snying du sdug cing yid du 'ong bas skye bo'i tshogs chen pos de lag ⑦pa nas lag par brgyud (nyapar byed pa bzhin te snga ma bzhin no/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam ⑨pa'i mod tho )nas spyan mi 'dzums (7par gzugs rnams la lta ste/de spyan mi 'dzums ⑩pa ni dper na sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha —rnams bzhin no/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam 0pa'i mod tsonas sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin 8pa las skyes pa'i lha'i spyan des de nyin dang mtshan du dpag tshad gcig kho ra khor yug tu gzigs so/ /las bcas las byung 'dri med spyan gyis ni / /gzugs chen po dang de bzhin phra rab rnams/ /nyin dang mtshan du khor ⑩yug dpag tshad gcig /mdun na gnas pa bzhin du'ang gzigs par 'gyur/ /chos nyid kyis 4)byang chub sems dpa' bltam yipa'i med ( 3 nas gsung snyan cing 'jibs pa dang / gsung snyan pa dang / gsung yid du 'ong ba yin te/dper na gangs can gyi bya skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / skad snyan pa dang /72—34

yid du 'ong ba de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' bltam ①pa'i mod ②nas gsung snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / gsung snyan pa dang / gsung yid du 'ong ba yin no / /ri bo kun 'dzin la drang srong nyon mongs med ces bya ba ①mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/ byams pa'i bdag nyid can snying rje dang ldan pa/ skye dgu la mnyes gshin pa zhig gnas te de la tsha bo mis byin zhes bya ba yod pa dang /de de'i tshe phug tu zhugs ④te bsam gtan byed pa na byang chub sems dpa' bltam stedu/ 'jig rten thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos dugasal bar gyur pa'i snang ba de mthong ba dang nyon mongs med la smras pa/ mkhan po 'dir ni nyi ma thams cad dag /cig lacar byung bar gyur tam ci/ /'di ltar ri ni phug bcas pa/ /'di ni 'od kyis gsal bar gyur/ /nyon mongs med kyis de la smras pa/ nyi ma'i 'od ni rgyun du rnoX/ /bu gcig snang ba 'di dag ni/ /yan lag reg na 'od bsil bas0/ /nges par thub pa de yi 'od/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od can ⑩ni/ /nges par lhums nas bltam ⑩gyur la/ /bltams ⑫nas sems dpa' chen po de'i/ /'od zer gser dang 'dra ba ni/ /dri ma med pa 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten gsum ni snang byas yin/ /mis byin gyis smras pa / mkhan po bzhud/ ci re zhig 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ram/'on te bla na med pa'i ye shes rtogs par 'gyur ba rang nyid kyis blta bar mdzod cig /drang srong nyon mongs med kyis smras pa/ da ltar na ⑩ni rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i khyim nyi 'og gi rgyal po dang / mkhar ④gyi rgyal po dang / tshong pa dang ske/ tshong dpon dang / ded dpon rnams dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag brgya stong dpag tu med pas kun tu khyab nas 'dug gis chagang gi tshe de 72—35

dben par gyur pa de'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i gan du 'gro bar bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma 'di snyam ①du kye mtho drang srong nyon mongs med rkang gis ser skya'i gzhir 'ongs na ci ma rung snyam du sems so/ /de nas drang srong nyon mongs med steng gi nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i pho brang sgor phyin pa dang / ji tsam na sgo srungs kyis ②rgyal po zas gtsang ma la lha dgyes pa bskyed du gsol/ drang srong nyon mongs med 'dir ②mchis so zhes rig par byas pa dang / rgyal po zas gtsang mas thos te dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / mchog tu rangs pa byung nas mchog tu gus pas mchod de 'di skad ces smras so/ /drang srong chen po legs par 'ongs so/ /dgos pa ci zhig la 'ongs/ nyon mongs med kyis stims pa/rgyal po chen po bdag ni 'dir/ /khyed sras blta ba'i phyir mchis te/ /'jig rten gtso bo rnam 'dren pa/ /thub pa de ni mthong bar 'tshal/ /rgyal pos smras pa / gal te de lta na ni gzhon nu gnyid log gis phyisad kyi bar du re zhig sdod cig /nyon mongs med kyis smras pa/ rigs dang ldan pa'i rta rnams ni/ /mtshan mo'i bzhi cha nyal ba ltar/ /dgos pa don gnyer rnams kyi gnyid/ /mig la yun ring mi gnas so/ /de nas gzhon nu shākya thub pa ma ma'i pang na 'dug pa drang srong nyon mongs med la byin pa dang / drang srong nyon mongs med kyis lag pa duganyis kyis blangs nas yud tsam brtags te smras pa/ lha gzhon nu 'di mtshan mkhan rnams kyis ji skad lung bstan/ rgyal po zas gtsang mas smras pa/ rin po che sna bdun dang ldan pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes zer ro/ /de nas drang srong nyon mongs med kyis byang chub 72—36

sems dpa' mthong nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ sa bdag rtog pa po rnams blo 'khrul te/ /rtsod pa'i dus na 'khor los sgyur mi 'byung / /bsod nams mchog gis chos kyi mdzod 'di ni/ /nyes las rnam par rgyal nas sangs rgyas 'gyur / /mtshan mi gsal dang ldan na mi dbang po/ /gling bzhi rnams kyi ①bdag po dbang phyug 'gyur/ /thub dbang mtshan ni shin tu gsal bas na/ /mi mchog sangs rgyas chos kyi 'khor los ④sgyur/ /de nas drang srong nyon mongs med kyis bdag nyid kyi che'i mtha'i nges pa dang ③/ byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par byang chub pa brtag pa la zhugs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' lo nyi shu rtsa dgu bzhes nas/ khab nas byung nas lo drug tu dka' ba spyod par 'gyur te de nas bdud rtsi rtogs par 'gyur bar mthong ngo / /bdag ni bar skabs der 'chi ba'i dus byed par mthong nas de mig mchi ④mas gang ste 'dug pa rgyal po zas gtsang gis mthong nas dngangs phyinas tshigs su bcad de smras pa⑥/skyes pa ⑦bud med rnams kyis mthong ba na/ /ngoms par mi 'gyur dga' ba thob ⑧'gyur ba/ /lus bzang dge byed de ni 'dir mthong nas/ /drang srong chen po ci slad ngu 6)bzhin gyur/ /gang las bdag gi gzhon nu 'jigs pa 'am//tshe zad 'gyur ba nye bar mi gnas grang / /de ni myur du legs par bdag la smrosatshul/ /khyod kyi mchi mas bdag ni 'dar bar gyur/ /drang srong nyon mongs med kyis kyang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gal te 'di yi steng du nam mkha' las / /rdo rje ser drag 'phangs pa bab gyur kyang / /thub pa chen po'i sku la ba spu ni/ /nyag ma gcig kyang g.yos par mi nus so/ /me 0chen rlung gi shugs kyis bdas pa dang / /mtshon cha rnon po shin tu mi bzad 'dang / /drag po'i 72—37

dug dang sbrul gyi ①dug rnon (0yang / /gzhon nu la bab skad cig 'jigs mi 'gyur / /thugs rje nyid la gnas gyur gang lags pa/ /'jigs pas nyen pa rnams la mi 'jigs stsol/ /de ni 'jig rten kun gyi 'jigs 'joms na/ /mi dbang 'di la 'jigs pa ga la 'byung / /'jig rten na ni bdag nyid che rnams kyi/ /gtsor gyur bdag nyid chen po gang zhig la/ /tshangs bcas lha yang rtag tu srung byed pa/ /mi dbang de la 'jigs pa ga la 'byung / /mi dbang bdag gi rgud pa mthong nas ni/ /gang phyir zhi ba mi 'thob bdag tu ②mod / /chos kyi mchog mdzod 'di dang phrad nas ni/ /don ma thob par bdag ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang dag smra ba dam pa mtshungs med pa/ /'di yi chos thos 'gyur zhing thos nas kyang / /rab tu zhi ba'i pha rol 'gro de dag /skyid ④cing bsod nams ldan la rims nad bral/ /de nas drang srong nyon mongs med byang chub sems dpa' la reg pa'i mthus de'i rdzu 'phrul nyams so/ /nyams pa dang nyon mongs med kyis smras pa/ rkang kho nas grong khyer nas phyir 'byung sgibar bya'o / /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ⑥mas thos pa dang grong khyer thams cad rdo ba dang —/ gseg ma dang / gyo mo rnams bsal nas spos (7dang / phye mas khyab par byed du bcug go/ /de nas drang srong nyon mongs med 'byor pa chen pos grong khyer nas byung ste/ rim gyis niri bo kun 'dzin du phyin pa dang mis byin 6stel smras pa/ ngas gzhon nu mthong ste/ bla na med pa'i ye shes rtogs par 'gyur na ngas ni de sleb tshupar mi 'gyur te nga ni bar skabs su dus byed par 'gyur gyis (sprekhyod ni de'i thad du rab tu byung la/ nga rgyal dang dregs pa nges par bcom par gyur pa dang / tshangs par spyod pa la spyad par bya ste/ rigs 72—38

kyis dregs par mi bya/ rus kyis dregs par mi bya/ rigs rgyud kyis dregs par mi bya ste/ khyod kyis kyang yun ring po mi thogs par bdud rtsi 'thob par 'gyur gyis ①zhes smras nas yang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshol 'dod na/ /shar phyogs su ni khyod 'dug dang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa/ /rnyed par dka' ba mthong bar 'gyur/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po zas gtsang mas gzhon nu ma chama'i pang gan 'dug pa la yang dang yang du lta zhing nga'i bu ci 'dra ba de lta bu ni sa'i steng na su la yang med do snyam du sems shing shin tu dga' bar gyur stito/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'khrungs nas ring por ma lon par ma ma'i pang du bzhugs nas/ gser gyi gzhong par 'bras dang shar bsres pa'i chan gsol ba na de ma mas bkag kyang ma thub par mang por gsol nas dbrog ⑤par brtsams (6)pa dang / dbrog ma nus nas des rgyal po zas gtsang la sbran pa dang / rgyal po btsun mo dang lhan cig ⑦gis dbrog par brtsams pa dang des kyang ma nus so/ /de nas rgyal pos 'a)blon po rnams dang ser skya na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams la bsgo 6)na de rnams kyis kyang tshudabrog par ma nus so/ /de nas glang po che lnga brgya la btags pa dang / byang chub sems dpas bsams pa/ 'di rnams kyis bdag gi stobs nyams na mi rung gis (1ma la bdag gis mdzub 8mo bkug pas gser gyi gzhong 8pa nas gzung ④ngo snyam nas des mdzub 8mo bkug pas gser gyi gzhong pa bzung nas drangs pa dang tso/ glang po che lnga brgya po de dag kha phyir bsgyur te drangs nas de dag gis kyang gser gyi gzhong pa dbrog par ma nus so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis bsams pa/ ji ltar byang chub semās dpa'i lag pa 72—39

g.yon pas glang po che lnga brgya drangs pa dang sbyar na gdon mi za bar lag pa gnyis kyis ni glang po che stong thub kyis ①de bas na ②gzhon nu'i ming glang po che stong gi stobs can zhes gdags so zhes btags so/ /grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi na gnod sbyin shākya 'phel zhes bya ba zhig gnyug mar gnas so/ /shākya rnams kyis kun tu spyod pa ni shākya su yang rung ba la khye'u'am/ bu mo btsas ②pa gang yin pa de gnod sbyin shākya 'phel gyi rkang pa la phyag 'tshal du gzhug pa'i phyir 'khrid ④pa yin pas rgyal pos blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag deng ⑤la gzhon nu gnod sbyin shākya 'phel gyi rkang pa la phyag 'tshal du chug shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' glang po che la bskyon ༅te dpung gi tshogs dpag tu med pas yongs su bskor te grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir 'jug par brtsams pa dang /grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi sgra bcu gnyis dang bral bar gyur cing byang chub sems dpa' de nang du zhugs pa na thub pa bzhin du gnas par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas bsams pa/ grong khyer 'di 'di ⑦lta ste/ glang po che'i sgra dang / rta'i sgra dang / shing rta'i sgra dang / dpung bu chung gi sgra dang / dung gi sgra dang / rnga bo che'i sgra dang / be de'i ④sgra dang / rwa dung gi sgra dang ske/ gar gyi sgra dang / glu'i sgra dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / sbyin pa ni ⑨byin / bsod nams ni gyis/ bsnyen gnas la ni nye bar gnas/ /tshul khrims yang dag par blangs te mnos ⑩shig ces bya ba'i sgra ste sgra yibacu gnyis dang bral zhing gzhon nu de nang du zhugs pa na 8thub pa bzhin du zhi bar gnas pas gzhon nu'i ming shākya thub pa zhes gdags so zhes tsobyang chub sems dpa'i ming shākya thub pa zhes bya bar btags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 72—40

gnod sbyin shākya 'phel gyi gan du khyer ba dang / gnod sbyin shākya 'phel gyis byang chub sems dpa' gnas dang nye bar phyin pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang phyir byung nas lus thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te phyag byas so/ /de mthong ba dang / rgyal po zas gtsang mas smras pa/lhas kyang rkang pa gnyis la gtugs pas 'di ni lha'i yang lha yin pas gzhon nu'i ming lha'i yang lha zhes bya'o zhes byang chub sems dpa'i ming lha'i yang lha zhes bya bar btags so/ /de nas de'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang gis dgos ①pa'i ched la 'dug nas don zab mo'i tshig dang yi ge dag shes rab kyis so sor 'byed par byed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa 'khor lnga brgya dang yi ge'i slob dpon srin bu go cha la yi ge slob par btang phyinas yi ge'i slob dpon srin bu go chas byang chub sems dpa' la yi ger bris nas phog pa dang / byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ 'di ni ngas shes so/ /de nas des yi ge gnyis dang gsum nas de bzhin du lnga brgya'i bar bris nas phog pa dang / byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ 'di dag thams cad kyang ngas shes kyis chagazhan dag sgros shig /rtsisrin bu go chas smras pa/ 'jig rten na ni yi ge 'di tsam spyod kyi gzhan ni bdag gis ma 'tshal to/ /de nas byang chub rgyasems dpa' nyid kyis yi ge bris te srin bu go cha la byin nas gsungs pa/ yi ge 'di ming ci yin smros shig /des smras pa ma 'tshal to/ /byang chub sems dpas skyogasungs pa/'jig rten du gnyis shig byung nas ⑦mngon par 'gyur te byang chub sems dpa' dang 'khor los sgyur ba'o/ /nam mkha'i ngos la gnas pa'i tshangs pas smras pa/srin bu go cha byang chub sems dpas laji skad gsungs pa de de bzhin te/ yi ge 72—41

'di ni 'jig rten du gnyis shig byung na mngon par 'gyur te byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'o/ /byang chub sems dpas ①yi ge de tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis bklags la ②nam mkha'i ngos la gnas pa'i tshangs pas dbang byas pas tshangs pa'i yi ge zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yi ge'i mthar phyin pa dang 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas par bzang ②len dang / lhar bcas zhes bya ba 'phong gi slob dpon gyi gan ④du 'phong gi gnas su gtad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' gnas lnga po rgyang nas phog pa dang / sgra grag par (nyaphog pa dang / gnad du phog pa dang / mi 'chor bar phog pa dang / tshabs che ba la byang bar gyur to/ /de nas bzang len dang / lhar bcas 'di snyam du sems te byang chub sems dpa' 'di ni snying rje can yin pas bslab par bya ba thams cad bslab kyi lha sbyin 'di ni gdug pa yin pas 'jig rten thams cad du gnod par 'gyur na mi rung gis yi'adi la gnad du bsnun par bslab par mi bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na lha sbyin gyis ngang pa lcags mdas bsnun pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' steng gi khang bzangs kyi (gegazhi la bzhugs pa de'i pang par de lhung ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpas bzung (8)nas mda' phyung ste sman gyis byugs pas sos so0 lha sbyin gyis smras pa/ byang chub sems dpa' ngang pa 'di ni ngas yongs su bzung ba yin gyis bskur 7cig /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ ngas ches sngar ⑩yongs su bzung ste gang gi tshe bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de kho na'i tshe yongs su bzung ngo / /der byang chub sems dpa' la yi lha sbyin gnod sems dang / bzod pa ma yin pa dang / phebs pa ma yin 72—42

pa byung bar gyur to/ /de nas lha sbyin la sogs pa shākya'i gzhon nu lnga brgya byung ba dang / lha sbyin gyis ras kyis bcings nas shākya'i gzhon nu lnga brgya bskyel ①tol/ /ci tsam na byang chub sems dpa' phyogs der bzhud pa dang / lha sbyin gyis smras pa/ byang chub sems dpa' ci la sdod/ byang chub sems dpas kyang ras bcings te shākya'i gzhon nu lnga brgya bsgyel duto/ /de nas lha sbyin ras kyis bcings pa dang ②/ byang chub sems dpas kyang bzung ste rkang ④pa gyen du bstan nas gan rgyal du bsgyel ⑤pa dang / der yang byang chub sems dpa' la lha sbyin gnod sems dang / mi bzod pa dang / bag mi phebs pa'i sems gnyis pa bskyed par gyur to/ /de nas shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya mda' gzhu thogs te phyi rol du byung nas ta la la tshabs byed pa la zhugs pa dang / la las ni ta la gcig phigs so/ /la las ni gnyis so/ /lha sbyin gyis ni gsum mo/ /byang chub sems dpas ༷lcags mda' 'phangs pa dang shing ta la bdun phigs pa las ji srid rlung gis bskyod de thams cad 'gyel ⑦ba'i bar du rgya cher sbyar (nyaro/ /de nas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis 'bab chu ro hi ta ma'i 'gram na shing dge ba'i snying po zhes bya ba nyi ma gcig cing khru yi)brgyar skye ba mtshan mo ni sen mos kyang gcad du rung la nyin par ni mtshon gyis kyang gcad par mi nus pa zhig yod pa dang ske/ gnas gtsang ma pa'i ⑩lha rnams kyis gang gis shing dge ba'i snying po rtsa ba steng du ⑩bton nas ro hi ta ku'i nang du bcug pa de lta bu'i rlung dang char drag cig sprul to/ /de rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang / legs par rab sad kyis thos nas shing 'dis 'grong khyer brlag par ma gyur tam snyam nas srog chags brgya stong dpag tu med pa dang / shing dge ba'i snying po gang na ba der song ste phyin 72—43

pa dang / 'khor brgya stong dpag tu med pas drangs su zin kyang ci tsam du bskyod par yang ma nus so/ /'char gas smras pa/ lha byang chub sems dpa' sgron cig /rgyal pos smras pa/ kho bos gzhon nu la bka' stsol bar mi nus so/ /'char gas smras pa/ khyed rnams kyis ca co'i sgra gsang mthon po sgrogs shig /ci nas kyang ngas byang chub sems dpa' gshegs par bya'o/ /de nas skye bo'i tshogs de rnams kyis sgra gsang mthon po dang chen pos ca co'i sgra bsgrags so/ /'char ka byang chub sems dpa'i thad du song ba dang / byang chub sems dpas 0)smras pa/ 'char ka ca co'i sgra 'di ci zhig yin/ 'char gas ⑧rnam pa de dag rgya cher gsol to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ gal te de lta tshun 'byin du 'deng ④/ de nas 'char ka dang /byang chub sems dpa' chas pa dang / ci tsam na khung nas sbrul gdug pa zhig byung ngo / /'char gas byang chub sems dpa' zin par gyur du 'ong ngo zhes ral gri rnon pos rked pa bcad pa dang / sbrul gyi dug gi dbugs kyis 'char ka la phog ste de nag por gyur nas de'i ming yang 'char ka phyinag po zhes bya bar gyur to / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' shing dge ba'i snying po gang na ba der bzhud de phyin pa dang / lha sbyin la gsungs pa/ khyod kyi stobs ci tsam pa blta yis bskyod yicig /lha sbyin gyis 'bad de cung zad cig bsgul to④/ /dga' bos ni cung zad drangs so/ /ji tsam na byang chub sems dpa' stobs kyi nyams sad par mdzad cing shing dge ba'i snying po phyag gis blangs te 'bab chu ro hi ta ma'i 'gram nas 'phangs te byang chub sems dpas dugasungs pa/ shes ldan dag shing dge ba'i snying po 'di ni bsil ba'i rang bzhin yin pas mkhris pa'i nad 72—44

dang —/ shu ba dang / phol mig byung ba la byugs na zhi bar 'gyur gyis 6)dum bur byos rgyal khyer te rang rang gi khyim du zhog shig /yang yangs pa can du glang po che rin po che zhig skyes pa dang / de nas yangs pa can gyi lid ①tsa bī ④rnams kyis 0glang po che mtshan dang ldan pa zhig 0rnyed nas de rnams kyis bsams pa/rgyal po zas gtsang gi sras mtshan mkhan rnams kyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa de'i mthus glang po che rin po che 'di byung gis ⑦dong la de kho na la dbul lo snyam mo/ /de rnams kyis glang po che de rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas khrid de dong ba las rim gyis ser skya'i gzhir phyin nas (nyargyal po'i pho brang gi sgor glang po che'i dam pa bzhag nas sdod pa dang / ma stes te gdug pa'i las can lha sbyin phyir byung ba des glang po che'i dam 6)pa de de ltar rgyan gyis brgyan par mthong nas de des phrag dog chen po skyes te de phrag dog dang mi bzod pa skyes pas dris pa/ glang po che'i dam pa 'di su'i yin/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ gzhon nu shākya thub pa mtshan mkhan rnams kyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung bstan pa de la yangs pa can gyi tshogs rnams kyis glang po rin po che 'di skyes su phul lo/ /lha sbyin lhag par mi bzod pa skyes nas smras pa/re zhig de 'khor los sgyur bar ma gyur par je khyed cag glang po rin 0po che 'bul lam zhes smras nas thal lcag gis glang po che bsad do/ /ji tsam na phyogs der dga' bo 'ongs pa des de mthong nas dris pa/ shes ldan dag glang po che bzang po 'di sus bsad/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha sbyin gyis so/ des bsams ⑪pa gdon mi za bar 'di la lha sbyin gyi tsomathu sad kyis tsom la bdag gis kyang 'di la mthu sad par bya'o snyam nas mjug 8ma nas bzung ste gom 8pa bdun du bor 72—45

ro / /ji tsam na byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa 0)phyir byung ba des de gzigs nas dris pa/ glang po che 'di gang nas 'ongs/ de rnams kyis ji ltar gyur pa smras so/ /sus bsad/ lha sbyin gyis so/ /mgon rnams la mgron gyi mchod pa bya ba yin nam legs pa zhig byas so/ /phyogs gang du bsad/ pha bir (gyiro/ /'dir sus drud/ dga' bos so/ /des dgongs pa 'dir ①gdon mi za bar de gnyis kyis ④'di la mthu sad kyis ⑤ma la ngas kyang 'di la mthu sad par bya'o snyam du dgongs nas mjug ⑥ma nas bzung ste ra ba'i khar 'phangs pa las ra ba rim pa bdun dang / 'obs rim pa bdun las 'das te bor ro/ /de lhung bas gshong btod pa glang po che'i gshong gaglang po che'i gshong zhes bya bar gyur to/ /'dir smras pal/ lha sbyin gyis ni glang chen dbang po bsad / /dga' bos de kyi)ni gom pa bdun du drud/ /byang chub sems dpas ⑩phyag gis bar snang la/ /rdo ba bzhin du phyi rol rgyang ring 'phangs mtshan mkhan rnams kyis lung bstan pa/ gal te gzhon nu lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du rab tu ma byung na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma 'di snyam du sems te/ ma la bdag gis 'di la 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga phal po che byin na de lta (han ni de rnams la dga' bas rab tu 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro snyam nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du gos dang / rgyan gyi phung po tibazhag tsonas smras pa/ deng khyed kyis shākya'i bu mo rnams la rgyan dang gos rnams byin cig /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis ser skya'i grong khyer du deng gzhon nu gos dang rgyan rnams ster bar 'gyur gyis ④shākya'i bu mo thams cad shog shig ces dril sgrog tu bcug go/ /de nas shākya'i gzhon nu 72—46
