ma lnga brgya 'ongs pa dang / thams cad la byang chub sems dpas 6)gos dang rgyan rnams byin no/ /de nas shākya dbyig pa can la grags 'dzin ma zhes bya ba'i bu mo yod pa dang ②/ des de la smras pa/ khyed la yang gzhon nu gos dang rgyan rnams ster bar 'gyur gyis ①song / de nas grags 'dzin ma ci bdag la byang chub sems dpa' las gzhan su zhig khyor 'gyur snyam du bsams nas byang chub sems dpa'i thad du song ba dang / ci tsam na gos dang rgyan thams cad byin zin nas ci yang ma lus pa dang / des byang chub sems dpa'i mgul na shin tu mdzes shing rin che ba'i ༷mu tig phreng gcig lus pa mthong nas de de la dga' bas bag 'khums dupa med par rang nyid kyis bkrol te rang gi mgul du btags nas byang chub sems dpa'i thad nas song ngo / /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 'di snyam du sems te bu mo 'di phebs shing brtan pa las na 'dis gzhon nu'i thugs dang bstun par nus kyis ⑥'di blang bar bya'o snyam du bsams nas grags 'dzin ma bud med kyi 'khor nyi khri ⑦dang byang chub sems dpa'i btsun mor blangs so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang mas byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ song las kyi mtha' ci tsam pa la ltos shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po zas gtsang mas bsgo ba gsan te shing rta bzang po la zhugs nas phyi rol du gshegs te yab rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i las kyi mtha' gzigs shing byang chub sems dpa' las kyi mtha' la zhugs pa rnams kyi gan du byon pa dang / gshol ⑧lnga brgya dang zhing med cing zhing ⑨pa'i mi de rnams kyis 0kyang gshol gnon cing 'dren pas stobs nye bar nyams pa mgo lus rdul gyis yog pa dang / rlung dang ⑪than pas lus la gdungs pas lus rtsub cing mdog ngan pa/ rkang pa dang /72—47

lag pa gas pa dang ①/ dengs shing dri ma can gyi gos gyon pa/ rkang pa dri ma can / ltogs pa dang skom pas mdog ngan zhing / lkog ma dang / mkhur ba dang ske/ mig gi logs skams pa dang / glang de rnams kyang rmon pa lcags gzer rnon po can gyis lus dral ②bas rgyab dang / mjug ③do'i phyogs khrag gis g.yogs ①pa/ ltogs pa dang skom pas dbugs brtsegs shing snying ga'i duphyogs nas yidabugs brtsegs pa ring du 'dren la gnya' ④shing gis mnan pa'i rma las rnag khrag 'dzag pa la sbrang bu dang / 'bu'i tshogs kyis ⑧za ba thong lcags kyis rkang pa la rma byung zhing kha dang sna nas kha chu dang sna chu 'dzag ⑨pa la sbrang ma dang / sha sbrang dang / sbrang bu mchu rings kyis ⑩yog pa rnams gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsod nams bskyed cing bsags pa'i thugs rjes tsokun nas bskyod pa'i thugs kyis zhing pa rnams la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /shes ldan dag khyed 8su'i yin/ de rnams kyis gsol pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i lags so/ /des gsungs pa/ shes ldan dag khyed deng phan cad 'bran du mi bya/ mngag gzhug par mi bya/ rang dbang can gar dga' bar 'gro bar byas/ bde ba la reg par gnas shigatso /rmon pa rnams kyang bkrol nas gsungs pa/ khyed cag kyang deng phan cad tsor+sā mchog ma nyams pa za zhing chu ma rdul ma brnyogs shing dang ba dag la 'thung ⑩shig /khyed la phyogs bzhi nas kyang rlung bsil ba ldang bar gyur cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yid byung ba de nyid kyis yab shākya zas gtsang gi zhing blas ⑩kyi mtha' la gzigs nas snum zhing sngo la 'dab ma mthug cing grib ma bzang po dang ldan pa'i 'dzam bu'i shing gi grib ma gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas shing 72—48

'dzam bu'i grib ma la bzhugs te/ 'dod pa las dben pa sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams las dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas dpyod pa dang bcas shing dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba zag pa med pa dang 'dra ba'i bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par zhugs so/ /skye bo'i ①tshogs chen po yang byang chub sems dpa' spangs te mi 'gro bar shing gzhan rnams kyi drung na sdod do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis bsams pa/ byang chub sems dpa' ring zhig thogs te 'di ltar dro'i dus las yol gyis bltar ②'gro'o zhes de shing rtar zhugs nas zhing pa'i grong du song ste phan tshun du byang chub sems dpa' tshol zhing shing ⑧'dzam bu'i drung du phyin to/ /de'i tshe nyi ma'i gung yol nas shing gzhan rnams kyi grib ma shar phyogs su gzhol/ shar phyogs su 'bab/ shar phyogs su bab par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mthus shing 'dzam bu'i grib ma ni byang chub sems dpa'i sku mi gtong ngo / /rgyal po zas gtsang gis nyi ma'i gung yol nas shing gzhan rnams kyi grib ma ni shar phyogs su gzhol/ shar phyogs su 'bab/shar phyogs su bab par gyur na/ shing 'dzam bu'i grib ma ni byang chub sems dpa'i sku mi gtong ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de 'di snyam du sems te/gzhon nu ni rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ 'di ltar da nyi ma'i gung yol nas shing gzhan rnams kyi grib ma ni shar phyogs su gzhol/ shar phyogs su 'bab/shar phyogs su bab par gyur na④/ shing 'dzam bu'i grib ma ni byang chub sems dpa'i sku mi gtong ba ngo mtshar che'o snyam mo/ /de nas dga' ba'i bsti dustang byas te byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs gnyis la gtugs dunas tshigs su bcad ⑦de smras pa/ ji ltar ⑧bltam ①tshe sa ni g.yos pa ltar/ /'dzam bu'i grib ma 72—49

khyod sku mi gtong ba/ /blo chen khyod kyi ya mtshan gnyis 'di ste/ /kun gzigs khyod kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs nas shing rtar zhugs pa dang / ji tsam na gter skyong ba skra ①dang kha spu dang sen mo ring ba gter thogs te byang chub sems dpa' gang na ba der song ste phyin nas byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha gter 'di rnams bzhes shig /byang chub sems dpas ②gsungs pa/ 'di gang gi lha skyes bu gang zhig dus las 'das pa de rnams kyi lags so/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ 'di rnams kyis chog gis ①re zhig de rnams kyi blun po yongs su gzung ba byas nas ci zhig byas khyed nga la dgos pa med kyis song shig /tshigs su bcad pas kyang gsungs pa/ gang gis nga la 'chi ba'i gtam smras pa/ /de dag kyang shi gtam du gyur pa yin/ /bdag kyang shi nas ring por mi thogs par/ /gzhan dag gi yang gtam du 'gyur bar 'ong /de rnams kyis yang sgra phyung ba/ gzhon nu gal te mi bzhes na bdag cag rgya mtsho chen por 'jug go/ /byang chub sems dpas ④ci bde bar zhugs ⑤sheg ces gsungs pa dang / de rnams rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du zhugs so/ /de nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni rgyu'i stobs can yin mod kyi 'on kyang rkyen bsgrub par bya dgos te 'di ltar 0rgyu'i stobs chen po yang rkyen gyi stobs la ltos so snyam nas byang chub sems dpa' dur khrod kyi nang nas gshegs pa na/ lha rnams kyis mi ro rnam par ༷sngos pa nidang / rnam par rnags pa dang / rnam par 'bus gzhigs pa dang / rnam par bam pa dang / rnam par zos pa zhig bstan pa 72—50

dang —/ byang chub sems dpas gzigs nas skyo ba 'khrungs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas byang chub sems dpa' lam gzhan nas grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir ①'jug par byas so/ /de nas grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi'i bud med kyi tshogs skar khung dang / skar khung dra ba can dang / ba gam dag na byang chub sems dpa' la lta zhing 'dug pa dang / shākya dus legs kyi bu mo sa 'tsho ②ma zhes bya ba steng gi khang bzangs kyi zhugazhi la 'dug pa byang chub sems dpa' la rtog pa na rkang pa'i mthe bos sa la brkos te khrag byung yang ma tshor ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang sa 'tsho dum la gzigs pa na phyag g.yas kyis ⑤mda' phye mar rlags duso/ /kha lo bas lcags mda' phul ba dang ⑦de yang phye ⑧mar rlags ⑨so / /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma 'di snyam du sems te/ 'dis ni gzhon nu'i thugs dang bstun par nus so snyam mo/ /de nas kha lo sgyur bas shing rta drangs pa dang / shākya dril bu sgra'i bu mo 0ri dgas skyes zhes bya bas byang chub sems dpa' shing rtar zhugs 7te byon pa mthong ba dang / yang steng gi khang bzangs kyi tsogazhi la 'dug nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ kye ma 'di yi yum bde zhing / /yab kyang shin tu bde ba yin/ /kye ma gang gi khyim thab gyur/ /bud med de yang mya ngan 'das/ /skyes mchog bsam gtan pa de yis8/ /mya ngan 8'das pa'i sgra gsan nas/ /mya ngan 8'das pa zhi nyid du/ /mkhyen nas de la thugs dgyes gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgra gsan pas ri dgas skyes la dgyes te mgul nas mu tig phreng cig phog ste/'phangs nas shing rta de la bsam gtan la snyoms par zhugs ⑩par mdzad do/ /phreng ba de yang de'i mgul du 'khris par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 72—51

ma 'di snyam du sems te/ 'dis ni byang chub sems dpa'i thugs dang bstun par nus so snyam nas sa 'tsho ma bud med nyi khris bskor ①ba dang / ri dgas skyes kyang bud med nyi khris bskor ②ba byang chub sems dpa'i btsun mor blangs so / /de ltar na grags 'dzin ma dang / sa 'tsho ①ma dang / ri dgas skyes la sogs pa btsun mo stong phrag drug cu byung bar gyur to/ /mtshan mkhan rnams kyis gal te byang chub sems dpa' lo bdun gyi bar du rab tu ma byung na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma 'di snyam du sems te ma la bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' la ④'dod pa'i yon tan lnga las phal po che zhig sbyin par bya'o snyam nas phal po che byin no/ /mtshan mkhan gyis gal te byang chub sems dpa' zla ba bdun gyi bar du rab tu ma (5)byung na gdon mi za bar 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas byang chub sems dpa' la 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga shin tu yang mang du byin te 'di ltar yang 'di la mngon par dga' bas rab tu 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' skyed 0mos tshal gyi gzhir gshegs bzhed ( )par gyur pa de'i tshe kha lo sgyur ba la/ kye kha lo sgyur ba re zhig bzhon ⑧pa bzang po myur bar shoms shig dang / der zhugs nas skyed mos tshal gyi ⑨gzhir 'gro'o/ /zhes gsung bar 'gyur bas de nas byang chub sems dpas tho)kha lo sgyur ba la bsgo ba/kye kha lo sgyur ba re zhig bzhon 7pa bzang po myur du shoms shig dang der zhugs nas skyed timos tshal gyi gzhir 'gro'o/ /lha bka' tshubazhin 'tshal zhes kha lo sgyur bas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa'i ltar mnyan nas bzhon ④pa bzang po 72—52

myur du bshams te byang chub sems dpa' nyushākya thub pa gang srin ba der song ②nas phyin pa dang ④/ byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa dul 'di skad ces smras so / /lha bcibs pa bzang po bshams lags kyis⑥/ lha da ⑦de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa bzhon ⑧pa bzang por zhugs nas skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pas ①mi rgas 'khogs gtugs pa/ skur po ⑩phyam dgu po ltar kyar kyor can mdun nas 'khar ⑩ba la rten 8cing / lus 'dar zhing 'gro ba de'i skra se ba/ ji ltar yang mi gzhan dag dang mi 'dra ba zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ kha lo sgyur ba mi rgas 'khogs gtugs pa/ sgur po 8phyam dgu po ltar ④kyar kyor can mdun nas 'khar tsob la rten rmyacing / lus 'dar zhing 'gro ba de'i skra se ⑩ba/ ji ltar yang mi gzhan dag dang mi 'dra ba 'di ci yin/ lha mi 'di ni rgas pa zhes bgyi'o/ /kha lo sgyur ba rgas pa zhes bya ba 'di ci yin/ lha mi 'di ring por mi thogs pa kho nar 'gum par 'gyur bas de rgas pa zhes bgyi'o/ /kha 8lo sgyur ba nga yang rga ba'i yichos dang / rga ba'i chos nyid las ma 'das sam/ lha yang rga ba'i 0chos dang rga ba'i 0chos nyid las ma 'das so/ /kha lo sgyur ba de'i phyir shing rta phyir sgyur cig /pho brang nyid du 'dong ngo / /'di ltar nga pho brang du phyin nas nga rga ba las 'am 'das so zhes grag ⑥pa'i don de nyid bsam par bya'o/ /kha lo sgyur bas shing rta phyir sgyur nas pho brang nyid du chas te der byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa pho brang gi nang du byon nas nga yang tsonas pa las ma 'das pa lta zhig ces mi dgyes shing thugs ngan dgongs so/ /'dir smras pa/ dar yol nas shing 72—53

skur la mgo skya ba/ /lag na 'khar 6)ba thogs pa'i mi gzigs nas/ /'di bdag rgas las ma 'das zhes ①grag ces/ /de nas mi dgyes thugs ngan dgongs par mdzad/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis kha lo sgyur ba la smras pa/kha lo sgyur ba ci (migazhon nu yid dga' ba dang mgu bas skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir byung ngam/ skyed mos tshal la mngon par dga' bya'am/ lha ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ lha gzhon nu skyed ⑤mos tshal gyi ⑥gzhir gshegs pa na/ mi rgas 'khogs gtugs pa (beskur po phyam dgu po ltar kyar kyor can mdun nas 'khar (9ba la rten kyi)cing / lus 'dar zhing mchi la de'i 7spa se ba/ ji ltar yang mi (nyugazhan dag dang mi 'dra ba zhig dhigazigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang bdag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kha lo sgyur ba mi rgas 'khogs gtugs pa skur po phyam dgu po ltar kyar tho)kyor can mdun nas 'khar tsob la rten 8cing /lus 'dar zhing 'gro la de'i skra se ba/ ji ltar yang mi gzhan dag dang mi 'dra ba 'di ci yin/ de la bdag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha 'di ni rgas pa zhes bgyi'o/ /des 'di skad ces gsungs 8te/ kha lo sgyur ba rgas pa zhes bya ba 'di ci yin/ de la bdag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha mi 'di ring po tsomi thogs pa kho nar 'gum par ()'gyur bas lha de ni rgas pa zhes bgyi'o/ /des 'di skad ces gsungs te/ kha lo sgyur ba nga yang rga ba'i chos dang rga ba'i chos nyid las ma 'das sam/ de la bdag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha yang rga ba'i chos dang / rga ba'i chos nyid las ⑩ma 'das so/ /des 'di skad ces gsungs te/ kha lo sgyur ba de'i phyir shing rta phyir sgyur cig /pho brang nyid du 'dong ngo / /'di ltar pho brang du phyin nas nga rga ba las ma 'das so zhes grag ⑩72—54

pa'i don de nyid bsam par bya'o/ /lha gzhon nu de pho brang gi nang du gshegs te / de nas rga ba las ma 'das pa lta zhig ces mi dgyes shing thugs ngan dgongs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma 'di snyam du sems te/ mtshan mkhan dang ltas mkhan gyi bram ze de rnams kyis yo)tshig yang dag par bden par mi 'gyur grang / gzhon nu skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar 'gyur du 'ong gis ②ma la bdag gis gzhon nu la 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga las phal po che zhig byin la ci nas kyang 'di la dga' zhing rab tu 'byung bar mi 'gyur bar ①bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa la 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga las phal po che byin te ci nas kyang 'di la ④dga' zhing rab tu 'byung bar mi 'gyur bar byas so/ /'dir smras pa/ kha lo sgyur ba'i tshig de thos pa dang / /gzhon nu la ni yab de dogs bzhin du/ /de (9tshe slar dga' nags su mi ⑥'gro'i phyir/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lngar bcas mang du byin / /de nas chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir gshegs par bzhed par ④gyur pa de'i tshe kha lo sgyur ba la kye kha lo sgyur ba re zhig bzhin ⑧pa bzang po myur du shoms shig dang de la nga zhon yinyenas skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir 'gro'o zhes gsung bar ⑩'gyur bas de nas byang chub sems dpas ⑩kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ kye kha lo sgyur ba re zhig bzhon ⑩pa bzang po 8myur du shoms shig /de la nga zhon chanas skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir gshegs so/ /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal lo zhes kha lo sgyur bas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa'i ltar mnyan nas bzhin 8pa bzang po bshams te/ byang chub sems dpa' shākya 72—55

thub pa gang na ba der song ste phyin nas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha bcibs pa bzang po bshams lags na/ lha da ①de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa bzhon ②pa bzang por zhugs nas skyed ①mos tshal gyi gzhir byung ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pas mi skya bo rbab rbab po durid pa nyam ⑤chung ba dbang po nyams pa/ skye bo mang po'i mig gis lta mi phod pa zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ kha lo sgyur ba mi skya 0bo rbab rbab po rid pa nyam chung ba dbang po nyams pa/ skye bo mang po'i mig gis lta mi phod pa 'di ci yin/ lha 'di ni bro nad kyis thebs pa zhes bgyi'o/ /kha lo sgyur ba bro ⑦nad kyis thebs pa zhes bya ba 'di ci yin/ lha mi 'di gang gis 'gum par 'gyur ba'i gnas de mchis te/ lha 'di ni bros thebs pa zhes bgyi'o/ /kha lo sgyur ba nga yang nad kyi nichos dang nad kyi chos nyid las ma 'das sam/ lha yang snyun gyi chos dang snyun gyi chos nyid las ma 'das so/ /kha 7lo sgyur ba de'i phyir shing rta phyir sgyur cig /pho brang nyid du 'dong ngo / /'di ltar pho brang du phyin nas nga nad las ma 'das pa zhes bya ba'i don de nyid bsam par bya'o/ /kha lo sgyur bas ⑩shing rta phyir bsgyur nas pho brang nyid du chas te/ der byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa pho brang gi nang du gshegs nas bdag kyang nad las ma 'das pa lta zhig ces mi dgyes shing thugs ngan dgongs so/ /'dir smras pa/mi ni lus rid skya bo rbab rbab po/ /rang dbang med pa'i nad thebs 'dir gzigs nas/ /nad las bdag ma 'das pa lta zhig ces/ /de nas mi dgyes thugs ngan dgongs par mdzad/ /de yinas rgyal po zas gtsang gis kha lo sgyur 72—56

ba la smras pa/ kha lo sgyur ba ci gzhon nu yid ①dga' ba dang mgu ②bas skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir byung ngam/ /skyed mos tshal la mngon par dga' bar gyur tam / /lha ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ lha gzhon nu skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir byung ba na/ mi skya bo rbab rbab po rid pa nyam chung ba dbang po nyams pa/ /skye bo mang po'i mig gis lta mi phod pa zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang bdag la bka' stsal pa/ kha lo sgyur ba mi skya bo rbab rbab po rid ①pa nyam chung ba dbang po nyams pa/ skye bo mang po'i mig gis lta mi phod pa 'di ci yin/ de la bdag gis 'di skad ces gsol to④/ /lha 'di ni bro nad kyis thebs pa zhes bgyi'o / /des 'di skad ces gsungs te/ kha lo sgyur ba nad kyis thebs pa zhes bya ba 'di ci yin/ de la bdag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /mi 'di gang gnod pa 'dis 'gum pa'i gnas mchis te/ lha de ni (6bros thebs pa zhes bgyi'o / /des 'di skad ces gsungs te/ kha lo sgyur ba nga yang nad kyi chos dang nad kyi chos nyid las ma 'das sam/ de la bdag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha yang snyun gyi chos dang snyun gyi chos nyid las ma 'das so/ /des 'di skad ces gsungs te/ kha lo sgyur 0ba de'i ⑦phyir shing rta phyir sgyur cig /pho brang nyid du 'dong ngo / /'di ltar nga pho brang nyid du phyin nas nga nad las ma 'das zhes grag ⑧pa'i don de nyid bsam 6)par bya'o/ /gzhon nu de pho brang gi nang du gshegs nas nga yang nad las ma 'das pa lta zhig ces mi dgyes shing thugs ngan dgongs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma 'di snyam du sems te mtshan mkhan dang ltas mkhan gyi bram ze de rnams kyi tshig yang dag par bden par mi 'gyur grang zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ⑩ma bzhin no/ /'dir smras pa/72—57

de tshe dga' nas bdag ngor ①mi gzhug phyir/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro rnams dang / /reg bya yid du 'ong ba gtso rnams kyi/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po yang byin no/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa skyed mos tshal gyi (migazhir gshegs par bzhed par gyur pa de'i tshe/ kha lo sgyur ba la bka' stsal pa la sogs pa snga ma bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pas ras kha dog sna tshogs las byas pa'i bla re ①byes pa dang / khyogs khyer ba dang / mdun skyinas me (5)sgron thogs pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs chen po dumadun nas 'gro ba dang / bud med skra bshig pa rnams ngu zhing rjes bzhin du 'brang ba zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ kha lo sgyur ba ras kha dog sna tshogs las byas pa'i bla re ④bres pa dang / khyogs khyer ba dang / mdun nas me sgron thogs pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs chen po mdun nas 'gro ba dang / bud med skra bshig pa rnams ngu zhing rjes bzhin du 'brang ba 'di ci (kyeyin/ lha 'di ni gum pa zhes bgyi'o/ /kha lo sgyur ba shi ba zhes bya ba 'di ci yin/ lha mi 'dis slan chad sdug pa'i pha ma mi mthong zhing bu pho dang / bu mo dang / bran pho dang /kyi) bran mo dang / las bgyid pa dang / /zho shas 'tsho ba'i mi rnams kyang ma lags la de dag gis kyang slan chad 'di mi mthong bas lha 'di ni gum pa zhes bgyi'o/ /kha lo sgyur ba nga yang 'chi ba'i chos dang 'chi ba'i chos nyid las ma 'das sam/ lha yang 'chi ba'i chos dang 'chi ba'i chos nyid las ma 'das so/ /kha lo sgyur ba de'i phyir shing rta phyir sgyur cig /pho brang nyid du 'dong ngo / /'di ltar nga pho brang du phyin nas nga 'chi ba las ma 'das zhes grag ⑩pa'i don de nyid bsam par bya'o/ /kha lo sgyur bas shing rta phyir 72—58

bsgyur nas pho brang nyid du chas te der byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa pho brang gi nang du gshegs nas bdag kyang 'chi ba las ma 'das pa lta zhig ces mi dgyes shing ①thugs ngan dgongs so/ /'dir smras pa/ tshe zad pa yis 'du shes bral gyur cing / /sems med mi yi ro zhig gzigs nas ni/ /'chi las bdag ma 'das pa lta zhig ces/ /de nas mi dgyes thugs ngan dgongs par mdzad/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis kha lo sgyur ba la smras pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni snga ma bzhin no/ /'dir smras pa/ grong khyer dam pa dpal ②ldan yid 'ong der / /lha yi lhar gyur sgron ma dang mtshungs pa/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga pos kun dgyes pa/ /mig stong dga' ba'i tshal na gnas pa bzhin/ /de nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ byang chub sems dpa' ni rgyu'i stobs can yin mod kyi 'on kyang rkyen bsgrub par bya dgos te 'di ltar rgyu'i stobs chen po yang 0rkyen gyi stobs la ltos so snyam nas de rnams kyis mi skra bregs shing gos ngur smrig gyon pa/ lag pa na lhung bzed thogs pa zhig khyim nas khyim dang / khang pa nas khang par rgyu zhing 'gro ba zhig sprul to/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir ④gshegs par bzhed (nyapar gyur pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni snga ma bzhin no/ /skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pas mi skra bregs shing gos yijur smrig gyon pa lag pa na lhung bzed thogs pa zhig khyim nas khyim dang / khang pa nas khang par rgyu zhing 'gro ba zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ kha lo sgyur ba mi skra bregs shing lag pa na lhung bzed thogs nas khyim nas khyim dang / khang pa nas khang par rgyu zhing 'gro la ⑦'di'i gos kyang kha 72—59

dog mi mtshungs te ji ltar yang mi gzhan dag gi dang mi 'dra ba ci yin/ lha de ni rab tu byung ba zhes bgyi'o/ /kha lo sgyur ba rab tu byung ba zhes bya ba 'di ci yin / lha rab tu byung ba de ni dul ba legs pa dang / yang dag par sdom pa legs pa dang / don spyod pa legs ①pa dang / chos spyod pa legs pa dang /dge ba spyod pa legs ②pa dang / dge legs spyod pa legs par rig nas ⑧spa dang ske/ kha spu bregs te/ gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba ste/ lha 'di ni rab tu byung ba zhes bgyi'o / /kha lo sgyur ba de'i phyir shing rta 'di rab tu byung ba gang na ba de logs su sgyur cig /lha bka' rgyabazhin 'tshal zhes kha lo sgyur bas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa'i ltar mnyan nas shing rta de rab tu byung ba gang na ba der bsgyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pas rab tu byung ba de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye mi khyod ci'i phyir skra bregs shing lag pa na lhung bzed (gethogs nas khyim nas khyim dang / khang pa nas khang par rgyu zhing 'gro la ⑥khyod kyi rtsigos kyang kha dog mi mtshungs te ji ltar yang mi gzhan dag gi dang mi 'dra ba yin/ des 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu bdag ni rab tu byung ba zhes bgyi'o / /kye mi khyod ji ltar na rab tu byung ba zhes byani/ gzhon nu bdag gis dul ba legs pa dang / yang dag par sdom pa legs pa dang / don spyod pa legs pa dang / chos spyod pa legs pa dang / dge ba spyod pa legs pa dang /dge legs spyod pa legs par rig nas/ skra dang kha spu bregs te/ gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa khyakho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste / de ltar na bdag rab tu byung ba zhes bya'o⑩/ /kye mi khyod kyis dul ba 72—60

legs pa dang / yang dag par sdom pa legs pa dang / don spyod pa legs pa dang ske/ chos spyod pa legs pa dang / dge ba spyod pa legs pa dang / dge legs spyod pa legs par rig nas skra dang kha spu bregs te/ gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba legs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pas kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ kha lo sgyur ba de'i phyir shing rta phyir sgyur cig /pho brang nyid du 'dong ngo / /'di ltar nga pho brang nyid du phyin nas don 'di kho na bsam par bya'o / /kha lo sgyur bas shing rta phyir sgyur nas pho brang nyid du chas te/ der pho brang du gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa kye ma'o bdag ni skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa ②kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar bya'o snyam pa'i don de nyid dgongs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis kha lo sgyur ba la smras pa la sogs pa ni snga ma bzhin no / /de nas skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mos rmi lam rmis pa dbang po'i tog lhung ba dang —/ shākya rnams phyag dar gyis khengs pa dang / sa ldog pa dang / dpal khyim nas byung ba dang / phyi rol na skad cig cing ngu zhing dgod pa la bdag nyid lta ba dang / nyi ma gang nas shar ba de nyid nas nub pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpas de gsan pa dang / dgongs pa nga ni shākya rnams kyi dbang po'i tog ②gi gnas yin pa dang / nga grong khyer nas 'byung na dpal 'byung nibar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po zas gtsang mas kyang rmi lam rmis pa dpal gyi mal khri chag pa dang / pha'i rgyud chad pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpas ④de gsan pa dang / de de bzhin te/nga 0ni grags 'dzin ma'i dpal gyi gnas su gyur pa dang / zas gtsang ma'i 72—61

pa'i rigs rgyud kyi gnas su gyur pas nga rab tu byung na shākya rnams kyi rigs rgyud chad par 'gyur ro/ /mtshan mkhan rnams kyis rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i mdun ①du gal te gzhon nu zhag bdun gyi bar du rab tu ma byung na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /'di skad ces kyang smras sol/ /gal te de yi (5)bzang po gzigs bzhed na/ /de slad dgung bdun bar du srungs shig dang / /mi dbang gdugs ni bdal bar gyur pa lta'i/ /rin chen sna bdun 'byung bar the tsom ri4)med/ /khyod sras rin chen bdun po yiphyi/ /dbang phyug gi ni rgyal por 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho la ni thug pa'i sa/ /chad pa med pas skyong bar 'gyur/ /'on (6)te sa ni spangs stinas su/ /bsnyengs med nags su bzhud na ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thob zhoragyur nas/ /'gro ba sgrol ba mdzad par 'gyur/ /zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang zas gtsang dang / zas dkar dang / bre bo zas dang / bdud rtsi zas bzhi lhan cig gcig tu tshogs nas gros bya bar (9ribartsams pa/ shes ldan dag mtshan mkhan dang ltas ⑩mkhan gyi bram ze rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa la gal te zhag bdun gyi bar du rab tu ma byung na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan gyis 17de lta bas na bdag cag sna gis byang chub sems dpa' zhag bdun gyi bar du bsgrims te bsrung bar bya zhing grong khyer yang legs par bsrung bar tsobya'o/ /de nas de rnams kyis ser skya'i gzhi'i grong khyer ra ba rim pa bdun dang /'obs rim pa bdun gyis bskor nas grong khyer gyi sgo 'phar lcags las byas shing sgo 'phar rnams la dril bu shin tu sgra gsal ba btags te/ sgo phye na de'i sgras dpag tshad gcig khor yug tu grag par 'gyur ro'/ /byang chub sems dpa' 72—62

khang bzangs kyi gzhi stin bud med yid 'phrog pa/ gzugs bzang ba rnams dang gar dang / glu dang / rol mo rnams kyi spyod pas bsnyen bkur byed du bcug go/ /skas shin tu che ba spor (mirung ba mi lnga brgyas bteg ⑧pa byas so/ /chibs bsngags rtsildan gyi sa phyogs ni zangs ma'i glegs bus g.yogs shing gser gyi sil dkrol gyi dra ba btags pas bskor to/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni steng gi khang bzangs kyi ⑤gzhi skyes pa med par zhugs nas/ pi bang 6)dang / gling bu dang / khar charnga dang / sgra snyan la sogs (8dpa rol mo'i cha byad dag nye bar len cing 'byor pa chen pos bzhugs so/ /mtshan mo ni rgyal po zas gtsang yang dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang shar sgo'i phyi rol na 'dug go/ /lho phyogs na ni bre bo zas so/ /nub phyogs na ni zas dkar ro/ /byang phyogs na ni bdud rtsi zas so/ /grong khyer gyi dbus kyi 'dram 6)po byed pa ni shākya ming chen dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /de shar sgor song nas smras pa/ su zhig mel tse 7byed/ su zhig mel tse hu)byed/ rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ kho bo mel tse 'byed do/ /lha mel tse (nyamadzod cig /mel tse mdzad yidang khyod la legs par 'gyur zhes smras te tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ 'jig rten gnyid log ro dang mtshungs/ /gnyid log bdud kyi dbang du song / /'di ni mi nyal rtag tu mkhas/ /de bas ma nyal mel tse 8byos/ /lho sgor song nas smras pa/su zhig mel tse 7byed/ su zhig mel tse yi 7byed/ bre bo zas kyis smras pa/ kho bo mel tse (nyebyed do/ /lha mel tse (nyamadzod cig /mel tse mdzad 69dang / khyod la legs par 'gyur ro hūṃ nyezhes smras nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ 'jig rten gnyid log ro dang mtshungs/ /gnyid log bdung kyi dbang du song / /gnyid 72—63

log 'chi bdag dbang du song / /de bas ma nyal mel tse ①rgyas/ /nub sgor song nas smras pa/ su zhig mel tse ②byed/ su zhig mel tse ③byed/ zas dkar gyis khyims pa/ kho bo mel tse (5)byed do/ /lha mel tse stimadzod cig /mel tse mdzad ⑦dang khyod la legs par 'gyur ro zhes smras nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gnyid log pa ni rtag tu myos/ /myos 'gyur bre bos 'thungs pa ⑧nyal / /dgon pa nags su nyal ba 'dras/ /de bas ma nyal mel tse 6)byos/ /byang sgor song nas smras pa/ su zhig mel tse 7byed/ su zhig mel tse (nyabyed/bdud rtsi 8zas kyis smras pa/ kho bo 8mel tse yibyed do/ /lha mel tse tsomadzod cig /mel tse mdzad skyedang khyod la legs par 'gyur ro zhes smras nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ ri nyal ri sul nyal ba bzhin/ /rgya mtsho'i chur ni nyal ba dang / ljon shing rtse la nyal ba ⑩bzhin/ /de bas ma nyal mel tse tunyebyos/ /dbus kyi bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo dag tu song nas smras pa/ su zhig mel tse ⑩ byed / su zhig mel tse ri )byed/ srungs (stom rnams kyis smras pa/ bdag cag mel tse bgyid ( ri do/ /mel tse khrinabyos shig /mel tse byas yidang legs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ chos spyod chos ma yin ma spyod/ /bden par smros shig brdzun ma smra( nye/ /mun pa chen por 'jug par 'gyur / /de bas ma nyal mel tse dubyos/ /de nas nam nangs 6)nas shākya ming chen gyis rgyal po zas gtsang la smras pa/ lha dgung sangs lags te/ dgung bdun la dgung gcig ni thal dgung drug ni lus so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ legs kyis ( nyezhag drug 'das nas gzhon nu 'khor los sgyur bar gyur ⑥na bdag cag nam mkha'i ngos la rgyu zhing gling bzhir 6)phyi bzhin 'dong ngo / / de 72—64

bzhin du ①dgung gcig lus so zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya ②byin 'di snyam du sems te/ mi dbang shākya'i (7sras po thub pa 'di/ /bdag nyid chen po pha rol phyin drug rdzogs/ /thugs rnams dgyes par mdzad pa dka' thub tshal④/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i phyinags su gshegs par bzhed/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ bdag la gzhan dag gzhon nu shākya thub pa ni skyes pa ma yin te/ gang gi phyir grags 'dzin ma dang /sa 'tsho ⑥ma dang / ri dgas skyes dang / bud med drug khri spangs nas rab tu 'byung ④ngo zhes gzhi de las kha zer bar 'gyur du 'ong gis 6)ma la bdag gis grags 'dzin ma dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad par bya'o snyam nas des grags 'dzin ma dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad pa dang grags 'dzin ma sems can ) dang ldan par gyur nas/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ nam nangs nas po)byang chub sems dpa'i snyan du gsol lo snyam 7mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de'i tshe rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang ldan pas tshigs su bcad de yonyagasungs pa / bud med dang bdag khyim nyal ba'i/ /tha ma deng gi 'di yin te/ /phyin cad 8khyim du bud med dang / /nga ni lhan cig mi gnas so/ /de nas bud med de rnams gar dang / glu dang / rol mos ngal zhing lci la dub nas kha nas kha chu 8'dzag cing skra ⑩zhig la gos dang lag pa dag lhug par btang nas bla ba'i tshig byung rgyal du rdol zhing gnyid log go/ /byang chub sems dpas bud med de dag thams cad kha nas kha chu 'dzag cing skra zhig la gos dang lag pa dag ⑫lhug par btang nas/ bla ba'i tshig byung ⑩rgyal du rdol ⑩zhing gnyid log pa gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang btsun mo'i 'khor tsol dur khrod kyi 'du shes 72—65

skyes so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' skyo ba 'khrungs pa dang tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ rlung gi shugs kyis pad ma'i tshal ltar sa gzhi 6)'dir/ /lag pa dag ②dang rkang pa brkyang nas 'gyel 'gyur te/ /skra rnams zhig cing mdoms ①dang rkub kyi phyogs snang ba/ /shākya'i sras kyis gzigs nas rang bzhin skyo bar 'gyur/ /tshul dang bral 4)ba'i bud med na chung rgyatshogs 'di dag /dur (6)khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i rang bzhin 'drar mthong nas/ /sems can byis pa'i spyod yul la ni ( )deng dga' na/ /sems dang blo gros dran dang bral ba yin nam (7ci/ /'dod pa tha chad 'dam dang mda' mdung kyi)dug me 'dra/ /rmi lam lta bu yin te tshwa chu'i ro dang mtshungs/ /'dod pa phung byed rtsod dang sdig pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /mtha' ngan ⑩sprul gyi kha 'dra bdag gis spang bar (nyabya/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' gzims mal chen po la gzims pa na/ mtshan mo de nyid la rmi lam lnga rmis pa sa chen po nyid 8gzims mal du byas shing ri rab ri'i rgyal po dbu rten du bcug /phyag g.yon pa shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'jug /phyag g.yas pa nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'jug /zhabs gnyis rgya mtsho chen por 'jug pa dang / 'greng ba zhes bya ba'i rtsa'i tsorigs lte ba nas byung nas nam mkha'i bar du 'phags te 'dug pa dang / bya kun nas dkar la mgo nag pa rnams kyis zhabs gnyis la gtugs yinas pus mo'i lha nga la thug pa'i bar du lta ba dang / bya sna tshogs phyogs bzhi nas 'ongs nas mdun du kha dog gcig tu 'dug pa dang / mi gtsang ba'i ro'i steng nas bdag nyid mi gtsang bas ma gos par 'chag pa'o/ /de lta bu tsormis nas kyang thugs dgyes te dgongs pa nga'i rmi lam 'di 'dra ba mis pas ring po mi thogs pa kho nar bla na 72—66

med pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /grags 'dzin mas kyang rmi lam du mthong ba bdag gi 6)so kun lhags pa dang / dung gi (gyidapung pa chag pa dang /zla ba sa la lhung ③ba dang / skar ma rnams ni ngu ba'o/ /grags 'dzin mas kyang rmi lam rmis pa de byang chub sems dpa' la gsol ④pa dang / byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ khyod kyi so ni kha nang gnas(ge/ /zla ba 'di ni mkhar gnas kyis/ /yid kyi gdung ⑥ba bsal ⑦nas ni/ /dogs med bde bar gnyid log cig /de nas grags 'dzin ma ⑧'di snyam du sems te/ rmi lam 'jigs pa rmis pa na/ /bdag yid dogs dang bcas par 'gyur/ /deng gi mtshan mo sdug pa dang / /'bral ba dag tu mi 'gyur grang / /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni ji ltar rgyu'i stobs can yin mod kyi 'on kyang rkyen gyis bsgrub par bya dgos te/'di ltar rgyu'i stobs chen po yang rkyen gyi stobs la ltos so snyam ⑨nas byang chub sems dpa' gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / khang bzangs kyi tigazhi la 'dug ste byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /nags kyi spre'u ni spyod yul rgyu 'dra zhing / /yan par 'dug pa'i rte'u dang 'dra ba'i thugs/ /gal te 'dod pa'i yon tan las bzlog (7na/ /de las 7shin tu gsal ba'i snang ba gzigs/ /blo gros bzang po bzhengs shig bzhengs/ /sa ni spangs te bzhud mdzod la/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid brnyes 8nas ni/ /'gro ba dag ④ni bsgral bar 8mdzod/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa ni/ /kau shi ka ma mthong ngam / /nga ni ri dgas bdag po rgyas bskor ltar/ /mi ni mthu ldan gzhu mtshon ral gri thogs/ /rta glang shing rta dpung tshogs mang po yis/ /grong khyer ser skya 72—67

kun nas yongs su bskor/ /zas gtsang la sogs shākya'i tshogs 'di dag /glang chen rta zhon legs par go bgos lus/ /mi sdug sna tshogs lag na mtshon thogs te/ /khyams dang rta babs khang bzangs 6)gzhi nang gnas/ /pho brang dang ni khyim sgo dang / /de bzhin grong khyer sgo dag kyang / /bcad nas gtan ②pa dam bcug ste/ )/ /de bzhin kun nas bsrungs par gyurali/ /ru dung pa ṭa ha (5)sgra rnga sgra yis/ /khyams dang rta babs khang bzangs yinang gnas shing / /glang chen rta dmag 'bad pa'i skye bo'i tshogs/ /rgyun du nga mi gtang ( )phyir srung bar byed/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ des pa mar me mdzad kyis ④lung bstan dang / /sdug bsngal gyis gdungs 'jig rten 'di dang yang kyi)/ /khyod kyi sngon gyi dam bcas dgongs mdzod la/ /khab dag spangs te nges par 'byung bar mdzod / /ji ltar khyod ni bgegs med par/ /deng nyid nags su gshegs 'gyur ba/ /bdag cag tshangs sogs bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams kyis ni de bzhin bgyi/ /byang chub sems dpas 7legs so zhes gsungs nas thugs dgyes par gyur to/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis gnyid kyis myos par byas nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lngas rtsen la bsgo ba/ grogs po byang chub sems dpa' steng gi khang bzangs (stenas babs kyis tsoms long shig5nye /des skas blangs pa la byang chub sems dpa' babs pa dang de nas brgya byin gyis brda ④byas ma thag tu zhabs 'bring tsob 'dun pa gang na ba der gshegs na ji tsam na 'dun pa gnyid stug skyepos non par gzigs nas ⑩byang chub sems dpas hunyebasgrims te bslang yinas tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis gsungs pa/ 'dun pa longs kye ( )khyim nas myur bar ni/ / nga yi 0rta pho 7rin 72—68

chen bsngags 6)ldan long / /sngon gyi rgyal bas longs spyad ②dka' thub tshal/ /thub rnams dgyes pa mdzad par nga dugashegs so/ /'dun ④pa gnyid log pa'i mig phye nas smras pa/ lha khyod skyed mos tshal gyi dus ma bab/ /des pa khyod dang 'ga' yang 'khon ⑤ma mchis/ /khyod la dgra bo su yang ma stimachis na/ /dgung phyed khyod la bcibs ⑦pa ci zhig bgyi/ /byang chub sems dpas bka' stsal pa/ 'dun pa khyod kyis lan 'ga' yang / /nga yi tshig ni ma bcag na/ /nga yi deng dus tha ma la/ /nga yi tshig 'di ma gcag shig⑧ /'dun pas gsol pa/ gzhon nu mtshan mo 'di ni 'jigs pa dang 'jigs su rung ba mchis pas bdag bcibs pa mi len no/ /byang chub sems dpas 6)dgongs pa/lan dang yang lan gyis gdon mi za bar skye bo sad par 'gyur gyis tibadag nyid song la rta'i rgyal po bsngags 7ldan sta 8gon bya'o snyam nas de nas nyid kyis pho brang gi sgo phye nas rta'i rgyal po bsngags tsoldan gzung 8bar brtsams pa na mjing ⑫kyog byed la phar bros tshur bros shing 'dug tsoku mi btub bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i phyag bsod nams brgya phrag du mas bskyed 6)pa 'khor lo dang /bkra shis dang / g.yung drung 'khyil pa mnga' ba/ skrag pa rnams dbugs 'byin par mdzad pas mgo la byugs nas gsungs pa/ bsngags ldan tha ma yi ni khur long ste/ /dka' thub nags su ma thogs nga skyol cig /byang chub thob nas myur du 'gro ba kun/ /bsam gtan rnam thar char gyis tshim par bya/ /chos nyid kyis dud 'gro yang gdams na phyi lang mi byed 8pas rta'i rgyal po bsngags ldan mi g.yo bar 'dug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' thugs dgyes pa skyes 7te rta'i rgyal po bsngags ldan bstad do ⑦/ /ji tsam na shākya sh+yi72—69

ming chen 'dram 0)po byed pa skye bo nyul zhing phyogs der phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gshegs par chas pa mthong ngo / /de nas skad 'dzer (micing mig mchi (mims gang bas smras pa/ gzhon nu 'di ci mdzad/ ming chen 'gro'o gzhon nu 'di ni rigs ④pa ma lags so/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ming chen 'di nyid rigs (snyepa yin te/ gang gi phyir ngas ⑥bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du dka' ba brgya stong du mas sems can rnams kyi don du byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs pa des na da nga ci gakhyim na 'dug phod dam/ 'di ni nges te dka' thub kyi tshal du 'gro'o/ /gang zhig 'bar ba'i khyim chen las/ /mkhas rnams myur du 'byung ba la/ /(kyilegs min smra bar mi 'os kyi/ /de ni bsngags ⑨par 'os nyid 7yin/ /de bzhin rga nad 'chi ba yis/ /rab 'bar srid pa'i gzeb las ni/ /'byung bar 'dod gyur gang yin la/ /'dir ni mi rigs ci zhig mthong / /de ltar gsung drag pos spyos 41pa dang / ming chen gdong las mchi ma char bzhin du 'bab cing cho nge 'debs pa la zhugs te kyi hud/ deng du rgyal po zas gtsang dang / /shākya dag ni thams cad kyis/ /yang dang yang du bsam pa yis/ /re ba 'bras bu /2med par gyurayi/ /deng du rgyal po zas gtsang ni/ /sras kyi mya ngan gyis gdungs pa/ /lag bsgreng bzhin du sdug bsngal zhing / /mi bzad sgra ni 'byin par 'gyur/ /sa 'tsho dgrags 'dzin ri dgas skyes/ /de bzhin btsun mo'i 'khor ⑩rgyas pa'ang / /don grub dang ni bral ba yis/ /shin tu sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ /zhes smras nas/ de dngangs tsho 7pas grags 'dzin ma bslang ste smras pa/ don grub 'di ni shes gyur gyisanyusnye / /khyim thab sdug bsngal gyis gdungs nas/ /sdug bsngal nyam /rtethag du 72—70

ma 'ong ①/ /khyim thab sdug pa de zlog shig /khyed ②kyi khyim thab gshegs gyur 'di ni mthong dka' ste/ /khyod kyis 'di ltos khyim thab ①mthong ba'i tha ma yin/ /kyi hud phongs pa bdag stigis mtshan mo khus btab kyang / /sus kyang lan ma ster bas bdag gis ma nyes so/ /des ni de ltar khus btab kyang / /'di ltar lha rnams byin brlabs (9kyis/ /dgon par 'o dod bos pa bzhin/ /'ga' yang sad par ma gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te / gang bdag gis yab la ma bltas par 'gro ba ni nga'i tshul dang 'thun pa ma yin no snyam nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma gang 4nyen ba der gshegs te byon pa dang /rgyal po zas gtsang ma gnyid kyis non par gyur (7to/ /de nas 'di snyam du dgongs te (nyeji ltar nga 'jig rten thams cad kyi phar gyur cing 'jig rten gyi bla ma dang / 'jig rten gyi thu bo yin mod kyi de ltar na yang pha dang ma ni skyes bu'i slob dpon du gyur pa dang / lhar 6)gyur pa dang / tshangs par gyur pa yin zhing shin tu phan pa byed 7pa yin no snyam du dgongs nas yab kyi (7zhabs gnyis la btud de snyibaskor ba lan gsum mdzad nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bdag kyang yid la brtser ldan zhing / /bdag kyang nye du rnams la dga'/ /'on kyang 'khor ba rang bzhin ngan/ /'di mthong nas ni mchi (steb lags/ /gal te rga nad 'chi ba dang / /sdug pa'i gnyen bral las byung ba'i/ /gnod byed sdug bsngal ma mchis na/ /khyod ni spong bar su zhig byed/ /gang phyir mi 'dod bzhin du ni/ /rab che gnyen gyi dkyil 'khor dang / /mdza' bshes chung ma dbang phyug rnams/ /yun mi ring bar 'khor bar 'gyur/ /de bas yim chags yid kyis ni/ /'khor ba las ni rnam grol phyir/ /brtser ldan nye du 72—71

spangs nas ni/ /skye bo med nags bstan hu)pa lags/ /lus can 'du ba nges par ni/ /mthar ni 'bral 'gyur nyid lags pas/ /bdag ni rjes su dgongs nas ni/ /rmongs pas thugs ngan ma mdzad cig /ces gsungs nas chas so/ /de nas ming chen gyis rgyal po zas gtsang ma bslang ste smras pa/ don grub 'di ni bzhud lags kyis no/ /sa bdag de ni zlog ⑧par mdzod/ /sras kyi mya ngan gyis thebs ri nonas/ /sdug bsngal gyis gdungs bshums 'gyur mchi/ /ma stes te dhide yang gnyid ma sad do(yi/ /de nas lha'i ⑦dbang po brgya byin gyis lha'i dubu myu gu dang / mang ku ra dang / 'od zer dzi)can dang / lo ma gyon pa ste bzhi la smras pa/ grogs po dag khyed rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' gdeg par nus sam / de rnams kyis smras pa/ shin tu yang nus lags so/ /khyed rnams la stobs ci tsam tsheyod/ myu hustegs smras pa/ bdag gis ni sa la ri ji snyed yod pa de phrag pa sna gcig tu thogs te nyam nga ba chung 'dus 'gro nus pa de tsam gyi stobs yod do/ /mang ku ras smras pa/ bdag gis kyang spus la chu ji snyed yod pa de thams cad phrag pa gcig tu thogs nas 'gro nus so/ /'od zer 8can gyis smras pa/ bdag gis kyang 8sa la rdul ji snyed yod pa de thams cad phrag par thogs te nyam nga ba chung ngus 'gro nus so/ /lo ma gyon pas smras pa/bdag gis kyang sa la rtswa nyu dang shing dang yal ga dang lo ma ji 8snyed pa de thams cad phrag pa gcig tsho tu thogs te nyam nga ba chung ( — )ngus 'gro nus so/ /brgya byin gyis ri )smras pa/ grogs po dag stobs 'di dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' gdeg sa par nus kyis ri 2de nas myu gu dang / mang ku ra dang / 'od zer ④can dang / lo ma gyon pa ste/ bzhis chibs yirin po che bsngags ldan khyer te/72—72

byang chub sems dpa' gang 6)na ba der song ste phyin nas smras pa/ byang chub sems dpa' ci la bzhugs②/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te 'di rnams ni bdag cag gis byang chub sems dpa' bteg ste/bar snang la khyer ro zhes dregs pa skye bar 'gyur ro snyam nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i skur byin gyis brlabs pa dang / de rnams kyis bskul bar yang ma nus nas ngo mtshar skyes te gsol pa/ gzhon nu bdag cag gis ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la stobs 'di 'dra ba mnga' bar ma 'tshal to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chibs rin po che bsngags ldan la bcibs te 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i mthu dang lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus chibs rin po che ②bsngags ldan dang 'dun pa steng gi nam mkha' la 'phags so/ /de nas brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyang lha ④brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor nas byang chub sems dpa' gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' bskor cing dong ste g.yas phyogs nas gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyang (7spyod lam zhi ba dang / g.yon phyogs nas 'dod pa na spyod pa rnams kyis rgyal mtshan dang ba dan bsgreng yinas lha'i rol mo'i khyad par sna tshogs dang / mdun nas brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa rang rang ⑦gi spyod lam gyis dong ngo / /nam mkha'i ngos la gnas pa'i lha brgya stong du mas ni byang chub sems dpa'i steng nas lha'i me tog ud pa la dang —/ pad ma dang / ku mu da (gyidang / pad ma dkar po rnams kyis gtor ro / /a ga 6)ru'i phye ma dang / tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / ta ma la'i 'dab kyima'i phye ma dang / /lha'i me tog man dā lhosgor bas kyang gtor to/ /lha'i rol 72—73

mo'i cha (1)spyad sna tshogs kyang brdungs so/ /gos rnams kyang gtor ro/ /'dir smras pa/ mkha' la lha rnams ga zha'i sgra chen 'byin byed la/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis gos kyi g.yab mo 'debs byed cing / /kha cig byang chub sems dpa' la ni stod (7byed de/ /nam mkha' la ni rol mo brgya phrag sgyur bar byed/ /kha cig dag ni sgo rnams 'byed byed cing / /me tog man dā phyir bas 'thor bar byed/ /kha cig dag ni bcibs pa'i rkang 'dzin cing / /bde bar gshegs la rtog cing rjes bzhin 'brang / /kha cig dag kyang g.yas nas rjes bzhin 'brang / /g.yon nas 'gro ba dag kyang rjes bzhin 'brang / /brgya byin de bzhin tshangs par bcas pa dang / /lus ngan bdag nyid shul ni mtshon par byed/ /zla ba nya ba 54)rgyu skar tshogs kyis ltar/ /bdag nyid chen po lha tshogs mdun bdar nas/ /dka' thub nags ni thub rnams dgyes byed pa/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i nags su thugs dgyes gshegs/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas (snyebasngags ldan la dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir gsungs pa/ ma skyo ma skyo stobs ni gzung bar gyis6)/ /'gro don dal ba gcig ni de 57ring long / /mi ring byang chub thob nas 'gro ba rnams / /bsam gtan rnam thar gyis tshim byed par ⑧bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag tshad bcu gnyis su bzhud sgyuranas nang par grong khyer dpe med du byon to / /de nas lha 7rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' byung nas 'di slar yang rang gi grong khyer du 'jug par mi 'gyur ram snyam pa la sku thams cad kyi g.yas phyogs su glang po che'i lta stangs kyis gzigs nas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan pa yi/ /lam gyi mchog ni ma thob par/ /grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir ni slar / /nga ni 'jug par tsho1mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas byang chub 72—74

sems dpa'i zhabs la bskor ba lan gsum byas nas rang rang 0)gi gnas su song ngo ②/ /byang chub sems dpas chibs las babs te rgyan bkrol nas 'dun pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'dun pa rgyan dang rta khyer la slar song shig /'dir smras pa / kha lo sgyur khyod nga yi rta 'di dang / /rgyan 'di rnams kyang gnyen pa dag la byin/ /nga ni 'dod pa rgya chen spangs nas su/ /da lta la'adi nyid du ni rab 'byung ④bya/ /'dod pa 'di ni spu gri'i so 'dra zhing / /me 'obs 'bar dang mtshungs shing mtha' ngan padu/ /'jig rten phan phyir snying rjes nga (6)spangs te/ /dgon par song nas khyim du phyir mi ldog /de nas 'dun ⑦pa gdong la (nyamachi ma char bzhin 'bab pas byang chub sems dpa' la gsol pa/ seng ge stag gis gtams ⑨pa dang / phyugs rdzis gtams 0pa'i nags tshal du/ /'ba' tumezhig sku gnyen dang bral bas/ /'phags pa ji ltar spyod par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ skye dgu 'di ni skye na gcig pu skye/ /de bzhin 'chi na'ang gcig pu 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'di ni gcig pus sdug bsngal myong 'gyur gyi / /'khor ba la ni grogs yod ma yin no/ /'dun pas gsol pa/ kyi hud gzhon nus 8sdug bsngal ma gzigs te/ /zhabs 'jam glang chen rta la chibs (2goms pa/ /sa gzhi rtswa ④dang rdo bas gtams rtsub 57par/ /ji ltar zhabs kyis gshegs shing nags su rgyuyi/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ 'chi bdag 'jigs pa de ni lan 'ga' yang / /skyid 7la med min bde bar goms la min//mgon 8bcas la min rigs btsun la ma yin/ /dpa' dang btsun min skye bo dga' la min/ /rga bas 'chi bdag 'jigs pa dag /bskyed nas 'ong bar 'gyur zhes grag /don ma byas shing ma brtsams 37par/ /'chi bar yang ni 'gro 72—75

bar 'gyur/ 'dun pas gsol pa/ rgyal po bgres po ni sras kyi mya ngan gyis 'grongs par 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi tshogs bsags pa'i phyir 'dun 0)pa'i tshig thugs la ma bab bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas ud pa la sngon po 'dra ba'i ral gri shubs nas phyung ②nas gtsug phud ( )bregs te/ steng gi nam mkha' la bor ba dang / lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis blangs nas bkur sti chen po byas te sum cu rtsa gsum gyi dulha rnams kyi nang du khyer nas gtsug (5)phud kyi mchod pa chen po btsugs so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems te gzhon nu ni rgyal rigs kyi mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis 'di bzlog par mi nus so snyam nas dga' bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas 'dun pa la gsungs pa/ khyod kyis bsngags ldan pho brang gi nang du ma bkri 56)shig /de skad ces gsungs pa dang / 'dun pa skad 'dzer cing mig mchi mas gang nas rta'i rgyal po bsngags ldan khrid de yang dang yang du byang chub sems dpa' la lta zhing song ste ser skya'i gzhir phyin pa dang der ca co skyes te ji tsam na rgyal po zas gtsang ma la smras pa/ lha gzhon nu byon gyis ⑦dgyes pa bskyed du gsol/ grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir yang sgra gsang chen po bsgrags so/ /rta'i rgyal po bsngags ldan pho brang gi nang du zhugs pa dang /btsun mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis bsngags ldan gyi mgul du 'jus te ngu bar brtsams so/ /bsngags ldan yang dbugs khong du song ste de nyid du dus byas so/ /shi nas de sgra can (bgyi bram ze las drug la brtson pa zhig gi rigs su nying mtshams sbyor ba blangs ri noso/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rim gyis drang srong ngan spong gi bste gnas su gshegs pa dang / de'i tshe drang srong ngan spong gi bu lag pa 72—76

'gram pa la gtad 0)nas sems khong du (kyechud cing 'dug pa de lta bu de byang chub sems dpas gzigs nas gsungs pa/ drang srong chen po ci'i phyir lag pa 'gram pa la gtad nas sems khong du ②chud cing 'dug /des gsol pa/bdag gi bste gnas 'di na ④shing ta ⑤la rnams gser gyi lo ma dang / me tog dang ske/ 'bras bu chags pa las de rnams snga mkho bzhin du ma (6)gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ drang srong chen po gang gi mthus bsti gnas 'di na shing ta la rnams gser gyi lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bur ldan pa de rga ⑦ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba yang dag par mthong nas yid byung ste dka' thub kyi nags su gnas pas so/ /gal te des rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba yang dag par mthong nas yid byung ste (gyidaka' thub kyi nags su gnas par ma gyur na skyed mos tshal 'di de'i yin pa zhig /de skad ces gsungs pa dang /drang srong ngan spong gi bus byang chub sems dpa' la brtag par brtsams po)so /de nas gzugs bzang zhing zhi ba'i cha byad du mthong nas yun ring du brtags te ngo mtshar skyes nas gsol pa/ kye rab tu byung ba de khyod kho na ma lags grang /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ drang srong chen po de ltar nges so/ /de nas ngan spong 7gi bu ya mtshan skyes pa'i mig bgrad (7de bltas nas byang chub sems dpa' thog 8mar gdan la spyan drangs te/ me tog dang / 'bras bu bstabs 8so/ /grong tsokhyer dpe 8med na khyim bdag phyug pa tsodang / nor mang 3 tshol longs spyod che ba zhes bya ba nas de la khye'u bcu btsas so zhes bya ba'i bar du steX / de dag thams cad kyang rab tu byung nas rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mngon sum du byas so/ /ji tsam na ⑩bdag nyid chen po de rnams la ma rgan mos 72—77

sha na'i gos dag 4)cig byin pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ yum mkhyen par mdzod cig /rgyal po zas gtsang ( gegi sras gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa ②zhes bya ba rga ba dang / na ba dang / shi ba ci)mthong nas kun tu skyo ⑤ba'i yid kyis nags su song nas de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ de bas na bdag cag rnams sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gnas par mi nus (6)pas na bdag cag yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o / /sha na'i gos 'di rgyal po (7)zas gtsang ma'i sras la khyed byakyis phul cig /bdag nyid chen po de ni bla 1)na med pa'i ye shes thugs su chud par 'gyur la khyed kyis kyang 'bras bu chen po 'thob par 'gyur ro zhes smras nas 'bar ba dang / gsal 7ba dang / char 'bebs pa dang / glog 'byin pa'i cho 'phrul dag byas nas phung po lhag ma med 1)pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /rgan mo des kyang 'chi kur gos de dag bu mo la gtad nas ji ltar gyur pa rnams smras so/ /de'i bu mo de 8yang nad kyis thebs te 'chi bar shes nas des kyang shing drung zhig tu bzhag nas shing de la gnas pa'i lha gang yin pa de la khyod kyis 'di dag rgyal po zas gtsang gi tsosras la phul cig ces gsol ba btab bo/ /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi shes pa mthong ba ni 'og tu 'jug pa yin pas des de dag shes nas blangs te/de nas rngon pa rgas 'khogs 8pa lta bu zhig tu bdag nyid mngon par sprul nas de dag bgos te/ lag pa la mda' gzhu thogs nas byang chub sems dpa' gshegs pa'i lam kur mabasdad pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' ⑩yang rim gyis lam der byon nas rngon pa lag na mda' gzhu thogs shing gos ngur 0smig 72—78

gyon pa zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang mi de la gsungs pa/ kye 6)nang rje sha na'i gos 'o ni ②dag ni rab tu byung ba la 'tsham pa ①yin gyis (geka shi ma'i ras phran 'di dag khyer (snyel 'o ni dag nga la byin cig /des gsol pa/ gzhon nu bdag la gzhan dag khyod kyis rgyal bu gzhon nu bgrongs nas ka shi ma'i ras phran gyi gos 'di dag blangs so zhes gzhi des g.yar 'chi bar 'gyur lags pas bdag 'di dag mi 'bul lo/ /byang chub sems dpas 6)gsungs pa/ kye nang rje nga ni mthu ji ⑦lta bu dang ldan pa 'jig rten thams cad kyis shes te su zhig gis nga bkrongs 6)par nus/ khyod kyis nga bkrongs par su zhig yid ches kyis 6)bag tsha ba med par byin cig /de nas lha rnoms kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs gnyis la gtugs nas sha na'i gos dag phul te ka ⑩shi ku'i ras phran 0rnams blangs so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sku dang sha na'i gos dag 'tsham par ma gyur pa tsodang / de 'di snyam du dgongs te kye ma'o sha na'i gos rnams bdag gi sku dang 'tsham par gyur cig snyam nas tshig smras ma thag tu sha na'i gos de dag 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i mthu dang / lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus byang chub sems dpa'i sku dang 'tsham par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ da ⑩ni bdag rab tu byung zin gyis 'gro ba rnams rjes su gzung bar bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' mthar gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang rgyal po'i khab tu byon to/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzo'i ciganas dang / las kyi gnas de ⑫dang de rnams la mkhas pa yin pas des shing ka ra bī yira'i lo ma las lhung bzed ⑩byas nas spyod lam zhi bas rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs so/ /72—79

de'i tshe rgyal po gzugs can snying po steng gi khang bzangs kyi gzhi na ①'dug pa des 'gro ba dang / ldog pa dang / lta ba dang / rnam par lta ba dang /bskum pa dang / brkyang ba dang / chos gos snam ②sbyar dang / lhung bzed thogs pa mdzes pas bsod snyoms spyod pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ rgyal po'i khab na rab tu byung ba ji snyed cig gnas pa la rab tu byung ba 'di'i spyod lam de lta bu ni 'ga' yang med do snyam mo/ /'dir smras pate/ ji ltar mig can 'gro ba ltar/ /rab tu byung ba bsgrags par byas/ /'dis ni brtag par mdzad nas su/ /rab tu byung ba yang dag bzhed/ /khyim gnas 'di ni sdug bsngal te/ /'di ni rdul gyi gnas yin zhing / /rab tu byung ba bar snang ltar/ /mkhyen nas de tshe rab tu byung / /rab tu byung nas sku yis ni / /sdig pa'i las ni spangs pa dang / gsung gi sdig pa spangs nas ni/ /'tsho ba kun nas dag par mdzad/ /de nas ma ga dhā ①yi ni/ /grong mchog rgyal po'i khab gshegs nas/ /mgon po shes bzhin dran ldan pa/ /bsod snyoms phyir ni gshegs pa der/ /bzo sbyangs ma ga dhā yi ④bdag /khang bzangs ⑤'di na 'dug pas mthong / /mthong nas sems dang de nas ni/ /blon po rnams la 'di skad smras/ /mtshan mchog gis ni rgyas gyur cing / / kho lag ⑥phun sum tshogs pa dang / /gnya' shing gang du lta ba yi/ /'di la shes ldan dag ltos shig /spyan mi 'deg (7la yid gzhungs ⑧shing / /dman pa'i rigs las ma 'khrungs 'di/ /gang du gnas par gshegs 'gyur ba/ /rgyal pos pho nya rjes bzhin btang / /de nas pho nya la bsgo ba/ /dge slong de ni gar 'gro zhing —/ /gang du gnas ni btab pa yi/ /rjes bzhin du ni 'brang bar gyisaX/ /72—80

de ni bsod snyoms gshegs pa na/ /sgo drug legs par bsdams nas ni/ /shes bzhin dran dang ldan pa yis/ /lhung bzed 0)myur du gang bar mdzad/ /bsod snyoms spyad ②pa byas nas kyang / /thub pa grong khyer phyir byung nas/ /skya bseng la ni mngon gshegs te/ /de la gnas ni btab par gyur③/ /gnas btab pa ni shes nas kyang / /pho nya gcig gis bsdad byas nas/ /gzhan ni myur du slar log ste/ /rgyal po la ni tshig smras pa/ /rgyal po chen po dge slong de / /seng ge'am stag gi phru gu dag /ri (7sul dag na (snyeganas pa ltar/ /skya bseng gi ni steng na gnas/ /pho nya rnams kyi tshig thos nas/ /sa bdag shing rtar stizhugs nas ni/ /de ni blon pos yongs bskor nas/ /myur ba kho nar dong bar gyur/ /bzhon ⑦pas bgrod pa'i sar zhon te/ /de ni bzhon pa la babs nas/ /rkang gis nye bar song nas (nyeni/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ske/ /rgyal po 'dug nas dgyes pa dang / /mgu bar 'gyur ba'i gtam gsol nas/ /de ni ma khengs mi brlang bar/ /don 'di dag ni rab smras so/ /dge slong lang tsho 6)dang po la/ /bab par yang dag gnas gyur cing / /'di 'dra gzi brjid ldan pa la/ /bsod snyoms spyod par mdzes ma lags/ /khang pa nyams dga' dag dang ni/ /bud med rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /longs spyod mchog ni khyod gsol na/ /nyid kyi gdung ni zhu yis ⑩gsungs/ /rgyal po gangs 7ri nye ba na/ /yul gyi ljongs ni nor dag dang / /'bru dag gis ni gang gyur pa/ /ko sa la zhes grags pa yod/ /bu ram shing pa nyi ma'i rus/ /shākya dag ni de na gnas/ /rgyal po nga ni rgyal rigs te/ /nga ni 'dod pa'i tsodon mi gnyer / /sa 'di ri dang bcas shing rgya mtshor bcas/ /rin chen kun dang 72—81

ldan pa 'byor gyur kyang / /mi ni nams kyang 6)ngoms par mi 'gyur te/ / so ga (mitsha dus shing gi mi (mibazhin no/ /'dod pa rnams ni sha khon 'brel ces gsungs / /mi dbang rgal ④bar dka' ⑤zhing 'dam rdzab 'drarjo/ /sdug bsngal dang ni mya ngan 'jigs pa yi/ /rtsa stiba'i gtso ste blo ngan rnams kyis bsten/ /rgyal po ngas ni byung ma thag gtu yang / /'dod pa rnams la mi dga'i blo bskyed nam/ /'jigs byed chos kyi dgra bor gyur pa dag /bor ba de ko ⑨slar yang ci ltar blang / /rtse 7mo sna tshogs yangs par gyur pa yi/ /lhun po gangs can rlung gis bskyod srid kyi/ /nga yi blo ni thar pa la rten pa/ /'dod pa'i shugs ⑩kyis bskyod par mi nus so/ /'jig rten 'di ni 'dod par bying gyur nas/ /'khor ba'i 'khor los yongs su 'khyam pa la/ /mi dbang nga skyabs yin te gzhan med pas/ /'jigs pa che las de ni thar bar bya/ /'dod pa rnams kyi nyes dmigs mkhyen/ /mya ngan 'das pa zhi ba gzigs/ /spang phyir gang du nga yi yid/ /dga' ba dag tu 'gro 8bar bya/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos gsol pa/ kye rab tu byung ba brtul zhugs 'dis ci zhig don du gnyer/ des gsungs pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ kye rab tu byung ba gang gi tshe khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur pa de'i tshe bdag la yang dgongs shig /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ de bzhin du bsam par bya'o zhes gsungs nas rgyal po'i khab nas byung ste bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri dang ha cang yang mi ring bar drang srong rnams kyi bste 8gnas der gshegs so/ /de nas spyod pa dang gnas pas bsam gtan la brtson par gnas te/ de rnams 72—82

gang gi tshe rkang pa gcig gis nyin thun gcig 'greng ba de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' thun gnyis su bzhugs so/ /gal te de rnams gdung ba lnga'i sbyor ①bas nyin thun gcig 'dug pa de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas kyang sbyor ba des thun gnyis su bzhugs so/ /de nas de rnams ya mtshan (miskyes nas dge sbyong 'di ni chen po zhig go zhes smras pa/ dge sbyong chen po dge sbyong chen po zhes bya bar gyur to / /byang chub sems dpas de rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed brtul zhugs (mi'adis ci zhig don du gnyer/ /de na ④kha cig gis gsol pa/ brgya byin nyid do/ /kha cig gis (snyegasol pa/ bdag cag ni tshangs pa nyid do/ /kha cig gis gsol pa/ bdag cag ni bdud nyid do/ /byang chub sems dpas dgongs payi/ drang srong 'di dag ni slar yang ltung ba/ lam log par zhugs ⑦pa'o / /lam 'di ni shes par nus pa dum yin/ mthong bar nus pa ma yin/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub par nus pa ma yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas (7lam de nyid nus pa med par mkhyen nas/ sgyu ⑩rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur gang na ba der gshegs te byon pa dang / sgyu yirtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /ring 'phur gal te khyod la mi bde ba 8med na khyod kyi drung du kho bo tshangs par spyod pa spyad do/ /des smras pal/ tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma 8bdag la mi bde ba med kyis ④ci bde ba kho nar bzhugs shig /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ ring 'phur khyod kyis chos ji snyed cig rang gi mngon par shes pas rtogs par gyur/ des gsol pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gi 7ta ma ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi bar du'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur dad 72—83

pa de la ni nga yang dad la/ sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ①ring 'phur la brtson 'grus dang dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab yod pa ②ltar bdag la yang brtson 'grus dang dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab yod pas sgyu rtsal shes kyi ((bu ring 'phur gyis ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi bar gyi chos de snyed mngon sum du byas te/ ci'i phyir bdag gis kyang chos 'di dag mngon sum du mi bya snyam nas de nas byang chub sems dpas (gechos de rnams kho na ma thob pa thob par bya ba'i phyir dang / ma rtogs pa rtogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / mngon sum du ma byas pa mngon sum du bya ba'i 55)phyir dang / gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa rtun pa (6)dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid gtod par gnas te/ gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa/ rtun pa ⑦dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid gtod par gnas pa na ring po mi thogs pa (8)kho nar chos de dag mngon sum du mdzad par gyur to/ /chos de mngon sum du mdzad nas yang sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /ring 'phur khyod kyis ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi bar gyi chos 'di dag rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum du byas sam des 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gau ta ma mad 6)de bdag gis ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi bar gyi chos de dag mngon sum du byas so/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ tshe dang ldan pa ring 'phur bdag gis kyang ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi bar gyi chos de dag rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum du byas so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma de ltar na khyod kyi ji tsam pa bdag gi yang de tsam la / bdag gi ji tsam pa khyod kyi yang de tsam pas don 'di la 'o skol mtshungs 72—84

shing mnyam ①ste 'dra bar thos kyis ②tshur spyon/ 'o skol gnyi gas la'akhor 'di yongs su drang bar bgyi'o/ /de nas sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur byang chub sems dpa'i thog ma'i slob dpon nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' la rjed pa'i dam pas rjed cing mchod pa'i dam pas mchod do/ /de'i rtogs pa dag la yang dga' ba dang / mgu bar gyur to/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ lam 'di ni shes par nus pa ma yin/ mthong bar nus pa ma yin / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par ④byang chub par nus pa ma yin no snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas lam ⑤de nus pa med par rig nas/rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /lhag spyod gal te khyod la mi bde ba med na khyod kyi drung du tshangs par spyod pa spyad do/ /des gsol pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma bdag la mi bde ba med kyis 0khyod ci bde ba kho nar bzhugs shig /khyod kyis chos ji snyed cig mngon sum du byas/ tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma ⑦'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched kyi bar du'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' du'adi snyam du dgongs te/ rangs byed kyi bu 0lhag spyod dad pa la ni bdag kyang dad la/ rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang ske/ ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab yod pa lta bu'i ⑩brtson 'grus dang /dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab ni bdag la yod na rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod kyis 'du ⑩shes med 'du shes med min skye mched kyi bar gyi 8chos 'di snyed cig mngon sum du byas na 8bdag gis kyang chos 'di dag ci'i phyir mngon sum du mi bya snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas chos de rnams kho na 72—85

ma thob pa thob par bya ba'i phyir dang / ma rtogs pa rtogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / mngon sum du ma byas pa mngon sum du bya ba'i phyir gcig pu dben pa/bag yod pa rtun pa dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid gtod par gnas te/ gcig pu dben par bag yod pa bdag nyid gtod 0)par gnas pa na ②ring po mi (5)thogs pa kho nar chos de mngon sum du mdzad (gepar gyur to/ /chos de mngon sum du mdzad nas rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod gang na ba der gshegs te byon pa dang /rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /lhag spyod khyod kyis 'du ri5)shes med 'du shes med min skye mched kyi bar du chos 'di dag rang gis mngon sum du byas sam/ tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma mad spyilags te/ bdag gis 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched kyi bar gyi chos 'di dag mngon sum du bgyis so/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ tshe dang ldan pa lhag spyod bdag gis kyang 'du nyushes med 'du shes med min skye mched kyi bar gyi chos ci ci'adi dag rang gis ri mngon sum du byas so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma de ltar na khyod kyi ji tsam pa bdag gi yang de tsam la/ bdag gi ji 5)tsam pa khyod kyi yang de tsam pas don 'di la 'o skol mtshungs shing mnyam ste 'dra bar thos kyis 'itshur spyon / 'o skol gnyi gas 9/7tshogs 'di yongs su drang bar bgyi'o/ /de nas rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod byang chub sems dpa'i thog ma'i slob dpon gyis byang chub sems dpa' la rjed pa dam pas rjed cing mchod pa'i tshudam pas mchod do/ /de'i shes pa rnams la yang dga' ba dang mgu bar gyur tunyeto/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas 'di snyam du dgongs te/ lam 'di ni shes par nus pa ma yin/mthong bar nus pa ma yin/ bla na med pa yang dag ④par rdzogs par 7byang chub 72—86

par nus pa ma yin no snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas lam de yang nus pa med par rig nas gshegs so/ /de nas sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur gyi 'khor gsum dang / rangs 6)byed kyi bu lhag spyod kyi 'khor gnyis te drang srong lnga byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su 'brangs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lnga po dang lhan cig gang gā'i lho phyogs na lteng rgyas 'od srung ②gi sde'i grong rdal gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs te byon nas de phan tshun 'chag pa na phyogs dga' dga' ltar 'dug pa/ nags tshang (kyitshing mdzes pa/ chu klung nai rañja dhinā bsil bar 'bab pa/ gse gu can 'jug ngogs bde zhing mtha' rgya che la gsing ⑤ma sngon po dang / shing sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dga' dga' ltar 'dug pa zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang 'di snyam du dgongs te/ kye ma'o sa phyogs 'di ni dga' dga' ltar 'dug pa nags tshang tshing mdzes pa chu klung nai rañja yinā bsil bar 'bab pa/ gse gu can 'jug ngogs bde zhing mtha' rgya che la gsing ( )ma sngon po dang / shing sna tshogs kyis brgyan (8)pa dga' dga' ltar 'dug pa zhig ste/ kye ma spong ba don du gnyer ba'i rigs kyi bus nags khrod 'dir brten na spong ba 6)bya bar nus so/ /bdag spong ba don du gnyer ba yin pas/ ma la bdag gis kyang nags khrod 'dir rten bol spang bar (lhabya'o snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nags khrod du zhugs te shing gi drung du zhugs tshunas/ tshems la tshems gtad/ ljags rkan 7la bcar nas/thugs kyis thugs mngon du bzung / mngon du bsdams/ shin tu mngon du bsdams so/ /de thugs kyis thugs mngon du bzung / mngon du bsdams shin ⑩ tu mngon du bsdams pas8/ ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas rngul byung bar gyur 72—87

te / dper na mi stobs dang ldan pas mi stobs shin tu chung ba zhig phyin ka ①log tu bcings/ri/ mngon du bsdams(gu/ shin tu mngon du bsdams na de'i ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas rngul byung ba de bzhin du de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' tshems ri4)la tshems gtad/ ljags rkan ⑤la bcar te/ thugs kyis thugs mngon du bzung / mngon du bsdams/ shin tu mngon du bsdams pa la sogs pa ni snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par bya'o snyam mo/ /des rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par brtsams te/ des rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na/ zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags 56)so/ /de'i zhal dang shangs nas dbugs ⑦zub pa dang 'byung ba bgags (8༄pa dang / rlung thams cad spyi bo'i nang 6)du song nas de'i dbu la ⑩dbu'i tshor ba shin tu mi bzad 4)pa skyes so/ /dper na mi stobs dang ldan pas mi stobs shin tu chung ba'i spyi bor 'ilcags kyi phur pa rnon po btab na/ de'i mgo la mgo'i tshor ba shin tu mi bzad 8pa skye ba de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bam pa'i bsam cigatan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na/ dbu la dbu'i tshor ba shin tu mi bzad gepa skyes kyang de zhum pa ma yin gyi/ brtson 'grus brtsams pa 8yin/ sku ma sbyangs pa ma yin gyi sbyangs pa yin⑩/ rmugs pa ma yin gyi dran pa nye bar gzhag tu)pa yin te/ sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag 4tshepa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' sdug bsngal drag po mi bzad 3pa rtsub pa tsha ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba de lta bu nyams su myong yang 0'di ltar sku 72—88

bsgoms pa yin pa'i phyir thugs yongs su gtugs te mi gnas so/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis lhag par rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par bya'o snyam mo/ /des lhag par rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par brtsams te/ de rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan 0)dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na/ zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang / 'byung ba bgags (gyiso/ /de'i (7zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang / 'byung ba bgags ④pas rlung thams cad snyan gnyis kyi bu ga nas rgyus par gyur to/ /dper na mgar (5)bas sbud pa bus na rlung thams cad kyi rgyun grwa phyoganyis kyi bu ga nas rgyu ba de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bam pa'i bsam rtsigatan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na/ rlung thams cad kyi rgyun snyan gnyis kyi bu ga nas rgyus par gyur kyang de zhum pa ma yin gyi/ brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis lhag par yang rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par bya'o snyam mo/ /des lhag ⑧par rnam par bam pa'i bsam 6)gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par brtsams te/ de rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na/zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags so/ /de'i zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags pas phyal gyi nang thams cad rgyas par gyur/ shin tu rgyas par gyur te/ dper na mgar ba mkhas pas ⑩sbud pa bus na (nyugang bar gyur/ shin tu gang bar gyur pa de bzhin du de'i tshe/byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs 72—89

pa na phyal gyi tsho1nang thams cad rgyas par gyur/ shin tu rgyas par gyur kyang de zhum pa ma yin gyi/ brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis rnam par bam pa'i bsam (5)gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par bya'o snyam mo/ /des lhag par rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par brtsams te( ri/ de rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na/ zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags so / /de'i zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags pa dang /de'i tshe dbu la dbu'i tshor ba shin tu mi bzad ④pa skyes so/ /dper na mi stobs dang ldan pas mi stobs shin tu chung ba'i mgo phreng bas yang nas yang du bcings na / de'i mgo la mgo'i tshor ba shin tu mi bzad (5)pa skye ba de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par ⑥zhugs pa na/ dbu ri skul dbu'i tshor ba shin ⑧ku mi bzad 5dpa skyes 7kyang de zhum pa ma yin gyi brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni snga ma bzhin no / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par bya'o snyam mo / /de lhag par rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par brtsams te/ des rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags 17so/ /de'i zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags pa dang / de'i tshe sna khong du khong gi tshor ba mi bzad 8pa skyes so/ /dper na ba lang gi shan 8pa 72—90

mkhas pa'am/ ba lang gi shan 0)pa'i slob ma mkhas pas ba lang bsad pa'i gri rnon pos ba lang gi lto dral na de'i khong du khong gi tshor ba shin tu mi bzad (kyepa skye ba ②de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na khong du khong gi tshor ba shin tu mi bzad pa skyes kyang de zhum pa ma yin gyi brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni 6)snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de 'di snyam du dgongs te ma la bdag gis rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag (5)la snyoms par 'jug par bya'o snyam mo/ /de lhag par rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par brtsams te/ des (5)rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags so/ /de'i gzhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags pa na (kyede'i tshe sku la sku'i gdung ba shin tu mi bzad pa skyes so/ /dper na mi shin tu stobs dang ldan pa gnyis kyis mi stobs shin tu chung ba zhig phyin ka 6)log tu bzung ste me dong gi nang du sbyangs ⑩na/ de'i lus la lus kyi gdung ba shin tu mi bzad pa skye ba de bzhin du de'i tshe (7byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na sku la sku'i gdung 8ba shin tu mi bzad pa skyes kyang de zhum pa ma yin gyi brtson 'grus 7brtsams pa yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis thams cad kyi thams cad du zas mi bza' ba bsgrub par bya'o snyam mo / /de nas ④lha rab tu mang po'i sems kyis byang chub sems dpa'i thugs shes nas byang chub sems dpa' gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas byang chub sems 72—91

dpa' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po gal te khyod mi'i kha zas kyis 'jom 6)par mdzad/ ngo (5)tsha bar mdzad/ smod par mdzad na/ bdag cag gis khyod kyi ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas lha'i mdangs bsgrub par bgyis nikhyod kyis bdag gir mdzod cig /de nas byang ༷chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te / gal te bdag gis mi'i kha zas mi bza' ⑤bar dam bcas la bdag gi ba spu'i khung bu thams cad du lha rnams kyis lha'i mdangs bsgrubs nas de bdag gir byed pa ni bdag gi brdzun 55)yin la/ bdag gi brdzun rtsigang yin pa de ni bdag gi log pa yin no/ /bdag gi log pa gang yin pa de'i rkyen gyis ni 'di na (kyesems can kha cig lus zhig ste shi nas ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar ⑨'gyur gyis ⑩ma la bdag gis yilha rnams kyi tshig ni thams cad kyi thams cad du spangs la 8kha zas nyung ba dang 'acung zad chang chung bza' ba 'am yang na mon sran sde'u yi khu ba'amacha/ 'on te rgya sran gyi khu ba'am/ yang na ha re nu ku'i 'bras bu'i khu ba btung ngo snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas de'i tshe lha rnams kyi tshig thams cad kyi thams cad du spangs nas zhal zas nyung ba dang / chung ba dang / cung 8zad dang / chang chung gsol ba'am/ yang na mon sran sde'u byayi khu ba'am/ 'on te rgya sran gyi khu ba'am / yang na ha re nu ku'i 'bras bu'i khu ba ⑩gsol lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' zhal zas nyung ba ba dang / chung ba dang / cung 8zad dang /chang chung gsol ba na/ yan lag dang / nying lag thams cad kun tu (rtezhum ste/ skam zhing sku dpal chung bar gyur to/ /dper na sdum 0bu a ( nyasi ta'i sdong bu dang / ka li ku'i sdong bu 'jumatso/ kun tu 'jum pas sha chung zhing 72—92

skams ①par gyur pa de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' zhal zas nyung ba dang ske/ chung ba dang / cung ②zad dang / chang chung gsol ba na/ yan lag dang —/ nying lag thams cad zhum/ kun tu zhum ste/ skem zhing sku dpal chung bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de'i tshe zhal zas nyung ba dang /chung ba dang / cung chazad dang ④/ chang chung gsol ba na/ dbu la dbu'i pags ⑤pa rnyings kun tu rnyings te/ 'khums shing 'bar 'bur du gyur to/ /dper na ku yib rtsa ba nas bcad na/ rnyis kun tu rnyis pas 'khums la 'bar 'bur du gyur pa de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' zhal zas nyung ba dang —/ chung ba dang / cung zad dang / chang chung gsol ba na/ dbu la dbu'i pags ⑦pa nyis kun tu rnyis te 'khums shing 'bar 'bur du gyur kyang de zhum pa ma yin te/ brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ zhal zas nyung ba dang / chung ba dang / cung 98)zad dang / chang chung gsol ba na/ spyan gnyis kyi spyan gyi 'bras bu phug tu song zhing shin tu phug tu song ste zab pa shin tu zab par ring du song bas phyung ba lta bur snang ngo / /dper na khron pa zab mo'i chur skar ma'i gzugs brnyan 99)phug tu song zhing shin tu phug tu song ste/ zab pa shin tu zab par ring du song bar gtam du bya ba de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' zhal zas nyung ba dang / chung ba dang /cung 0zad dang / chang chung gsol ba na/ spyan gnyis kyi spyan gyi 'bras bu phug tu song / shin tu phug tu song ste/ zab pa shin tu zab par ring du song bas phyung ba lta bur snang yang de zhum pa ma yin gyi brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin zhes 72—93

bya ba la sogs pa ni snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' zhal zas nyung ba dang / chung ba dang / cung 1)zad dang / chang chung gsol ba na/de'i tshe rtsib ma'i bar mtho ( dman can du gyur te/ dper na rtswa khang lo gnyis sam gsum lon pa'i phyam dgu bo mtho ①dman du gyur pa de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' zhal zas nyung ba dang / chung ba dang / cung gzad dang /chang chung gsol ba na/ rtsib ma'i bar mtho (5)dman can du gyur kyang de zhum pa ma yin gyi brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa rnams ni snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' zhal zas nyung ba dang / chung ba dang / cung (6)zad dang / chang chung gsol ba na/ sgal pa'i ⑦tshigs 'di lta ste/ skra'i lan bu lta bur gyur to/ /mjug do ni 'di lta ste/ rnga mo'i rkang pa lta bur gyur to/ /de lan 'ga' ldang bar 'dod na kha sbub tu 'gyel la/lan 'ga' 'dug par 'dod na gan rgyal du 'gyel lo/ /de ⑧ro stod la brten ⑨nas ro smad 'jog par byed/ ro smad la brten tsonas ro bstod 'jog par byed do / /de phyag gnyis kyis sku la byugs te/ de'i phyag gnyis kyis sku la byugs yongs su byugs pa de'i tshe ba spu rnams drung rul bas sa la lhags par gyur to/ /hu spede nas byang chub sems dpa' de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis til 'bru gcig mgis zas bza' bar bya'o zhes te des til 'bru gcig gi zas gsol to/ /de til 'bru gcig gi zas gsol ba na yan lag dang nying lag thams cad zhum kun tu zhum ste/ skem zhing sku dbal chung bar gyur to/ /til 'bru gcig gis ji lta bar 'bras bu gcig dang / sran go til 'bru gcig dang /rgya sran 'bru gcig dang / mon sran gre'u 'bru gcig dang / mon sran sde'u 7 dzi——— 94

'bru gcig dang / rtswa'i gding 6)ba la mnal bar mdzad do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis dka' ba ②spyod pa'i gnas skabs de thos nas nyi ma re re zhing rtog ⑧pa nyis brgya lnga bcu gtong bar byed do/ /rgyal po ④legs par rab sad kyis kyang nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/ /de dag nyi ma re re zhing de gnyis la myur ba myur bar gtam skyel bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni 'di 'dra ba'i dka' ba spyod de(5)/ /til 'bru gcig dang / 'bras 'bru 6)gcig dang / sran go la 'bru gcig dang / rgya sran 'bru gcig dang / mon sran 3)gre'u 'bru gcig dang /mon sran sde'u 'bru gcig gi zas gsol zhing rtswa'i (8)gding ba la mnal to zhes smra'o / /de rgyal po zas gtsang gis thos nas bu'i mya ngan gyis non pas lhag par dang ka na zhing khyimig mchi mas ⑩brnangs te gdungs nas btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas par rtswa'i gding ba la nyal bar byed do/ /grags 'dzin mas kyang de thos pa dang / khyim thab kyi mya ngan gyis non skyuto/ /til 'bru gcig za ba dang —/ de'i rum mi bde ba de nyid du zhu bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te lam 'di yang shes par nus pa ma yin/mthong bar nus pa ma yin/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par byang chub par nus pa ma yin no snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ /ma la bdag gis kha zas shin tu ngan pa bza' bar bya'o snyam ste des kha zas shin tu ngan pa gsol bar mdzad do/ /de la zas phal pa ni 'di yin te be'u byung nas ring po ma lon pa'i 'o ma 'thung ba gang yin pa de rnams kyi gcin dang lci ba yin no/ /de ji srid de'i sku las mdangs de yal bar ma gyur pa de srid du zas gnyis pa mi gsol te⑩/ yal nas kha zas phyi ma gsol bar 72—95
