'phags pa'i bden pa dang / sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba dang / sdug bsngal 'gog pa dang / sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa'o / /sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa gang zhe na/ skye ba sdug bsngal ba hunyedang ske/ rga ba sdug bsngal ba dang / na ba sdug bsngal ba dang / 'chi ba sdug bsngal ba dang / sdug pa dang bral ba sdug bsngal ba dang / mi sdug pa dang phrad pa sdug bsngal ba dang / gang 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed pa de yang sdug bsngal ba dang —/ mdor ②na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sdug bsngal ba ste/ de yongs su shes parngo dubya ba'i phyir 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bsgom par bya'o/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa gang zhe na/ yang srid pa'i sred ④pa dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang ldan pa de dang de la mngon par 'dod pa ste/de spang ba'i phyir 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bsgom par bya'o/ /sdug bsngal 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa gang zhe na/ yang srid pa'i sred pa dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang ldan pa de dang de la mngon par dga' ba gang yin pa de nyid ma lus par spangs pa dang / bor ba dang / bsal ba dang / zad pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / 'gags pa dang / nye bar zhi ba dang nub pa ste de mngon sum du bya ba'i phyir 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bsgom par bya'o/ /sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa gang zhe na/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ste/ 'di lta ste/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtog pa dang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin 72—145

te de yang bsgom par bya'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi ①rgya len pa med par zag pa las sems rnam par grol lo/ /lnga sde'i dge slong lhag ma rnams la ni chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral 97ba skyes so/ /de'i tshe 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa gcig dang gnyis pa ni bcom ldan 'das so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang dge slong lnga sde'i lhag ma rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gzugs ni bdag ma yin rnam/ /dge slong dag gal te gzugs bdag yin na gzugs la gnod pa dang sdug bsngal bar mi 'gyur zhing / gzugs la bdag gi gzugs 'di lta bur gyur cig 'di lta bur ma gyur cig snyam na yang 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag gang gi phyir gzugs bdag ma yin pa de'i phyir gzugs la gnod pa dang sdug bsngal bar 'gyur zhing gzugs la bdag gi gzugs 'di lta bur gyur cig /'di lta bur ma gyur cig snyam pa yang 'thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag tshor ( dab dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa ni bdag ma yin no/ /dge slong dag gal te rnam par shes pa bdag yin na rnam par shes pa la gnod pa dang sdug bsngal bar mi 'gyur zhing / rnam par shes pa la bdag gi rnam par shes pa 'di lta bur gyur cig /'di lta bur ma gyur cig snyam na yang 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag gang gi phyir rnam par shes pa bdag ma yin pa de'i phyir rnam par shes pa la gnod pa dang / sdug bsngal bar 'gyur zhing rnam par shes pa la bdag gi rnam par shes pa 'di lta bur gyur cig /'di lta bur ma gyur cig snyam na yang 'thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ gzugs rtag gam mi rtag /btsun pa mi rtag lags so/ /mi rtag 72—146

pa gang yin pa de sdug bsngal yin nam sdug bsngal ma yin/ btsun pa sdug bsngal ba ①lags so/ /mi rtag pa sdug bsngal ba rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos can gang yin pa de la ci ga 'phags pa nyan thos thos ②pa dang ldan pa de ⑧la 'di ni bdag go④/ /bdag ni 'di yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi bdag go zhes bdag tu khas len tam/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa rtag gam mi rtag /btsun pa mi rtag lags so/ /mi rtag pa gang yin pa de sdug bsngal yin nam/ sdug bsngal ma yin/ btsun pa sdug bsngal lags so/ /mi rtag pa sdug bsngal ba rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos can gang yin pa de la ci ga ⑤'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa 'di ni bdag go/ /bdag ni 'di yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi 6)bdag go zhes bdag tu khas len tam/ btsun pa ma lags so/dge slong dag de lta bas na gzugs gang yin pa de ci yang rung ba 'das pa'am/ma 'ongs pa'am/ da ltar byung ba'am/ nang gi'am/ phyi'i 'am/ rags pa'am / phra ba'am/ ngan pa'am/ gya rnam ⑦pa'am/ gang dag thag ring ba'am / gang dag thag nye ba de dag thams cad ni bdag ma yin/ bdag ni de ma yin de ni bdag gi bdag ma yin no zhes ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis blta bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na tshor nib dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa ji snyed pa gang ci yang rung ba 'das pa'am/ ma 'ongs pa'am/ da ltar byung ba'am/ nang gi'am/phyi'i 'am/ rags pa'am/ phra ba'am/ ngan pa'am/ gya rnam ⑨pa'am/gang dag thag ring ba'am/ gang dag thag nye ba de dag thams cad ni bdag ma 72—147

yin / bdag ni de ma yin/ de ni bdag gi bdag ma yin no zhes ji lta ba de bzhin du yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis blta bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag 'di ltar 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa ni nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po 'di bdag ma yin bdag gi ma yin par lta ste/ de de ltar lta ba na 'jig rten na yonyeci yang len pa med do/ /len pa med pa na yongs su gdung ba med do/ /yongs su gdung ba med na bdag nyid yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa ste bdag gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa la bsten (0to/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na lnga sde'i dge slong lhag ma rnams kyis len pa med par zag pa las sems rnam par grol lo/ /de'i tshe dgra bcom pa lnga dang drug pa ni bcom ldan 'das so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bā rā ṇa sī'i (mi'abab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe bā rā ṇa sī lin rigs kyi gtso bo zhes bya ba'i bu grags pa zhes bya ba zhig gnas te/ de nyi ma re re zhing bud med kyis byas pa'i rol mos rtse bar byed/ dga' dgur ri spyod par byed pas lus snyom 6)lus dub/lus rgud pas myur du gnyid log par gyur to/ /bud med de rnams kyang lus snyomadzo / lus dub/ lus rgyad pas gnyid log par gyur to/ /rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa mtshan mo gnyid sad pa na bud med de dag thams cad brdol zhing sgren gshemor byung la skra zhig /lag pa brkyang 5)ste byung rgyal du bla ba mthong ngo //mthong nas kyang de dag gis 7chung ma la dur khrod kyi 'du shes skyes par gyur to/ /de nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa ma la chen po las ⑩babs te/ rin po che'i lham brgya stong ri ba zung cig 5)gyon nas nyal khang gi sgo gang tson ba der song 72—148

ste / phyin nas grogs po bdag ni gtses ①so/ /grogs po bdag ni nyams so zhes skad ngan phyung ba dang / de'i sgo mi ma yin pa rnams kyis phye nas skad kyang mi grag par byas so/ /de nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa khyim gang na ba der song ste phyin nas grogs po bdag ni gtses ②so/ /grogs po bdag ni nyams so zhes skad ngan phyung ①ba dang / de'i sgo mi ma yin pa rnams kyis phye nas skad kyang mi grag par byas so/ /de nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa grong khyer gyi sgo gang na ba der song ①ste phyin nas grogs po bdag ni gtses so/ /grogs po bdag ni nyams so zhes skad ngan phyibyung ba dang / de'i sgo mi ma yin pa rnams kyis phye nas skad kyang mi grag par byas so/ /de nas rigs kyi ⑥gtso bo'i bu grags pa 'bab chu gnod pa can de gang ⑦na ba der song ba na/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram na gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol bla gab med pa na rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa 'ong ba la yang dang yang du bzhengs shing 'chag pas 'chag go/ /rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pas bcom ldan 'das 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram na 'chag pa rgyang niring po nas mthong ngo /mthong nas kyang dge sbyong bdag ni gtses so/ /dge sbyong bdag ni nyams so zhes skad ngan phyung ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gzhon nu tshur shog /gnas 'di ni khyod la 'tshe ba med pa yin/ 'di ni nyams pa med pa yin no/ /de nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa rin po che'i lham brgya stong ri ba zung cig 0po 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram du phud nas 'bab chu gnod pa can rgal 0te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs 72—149

gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa khrid de nyid kyi gtsug lag khang gang na ba der gshegs nas byon pa dang gdan 1༄bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs (gebastod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi (khuthog ma'i dus su chos kyi gtam gleng ba gang yin pa 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i gtam dang / tshul khrims kyi gtam dang /mtho ris kyi gtam dang / 'dod pa rnams la mnog chung zhing nyes dmigs dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / nges par byung ba dang / rab tu dben ri pa'i rjes su bsngags (pepa dang / rnam par byang ba'i phyogs kyi chos rnams rgya cher bshad do/ /gang gi tshe de bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' ba'i sems dang / dge ba'i sems dang / mgu ba'i sems dang /sgrib pa dang bral ba'i sems dang / skal ba dang ldan pa dang / yang dag phul gyi chos bshad na shes par nus par gzigs pa de'i tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 55)yang dag phul gyi chos bshad pa gang yin pa 'di lta ste 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po sdug bsngal ba dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang —/ lam de /rgya cher bshad do/ /dper na gos gtsang ma nag nog med pa tshon rtsi 'os pa'i nang du bcug na tshon brtsi legs par 'dzin skyudu btub 7pa de bzhin du rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po nyurte'adi lta ste/ sdug bsngal ba dang / kun 'byung tsob dang /72—150

'gog pa dang / lam rtogs so/ /de nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa chos mthong ba dang / chos thob ①pa dang / chos rig pa dang / chos kyi gting slebs pa dang / som nyi las rgal ba dang / the tshom las rgal ba dang /gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang / gzhan gyis (mimi bkri ①ba dang / ston pas bstan pa'i chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob nas stan stilas langs te bla gos phrag pa ⑤gcig tu gzar nyanas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de (7logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /bdag bcom ldan 'das dang ske/ chos dang / dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi (8)lags kyis 6)bdag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so/ /bran mo zhig de nyid kyi mtshan mo gnyid log pa las sad na/ gzhon nu grags pa mal chen po na mi snang bar mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo yigang na ba der song ste phyin nas khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /jo bo mkhyen par mdzod cig /gzhon nu grags pa ni rang gi mal chen po na mi gda' lags so/ /de nas khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo 'di snyam du sems te/gzhon nu nor gyi phyir chom rkun nam/ g.yon can rnams kyis 7phyi rol tu khrid par ma gyur grang snyam du sems shing phyogs bzhir pho nya rta pa dag bkye nas rang nyid mi lag na sgron ma thogs pa rnams dang lhan cig tu 'bab chu gnod pa can gang na ba de logs su song ba dang / khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bos 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram na rin po che'i lham brgya stong ri ba zung cig kyiphud pa 72—151

mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de 'di snyam du sems te/ gzhon nu ni nor gyi phyir chom rkun nam g.yon can rnams kyis 6)phyi rol du ma dukhrid kyi 'di ltar 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram na rin po che'i lham brgya stong ri ba zung cig ②phud pa las na (4)gzhon nu 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi ngogs 'di nyid ⑤las rgal ⑥bar ma gyur grang / 'di ltar 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram na rin po che'i lham brgya stong ri ba zung cig (7)bor ro snyam du bsams nas 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi ngogs de nyid las rgal (8)te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo rgyang ring po nas gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang 'di snyam du dgongs te ci nas kyang ngas rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba ji lta bu mngon par 'du byas pas khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bos gzhon nu grags pa stan 'di nyid la 'dug bzhin du mi mthong ba de lta bu zhig bya'o snyam nas / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba ji lta bu mngon par 'du mdzad pas khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bos gzhon nu grags pa stan de 95nyid la 'dug bzhin du mi mthong ba de lta bu mdzad do/ /de nas khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci ga gzhon nu grags pa gzigs sam/ khyim bdag de'i 7phyir 'dug shig dang / stan 'di kho na la gzhon nu grags pa 'dug pa yimathong bar 'gyur ba'i gnas gang yin pa de yod do/ /de nas khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo 'di snyam du sems te/gdon mi za bar bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhon nu grags pa gzigs par gyur te 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das 'di skad ces khyim bdag de'i phyir 'dug shig dang 72—152

stan 'di kho na la gzhon nu grags pa 'dug pa mthong bar 'gyur ba'i gnas gang yin pa de yod do zhes bka' stsal to 0)snyam du rig nas dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang ske/ mchog tu dga' ba dang / dga' ba rgya chen po dang / yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo la bcom ldan 'das kyis chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan pa la sogs pa ni snga ma bzhin no/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes so/ /tshe dang ldan pa grags pa yang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan bzhin du len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa de slar brtul nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pas bka' stsal pa/ rgyan gyis brgyan bzhin du ni chos spyad de/ /dul zhing (miyang dag sdom pa tshangs spyod la/ /'byung po kun la chad ①pa spangs pa ni/ /de ni bram ze dge sbyong dge slong yin/ /de'i tshe 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa drug dang bdun pa ni bcom ldan 'das so/ /khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bos gzhon nu grags pa stan de nyid la 'dug pa mthong ngo /mthong nas kyang gzhon nu grags pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu tshur shog /khyod kyi ma lus ngal zhing lus dub pas smre sngags 'don gyis dhikhyim du 'dong ske/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyim bdag ji snyam du sems/ gang gis mi slob pa'i shes pa dang mi slob pa'i lta bas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/72—153

sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mngon par rtogs pa de ji ga khyim pa khyim na gnas pa'am sogs 6)'jog gi longs spyod kyis 'dod pa la longs spyod par 'gyur ram/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /khyim bdag ji ltar khyod kyis slob pa'i shes pa dang / slob pa'i lta bas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mngon par rtog napa de bzhin du gzhon nu grags pas mi slob pa'i ye shes dang mi slob pa'i lta bas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal dang /kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mngon par rtogs so/ /btsun pa gzhon nu grags pas gang gis na mi slob pa'i shes pa dang mi slob pa'i lta bas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mngon par rtogs pa ni rnyed pa legs par rnyed lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das slad bzhin du 'brang ba'i dge sbyong grags pa dang / thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste rigs kyi gtso bo gang na ba der gshegs na legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo la cang mi gsung bas gnang ri ༄ngo / /de nas khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bos bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas cadaganang bar rig nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyi mtshan mo zhu)'das nas snga dro na bza' (nyasham thabs mnabs/ lhung bzed ri chodang / chos gos bsnams te phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong tshe dang ldan pa grags pa dang / khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo'i khyim gang na ba der gshegs so/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang /72—154

chung ma gnyis bcom ldan 'das la yang dang yang du bsu ba'i phyir bar sgo na sdod do / /tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang / chung ma gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gdan bshams nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das tshur 0)spyon/bcom ldan 'das byon pa legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs su gsol zhes gsol nas bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang chung ma gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang / chung ma gnyis la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod②ske/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thog ma'i dus su chos kyi gtam gleng ba gang yin pa 'di lta ste/sbyin pa'i gtam dang / tshul khrims kyi gtam dang / mtho ris kyi gtam dang /'dod pa rnams la mnog chung zhing nyes dmigs dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang ske/ rnam par byang ba dang / nges par 'byung ba dang / rab tu dben pa'i rjes su bsngags ③pa dang / rnam par byang ba'i phyogs kyi chos rnams rgya cher bshad do/ /gang gi tshe de gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' ba'i sems dang ske/ mgu ba'i sems dang / sgrib pa dang bral ba'i sems dang / skal ba dang ldan pa dang / yang dag phul gyi chos bshad na shes par nus par gzigs pa de'i tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi stiyang dag phul gyi chos bshad 72—155

pa gang yin pa 'di lta ste/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po sdug bsngal ba dang /kun 'byung gyo)dang / 'gog pa dang / lam de ②rgya cher bshad do/ /dper na gos gtsang ma nag rnag med pa tshon rtsi 'os pa'i nang ①du bcug na tshon rtsi legs par 'jen rdo )du btub pa (gede bzhin du tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang /chung ma gnyis kyis stan de nyid la 'khod bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mngon par rtogs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang / chung ma gnyis kyis chos mthong ba dang / chos thob ⑥pa dang / chos rig pa dang /⑦chos kyi gting slebs pa dang / som nyi las rgal ba dang / the tsom (nyalas rgal ⑨ba dang / gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang / gzhan gyis mi bkri ba dang /ston pas bstan pa'i chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob nas stan las langs te/bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de 7logs su thal mo sbyar ba yibatud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag ni 'phags so/ /bdag cag ni mngon par 'phags lags 8te/ bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis tsodage bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so/ /btsun pa de'i slad du 'dir zhal zas kyi mdzad pa mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang / chung ma gnyis la cang mi gsung bas ④gnang ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang / chung ma gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das cang mi tsogasung bas gnang bar rig nas bcom ldan 'das gdan la bde bar 72—156

bzhugs pa dang / gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang / bca' ba dag rang gi lag nas stobs shing tshim par byed de rnam grangs du mar gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ①ba dang / bca' (mib dag rang gi lag nas bstabs ⑧shing tshim par byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin cing phyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu bar rig nas stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos nyan pa'i phyir 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang / chung ma gnyis la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod ④par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs ⑤bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs yite gshegs so/ / bā rā ṇa sī ⑦na khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang /bzhi pa dang / lnga pa gang po dang / dri med dang / ba lang bdag dang /lag bzangs te'u)/ rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu dag gis rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig ⑨bgos nas dad pa ⑩yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma'o sangs rgyas ni mchog ma yin pa ma yin zhing chos bstan pa yang mchog ma yin pa ma yin te/ gang gi phyir da ⑩ltar gyi rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa re zhig shin tu gzhon pa/ shin tu bde ba 'dod pa yang skra dang / kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig ⑩bgos nas dad pa ⑫72—157

yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung gis6)/ ma la bdag cag gis kyang skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas/ dad pa ②yang dag pa kho nas (khukhyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa gang po dang / dri med dang / ba lang ④bdag dang / lag bzangs te⑤/rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu rnams bā rā ṇa sī (6)nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa gang po dang /dri ma med 7dang / ba lang bdag dang / lag bzangs te(kye/ rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la bdag cag rab tu 'byung ba dang /bsnyen par rdzogs par 9nodage slong gi dngos po gnang na/ — bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa de dag gis legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang /bsnyen par rdzogs par dge slong gi dngos po thob ste/ de ltar rab tu byung nas tshe dang ldan pa de dag gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa rtun pa dang ldan pa bdag nyid gtod par gnas so/ /gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa/ rtun pa dang ldan pa bdag nyid gtod par 'oganas pa na gang gi phyir rigs kyi bu de dag skra dang kha spu bregs /1te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar byed pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i mtha' bla 72—158

na med pa tshe 'di 6)nyid la rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum dzubadu byas te bsgrubs nas bdag cag gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa bsten gto/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes go bar byed cing tshe dang ldan pa de dag sems shin tu rnam par grol ba kun shes pa dang ldan pa'i dgra bcom par ④gyur to/ /de'i tshe 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa bcu dang / bcu gcig pa ni bcom ldan 'das so/ / bā rā ṇa sī ⑤na grong mi gtso bo gtso bo ⑥rnams kyi khye'u lnga bcus rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu dang po dang / gnyis pa dang /gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa ste grags pa dang / gang po dang / dri med dang / ba lang bdag dang / lag bzangs te⑦/ rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu rnams skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos (kyenas dad pa yang dag pa dzi)kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma sangs rgyas ni mchog ma yin pa ma yin zhing /chos bstan pa yang mchog ma yin pa ma yin te/ gang gi phyir da ⑩ltar rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu dang po dang / gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang /lnga pa ste grags pa dang / gang po dang / dri med dang / ba lang bdag dang /lag bzangs te⑩/ rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu rnams ni re zhig shin tu gzhon pa/shin tu bde ba 'dod pa yang skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung gisatso/ ma la bdag cag kyang skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos tsonas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung ngo snyam mo/ /de nas grong khyer gyi gtso bo rnams kyi khye'u lnga bcu po dag bā rā ṇa sī skyonas byung nas bcom 72—159

ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste lhags pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas grong mi'i gtso bo'i khye'u lnga bcu po dag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po gnang na bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa de dag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po thob ste/ de ltar rab tu byung nas tshe dang ldan pa de dag gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa rtun pa dang ldan pa / bdag nyid gtod par 0)gnas so/ /gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa rtun pa dang ldan pa bdag nyid gtod par (miganas pa na gang gi phyir rigs kyi bu de dag snga ma bzhin du ji srid sems shin tu rnam par grol ba kun shes pa dang ldan pa'i dgra bcom par gyur to/ /de'i tshe 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa drug cu dang —/ drug cu gcig pa ni bcom ldan 'das so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bā rā ṇa sī'i gedrang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nga ni lha dang mi'i 'ching ba gang yin pa thams cad las grol ba yin no/ /dge slong dag khyed kyang lha dang mi rnams kyi 'ching ba gang yin pa thams cad las grol ba yin gyisali/ dge slong dag skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / lha dang mi rnams la phan pa dang /bde ba'i ched du rgyu zhing deng la khyed gnyis shig ni gcig ⑤tu ma 'gro zhig /nga 72—160

yang lteng rgyas ①kyi grong khyer sde can gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs so/ /de nas bdud sdig can 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong gi ta ma cha'adi bā rā ṇa sī'i ③drang srong smra ba buri dgas kyi nags su 'dug nas de nyan thos rnams la 'di skad ces chos ston te⑤/ dge slong dag nga ni lha dang mi'i 'ching ba gang yin pa thams cad las dugrol ba yin no/ /dge slong dag khyed kyang lha dang mi'i 'ching ba gang yin pa thams cad las grol ba yin gyisaX/ dge slong dag skye bo mang po la phan pa dang zhes bya ba nas rgyu zhing deng shig ces bya ba'i bar du ste/ nga yang lteng rgyas kyi grong khyer sde can gang na ba der rgyu zhing 'gro'o zhes zer gyisani/ma la bdag gis de la 'di lta ste/ dkrug pa'i las shig bya ba'i phyir nye bar 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas bdud sdig can bram ze'i khye'u'i ⑨cha byad du bdag nyid mngon par sprul te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 0spyan sngar 'dug ste tshigs su bcad pas gsol pa/ ma grol grol bar 'du shes na/ /ji ltar bdag nyid grol bar sems/ /bdag nyid yidage sbyong ma bkrol 8bas/ /'ching ba chen pos bcings pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ e ma'o 'di ni bdud sdig can yin te/ 'di lta ste dkrug 8pa'i las kyi phyir nye bar 'ongs so snyam du thugs su chud nas tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ nga ni lha dang mi rnams kyi/ /'ching ba gang yin kun las grol/ /bar chad byed pa khyod bcom par/ /sdig can de ltar shes par gyis/ /de nas bdud sdig can 'di snyam du sems te/dge sbyong gi ta ma'i ④sems kyis bdag shes so snyam du rig nas sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde la yid 8gcags ⑩nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas 72—161

bcom ldan 'das kyis lan gnyis su yang dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag nga ni lha dang mi rnams kyi 'ching ba gang yin pa thams cad las grol ba yin no/ /dge slong dag khyed kyang lha dang mi rnams kyi 'ching ba gang yin pa thams cad las grol ba yin gyis6)/ dge slong dag skye bo mang po la phan pa dang zhes bya ba nas/ rgyu zhing deng shig ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /nga yang lteng rgyas kyi grong khyer sde can gang na ba der gshegs so/ /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal lo zhes dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das las ②mnyan nas ljongs rgyu zhing dong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bā rā ṇa sīr ②ji tsam bzhed kyi bar du bzhugs nas lteng rgyas kyi grong khyer sde can gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs te/ rim gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang grong khyer sde can du byon to(4)glu/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ras ⑤bal can gyi nags tshang tshing gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas shing 95)zhig gi drung du brten te nyin par gyi gnas pas bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe drug cu sde bzang po'i tshogs grong khyer sde can gyi phyi rol du nyi ma re re zhing bud med kyis byas pa'i rol mos rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed dga' dgur 7daspyod par byed pa na de rnams las bud med cig dam bcas pa dral te bros so/ /de nas drug cu sde bzang po'i tshogs bud med de tshol zhing ras bal gyi nags tshang tshing gang na ba der (kyedong ba dang / drug cu sde bzang po'i tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das mdzes pa/ dad par 6)'os pa/ dbang po zhi ba/ thugs zhi ba/ thugs mchog tu dul ba/ zhi ba dang / dul ba dang ldan nga / gser gyi mchod sdong lta bur dpal gyis 'bar zhing shing zhig gi ⑩drung na brten te bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das gang na 72—162

ba der dong ste lhags nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces ①gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ga bud med gcig gzigs sam/ gzhon nu dag bud med de khyed cag gi cir 'ong / btsun pa 'di (snyen bdag cag drug cu sde bzang po'i tshogs grong khyer sde can gyi slad rol du bud med kyis bgyis pa'i rol mos rtse bar bgyid(mi / dga' bar bgyid dga' dgur ④spyod par bgyid de/ de rnams dang bdag cag rtse bar bgyid/ dga' bar bgyid/ dga' dgur ⑤spyod par bgyid pa na/ bud med gcig dam bcas pa dral te bros nas bdag cag tshol lags so/ /gzhon nu dag ji snyam du sems/ bud med tshol ba gang yin pa dang ske/ bdag nyid tshol ba gang gdamayi/ btsun pa bdag cag la bud med kyis ci bgyis/ bdag cag ni bdag nyid tshol ba gang lags pa de gdam ⑦lags so/ /gzhon nu dag de'i phyir 'dug shig dang khyed la chos bshad do/ /de nas drug cu sde bzang po'i tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das kyis drug cu sde bzang po'i tshogs la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan pa la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas drug cu sde (kyibazang po'i tshogs kyis stan de nyid la 'khod bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi 5)po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal ba dang / kun 'byung kyib dang / 'gog pa dang ske/ lam mngon par rtogs so/ /de nas drug cu sde bzang po'i tshogs kyis chos mthong ba dang / chos thob pa dang / chos rig pa dang / chos kyi gting slebs pa dang / som nyi las rgal ⑩ba dang / the tsom tilas rgal 8ba dang /gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang / gzhan gyis mi bkri 8ba dang / ston pas 72—163

bstan pa'i chos rnams la mi 'jigs zhi)pa thob nas stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de ⑧logs su thal mo sbyar ba (kyebatud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /bdag cag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong (0gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis ⑤bdag cag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so/ /de nas drug cu sde bzang po'i tshogs bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa la 6)mngon par dga' ste rjes su yi rangs ri nyenas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas dong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de'i (5)nub mo 'das nas snga dro na bza' sham thabs mnabs/ lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams te grong khyer sde (1)can du bsod snyoms la zhugs thorteso / /de nas bcom ldan 'das grong khyer sde can du bsod snyoms la zhugs yipa na 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la ngas grong khyer sde can 8der thog mar su zhig la yichos bshad snyam pa las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ngas grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs ma la thog mar chos bshad par bya ste/ cho de dag gis nga sngon sdug bsngal spong ba'i rnal 'byor la rjes su brtson pas gnas pa na 'dis tsomar gsar dang 'o thug sbrang rtsi ltar mngar bas bsnyen bkur byas so snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs ma'i khyim gang na ba der gshegs so/ /grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs mas bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po nas mthong 72—164

ngo la/ /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi ched du gdan bshams nas 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das tshur spyon/ bcom ldan 'das byon pa legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs su gsol / zhes gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa de ①nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs mas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das kyis grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs ma la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan ces bya ba nas/ mngon par dad nas skyabs su song ngo zhes bya ba'i bar ②du gong ma bzhin no/ /de nas grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs mas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa de'i slad du 'dir zhal zas kyi mdzad pa mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑧grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs ma la cang mi gsung bas ④gnang ngo / /de nas grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs mas bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas (geganang bar rig cing bcom ldan 'das bde bar bzhugs par rig nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ⑥ba dag⑦ /rang gi lag nas stobs shing tshim par byed de rnam grangs du mar gtsang gzhing bsod pa'i bza' ⑨ba dang bca' ba dag rang gi lag nas bstabs shing tshim par byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin te phyag bcabs shing lhung bzed gyu bar tirig nas stan ches yidama' ba zhig blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis grong pa'i bu mo 72—165

dga' mo dang / dga' stobs ma la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs ①bstod/yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs te gshegs so / /de nas bcom ldan 'das grong khyer sde can nas gshegs pa na 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ngas yul ma ga dhā ( 'dir ngang tshul bzang por bkur ba'i dge sbyong ngam (dkyibram ze gang zhig dbang du byas na de dbang du gyur pas tshegs lichung ngus skye bo'i tshogs chen po dbang du 'gyur ba su zhig yod snyam mo/ /de'i tshe steng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can btsas nas lo brgya nyi shu lon pa rgas pa 'khogs gtugs pa zhig yod pa de ma ga d+ma'i (5)mi rnams kyis bkur stir bya ba dang / bla mar bya ba dang / rjed par bya ba dang / mchod par bya bas dgra bcom par bkur cing 'khor lnga brgya dang nai rañja nā'i (6)chu klung gi 'gram gyi bsti gnas na dka' thub spyod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can btsas nas lo brgya nyi shu lon pa rgas 'khogs gtugs pa 'di ma ga d+ma'i 57)mi rnams kyis zhes bya ba nas dka' thub spyod do zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ ma la ngas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can dbang du bya rinaste 'di dbang du gyur na tshegs 59)chung ngus skye bo'i tshogs chen po dbang du 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa 7can gyi bsti gnas ga na ba /7der gshegs so/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi ched du gdan bshams nas 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po tshur spyon/ dge sbyong chen po byon pa legs so/ /dge sbyong chen 72—166

po yun ①ring po zhig lags na gang nas 'khor 'dir byon②/ dge sbyong chen po gdan bshams nipa nyid la bzhugs shig ces ④gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gdan (nyabashams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can dang / bcom ldan 'das lhan cig mngon du yang dag par dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / mgu bar 'gyur ba'i gtam (6)rnam pa sna tshogs mdzad nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /7phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis lteng ⑧rgyas 'od srung ral pa can la 6)'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'od srung gal te khyod la mi bde ba med na khyod kyi me khang du nga zhag gcig cig 'dug go/ /dge sbyong chen po bdag la mi bde ba ma mchis na/ 'on kyang de na ⑩klu gdug pa zhig gnas te des khyod tho btsams par 'gyur ⑩du mchi'o/ /'od srung khyod kyis re zhig gnang bar gyis shig dang tho btsams 7par mi 'gyur ro/ /dge sbyong chen po gal te khyod la mtho mi 'tsham tunyen dge sbyong chen po ci bde ba tustekho nar bzhugs shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng 8rgyas 'od srung ral ⑩ pa can gyi me khang gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas me khang gi phyi rol du zhabs bsil nas 0me khang gi nang du zhugs 8te/ nyid kyis rtswa'i (7gding ba bshams gu nas sku drang por bsrang 0ste skyil mo krung 4)bcas nas dran pa mngon du phyogs par bzhag ste bzhugs so/ /klu gdug pas bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang khros pa'i mthus dud pa phyung ( )ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus dud pa phyung ngo / /klu gdug pas khro ba'i mthus 'bar bar byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs tsoso/ /de nas klu gdug pa khros pa'i mthu dang / bcom ldan 'das 72—167

kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus me khang thams cad 'bar rab tu 'bar kun tu rab tu 'bar te/ me lce gcig tu gyur pas sreg 6)par byed do/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can mtshan mo rgyu skar la lta ba na me khang thams cad 'bar rab tu 'bar/kun tu rab tu 'bar te/ me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg pa mthong ngo mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong chen po gi ta ma 'di ltar mdzes pa ②klu gdug (5)pas thal bar byas par ma gyur rgyagrang / kyi ⑤tud nyon mongs bdag gi tshig ma nyan (6)to snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/nga lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'khor dang bcas pas phyas spyad kyis ⑦ma la ngas rdzu 'phrul ji lta bur dunasamangon par 'du bya ba la sems mnyam par bzhag na mes klu gdug pa'i me zil gyis mnan la/ des kyang de'i lus la gnod par mi byed cing de dul bar byas nas lhung bzed 6)kyi nang du bcug ste/ lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can de la sbyin pa de lta bu zhig bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul ji lta bu mngon par 'du mdzad pa la thugs mnyam par bzhag na mes klu gdug pa'i me zil gyis mnan la/ des kyang de'i lus la gnod pa mi byed pa de lta bu mngon par 'du mdzad de/ de dul ⑩bar mkhyen ⑪nas lhung bzad du bcug ste/ lteng rgyas 'od srung gang na ba der bsnams 8te gshegs so/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /dge sbyong chen po gson pa lta zhig /'od srung gson no/ /dge sbyong ⑫chen po khyod kyi lhung bzed na 'basnams te byon pa ci/ 'od srung klu gdug pa gang gi mthus khyod kyi 8me khang du mir gyur pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang mi ldan pa gnas 72—168

su mi ster ba de ngas btul nas lhung bzed du bcug nas khyer te 'ongs so de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag cag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng ①rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bsti gnas kyi nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bsti gnas na bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya tsam me la yongs su spyod pa re re'i me thab gsum gsum stel/ me thab stong lnga brgya yod do/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u de rnams me la yongs su spyod par 'dod na me spar bar ma nus so/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u de rnams lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gang na ba ②der song ste phyin nas/ lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mkhan po mkhyen par mdzod cig /'dir bdag cag zhugs la yongs su spyod par 'tshal na zhugs de spar bar rngo ma thogs ④lags so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong chen po bdag gi nye 'khor na gnas na de'i mthu zhig ma byung grang snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od sung ral pa can bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzod cig /'dir bdag gi bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya tsam me la yongs su spyod par 'tshal na/ me de spar bar rngo ma thogs ⑤nas bdag 'di snyam du sems te/bdag gi nye 'khor na dge sbyong chen po bzhugs na de'i mthu zhig ma byung grang snyam bgyid do/ /'od srung me spar bar 'dod dam dge sbyong chen po spar du gsol/de nas 'di dultar sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / lha rnams kyi 72—169

lha'i mthus me de rang nyid 'bar bar gyur to/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te ya mtshan che mod kyi/ bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo6)/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u de rnams me la yongs su spyad nas me gsad ②par 'dod na gsad (gepar ma nus so/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u de rnams lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gang na ba der dong ste lhags nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mkhan po mkhyen par mdzod cig /'dir bdag cag zhugs la yongs su spyad yinas zhugs dgum par (snye'atshal na dgum ⑥pa'i rngo ma thogs ( skulags so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te / dge slong ( chen po bdag gi nye 'khor na gnas na de'i mthu zhig ma byung grang snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste (9)phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ /'dir bdag gi bram ze'i khye'u rnams zhugs 'ol yongs su spyad rmo/glenas zhugs dgum par 'tshal na dgum pa'i rngo ma thogs munas bdag 'di snyam du sems te(ge/ bdag gi nye 'khor yin dge sbyong chen po bzhugs na de'i mthu zhig ma byung grang snyam bgyid do/ /'od srung me de bsad dam/ dge sbyong chen po dgum du gsol/ de nas 'di ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi tshesangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / lha rnams kyi yilha'i mthus me de rang nyid shi'o / /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po ni rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas yang dus gzhan zhig na lteng 72—170

rgyas 'od srung ral pa can rang nyid me la yongs su spyod par 'dod na spar bar ma nus so zhes bya ba nas/ bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no 6)zhes bya ba'i bar du gong ma bzhin no snyam mol/ /de bzhin du yongs su spyad nas gsad (7par 'dod na zhes bya ba nas/ bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no zhes bya ba'i bar du gong ma bzhin no/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi me khang thams cad 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par byed pa de la lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang skye bo'i tshogs chen po rnams kyis bsgrims ④kyang gsad ⑤par ma nus so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi nye 'khor na dge sbyong chen po gnas na de'i mthu zhig byung bar ma gyur grang snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom 9ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ dge sbyong chen po 'dir bdag gi me khang thams cad 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu 'bar te / me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par bgyid pa de la bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang skye bo'i tshogs chen pos bsgrims (7)na zhugs dgum pa'i rngo ma thogs ⑧nas bdag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi nye 'khor na dge sbyong chen po bzhugs na de'i mthu zhig byung bar ma gyur grang snyam bgyid do/ /'od srung me de zhi bar bya'am/ dge sbyong chen po zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas 'di ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus me khang de rang nyid zhi bar gyur to/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa 72—171

can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te ya (1)mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bsti gnas kyi ②nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag kha dog 'phags pas mtshan mo la bab pa na bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas te de rnams dper na me'i phung po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu 'bar te/ me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par byed (snyopa bzhi mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/dge sbyong chen po yang me la yongs su spyod de 'di ltar de'i spyan snga na me'i phung po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu 'bar te/ me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par byed pa bzhi 97yod do snyam mo/ de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can nang par sngar langs te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kun)la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ 'dir bdag ma dang sum rgyu skar snoms la lta ba na dge sbyong chen po'i spyan snga na zhugs kyi phung po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu 'bar te/me lce gcig tu gyur te sreg par byed pa bzhi mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong chen po yang me la yongs su spyod do/ /'di ltar de'i spyan snga na me'i phung po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu 'bar te/me lce gcig (6)tu gyur nas sreg par bgyid pa bzhi mchis so snyam mo/ /'od srung cing 57)me la yongs su spyod dam/ nga me la yongs su mi spyod de/ mkhas pa kun nas nyon mongs las/ /sems ni yongs su zlog (nyabyed kyi/ /me 'am yang na chu 72—172

dag la/ /yongs bsten yon tan ci zhig yod/ /de lta mod kyi 'dir mdang sum rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag kha dog 'phags pas mtshan mo la bab pa na nga gang na ba der 'ongs te lhags nas nga'i zhabs gnyis la mgo bos hu)phyag byas te de rnams dper na me'i phung po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu 'bar te/me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par byed pa bzhi po lta bu'i lus kyis phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa yin no/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te / 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te ya mtshan che med kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya ②byin kha dog 'phags pas mtshan mo la bab pa na bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ①zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ de dper na me'i phung po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu 'bar cite/ me lce gcig tu gyur pa bzhi po de dag pas ches lhag cing ches 'phags la ①ches bzang ba lta bu'i lus kyis phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung ⑤ral pa can de nyid kyi mtshan mo rgyu skar rnams la lta ba na/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na me'i phung po 'bar zhes bya ba nas/ dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo zhes bya ba'i bar du gong ma bzhin no/ /de nas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa kha dog 'phags pas mtshan mo la bab pa na bcom ldan 'das gang dun ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs ⑦la mgo bos phyag byas te/ de dper na me'i phung po bzhi po de dag nyid snga ma bzhin du sreg pa zhes bya ba nas/ me'i phung po chen po lnga po de me lce gcig tu gyur nas 72—173

sreg par byed do zhes bya ba'i bar de dag pas kyang ches hu)lhag cing ches 'phags la ches bzang ba lta bu'i lus kyis phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can de nyid kyi mtshan mo rgyu skar rnams la lta ba na bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na me'i phung po chen po 'bar zhes bya ba nas/ dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo (kyezhes bya ba'i bar du gong ma bzhin no/ /de'i tshe lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi 'dug gnas na mchod sbyin zhag bdun pa byed pa la bab bo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te gal te ma ga ṅgā'i ②mi rnams kyis dge sbyong chen po 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin par shes na de nyid la bya ba byed par sems kyi bdag la ni de lta ma yin pa'i gnas yod kyis(cir/ kye ma dge sbyong chen po zhag bdun zhig 'di nas gzhan du song yang ci ma rung snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyis lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi sems mkhyen nas zhag bdun gzhan du bzhud do/ /de'i tshe zhag 45)bdun du lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can la rnyed pa dang / bkur sti chen po byung nas/ bza' ba dang bca' ba 6)rab tu mang po dang ldan⑦/ skye bo'i tshogs chen po yang dbang du gyur to/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi 'dug gnas na mchod sbyin zhag bdun (8)du byas zin pa dang 'di snyam du sems te / zhag bdun po 'di la bdag la rnyed pa dang / bkur sti 6)chen po byung nas bza' ba dang / bca' ba kyirab tu mang po dang ldan/ skye bo'i tshogs chen po yang dbang du gyur gyis tu)kye ma da ni dge sbyong chen po 'ongs kyang ci ma rung bdag gis de yang de la bsod snyoms spyod du gzhug go snyam mo/ /de nas 72—174

bcom ldan 'das kyi ①thugs kyis lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi sems mkhyen nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gang na ba der gshegs so/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po byon tam / 'od srung 'ongs so/ /dge sbyong chen po khyod ci'i slad du zhag bdun 'di nas gzhan du ②bzhud lags/ 'od srung khyod kyi 'dug gnas na mchod sbyin zhag bdun du byed pa la bab nas 'di snyam du gal te ma ga d+ma'i ①mi rnams kyis dge sbyong chen po ni 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che zhing 'di ltar mthu che ba yin no bar shes na de kho na la bya ba byed par sems kyi bdag la ni de lta ④ma yin pa'i gnas 'di yod par 'gyur gyis kye ma dge sbyong chen po zhag bdun zhig 'di nas gzhan du song yang ci ma rung snyam sems pa ma yin nam/ /nga'i thugs kyis khyod kyi sems shes nas zhag bdun 'di nas gzhan du song ngo / /'o na ci'i slad du 'dir byon lags/ 'od srung khyod kyi mchod sbyin zhag bdun du byas zin nas 'di snyam du ⑤bdag la zhag bdun du rnyed pa dang / bkur sti chen po byung zhing bza' ba dang bca' ba rab tu mang po dang yang ldan/ skye bo'i tshogs chen po yang dbang du gyur gyis ⑥kyi ma dge sbyong chen po 'ongs kyang ci ma rung bdag gis de yang de la yongs su longs spyod du gzhug go snyam du sems pa ma yin nam dge sbyong chen po de lta lags so/ /nga'i thugs kyis khyod kyi sems shes nas nga 'ongs pa yin no/ /dge sbyong chen po ci bde ba kho nar longs spyad ⑦du gsol/de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che med kyi bdag kyang 72—175

dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces yo)gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po de'i slad du bdag gi nye 'khor du bzhugs shig dang bdag gis khyod la chos dang 'thun pa'i 'tsho (snyeb sbyar ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi ③ched du rang kho nas g.yos byas nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der rmeng ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po gdugs tshod lags shing mchis na dge sbyong chen po da de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ 'od srung de'i phyir song shig nga yang 'ong ngo —/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can song nas ring po ma lon par mkhyen nas ji ltar thugs mnyam par bzhag dun shing 'dzam bu zhes zhu)bya ba gang gis 'dzam bu gling du gdags pa de las kha dog dang dri dang ro dang ldan pa'i 'dzam bu'i snye ma rnams kyis lhung bzed yibakang nas bsnams te / lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bste gnas gang na ba der gshegs pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byon nas gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas de'i 'og tu lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'ongs nas steng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das bsti gnas kyi gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po byon tam/ 'od srung du'ongs so/ /dge sbyong chen po khyod kyi lhung bzed na ci mchis/ 'dir ngas 'od srung lakhyod song nas ring po ma lon par mkhyen nas/ ji ltar thugs mnyam par bzhag ⑨na shing 72—176

'dzam bu zhes bya ba gang gis 'dzam bu gling du gdags pa de las kha dog dang dri dang ro dang ldan pa'i 'dzam bu'i snye ma rnams kyis lhung bzed bkang nas 'dir phyin pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs kyis 6)gal te 'dod na longs spyod cig /dge sbyong chen po ci bde ba kho nar 'tshal lags so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ②ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar chadage sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che mod kyi ④bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo/ /shing 'dzam bu zhes bya ba gang gis 'dzam bu'i gling du gdags pa de dang / ha cang mi ring ba zhig na a ru ra'i nags dang ske/ bil ba'i nags dang ka yid ⑤tha'i nags dang / skyu ru ra'i nags kyang de bzhin no/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling du gshegs nas ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā skyolus lhung bzed bkang ste bsnams nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi ⑦bsti gnas gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas gdan bshams ⑧pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas de'i 'og tu lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'ongs nas steng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das bste gnas kyi gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po byon tam/ 'od srung 6)'ongs so/ /dge sbyong chen po khyod kyi lhung bzed na ci mchis 'dir ngas 'od srung khyod song nas ring po ma lon par mkhyen nas ji ltar thugs ⑩mnyam par ⑩bzhag na byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling du gshegs nas ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā 8lu'i 'bras lhung bzed bkang nas 'dir phyin pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs kyis (shegal te 'dod na longs spyod cig /dge slong 8chen po ci bde ba kho nar 'tshal 72—177

lags so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can las bsod snyoms bzhes nas phyogs gzhan zhig tu bzhugs nas ①zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la chus chu'i dgos pa zhig byung ngo / /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya (7byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la chus chu'i dgos pa byung bar shes nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der ⑧song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lag pas sa la bsnun pa dang /de nas bkod ma chen po zhig byung ste chu bab pa de la bcom ldan 'das kyis chus chu'i bya ba mdzad do/ /lteng ④rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bsti gnas na 'chag pa na bkod ma chen po byung ste chu bab (snyepa mthong ngo / /mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ chu 'di sngon ni med na chu 'di da ltar gang nas byung snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bcom ldan 'a das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ bdag 'dir bsti gnas na 'chag pa na bkod ma chen po'i chab cig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bdag 'di snyam du sems te/ chu 'di sngon ma mchis na da ltar chu 'di gang nas bab snyam bgyid do/ /'od srung 'dir khyod las bsod snyoms bzhes nas phyogs 'dir bzhugs te zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzad pa na nga la chus chu'i dgos pa zhig byung ngo / /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis zhung la chus chu'i dgos pa byung bar shes nas nga gang na ba der 'ongs te phyin nas nga'i mdun du lag pas sa la bsnun ⑦pa las de nas 72—178

bkod ma chen po zhig byung ba de la ngas chus chu'i bya ba mdzad de①/ 'od srung rdzing 'di ni lag pas brkos pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas lteng rgyas ②'od sung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba ③yin te/ ya mtshan che med kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phye ma red ④du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs nas rdzing lag pas brkos pa gang na ba ⑤der gshegs te byon nas rdzing lag pas brkos pa'i 'gram gyi mtha' gcig tu na bza' chos gos rnams bzhag ste rdzing dulag pas brkos ⑦par zhugs nas sku khrus mdzad nas/ rdzing lag pas brkos ⑧pa nas byung bar bzhed pa na shing ardzu na gang na ba de logs su phyag brkyang yo)ngo / /de nas ardzu na'i yal ga chen 0po dud par gyur te/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis gzung yinas rdzing lag pas brkos 7pa nas byung ngo / /0lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bsti gnas na 'chag pa na 'ardzing lag pas brkos pa'i 'gram na ardzu na'i 8yal ga chen po dud pa zhig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ ardzu na'i yal ga 'di sngon ni dud par ma gyur na/ ardzu na'i yal ga chen po 'di da su zhig gis btud snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/bdag 'dir bste gnas na 'chag pa na rdzing lag pas brkos ⑩pa'i 'gram na ardzu na'i yal ga chen po dud par mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bdag 'di snyam du sems te⑩/ ardzu na'i yal ga chen po 'di sngon ni dud par ma gyur na da su zhig gis btud snyam bgyid do/ /'od srung 'dir phye ma red tunyenang du yang dag 72—179

'jog las bzhengs nas/ rdzing lag pas brkos pa'i 'gram gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas rdzing lag pas brkos pa'i 'gram gyi mtha' gcig tu na bza' chos gos rnams bzhag ste rdzing lag pas brkos par zhugs te lus khrus byas nas/ rdzing lag pas brkos pa 6)nas byung bar 'dod nas ②shing ardzu na 'di dag gang na ba de (0logs su lag pa brkyang ④ba dang / de nas ardzu na'i yal ga chen po 'di dud par gyur te/ de la ngas 'jus nas rdzing lag pas brkos pa nas byung ngo / /'od srung 'di ni ardzu na lag pas bzung ⑤ba zhes bya'o / /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑥phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras dag brnyes nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ nga'i phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras gang du bkru snyam mo / /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi sems kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi 57dgongs pa shes nas ri brag cig (8)las rdo leb che la ring ba zhig blangs nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras dag 'di la bkru bar gsol/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis 6)phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams bkrus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ nga'i ⑩phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams gang du dgram 7snyam pa dang / de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi sems kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi 8dgongs pa shes nas brag cig 'alas rdo leb che la ring ba zhig khyer nas/ bcom ldan 'das 72—180

gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di la phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams dgram ①du gsol/de la bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras dag bkram mo/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bste gnas na 'chag pa na rdo leb che la ring ba dag mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam ②du sems te/ rdo leb che la ring ba 'di dag sngon ①ni med na rdo leb 0che la ring ba 'di dag da ⑤su zhig gis ⑥khyer te 'ongs ⑨snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol tol/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzad ⑧du gsol/ 'dir bdag bste gnas na 'chag pa na rdo leb che la ring ba dag cig ⑨mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bdag 'di snyam du sems te/ rdo leb che la ring ba 'di dag sngon ni ye ma mchis na/ rdo leb che la ring ba 'di dag da su zhig gis 'tshal te mchis snyam bgyid do/ /'od srung 'dir ngas phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras dag brnyes so//de yinas nga 'di snyam du dgongs te/ phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras dag gang du bkru snyam pa dang / de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi sems kyis nga'i dgongs pa shes nas/ brag cig 7las rdo leb che la ring ba zhig blangs te nga gang na ba der 'ongs te phyin nas nga la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di la phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams bkru bar gsol/ ngas de la phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams bkrus so/ /nga 'di snyam du dgongs te / ngas phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams gang du dgram 8snyam pa dang /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi 8sems kyis nga'i dgongs pa shes nas 72—181

brag cig 0)las rdo leb che la ring ba zhig blangs te nga gang na ba der 'ongs te byin (minas nga la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di la phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams shedagram du gsol/ ngas de la phyag dar khrod pa'i ④sha na'i ras rnams bkram mo/ /'od srung rdo leb che zhing ring ba 'di dag ni gnod sbyin gyis blangs pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas lteng (9rgyas 'od srung ral pa can ⑥'di snyam du sems te 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das steng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bsti gnas kyi nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe nai rañja nā'i rtsichu cher zug (8)nas bab po/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das chu klung mi gang bas lhag pas khebs pa'i steng na 6)rdul gyis yog pa bla gab med pa la 'chag pas 'chag par mdzad do/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong chen po de ltar mdzes pa chu chen po brug 'opas khyer bar ma gyur grang / ma la bdag gis dge sbyong chen po btsal snyam du bsams nas shing gcig pa'i gru'i nang du zhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das btsal ba na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das chu klung mi gang bas lhag par khebs pa'i steng nas rdul gyis yog dzinapa bla gab 8med pa na 'chag pas 'chag pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po gson nam/ 'od srung gson no/ /dge sbyong chen po zhugs shing gcig pa'i grur 'jug gam/ 'od srung 'jug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la ngas ji ltar thugs mnyam par bzhag 8na shing gcig pa'i gru ji ltar chu la 'jug pa de lta bu'i rdzu 72—182

dang / ha cang yang 1)mi ring ba zhig tu byung ba de bram ze mtshan mkhan dang /ltas (5)mkhan rnams kyis gal te khyim par gyur te/ khyim na gnas na ni 'khor los (5)sgyur ba'i rgyal po chos dang ldan pa ④chos kyi rgyal po mtha' bzhir rnam par rgyal ba rin po che po risna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de'i rin po che sna bdun ni 'di lta bu dag yin par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ 'khor lo rin po che dang /glang po rin po che dang / rta rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che dang / bud med rin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / bdun pa blon po rin po che yin no/ /de la 96dbu stong yang tshang bar (7)'byung bar 'gyur te/ dpa' ba rtul phod pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pani/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms pa de rgya mtsho la thug tsa)pa'i sa chen po ma lus par gnod par sdo ⑩ba med cing 'tshe ba med pa 'di nyid chad pa med cing mtshon gyis bda' ba med la chos dang 'thun zhing snyoms pas legs par phab ste gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gal te skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas 1 khyim med par rab tu byung bar gyur na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags tu)par 'gyur bar ’ lung bstan to zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang ma ga d+ma'i ④rgyal po bzo nyu5sbyangs gzugs can snying po gang na ba der song ste phyin nas ma ga d+ma'i ⑩rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag 'dir lha'i yul na rgyu ba na 0shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu gangs ri'i ngos zhes bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 72—190

'gyur bar lung ①bstan pa zhig thos so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /lha de khum ②shig /lha ches ⑧gtso bo (4)bas ches gtso bor 'gyur du mchi'o/ / ༅grong pa dag shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu gangs ri'i ngos zhes bya ba nas/ grags par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin te/ lha de khum ⑧shig /lha ches ⑥gtso bo bas ches gtso bor 'gyur du mchi'o zhes khyed cag de skad ma smra zhig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/za④ grong pa dag shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu zhes bya ba nas byung ba zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du stedu/ gal te 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal 6)por gyur na de'i g.yog bya'o/ /gal te skra yidang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa 0kho nas khyim nas khyim 8med par rab tu byung bar gyur te / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par gyur na de'i nyan thos su khas blang bar bya'o / /de nas ma ga ṅgā'i 8rgyal po bzo yisbyangs gzugs can snying po steng gi khang bzangs kyi (nyegazhi la 'dug nas smon pa'i (9gzhi lnga la smon par (nyebyed de/kye ma'o bdag gi yul du 'jig rten gyi ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang / zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das byung ba dang de la yang blta ba'i phyir bdag nye bar 'gro ba dang / nye bar song ba na des kyang bdag la chos bshad pa dang / bdag gis kyang chos bshad pa de shes pa dang —/ bdag gis chos shes nas bslab pa bcas shing bslab pa de yang bdag gis blangs te gnas kyang ci tunyem rung snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 72—191

dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ma ga d+ma'i ①rgyal po bzo ②sbyangs gzugs can snying po de steng gi khang bzangs kyi dugazhi la 'dug nas/smon 4)pa'i gzhi lnga smon par ⑤byed de/ kye ma'o bdag gi yul du 'jig rten gyi ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas (5)zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /ma ga d+ma'i ⑦rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po'i zho shas 'tsho ba dag cig ljongs rgyu ba na/ shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu gangs ri'i ngos chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram drang srong ser skya'i bsti ⑧gnas dang / ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig tu byung ba gang yin pa de bram ze mtshan mkhan dang ltas mkhan zhes bya ba nas 6)'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pas de ga yā ⑩na ga yā'i 0mgo'i mchod rten la sngon thams cad ral pa can du gyur pa'i dge slong stong thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba sha stag dang thabs cig ⑫tu bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang ma ga d+ma'i 8rgyal po bzo sbyangs tsogazugs can snying po gang na ba der dong ste lhags nas ma ga d+ma'i 8rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol / bdag cag 'di na lha'i yul na rgyu ba na / shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu 72—192

gang lags pa de zhes bya ba nas/ 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ de skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa tu)yang dag pa kho nas lakhyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba de bla na med pa yang dag par ⑤rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ de ga yā ④na ga lnga'i ⑤mchod rten la sngon thams cad ral pa can du gyur pa'i dge slong ⑥thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa zhes bya ba nas/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba sha stag dang thabs cig ⑦tu bzhugs so zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ lha de dag la bkur sti mdzod cig dang / de lta na lha gtso bo bas ches gtso bor 'gyur ro/ /de nas ma ga ṅgā'i nirgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos mi zhig la bsgo ba/ kwa'i 6)nang rje tshur khyod bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song la 4)song nas kho bo'i (1tshig 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byos la gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba chung ngam/ 'tsho'am/ bskyod pa 0yang ngam/stobs dang / bde ba dang / sku nyams dang ldan nam/ reg par spyod dam zhes zhus la 'di skad ces kyang gsol cig /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig (sprel ji srid 'tsho'i bar du na bza' chos gos dang /bsod snyoms dang / gzims cha dang / snyun dpyad kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i tshukhab tu gshegs su gsol zhes gsol cig /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes mi des ma byag d+ma'i ⑩rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po las mnyan nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la ⑩mgo 72—193

bos phyag 'tshal 6)te phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mi des 'di skad ces (migasol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi gzhabs gnyis la ma ga d+ma'i ④rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba chung ngam zhes bya ba nas/ reg par spyod dam zhes bya ba'i bar du gong ma bzhin du ste snyun gsol lags so/ /kye mi khyod dang ma ga d+ma'i (5)rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po bde bar gyur cig /btsun pa ma ga d+ma'i yirgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po'i mchid nas/ 'di skad ces bdag bcom ldan 'das dge slong stigi dge 'dun dang / thabs cig dul ji srid 'tsho'i bar du na bza' dang / chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang /gzims cha dang / snyun dpyad kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur bgyid na dziXbacom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs su gsol zhes mchi lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo ⑩/ /de nas mi des bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas (speganang bar rig nas6)/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis tshul mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga minas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das sngon thams cad ral pa can du gyur pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa zhes bya ba nas/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i bar sha stag dang thabs cig 8tu ma ga d+ma'i ⑩yongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na/ yul ma ga dhā ⑩pa rnams kyi mchod rten legs par rab gnas ltang brang gi tshal yod pa gang tson ba der gshegs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das legs par rab gnas su byon nas/ ma ga dhā ⑩pa rnams kyi mchod 72wa 194

rten legs par rab gnas ltang brang gi tshal yod pa na bzhugs so/ /ma ga ṅgā'i ①rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das sngon thams cad ral pa can du gyur pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po stong gi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po zhes bya ba nas/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ ma ga d+ma'i ②stongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na/ ma ga dhā ①pa rnams kyi mchod rten legs par rab gnas ltang brang gi tshal yod pa gang na ba der gshegs te/ma ga dhā ①pa rnams kyi mchod rten legs par rab gnas ltang brang gi tshal ⑤yod pa na dubazhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang shing rta bzang po'i nang du zhugs te/ rgyal po'i mthu chen po dang / rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen pos rta dang shing rta brgya stong snyed dang lhan cig 'khor brgya phrag du ma dang rgyal po'i khab nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ba na/ de'i shing rta'i 'khor lo sa'i nang du bying bar gyur to/ /des bsams pa bdag gis las skyon can cung zad cig byas par ma gyur grang snyam mo/ /lha rnams kyis de la smras pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis las skyon can ma byas mod kyi khyod dang lhan cig las mtshungs par spyod pa gang yin pa de dag btson ra na 'dug gis ⑦de dag thon cig /rgyal pos smras pa/ gal te de lta na gdon no zhes rgyal pos btson rnams 'don du bcug go⑧/ /yang rgyal po phyir byung bar brtsams pa na de'i dbu rgyan sgo la thug go/ /des ⑨yang bsams pa/ bdag gis ni gdon mi za bar las skyon can zhig byas te des na bdag la ltas ngan pa gzhan sgo la dbu rgyan thug pa 'di byung ngo snyam mo/ /lha de rnams kyis yang smras pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis las skyon can ma byas mod kyi 72—195

khyod dang lhan cig las mtshungs par spyad pa gang yin pa de dag kha cig ni 'dus kyang kha cig ni yul ljongs gzhan ga ge mo zhes bya ba dag na las kyi mtha' byed cing 'dug pa de dag sgron 6)cig /rgyal pos yul de na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyang (7bkug go/ /de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po shing rta khri nyis stong dang / zhabs ( )'bring ba rta pa'i tshogs khri brgyad stong dang /ma ga ṅgā'i (4bram ze dang khyim bdag brgya stong phrag du ma dang lhan cig rgyal po'i khab nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ngo / /de ji tsam bzhon pa'i sa'i bar du bzhin pas song ste/ bzhon (5)pa las babs nas rkang pa kho nas kun dga' ra bar 56)zhugs so/ /ma ga d+ma'i ( )rgyal po bzo sbyangs dugazugs can snying pos thag ji tsam nas bcom ldan 5)'das mthong ba'i bar de nas rgyal po'i mtshan ma lnga po ze'u kha dang / gdugs dang / ral gri dang / nor bu'i rnga yab dang / lham khra bo rnams phud do/ /de nas ma ga d+ma'i yirgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos rgyal po'i mtshan ma (7lnga bzhag nas bcom ldan 'das ga na ba der song ste phyin pa dang bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de ⑫logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de ⑩de rang gi ming nas phyung ste lan gsum du gsol pa/ btsun 8pa bdag ni ma ga d+ma'i 7rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po lags so/ /btsun pa bdag ni ma ga ṅgā'i ⑩rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po lags so/ /rgyal po lags 7so/ /rgyal po de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rgyal po chen po khyod ma ga d+ma'i 9/3rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po yin no rgyal po chen po khyod ma ga d+ma'i ⑩rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can 72—196

snying po yin no/ /rgyal po yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod rang gi stan ji ①lta ba la 'dug shig /de nas ma ga d+ma'i ②rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /ma ga d+ma'i ③bram ze dang / khyim bdag kha cig ni bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /kha cig ni bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig mngon du yang dag par dga' ba dang /yang dag par mgu bar 'gyur ba'i gtam rnam pa sna tshogs byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /kha cig ni bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de 'khod do/ /kha cig gis ni bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po nas mthong nas cang mi smra bar phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas ④'od srung 'khor dang bcas te de nyid du 'dus shing 'dug par gyur to / /de nas ma ga d+ma'i (7bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams 'di snyam du sems te / ci dge sbyong yichen po lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi tshangs par spyod pa la spyad dam/ 'on te lteng rgyas 'od srung phyaral pa can dge sbyong chen po'i tshangs par spyad ⑧pa la spyod snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyis ma ga d+ma'i 6)bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyi sems mkhyen nas tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can til tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis dri ba rmas ⑩pa/ lteng rgyas gnas pa khyod 'dir ci mthong na/ /me spangs tshunas ni brtul shugs ti'adi dag spyod/ khyod kyis ji ltar me yi mchod spangs pa/ /don de 'od srung nga la smra bar gyis/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung gis gsol pa/ 'di na kha cig zas skom de bzhin ro④/ /'dod pa dag dang 8bud med kho na smra/ /72—197

de dag phung po'i dri mar rab mthong ste/ /des bdag mchod sbyin mi dga' bsreg 0)blugs min/ /khyod ni 'dod dang bza' dang btung ba dang / /de bzhin ro la yid ni mi dga' na/ /lha mi 'jig rten la ci khyod kyi yid/ /dga' ba yin nam 'od srung dri yis cismros/ /phung po ma mchis zhi ba ci ma mchis / /'dod sred ma chags gzhan du 'gyur ma mchis/ /gzhan gyis mi bkri'i ri nigo 'phang mchog 4nomathong ste/ /des bdag mchod sbyin mi dga' bsreg blugs min/ /go 'phang (5)mi nyams mchog ni ma mthong bas/ /mchod sbyin brtul zhugs dang ni zhugs dag gis/ /grol snyam yibadag gi yid ni rmongs gyur te / /dmus long nyagyur nas skye shi'i rjes bzhin mthong / /skyob pa gtso bo mchog gis legs bshad pa/ /go 'phang 'dus ma byas te bzod ⑧mthong na/ /thub pa gi tam rnam par 'dren khyod ni/ /skye bo 6)phal chen don brtson bden la zhugs / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyis rtogs pa legs rtogs te/ /khyod kyis nyes par bsams ma yiyin/ /rab tu phye ba'i chos rnams las/1la/ /gtso bo gang yin de blangs so/ /'od srung 'khor skyo ba skyed cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs phye nas ji ltar sems mnyam par bzhag na rang gi stan gyi nang du mi snang bar gyur to/ /shar phyogs kyi steng sna gi bar / snang la mngon par 'phags nas spyod lam rnam pa bzhi byed de/ snga ma bzhin du phyogs bzhir rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul rnam pa bzhi bstan munas rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba dag bsdus te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar genas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs 8te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad 72wa 198

ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ni bdag gi ston pa lags so/ /bdag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das ni bdag gi ston pa lags so/ /bdag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos lags so/ /'od srung de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ 'od srung nga ni khyod kyi ston pa yin no/ /khyod ni nga'i nyan thos yin no/ /'od srung nga ni khyod kyi ston pa yin no/ /khyod ni nga'i nyan thos yin no/ /'od srung khyod rang gi stan ji lta ba la 'dug shig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa steng rgyas 'od srung gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas ma ga d+ma'i 6)bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong chen po ni lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi tshangs par spyod pa la mi spyod kyi lteng (brgyas 'od srung ral pa can nyid ni dge sbyong chen po'i tshangs par spyod pa la spyod do snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ma ga d+ma'i (gyirgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po la bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po gzugs la skye ba yang yod/ 'jig (7pa yang yod / de'i skye ba dang 'jig 6)pa yang rig par bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa la skye ba yang yod/'jig pa yang yod de⑥/ de'i skye ba dang / 'jig pa yang rig par bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po yang rigs kyi bus gzugs kyi skye ba dang 'jig ⑦pa'i chos nyid rig nas gzugs de yongs su shes so/ /rgyal po chen po rigs kyi bus tshor ba dang ske/ 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa'i skye ba dang / 'jig pa'i chos nyid rig nas rnam par shes pa de 67yongs su shes so/ /rgyal po chen po rigs kyi bus gzugs yongs su shes na gzugs la bdag gam 72wa 199

bdag gir khas mi len na 1)mi 'dzin lhag par mi gnas mngon par zhen ②par mi byed do/ /rgyal po chen po rigs kyi bus tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su shes na bdag gam bdag gir khas mi len na (5)mi 'dzin lhag par mi liganas mngon par zhen par mi byed do/ /rgyal po chen po rigs kyi bus gzugs la bdag gam bdag gir khas mi len/mi 'dzin/ lhag par mi gnas/ mngon par zhen par mi byed na tshad med cing grangs med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yin no zhes smra'o⑤/ /rgyal po chen po rigs kyi tshi)bus tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed ⑦dang / rnam par shes pa la bdag gam bdag gir khas mi len mi 'dzin/ lhag par mi gnasal/ mngon par zhen par mi byed na tshad med cing grangs med pa'i nimya ngan las 'das pa yin no zhes smra'o/ /de nas ma ga ṅgā'i 'bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te gzugs bdag ma yin/ tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa bdag ma yin na/ 'o na bdag gam/ sems can nam/ srog gam/ skye ba po'amatshu/ gso ba po'am/gang zag gam/ shed las skyes sam/ shed bu'am/ byed pa po'am/ byed du 'jug pa po'am/ shes pa po'am/ kun nas shes pa po'am/ slong ba po'am/kun nas slong ba po'am/ smra ba po'am/ kun nas smra ba po'am tshor ba po'am / kun nas tshor ba po gang yin pa nam yang ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing da ltar yang yod pa gang gis de dang der dge ⑩ba dang / sdig pa'i las byas pa rnams kyi ḍa/gernam par smin 8pa so sor nyams su myong zhing gang gis phung po 'di bor te phung po gzhan dang nying mtshams sbyor ④ba de su zhig yin par 'gyur 72—200
