snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 6)thugs kyis ma ga d+ma'i (0bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyi sems mkhyen nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bdag bdag ces bya ba ni byis pa so so'i skye bo thos pa dang mi ldan pas btags pa'i rjes su ltung ba yin te/ 'di la bdag ce'am / bdag gi med kyi dge slong dag skye ba na sdug bsngal 'di skye zhing 'gag pa na yang sdug bsngal 'di 'gag go/ /skye ba na 'du byed rnams skye zhing 'gag pa na'ang 'du byed rnams 'gag par 'gyur ④te/ rgyu de ⑤dang rkyen de la brten nas sems can rnams kyi 'du byed kyi rgyud 'jug go/ /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pas 'du byed kyi nying mtshams sbyor ba thugs su chud nas sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba 'dogs ⑥par mdzad deg/ dge slong dag ngas lha'i spyan rnam par dag pa'i mi las 'das pas sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho zhes bya ba nas/bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du lha rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya bar mkhyen to zhes bya ba'i bar du gong ma bzhin no/ /dge slong dag ngas de ltar mkhyen cing de ltar gzigs pas nga 'di skad ces bdag gam/ sems can nam zhes bya ba nas tshor ba po zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ⑧ste/ gang nam yang ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing da ltar yang yod pa ma yin pas gang gis de dang der sdig pa'i las byas pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa so sor nyams su myong zhing gang gis phung po 'di bor te phung po gzhan dang nying mtshams sbyor ba de chos su brdar btags ⑨pa ma gtogs pa 'di yin no zhes mi gsung ngo ⑩/ /de la chos kyi brdar btags pa ni 'di yin te/ 'di lta ste/ 'di yod pas 'di yod / 'di skyes pas 'di skye ba ste/ 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du 72—201

byed / 'du byed kyi 4)rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa/ rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs/ ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis skye mched drug /skye mched drug gi na)rkyen gyis reg pa/ reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba/ tshor ba'i rkyen gyis sred ( napa/ srid pa'i rkyen gyis len pa/ len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa/ srid pa'i rkyen gyis skye ba/ skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba rigadang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'byung ste/ de ltar sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig po 'di 'byung 5bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ 'di med pas 'di med la/ 'di 'gags pas 'di 'gag par 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag /'du byed 'gags pas rnam par shes pa 'gagazhu /rnam par shes pa 'gags pas ming dang gzugs 'gag /ming dang gzugs 'gags ⑦pas skye mched drug 'gag /skye mched drug 'gags (kyepas reg pa 'gag /reg pa 'gags 9 pas tshor ba 'gaga'i /tshor ba 'gags pas sred pa 'gag /sred pa 'gags pas len pa 'gag /len pa 'gags pas srid pa 'gag /srid pa 'gags pas skye ba 'gag /skye ba 'gags pas rga shi dang mya ngan ⑩dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa ⑫rnams 'gags te/ / de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po ④'ba' zhig po 'di 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag 'du byed rnams ni sdug bsngal lo/ /mya ngan las 'das pa ni zhi ba'o/ /rgyu kun 'byung bas sdug bsngal kun 'byung zhing rgyu 'gags 8pas sdug bsngal 'gag ste/ rgyun bcad pas mi 'byung zhing nying mtshams sbyor ba med pas 'gags pa 'di nyid ni sdug bsngal gyi mtha' yin 72—202

no / /dge slong dag 6)de la yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa gang zhe na/ gzhan med ②kyi sdug bsngal 'gag pa gang (geyin pa de ni nye bar zhi ba/ de ni bsil bar gyur pa/ de ni nub pa ste/ dge slong dag zhi ba'i gnas ni 'di yin te/'di lta ste/ phung po thams cad spangs pa srid pa zad pa 'dod chags dang bral ba 'gags pa mya ngan las 'das pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang ma ga d+ma'i ④rgyal po bzo sbyangs zhi)gzugs can snying po la lan gnyis su bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po ji snyam du sems/ gzugs rtag gam mi rtag /btsun pa 'di ni dumi rtag lags so/ /mi rtag pa gang yin pa de sdug bsngal yin nam / sdug bsngal ma yin/ btsun pa 'di ni sdug bsngal lags so/ /mi rtag pa sdug bsngal ba ⑦'gyur ba'i chos can gang yin pa de la ci ga 'phags pa'i nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa (nya'adi ni bdag yin no/ /bdag ni 'di yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi bdag go zhes bdag tu khas len par byed dam/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /rgyal po chen po ji snyam du sems/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa rtag gam mi rtag /btsun pa 'di ni mi rtag po)lags so/ /mi rtag pa gang yin pa de sdug bsngal yin nam sdug bsngal bom yin/btsun pa 'di ni sdug bsngal lags so/ /mi rtag pa (1sdug bsngal bar ()'gyur ba'i chos can gang yin pa de la ci ga 'phags pa'i nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa 'di ni bdag yin no/ /bdag ni 'di 9/geyin no/ /'di ni tshubadag gi bdag go zhes bdag tu khas len par byed dam/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /rgyal po chen po de lta bas na khyod kyis gzugs gang ci yang rung / 'das pa'am7 ma 'ongs pa'am/ da ltar byung ba'am/ nang gi'am/ phyi'i 'am/ ngan pa'am/72—203

gya rnam pa'am/ gang dag thag ring ba'am/ gang dag thag nye ba yang rung ste/de thams cad la 'di ni bdag ma yin no/ /bdag ni 'di ma yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi bdag ma yin no zhes de bzhin du yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis ji lta ba bzhin du blta bar bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po de lta bas na khyod kyis tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed gang ci yang rung ba dang / rnam par shes pa gang ci yang rung ba 'das pa'am/ ma 'ongs pa'am/ da ltar byung ba'am/ nang gi'am / phyi'i 'amatsho )/ rags pa'am/ phra ba'am/ ngan pa'am/ gya nom pa'am / gang dag thag ring ba'am/ gang dag thag nye ba yang rung ste/ de dag thams cad la 'di ni bdag ma yin no/ /bdag ni 'di ma yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi bdag ma yin no zhes de bzhin du yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis ji lta ba bzhin du blta bar bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa de ltar mthong ba ni gzugs la yang yid 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / — rnam par shes pa la yang yid 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yid byung na 'dod chags dang 'bral ②lo/ /'dod chags dang bral gen rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par grol na bdag gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa bsten to/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na ma ga d+ma'i ④rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po dang / lha brgyad khri dang / ma ga d+ma'i 0bram ze dang / khyim bdag 'bum phrag du ma chos rnams la chos kyi ⑥mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes so / /de nas ma ga d+ma'i (gergyal po bzo sbyangs dugazugs can snying pos chos mthong 72—204

ba dang / chos thob ①pa dang / chos rig pa dang / chos kyi gting slebs pa dang ske/ som nyi las rgal ②ba dang / the tsom (snyelas rgal ④ba dang / gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang / gzhan gyis mi bkri ba dang / ston pas bstan pa'i chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob ⑤nas stan 6)las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar ⑦nas bcom ldan 'das gang (nyan ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de ⑨bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /bdag btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dang —/ chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis bodage bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar yimangon par dad lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun du 8bcas pa la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du na bza' chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / gzims cha dang ske/ snyun 8dpyad kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur bgyid ⑫lags na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab kyi 8ma ga d+ma'i ⑩rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas ma ga d+ma'i ⑩rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma ga dhā (nyenas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang rgyal po'i khab tu byon nas rgyal po'i khab bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs yiso/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab na mu stegs yang dag ⑥ rgyal ba can zhes 72—205

bya ba skyes nas ring po ma lon par de rnams kyi ston pa dus byas par gyur pa dang /de rnams kyi nang na nye rgyal dang / pang nas skyes zhes bya ba gnyis tshogs yongs su sdud 4)pa dang / tshogs kyi 'dren par gyur pa gang yin pa de yongs su 'dren pa na de gnyis kyis 'di ltar yu bu cag las gcig gis bdud rtsi sngar rnyed kyang de gcig la gcig smra bar bya'o zhes dam bca' ba byas so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul snga dro sham thabs bgos/ lhung bzed dang / chos gos thogs te ②'gro ba dang / ldog pa dang / cung zad lta ba dang / rnam par lta ba dang /bskum pa dang / brkyang ba dang / snam sbyar dang / chos gos dang / lhung bzed thogs pa mdzes pas rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /de'i tshe na kun tu rgyu nye rgyal rgyal po'i khab tu bya ba zhig gi phyir spyod yul du zhugs pas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul 'gro ba dang / ldog pa dang / cung zad lta ba dang /rnam par lta ba dang / bskum pa dang / brkyang ba dang / snam sbyar dang /chos gos dang / lhung bzed thogs pa mdzes pas rgyal po'i khab na bsod snyoms ⑧la rgyu ba thag ring po kho nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/rgyal po'i khab 'dir rab tu byung ba ji snyed lhags shing gnas pa dag las 'di lta ste / rab tu byung ba 'di'i spyod lam 'di lta bu ni bdag gis sngon chad 'ga' yang ma mthong gis bram la bdag de'i gan ⑤du song ste/ dge slong khyed ⑥kyi ston pa ni gang yin/ gang gi phyir ni rab tu byung / su'i chos la ni dga' zhes dri'o snyam du rig nas lam po che rub pa zhig na 'gro ba dang ldog pas shas cher stisdod cing 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul kun tu rgyu nye rgyal ga la ba der song ngo / /de nas kun tu rgyu nye rgyal gyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la 'di skad ces 72—206

smras so/ /dge slong khyod kyi ston pa ni gang yin/ gang gi phyir ni 6)rab tu byung /su'i chos la ni dga'/ tshe dang ldan pa shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong gi ta ma shākya'i rigs ②las skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig dag bgos te dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba ①zhig yod debya/ de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas kho bo'i ston ⑤pa ni bcom ldan 'das de yin no/ /kho bo de'i phyir rab tu byung ngo / /kho bo de'i chos la dga'o/ /dge slong de'i phyir chos ston cig /tshe dang ldan pa kho bo ni na gzhon pa dang / rab tu byung ba gsar pas de'i phyir kho bos bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de'i bstan pa rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan par sla ba ma yin te/ 'on kyang 'di ltar de'i don bstan par bya'o/ /dge slong kho bo la ni don dgos kyi tshig ni shin tu mang pos kyang ci bya ste/ khyod kyis don mang yang rung nyung yang rung ston cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byung ba dang / / de yi ⑥rgyu dang de 'gog ⑦gang yin pa'ang / /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis bka' stsal teni/ /de skad gsung pa'i tshul can dge sbyong che/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na/ kun tu rgyu nye rgyal chos rnams la chos 6)kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes so/ /de nas kun tu rgyu nye rgyal chos mthong ba dang / chos thob pa dang /7 chos rig pa dang / chos kyi gting 0slebs pa dang /som nyi tshulas rgal tsob dang / the tsom yilas rgal 8ba dang / gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang / gzhan gyis mi bkri ba dang / ston pas bstan pa'i chos 72—207

rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob nas ro stod bsrang nas lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste/tshe dang ldan pa rta thul ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de ①de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ skyob pa rnams kyi chos 'di yin/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig tu/ /sngon chad ma mthong ma thos pa/ /'chi med mya ngan med pa yil/ /go 'phang 'di la rjes su rtogs/ /tshe dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das de dud lta ga la bzhugs/ tshe dang ldan pa rgyal po'i khab na bya'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ku'i gnas 'di nyid na'o/ /de nas kun tu rgyu nye rgyal tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis smras pa la mngon par bstod (5)pa dang rjes su yi ⑥rang ba byas te⑦/ tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyi rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la lan gsum bskor ba byas te song nas kun tu (kyergyu pang nas skyes ga la ba der song ngo / /kun tu rgyu pang nas skyes kyis kun tu rgyu nye rgyal thag ring po kho na ⑨nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang kun tu rgyu nye rgyal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyi dbang 7po rnams ni rnam par dngas/ bzhin 7gyi mdog ni yongs su dag pags 8pa'i mdog ni yongs su dkar na khyod kyis bdud rtsi rnyed dam/ tshe dang ldan pa rnyed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa de'i phyir 0chos ston cig /de nas kun tu rgyu nye rgyal gyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byung ba dang / /de yi rgyu dang 8de 'gog gang yin btso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis bka' stsal te⑩/ /de skad gsung pa'i tshul can dge sbyong che/ /tshe dang ldan pa da dung yang lan cig rjod ⑩cig /tshe dang ldan pa brjod par bya'o/ /chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byung ba dang / /zhes pa la ⑫sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad yipa na kun tu rgyu pang 72—208

nas skyes chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes so/ /de nas kun tu rgyu pang nas skyes chos mthong ba dang / chos thob pa dang / chos rig pa dang / chos kyi gting slebs pa dang / som nyi 6)las rgal (gyib dang /the com ①las rgal ④ba dang / gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang / gzhan gyis mi bkri ba dang / ston ⑤pas bstan pa'i chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob nas ro stod bsrang dunas lag pa g.yas pa ⑦brkyang ste/ kun tu rgyu nye rgyal ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de ⑧de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ skyob pa rnams kyi chos 'di yin/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig tu/ /sngon chad ma mthong ma thos pa/ /'chi med mya ngan med pa yi/ /go 'phang 'di la rjes su rtogs/ /tshe dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das de da lta ga la bzhugs/ tshe dang ldan pa rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ku'i gnas 'di nyid na'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa tshur shog /bcom ldan 'das de'i spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa de'i phyir je 6)'khor la blta bar bya ste/ bdag cag lta bu mi grags pa dang ldan pa/ shes par gyur pa dag gis 'khor la blta ba ni legs pa yin no/ /de nas kun tu rgyu nye rgyal dang / pang nas skyes gnyis kyis bram ze'i khye'u rnams la smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u rnams shes par gyis shig /kho bo cag gnyis ni bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par spyad ⑩pa spyod par byed na khyed cag ji ltar byed/ mkhan po gnyis bdag cag cung zad ci 'tshal ba gang lags pa de dag thams cad mkhan po gnyis las brten nas 'tshal ba lags na/ gal te mkhan po gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par spyad pa spyod na/ bdag cag kyang mkhan po gnyis rab tu byung ba'i rjes su rab 72—209

tu 'byung bar bgyi'o/ /bram ze'i khye'u rnams da de'i dus la bab par shes par gyis shig /de nas kun tu rgyu nye rgyal dang / pang nas skyes gnyis 'khor nyis brgya lnga bcu lnga bcu dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ngo / /de'i tshe na bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi ①'khor brgya phrag du ma'i gung la chos ston cing bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kun tu rgyu nye rgyal dang / pang nas skyes gnyis thag ring po kho nas gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyod ②kyis grogs po'i tshogs yongs su sdud pa/tshogs yongs su 'dren pa/ tshogs kyi mdun nas 'ong ba 'di lta ste/ nye rgyal dang / pang nas skyes gnyis mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong ngo / /'di gnyis ni nyan thos zung dang / zung gi mchog dang / zung bzang por gyur te/gcig ni rdzu 'phrul dang ldan ( pa rnams kyi mchog tu 'gyur la/ cig 0shos ni shes rab dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /de nas dge slong zhig gis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ ston pa dgongs yul mtha' yas pa/ /skyes bu'i dbang po mkhyen mthar byon/ /bcom ldan srid pa mthar mdzad pas/ /grogs po nye rgyal pang nas skyes/ /'od ma'i tshal du ma phyin (9par/ /de ltar mchi ba gzigs gyur nas/ tshogs mchog dbus su de gnyis ni/ /'di gnyis nga yi nyan thos kyi/ /zung mchog 'gyur zhes des bstan te/ /gcig ni rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i mchog /cig (7shes shes rab ldan pa yi/ /mchog tu 'gyur bar lung bstan mdzad/ /de nas kun tu rgyu nye rgyal dang / pang nas skyes gnyis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal ⑦te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces 72—210

gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa ①dge slong gi dngos por gnang na bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyi ②spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de gnyis la dge slong tshur shog ces bya bas rab tu byung zhing dge slong dag tshur shog /tshangs par spyad pa spyod cig ces bka' stsal pa dang ske/ de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi bka'i mjug kho nar skra byi ba dang / snam sbyar gyon par gyur te dulag na lhung bzed thogs pa ④spa dang kha spu zhag bdun skyes pa tsam dang / dge slong bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa'i spyod lam lta bur gnas par gyur to/ /yang smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas tshur shog bka' stsal pas/ /skra byi snam sbyar gyon pa'i lus ldan zhing / /mod la dbang po rab zhir (snyeganas gyur te/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pas lus gzugs bkab par gyur / /de nas dge slong rab tu mang po dag snga dro sham thabs bgos/ lhung ⑥bzed dang chos gos thogs te/ rgyal po'i khab tu bsod ⑦stoms la zhugs pa dang / de nas rgyal po'i khab kyi mi gang dag yang dag rgyal ba can gyi mu stegs can gyi gnas (nyerab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas ring po ma lon pas yid ma rangs shing mngon par mi dga' ba de dag gis dge slong de dang ⑨de dag mthong nas co 'dri zhing tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ sangs rgyas ma ga dhā ⑩dag gi / /grong mchog rgyal po'i khab gshegs pas/ /yang dag rgyal ba'i kun khrid na / /phyin chad ci zhig bkri ⑩bar bya/ /des 8dge slong rnams spa 'gong zhing mi dga' ba dang / mi 'jigs pa med par gyur to/ / de nas yidage slong rab tu mang po dag rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms rgyus nas zas kyi bya ba byas te/ phyi dro 72—211

bsod snyoms mi len pas lhung bzed dang chos gos mkhos su phab nas①/ rkang pa gnyis bkrus te/ sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde bas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal (gete phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rab tu mang po dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa 'di na bdag cag dge slong rab tu mang po dag ①snga dro sham thabs 'tshal/lhung bzed dang chos gos dag thogs te/ rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / de nas rgyal po'i khab kyi mi gang dag yang dag ④rgyal ba can gyi mu stegs can gyi gnas nas rab tu byung zhi)zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas ring po ma lags pas (6)yid ma rangs ri )shing mngon par mi dga' ba (nyade dag gis dge slong de dang / de dag mthong nas co 'dri zhing tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ sangs rgyas ma ga dhā (9)dag gi/ /grong mchog rgyal po'i khab gshegs pas/ /yang dag rgyal ba'i kun khrid na/ /phyin chad ci zhig bkri bar bya/ /zhes mchi 7nas des bdag cag rnams spa /mgong zhing mi dga' ba dang / mi 'jigs pa ma 8mchis par gyur /sheto/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rgyal po'i khab kyi mi de skad zer ba rnams la 'di skad ces/ 'di la dpa' chen bde gshegs dgatso /dam pa'i chos kyis 8khrid mdzad de/ /de dag chos kyis khrid mdzad la/ /mkhas pa su zhig mi bzod byed/ /ces brjod na rgyal po'i khab kyi mi de skad zer ba rnams kyi rlom pa tsam mamatshu/ spobs ⑩pa tsam gang yin pa de thams cad kyi thams cad du med par gyur to8/ /de nas dge slong rab tu mang po dag snga dro sham thabs bgos/ lhung bzed dang 7chos gos thogs te 6)rgyal 72—212

po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / de nas rgyal po'i khab kyi mi gang dag yang dag rgyal ba can gyi mu stegs can gyi gnas nas yonyerab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas ring po ma lon pas yid ma rangs shing mngon par mi dga' ba de dag gis dge slong de dang de dag mthong nas co 'dri ②zhing tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ sangs rgyas ma ga dhā yidag gi/ /grong mchog rgyal po'i khab gshegs pas/ /yang dag rgyal ba'i kun khrid na/ /phyin chad ci zhig bkri bar bya / /de nas dge slong zhig gis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ 'di na dpa' chen bde gshegs dag /dam pa'i chos kyis khrid mdzad de/ /de dag chos kyis khrid ④mdzad la/ /mkhas pa su zhig bzod mi byed/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / rgyal po'i khab kyi mi de skad phyizir ba rnams kyi rlom pa tsam mamayi/spobs ⑦pa tsam gang yin pa de thams cad kyi thams cad du med par gyur to/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis rgyal po zas gtsang la spring yig bskur ba/ lha dgyes pa bskyed du gsol/ khyod kyi sras kyis bdud rtsi thob nas bdud rtsis 'gro ba nitshim par byed do zhes spring ba rgyal po zas gtsang gis thos nas pho nya btang yonyeb las de de nyid du rab tu byung ste / pho nya gang dang gang btang ⑩ba de dang de dag ⑩de nyid du legs par gsungs ⑩pa'i chos 'dul ba nyid la rab tu byung bar gyur to/ /rgyal po zas gtsang lag pa 'gram pa la gtad tsonas pho nya gang dang gang btang 8ba de dang de dag de 8nyid du legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba nyid la rab tu byung ngo snyam nas sems khong du 8chud cing 'dug pa 'char mas mthong nas smras pa/ lha 72—213

khyod 3)ci'i slad du phyag ri la zhal gtad (minas thugs mi dgyes ④shing bzhugs/des smras pa/ 'char ka gang gi tshe/ gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa dga' (snyeb spyod pa de'i tshe kho bos spring yig skyel ba'i mi btang yib las de dag kho bo'i gan du 'ongs nas gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa bzhugs pa 'di dang 'dis bzhugs so zhes smra'o/ /da 57)ni kho bos spring yig skyel ba'i mi btang na 'ga' ⑧yang phrin yig khyer te mi 'ong na ji ltar sems khong du chud par mi 'gyur/'char yis 9smras pa/ lha bdag mchis te bka' mchid 'tshal la slar mchi'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ 'char ka gang dang gang song ba de dang de'i bstan pa phun sum mutshogs pa mthong nas de nyid du 'dug pas khyod kyang song na de nyid du 'dug par 'gyur ba'i gnas gang yin pa de yod do/ /'char gas smras pa/ lha slar mchis /glelags so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang rang nyid kyis spring yig bris pa/ lhums su zhugs pa bzung nas su/ khyod ni bdag gis cher bskrun tem/ /nyon mongs me rab 'bar bzhin du/ /rgyal ba ljon shing la bsten na / /de nyid khyod kyi slob ma yim/ /yal ga lcug ma 'phel 'gyur bas8/gzhan ni bde bas dga' bar 'gyur/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal skal bar 8ldan/ /gzhan yang gang gis khyod ni ljon shing lcug phran mtshungs tsam na/ /bdag gi skyebu ni 'di yin snyam nas chung nas bskrun bskrun 7te/ /bu gcig yul mis 'bras bu yongs su spyad pa thob gyur yin/ /de la yon tan 'bras bu mi ster (rkyekhyod la snying rje med/ /gang tshe thog ma bltam zho 3 pa na( nye/ /nyid don bsgrubs nas gnyen rnams ni/ /shin tu che (zhusadang phan gdags zhes/ /khyod kyis dam bcas mdzad pas na/ /khyod kyis zhi gnas de brnyes na/ /bdag dang gnyen gyi 72—214

tshogs rnams la/ /thugs brtses rjes su gzung mdzod de/ /gshegs par dgongs pa mdzad du gsol/ /zhes spring ba'i yi ge 'char 0)kas khyer nas chas (gete rim gyis mnyan yod du phyin pa dang / lam gyis dub pa ngal bsos nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol ba'i yi ge lags so/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das la yi ge phul ba dang —/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis bzhes nas bklags (bso/ /bklags ④nas yi ge mtha' gcig 0tu bzhag pa dang / 'char kus (6)gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ ser skya'i gzhir mi bzhud dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'char ka 'dong ngo / /'char ka sngon bcom ldan 'das dang lhag par 'dris pa yin pas de sngon gyi ⑦'dris pa kho nas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te mi bzhud dang bdag gi mthus bkri bar bgyi lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di la tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/gang zhig yul gyi rgyal mor ma chags shing / /srid (8༄'gas bkri ba yod pa ma yin pa'i / /sangs rgyas spyod yul mtha' yas mnga' ba de/ /gzhi med na ni gang gi gzhi yis bkri/ /gang zhig yul gyi rgyal mor ma chags shing / /sred 'gas 6)bkri ba yod pa ma yin pa'i/ /sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa yi rtsal mnga' de/ /gzhi med na ni gang gi gzhi yis bkri/ /gang zhig bcom nas brtsegs pa med gyur cing / /'jig rten ma bcom chung 7zad yod min pa/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul mtha' yas mnga' ba de/ /gzhi med na ni gang gi gzhi yis bkri/ /lan la spobs pa med nas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mchi ste/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma la rig par bgyi'o/ /'char ka sangs rgyas kyi pho nya ni 'di lta bu ma 72—215

yin no/ /'char kus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci 'dra ba zhig lags/rab tu byung ba yin gyis 6)khyod kyang rab tu byung shig /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis rgyal po zas gtsang la slar tshimachi bar dam bcas lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'char ka rab tu byung la ji ltar dam bcas ①pa bzhin du gyis shig /'di ltar bcom ldan 'das sngon byang chub sems dpar dugyur pa na yab dang / yum dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang / bla ma dang / bla ma'i gnas lta bu rnams kyis chos dang 'thun pa'i tshig lan 'ga' yang slar ma bzlog pas/ 'char gas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te de lta (5)na rab tu 'byung lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā (7ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu 'char ka ⑦'di ni yun ring po'i don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir rab tu phyung ⑧shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das la mnyan nas 'char ka rab tu byung ste/ bsnyen par rdzogs par byas nas kun tu spyod pa'i chos dag de la rgyas par smras nas/ 'char ka 'di ni khyod kyi bya ba yin te/deng phan chad bud med dang lhan cig khang pa gcig tu nyal bar mi bya'o zhes bya ba dag go/ /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes 'char kus tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos dzi༄phyag byas te song nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gzhir mchi lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'char ka song la khyod mod kho nar rgyal po'i khab tu ma 'jug par sgor 0sdod la 72—216

shākya'i dge slong 'ongs so zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te nang du spyon cig zer na 'jug par bya'o/ /zhugs nas gal te shākya'i dge slong gzhan yang yod dam zhes zer na/ yod do zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa yang 'di 'dra ①zhing cha byad 'di ②'dra'am zhes 'dri na/ 'di 'dra zhing cha byad 'di 'dra'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ /khyod kyis rgyal po'i khab tu yang gnas par mi bya'o/ /gal te gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa yang rgyal po'i ⑧khab tu gnas par mi byed dam zhes 'dri na/ mi bzhugs so zhes brjod par bya'o / /gal te gang du gnas par byed ces 'dri na/ dgon pa'am/ gtsug lag khang du'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te gtsug lag khang ci 'dra zhes 'dri na / rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi rnam pa bris te bstan par bya'o/ /gal te gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa byon nam zhes 'dri na/ byon no zhes brjod par bya'o/ /ji srid cig na byon zhes 'dri na/ zhag bdun lon na'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ /des gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mchi lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa song ④shig /sa bdag rnams ni tshig gis te / /lha rnams bsams ①pas 'grub ⑥'gyur zhing / /de bzhin bsam ⑦gtan pa rnams kyi/ /sems bskyed pas ni thams cad 'grub/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka de ji ltar skad cig de nyid la grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir ⑧song ba de ltar byin gyis brlabs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka bcom ldan 'das la dad pa drag po skyes pa de rgyal po'i khab kyi sgor bsdad nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag rgyal po la shākya'i dge slong mchis so zhes gsol cig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ ci shākya'i dge slong gzhan dag kyang yod dam/ shes 72—217

ldan dag yod do/ /de rnams kyis rgyal po la smras pa/ shākya'i dge slong mchis so / /rgyal pos smras pa/ nang du thong 4)shig /de nang du zhugs pa rgyal po zas gtsang gis mthong nas smras pa/ 'char ka rab tu byung ngam/ lha rab tu byung ngo / /khyod slar 'ong ngo zhes smras tshon)pa ma (miyin nam/ 'di ci yin/ 'char mas smras pa/ lha bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas kyi pho nya ni 'di lta bu ma yin no / /zhes bka' stsal nas chos 'dul ba legs par gsungs pa'i ④phyir bdag rab tu byung 555med kyi bdag rang gi dad pas kyang rab tu byung ngo / /rgyal pos yan lag thams cad kyis 'khyud 56)nas stan bshams pa nyid la 'dug tu bcug ste / de'i don du chur ( rabatsags pa dang / 'bras bu btags ⑧pa gtsang sbra byas te zar bcug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka mchog tu nye bar zhi ba dang /dul (9)bar gnas pa dang ldan zhing ji skad rjes su bstan pa'i cho gas ⑩yongs su longs spyod do/ /rgyal pos de la brtags nas ngo mtshar skyes te smras pa/'char ka ci gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa yang 'di 'dra bar nye bar zhi ba yin nam/ 'char mas smras pa/ lha bdag gi dul ba dang nye bar zhi ba ni cung zad tsam lags so/ /dper ji lta nyu7bu ri rab dang yungs 'bru bzhin no/ /rgya mtsho dang rmig rjes bzhin no/ /nyi ma dang srin bu me khyer bzhin no/ /nam mkha' dang pad ma'i rtsa ba'i bu ga bzhin no/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa / 'char ka gzhon mi nu don thams cad grub pa yang 'di 'dra zhing cha byad 'di 'dra'am / lha 'di 'dra zhing cha byad kyang 'di 'dra'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang brgyal nas sa la 'gyel ba dang / chu mang du btab nas dbugs slar phyung ste smras pa/ 'char ka gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa byon nam/ 'char kus 72—218

smras pa/ lha byon no/ /dus ji tsam na dgung bdun lon na'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan (1)gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa byon par 'gyur gyis②/ rgyal po'i khab dang pho brang byi dor byos shig /'char gas smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni pho brang du bzhugs par mi mdzad do/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gang du bzhugs/ 'char gas smras pa/ dgon pa'am/gtsug ①lag khang du'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ 'char ka gtsug lag khang ci 'dra ba yin/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi rnam pa ④ri mor bris te bstan to/ /de nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la smras pa/shes ldan dag n+ya gro d+ma'i (5)kun dga' ra bar rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi rnam pa gtsug lag khang chen po bcu drug dang / khang phran drug cu brtsig (6)tu chug shig /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes blon po rnams kyis rgyal po zas gtsang stilas mnyan nas n+ya gro ṅgā'i 6)kun dga' ra bar rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi rnam pa gtsug 6)lag khang chen po bcu drug dang / khang phran drug cu brtsig 6tu bcug go / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal te(7/ mod gal gyi bu song la dge slong rnams la bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gzhir gshegs te yab sras gdan 'dzom na/ khyod cag las su zhig lta bar 7spro ba de chos gos dag long 6)shig ces bsgo yishig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal ⑩zhes tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das las tsomanyan nas dge slong rnams la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gzhir gshegs te/ yab sras gdan 'dzom na/khyed cag las su lta bar spro ba de chos gos dag long 7shig ces bka' stsal to/ /72—219

de nas bcom ldan 'das dul ba 'khor dul ba/ zhi ba 'khor zhi ba/ grol ba 'khor grol ba/ dbugs phyin pa/ 'khor dbugs phyin pa/ rnam par dul ba 'khor rnam par dul ba/ dgra bcom pa 'khor dgra bcom pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba 'khor 'dod chags dang bral ba/ mdzes pa 'khor mdzes pa khyu mchog ba lang gi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ glang po che glang po'i phrug ①gu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ seng ge mche ba can gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ngang pa'i rgyal po ngang pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ nam mkha' lding bya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ bram ze slob ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/sman pa mkhas pa nad pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ dpa' bo ru pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ lam mkhan 'gron ①po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ded dpon tshong pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ khams kyi rgyal po blon po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bu stong gis bskor ②ba lta bu/ zla ba rgyu skar gyi ci)tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ nyi ma 'od zer stong gis bskor ba lta bu/ yul 'khor skyong dri za'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/'phags 55)skyes po grul bum gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ mig ⑥mi bzang klu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ rnam thos kyi bu gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ thags bzangs zhu )ris lha ma yin gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ brgya byin sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ tshangs pa tshangs ris kyi tshogs kyis bskor 5geb lta bu/ rgya mtsho g.yo ba med pa lta bu/ sprin chu dang bcas pa lta bu/ glang po dam pa dregs pa dang bral ba ltar dbang po rnams shin tu dul bas spyod lam gyi tshul ma 'khrugs pa sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa 72—220

gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus rnam par mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa'i sku nyi ma'i 'od zer 6)stong bas lhag pa'i 'od can/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar ②kun nas mdzes pa/stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i ②dran pa nye bar gzhag ④pa gsum dang / thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig (nyetu 'bab chu ro hi ta kur byon to/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa 'bab chu ro hi ta kur byon to zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang rgyal po zas gtsang gis grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi rdo ⑥ba dang gyo mo dang / gsog ⑦ma rnams bsal nas tsan dan gyi chus chag chag btab / dri shin tu zhim po'i pog por nye bar bshams/ dar gyi chun 'phyang (8)mang po dpyangs 6)te/ gang yang 'bab chu ro hi ta ka nas gang yang n+ya gro d+ma'i ⑩kun dga' ra ba de'i bar gyi lam shin tu mdzes par byas te/ sa phyogs yangs shing rgya che bar gdan rnam par bkra ba dag shom (1du bcug go/ /de nas 'bab chu ro hi ta ka la dge slong 8kha cig ni lag pa 'khru bar byed do/ /kha cig ni so shing 'dor bar byed do/ /kha cig ni khrus byed do/ /ser skya'i gzhi na gnas pa'i shākya rnams kyis gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa gshegs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang kha cig ni sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas bskul/ kha cig ni ya kyimatshan skyes nas thams cad n+ya gro d+ma'i 8kun dga' ra ba nas byung ste/ ci yab sras kyi zhabs la phyag byed dam/tso 'on te sras yab kyi zhabs la phyag byed pa blta'o ⑩snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ gal te nga zhabs kyis ser skya'i gzhir gshegs na shākya'i nga rgyal can rnams kye ma'o gzhon 72—221

nu don thams cad grub pas dka' thub kyi nags su gshegs nas ltog po zhig grub pa lta zhig ste/ de lta brgya nyu)stong phrag du mas zhabs ②'bring byas nas steng (5)gi nam mkha' las gshegs te des de srid du dka' ba brgya stong spyad pas bdud rtsi thob nas nga zhabs kyis gshegs pa lta zhes ma dad pa skyes par 'gyur ro snyam nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs mnyam par bzhag na/ shar phyogs kyi steng gi bar snang la mngon par 'phags nas spyod lam rnam pa ④bzhi mdzad de/ 'di lta ste/ 'chag pa dang / bzhengs pa dang / bzhugs pa dang / mnal ba 53)mdzad do/ /me'i ting nge 'dzin la yang snyoms par 'jug par mdzad de/ me'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku las 'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs dag 'byin par mdzad de/'di lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / le brgan 'chidang / shel gyi kha dog dag go/ /cho 'phrul zung du yang ston par mdzad de ni/ sku'i smad nas me 'bar bar mdzad la/ sku'i stod nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bebs par mdzad de58)/ sku'i stod nas me 'bar bar mdzad la / sku'i smad nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bebs par dzi)mdzad pa de lta bu'i ⑩ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs kyi so/ /shar phyogs la ji lta bar lho dang / nub dang byang phyogs su yang de bzhin no/ /phyogs bzhir rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul rnam pa bzhi bstan nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon par 'du mdzad pa de bsdus te ta la bdun gyi srid tsam na bzhugs so/ /dge slong rnams ni ta la drug gi srid tsam na'o / /bcom ldan 'das drug gi srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams lnga'i srid tsam na'o / /bcom ldan 'das lnga'i srid tsam na ni 8dge slong rnams bzhi'i srid tsam 72—222

na'o / /bcom ldan 'das bzhi'i srid tsam na ni 0)dge slong rnams gsum gyi srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gsum gyi srid (btsam na ni dge slong rnams gnyis kyi srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gnyis kyi srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams ta la gcig gi srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mi bdun gyi srid tsam na bzhugs na ni dge slong rnams mi drug gi srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das drug gi srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams lnga'i srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das lnga'i srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams bzhi'i srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bzhi'i srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams gsum gyi srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gsum gyi srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams gnyis kyi srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gnyis kyi srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams mi gang lhag tsam na'o//bcom ldan 'das mi chagang lhag tsam na ni dge slong rnams sa la'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis cho 'phrul de lta bu de dang / dge slong mang po mthong nas de la bcom ldan 'das gang yin pa ma shes te rmongs par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la smras pa/ 'char ka 'di na (4)ngur smrig gyon pa'i rab tu byung ba mang po zhig yod na de la gzhon nu gang yin/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char mas bcom ldan 'das bstan nas smras pa/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das lags so/ /srid pa'i mthar byed sems kyi dbang phyug 'dren pa lags/ /'di ni nyon mongs sel mdzad nyin byed don ni kun tu ston (snyemadzad lags/ /'di ni dgongs pa bzhin brnyes stobs bcu mnga' bas kun gyi pha rol gshegs pa lags/ /dri med btsal ba chos kyi dbang phyug khyod kyi sras lags mi dbang de gzigs shig⑥ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis lus btud nas zhabs la phyag byas te tshigs su 72—223

bcad pas gsol pa/ blo gros yangs pa khyod la 'di dang ni/ /kun spyan zhabs la lan gsum phyag bgyis te/ /bltam 0)pa'i tshe na sa ni g.yos pa dang / /'dzam bu'i grib mas sku las ma 'das pa'o/ /de nas shākya dang shākya mo rnams kyis rgyal po zas gtsang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs pa mthong nas de ltar yab sras kyi zhabs la phyag byed pa ci'i tha tshig ces ma dad pa bskyed do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis shākya dang shākya mo rnams la go bar bya ba'i phyir 'di skad ces smras so/ /shes ldan dag da gdod kho bos gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa'i zhabs la phyag byas pa ma yin te/ gang gi tshe na gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa bltam ②pa na sa chen po g.yos par gyur cing du'ajig rten 'di thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos gsal bar gyur ④te/ 'jig rten na 'jig rten gyi bar gyi mun pa (gesun nag smag tu gyur pa nyi ma dang / zla ba 'di gnyis 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba 'di ltar mthu che ba'i 'od kyi snang ba nyams su ma myong ba gang yin pa de yang de'i tshe snang ba chen pos gsal bar gyur nas sems can gang dag skyes pa de dag snang ba des sems can dag gcig 0gis gcig mthong nas/shes ldan dag sems can gzhan dag kyang 'dir skyes pa lta/ shes ldan dag sems can gzhan dag kyang 'dir skyes pa lta zhes ngo shes par gyur pa de'i tshe yang kho bos byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas so/ /gang gi ⑦tshe gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa zhing las kyi mtha' la gzigs ⑧pa na shing 'dzam bu'i grib ma la bzhugs nas 'dod pa rnams las dben pa/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams las dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas ⑨dpyod pa dang bcas pa / dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba zag pa med pa dang mtshungs 72—224

pa'i bsam ①gtan dang po bsgrubs te bzhugs pa na/ shing gzhan rnams kyi grib ma ni shar phyogs su gzhol(mi/ shar phyogs su 'bab/ shar phyogs su bab kyang shing 'dzam bu'i grib ①ma ni byang chub sems dpa'i sku las ma 'das par gyur pa de'i tshe yang ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos des kho bo'i ④yid bsdus pas/bcom ldan 'das kyi duzhabs la yang phyag byas te/ 'di dang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la lan gsum phyag byas so/ /de bas na 'di skad ces/ blo gros yangs pa khyod la 'di dang ni/ /kun spyan zhabs la lan gsum phyag bgyis te/bltam ⑥pa'i tshe na sa 'di phyagayos pa dang / /'dzam (7bu'i grib ma sku las ma 'das pa'o/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa de brtul nas 'khor brgya phrag du ma zil gyis mnan nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang skad 'dzer 0cing mig mchi mas gang bas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ gzhal med khang gi gnas rnams las/ /yab kyi khab na bzhugs pa las/ /dgon pa 'jigs dang bcas rnams su/ /ji lta bur ni 'ba' zhig bzhugs7/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi yi bdag po gang du ni/ /khyim gyi (7'ching ba las grol ba/ /'phags pa yi ni gnas pa bcus/ /thub pa rnams ni gnas par mdzad/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ ba so gser gyi rtsa ba can/ /shin tu bde ba bting ba yi8—/ /khri la mnal bar mdzad pa las/ /gding ba la ni ji ltar mnal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po rnam grol gnas mal ni/ /dga' ba byang chub yan lag gi/ /me tog bkram par chags med cing / /72—225

yongs su gdung ba rnam 3)spangs mnal(gyi/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ dpa' bo nyid kyi pho brang na/ /glang po shing rta rtas bzhud pa/ /tsher mar bcas pa'i sa gzhi la / /zhabs kyis ji ltar gshegs par mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nga yi shing rta rdzu 'phrul rkang / /yang dag rtsol ba'i gzhol ba yis/ /sa kun (mirnam par rgyu na yang / /nyon mongs tsher mas gnod pa med/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol pa/ dpa' bo sngon ni ka shi ku'i/ /na bza' mnabs ④nas mdzes pa las(5)/ /ngur smrig rtsub 6)po'i gos mnabs 9)pa/ /ji ltar khyod kyi (kyisku yis bzod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po nga'i gos ngo tsha shes/ /nga 5nyeyi bgo ba snam sbyar te/ /de bgos thub pa zhi ba rnams/ /nags khrod na ni mdzes par 'gyur/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis (lhagasol pa/'di ltar khyod sngon gser gyi gzhang (nyapa nas/ /du ma'i ro ldan 'bras chan ⑫gsol ba las/ /'di ltar gtso bo da lta'i bsod snyoms ni/ /phal pa gsol ba ji ltar mgul du mchi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zas kyi sred ⑫pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /nges par byung dang mnyam par bzhag 8ldan pa'i / / nga yi 8chos kyi ro mchog gsol mod kyi/ /'jig rten la snying brtse ba'i phyir spyod do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol pa/ mgur du bde ba mang bgyid pa'i/ /rgun skyems kha ra'i chab yigasol na/ /rnyog pa can la dri nga ba'i/ /chab ni ji lta zhig tu gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi yi bdag po gang 'thungs na/ /bdag la 'thung ba thams cad ni/ dug dang 'dra bar snang gyur pa/ /chab kyi ro mchog nga ⑩'thung ngo / /rgyal po zas gtsang gis ⑫gsol pa/ 'di ltar khyod sngon bsil khang gzhal med khang / /khang bzangs yi72—226

steng na ji lta'i dus bzhin bzhugs/ /da ltar gcig pu nags khrod khyod bzhugs pa / /blo bzangs ①ji ltar bsnyengs (kyepa med par bzhugs(snye/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gi tam 'jigs pa'i rtsa ba gang yin pa/ /dri ma bag chags bcas par yang spangs pas/ /nga ④ni mya ngan 'jigs pa med gnas te / /nga la 'di na (nya'ajigs pa chung yizad med/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol pa/ khyod sngon khrus khang shin tu yid 'ong bar/ /khrus mchog khyad par 'phags pas rtag bsil na/ /gcig pu khyod ni nags khrod gnas ldan par/ /thub dbang da ltar su yis ༷khrus mdzad 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gi tam chos kyi mtsho phran dri med pa/ /tshul khrims 'jug ngogs dam pas bsngags pa ste/ /de la reg pa'i yon tan mi bkru na/ /lus mi gsher ⑧bar pha rol rab tu rgal6)/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol pa0/ dpa' bo nyid kyi tunyekhab na ni/ /gser dngul bum pas khrus mdzad na/ /rtog pa can la dri nga ba/ /chab kyis ji ltar khrus mdzad lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gi tam dad pa'i 'bab chu rnyog pa med/ /bsod nams 'jug ngogs dam pas bsngags pa ste/ /de la rig pa'i yon tan mi bkrus na/ /lus mi gsher bar pha rol rab tu rgal(nye/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol pa/dpa' bo khyod sngon ser skya yis/ /tsan dan gyis ni sku bkrus shing / /ka shi'i ⑫mchog gnas mdzes pa las/ /de dang bral nas mdzes ma lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshul khrims nga yi rgyan yin te/ /tshul khrims nyid ni byug pa yin/ /gser dang nor bu rna cha dag /rmongs skyes nga la ci zhig bya/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol pa/ gang gis khyod ni khyad du gsod④/ /gang 72—227

las 'jigs su rung ba skye/ /yid 'byung ba yang ga las skyel/ /zhus pa de dag bdag la gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gis nga ni khyod (gegasod dang / /gang zhig las ni 'jigs pa chadang / /gang las yid 'byung skyes pa dag /nyon cig ( )khyod la bshad par bya/ /rga dang na dang 'chi ba ste/ /gal te 'di gsum yod min na/ /nga yang shin tu yid 'ong ba'i/ /yul rnams la ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol pa/ shākya rnams kyi rigs dga' ba/ /legs par 'khrungs pa'i dpa' bo legs/ /khyod ni 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis/ /ji lta (7bur yang ma gos so/ /de nas rab dga' dad pa rgyas byas nasayi/ /drang srong dge 'dun bskor ba byas nas ni⑦/ /thub pa'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas te/ /bde bar gshegs la kun nas rtog cing 'dug /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 'di snyam du sems te/ gang bdag gi (kyebus yon tan gyi tshogs 'di lta bu thob pa ni ⑨bdag gi rnyed pa legs par rnyed do snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis n+ya gro rmye'i 0kun dga' ra bar 'khor de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ()dang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas de dang 'thun pa'i chos bshad pa tsomadzad de/ de thos pas zas dkar la sogs pa shākya bdun khri bdun stong gis rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te rgyal po zas gtsang ni ma gtogs so/ /lha sbyin snying rgyal las nga rgyal can sdig pa 'dod pa des bden pa mthong bar ma byas pas khro bas kun nas dkris 8pa dang bcas pas smras pa/ ci gal te bdag gis 'di 'dra ba'i sgyu mas dbang du byed pa shes na/ bdag gis kyang 'jig rten thams cad dbang du bya ba zhig /de la shākya rnams kyis gshe ba'i tshig gis smras pa/ lha sbyin 8bcom 72—228

ldan 'das ni rdzu 'phrul che ba yin gyis 6)de skad ma smra shig ces bzlog nas cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /tshangs pas bskor ba'i skyed mos tshal du 'di lta bu'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ de thos pas rgyal po zas gtsang ma gtogs par bre bo zas la sogs pa ④shākya drug nikhri drug stong gis rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa na yang lha sbyin ④de kho na bzhin du zer ro/ /ro hi ta ku'i skyed mos tshal du 'di lta dubu'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ de thos pas rgyal po zas gtsang ma gtogs par bdud rtsi zas la sogs pa shākya bdun khri lnga dustong gis rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa na yang lha sbyin ⑦de kho na bzhin du zer ro/ /'khor lhag ma rnams las kha cig gis ni nyan thos kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /kha cig gis ni rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu kha cig gis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu/ kha cig gis ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum ⑧du byas/ kha cig gis ni lan cig ①phyir 'ong ⑩ba'i 'bras bu/ kha cig gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ kha cig gis ni rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs (1te dgra bcom par gyur(1/kha cig gis ni sangs rgyas la skyabs su song / kha cig gis ni chos la/ kha cig gis ni dge 'dun la ste 'khor de dag phal cher 4)yang sangs rgyas la gzhol/chos la 'bab/ dge 'dun la bab par bkod do/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 'di snyam du sems te/ sngon ni bcom ldan 'das lha dang lha ma yin gyi 'gro bar bcas pas mchod pa dang / rjed pa dang mngon du smra bar bya bar ④gyur na/ da lta 8ni mis mchod kyis ⑩lhas ni ma yin no snyam mobya/ /de nas shākya gzhon nu zhig gis tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ drang srong chen po smra 72—229

mchog dam chos kyi/ /char pas 'gro ba 'di ni tshim mdzad 4)de/ /mi bzad lam du lhung ba'i 'jig rten 'di/ /drangs (mite thar pa'i lam la sbyor bar nusamadzod / /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ rgyal po zas gtsang ni 'di snyam du bdag gi bu 'ba' zhig /'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che zhing 'di ltar mthu che ba yin no snyam ste lhag par dga' ba las gyur gyis ④mdor na de'i dregs pa spong du gzhug go/ /rgyu gnyis kyis bden pa rnams mthong bar mi 'gyur te/ ha cang zhum pa dang shin tu dga' ba'o/ /de la zhum pa'i sems dang shin tu dga' ba yod kyis ma la ngas de'i zhum pa dang shin tu dga' ba gnyis spong du gzhug go snyam 55)nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu rgyal po zas gtsang ma la soms shig btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas rgyal po zas gtsang gang na ba der song ba dang / rgyal po zas gtsang gis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po rgyang ring po nas 'ong ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi zhirabu chen po tshur spyonari / mod gal gyi bu chen po khyod byon pa legs so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs shig /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos gdan bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos sems ji ltar mnyam par bzhag ⑧na/ rang gi stan las mi snang bar gyur te shar phyogs kyi steng gi bar snang la mngon par 'phags nas spyod lam rnam pa ri9༄bzhi byed de/ 'di lta ste/ 'chag pa dang / 'greng ba dang /72—230

'dug pa dang / nyal bar byed do/ /me'i ting nge 'dzin la yang snyoms par 'jug par byed dezhi)/ me'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa na/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i lus las 'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs dag 'byin par byed de②/ 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / /dkar po dang / le brgan (snyedang / shel gyi kha dog dag go/ /cho 'phrul zung du yang ston par byed do/ /lus kyi smad nas me 'bar bar byed la lus kyi stod nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bebs par byed do/ /lus kyi stod nas me 'bar bar byed ④la lus kyi smad nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bebs par byed pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /shar phyogs la ji lta ba (5)bzhin du lho dang /nub dang / byang phyogs su yang de bzhin no/ /phyogs bzhir (7rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul rnam pa bzhi bstan nas rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba bsdus (7)te stan (33bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba 'di ltar mthu che ba gzhan yang mchis lags sam/ rgyal po chen po mchis so zhes tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ mthu che ba dag gsum rig dang / /sems kyi rnam grangs shes pa dang ske/ /zag 5)zad dgra bcom gang yin pa/ /thub pa'i nyan thos mang du mchis / /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi bu 'ba' zhig 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che bar ma 7zad de 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba'i rab tu byung ba gzhan yang yod do snyam nas de shin tu dga' ba gang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur to/ /skabs der bcom ldan 'das kyis 72—231

'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa mdzad de/ kye ma brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams 'ongs na/ lha'i 'khor dag pa 6)la chos bshad do snyam pa dang / chos nyid kyis (9gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ③kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa mdzad pa de'i tshe/ srog chags grog spur rnams kyi sems dzon kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi (snyedagongs pa shes par 'gyur na/brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ gang gi tshe 'jig rten las 'das pa'i thugs bskyed pa de'i tshe nyan thos chen po rnams kyi sems kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa mi shes na brgya byin dang /tshangs pa la sogs te lha rnams kyis lta ci smos/ srog chags grog sbur rnams kyis lta ga la shes/ de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems te / bcom ldan 'das ci'i phyir 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa mdzad ⑨snyam pa las de 'di snyam du sems te/ lha'i 'khor dag pa rnams la chos 'chad par bzhed do snyam nas des lha'i bu bzo thams cad pa la bsgo ⑦ba/ bzo thams cad pa bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor dag pa la chos 'chad par bzhed kyis ⑧rgya gro ṅgā'i 59༄kun dga' ra bar rin po che sna bzhi'i khang pa brtsegs ⑩ma gdan sna tshogs bshams /glepa zhig sprul cig /kau shi ka 7khyod kyi gsung mchog tu bzang ngo —/ /zhes lha'i bu bzo thams cad pas lha'i dbang po brgya byin las mnyan 8te n+ya gro dha'i mukun dga' ra bar rin po che sna bzhi'i khang pa brtsegs tsom gdan sna tshogs bshams pa zhig sprul to/ /de la rgyal po chen po bzhi sgo bzhi na 'khod pa ni yul 'khor skyong dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / lus ngan po ste/ shar sgo na ni yul 'khor skyong dpung rgyan dang / rna cha gdub 72—232

'khor 0)dang / phreng ba dang / rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po lha'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /nub (7phyogs na ni mig mi bzang rin po che sna bdun gyis brgyan pa'o/ /byang phyogs na ni lus ngan po rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de nas lha rnams kyi (bdabang po brgya byin gyis n+ya gro d+ma'i (9kun dga' ra ba che thang du brgyan du bcug ste/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la don de rgyas par gsol to/ /de nas brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs ⑤pa lha brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor nas khang pa brtsegs par zhugs te lha'i 'khor phal po che'i gung la rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i seng ge'i khri la bzhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal 96)gyi bu chen po rgyal po zas gtsang khrid de bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po nang du zhugs pa dang / rgyal po zas gtsang la rgyal po chen po yul 'khor skyong gis rgyal po chen po nang du ma 'gro bar sdod cig (7ces bzlog go/ /ci'i phyir/bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor dag pa la chos 'chad de der mir gyur pa 'jug tu mi dbang ngo / /bzhin bzangs 'a)khyod su zhig rgyal po chen po bdag ni yul 'khor skyong ngo / /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang lho sgor song ba dang / rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes pos mthong nas smras pa/ rgyal po chen po nang du ma 'jug par sdod cig /rgyal po zas gtsang gis 9rimathong nas smras pa/ bzhin bzangs kyikhyod su zhig /'phags skyes pos smras pa/ rgyal po chen po bdag ni 'phags skyes po'o/ /ci'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor dag pa la chos 'chad de/ der mir gyur pa 'jug tu mi dbang ngo / /de nas rgyal po zas 72—233

gtsang nub sgor song ba dang / rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang gis mthong nas smras pa/ rgyal po chen po nang du ma 'jug par sdod cig /rgyal po zas gtsang gis mthong nas smras pa/ bzhin bzangs 0)khyod su zhig /mig mi bzang gis smras pa/ rgyal po chen po bdag ni mig mi bzang ngo / /ci'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor dag pa la chos 'chad de/ der mir gyur pa 'jug tu mi dbang ngo / /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang byang sgor song ba dang / rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus mthong nas smras pa/ rgyal po (michen po nang du ma 'jug par sdod cig /rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs khyod su zhig /rnam thos kyi (sne bus smras pa/ rgyal po chen po bdag ni rnam thos kyi bu'o/ /ci'i phyir / bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor dag pa la chos 'chad de/ der mir gyur pa 'jug 4tu mi dbang ngo / /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang kye ma'o bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor dag pa la chos 'chad pa de bdag gis blta'o snyam pa'i 'dod pa skyes so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis zhum pa'i rgyud gang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa rgyal po zas gtsang gis gal te nga ma mthong na khrag dron po skyugs nas 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs gang yin pa de yod kyis 5)de la thabs shig bsham (7par bya'o snyam nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rin po che sna bzhi'i khang pa brtsegs pa gang yin pa de shel las byas par sprul pa dang / de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis sangs rgyas kyi sku sgrib 57 pa med par mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang dga' ba dang mgu ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal gyete phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po zas gtsang gi 6)bsam pa 72—234

dang / bag la 0)nyal ba dang khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen (5)nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta (gebu'i chos bshad (4)pa mdzad de/ de thos pas rgyal po zas gtsang gis 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ de bden pa mthong nas lan gsum du ched du brjod pa ched du brjod pa/ btsun pa bdag la pas ma bgyis mas ma lags/ rgyal pos ma lagasal/ lha rnams kyis ma lags/ sngon gyi 'das pa rnams kyis ma lags/dge sbyong dang / bram ze rnams kyis ma lags/ sdug pa dang / rang gi skye bo dang gnyen ⑤gyi tshogs kyis ma lags pa gang lags pa de ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la mdzad de/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams(6)/ rus pa'i ri bo las ni bsgralaspyi/ ngan song gi sgo rnams ni bkum(8)/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams ni phye/ bdag lha dang mi rnams su ni bzhag (9)go/ /yang gsol pa / pha la lan du phan gdags pa/ /dam pa'i bus ni bgyi ba gang / /khyod kyis bdag la mdzad lags te/ /sems ni grol bar gzhol bar bgyis/ /khyod kyis bdag ni ngan 'gro las/ /drangs te mtho ris thar pa las/ /bsgrim mi 'tshal bar bzhag lags te/ /khyod kyis dga' ⑩ba mdzad pa legs/ /mgon po byams pa khyed 7kyis ni/ /bdag gi tshong pa rnyed ldan ltar/ /mtho ris rnyed pa srid pa yi/ /longs spyod dag ni rnyed par mdzad/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de 8logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig nyi tu 72—235

sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po zas gtsang la ①cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas chas te zas dkar gang na ba der song ste phyin nas zas dkar la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu rgyal srid thob kyis (brgyal srid khyer cig /ci'i slad du/ ngas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bden pa mthong bas so/ /gang gi gdugs la lags/ de ring kho na'o/ /bdag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das gang gi nyi ma la n+ya gro d+ma'i (bkun dga' ra bar chos bshad pa de'i nyi ma la shākya bdun khri bdun stong dang lhan cig bden pa mthong lags so / /de bzhin du bre bo zas la rgyal srid khyer cig ces smras pa dang / des smras pa/ca bdag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gi tshe tshangs pas bskor ba'i skyed mos tshal du chos bshad pa de'i tshe shākya bdun ( khri drug stong dang lhan cig 56bden pa mthong lags so/ /de bzhin du bdud rtsi zas la rgyal srid khyer cig ces smras pa dang / des smras pa/57) bdag gis kyang gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis ro hi ta ma'i skyed mos tshal du chos bshad pa de'i tshe shākya bdun khri lnga stong dang lhan cig bden pa mthong lags so/ /gal te de ②ltar gyur na da su zhig rgyal srid la gzhagapor /de rnams kyis smras pa/ shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis bgyi'o zhes de rnams 'dus nas shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan 0rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang bskur ro/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis de nyid kyi mtshan mo nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag sta gon 72—236

byas nas nang par sngar langs te gdan bshams shing nor bu chu snod bzhag nas bcom ldan 'das la spyan 'dren gyis dus tshod gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gdugs tshod lags na/ da de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/bcom ldan 'das snga dro na bza' dang sham thabs mnabs0ste/ lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams te dge slong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing / dge slong gi ②dge 'dun gyis mdun du bdar nas/ rgyal po zas gtsang gi bkad (kyes gang na ④ba der gshegs te byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs par rig nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' bas rang gi lag nas stobs shing tshim par byed de / rnam grangs du mar gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' bas rang gi lag nas bstabs shing tshim par byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin nas phyag bcabs ⑤te lhung bzed gyu bar 6)rig nas gser gyi bya ma bum blangs te bcom ldan 'das la n+ya gro dha'i ⑦kun dga' ra ba phul lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i gsung (8)dbyangs kyis yon bsngo bar mdzad pa / sbyin pa'i bsod nams gang yin po)'dis/ /shākya rnams kyis bsams pa yi / /yid la re ba rdzogs nas ni/ /rtag pa'i gnas ni thob par shog /de nas bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gzhi shing n+ya gro ṅgā'i 7kun dga' tunyer ba na bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du bsam gtan pa 7rnams kyis kyang mdo sde la bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gzhi shing n+ya gro dha'i 8kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so zhes gdags pa byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gzhi de nyid na bzhugs nas 72—237

nyi ma gcig ni rgyal po'i pho brang du gdugs tshod gsol/ nyi ma gcig ni btsun mo'i nang du gsol lo/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis ral pa can las rab tu byung ba'i dge slong rnams spyod lam zhi zhing sems dang ba yin na dka' 6)thub drag pa'i (5)brtul zhugs dkyi khyad par dag gis lus gdungs pas lus mi mdzes par mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar ral pa can 'di dag spyod lam zhi zhing sems dang ba yin mod kyi lus mdzes pa ma yin na 'khor ci 'dra ba zhig gis bcom ldan 'das mdzes par 'gyur snyam pa las des bsams pa shākya'i 'khor gyis yin no snyam nas/ de nas shākya thams cad bsogs te smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa rab tu byung bar ma gyur na ji ltar 'gyur 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro / /khyed cag ci zhig byed par 'gyur/ g.yog bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /da ltar gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa bla na med pa chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur na/khyed cag ci'i phyir g.yog mi byed/ lha ci rab tu 'byung ngam/ rab tu byung li shig /ci thams cad dam/ khyim re nas re re'o/ /bka' bzhin 'tshal/rgyal po zas gtsang gis grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir dril sgrogs su bcug pa/ rgyal po'i zhal nas nga'i yul na gnas pa'i shākya rnams kyis khyim re nas/ re re rab tu byung shig ces de skad bka' stsal to/ /bre bo zas la bu gnyis yod pa ma 'gags pa dang ming chen no/ /ming chen ni zhing blas kyi mtha' ⑤la lhag par brtson no/ /ma 'gags pa ni steng gi khang bzangs kyi zhugazhi la 'dug nas skyes pa med pa'i rol mos rtse bar byed dga' bar byed chadaga' mgur zho)spyod par byed do / /ming chen la mas smras pa/ bu rgyal pos dril sgrogs su bcug pa shākya 72—238

rnams las khyim re nas re re rab tu phyung shig ces bsgos0te/ khyod rab tu byung shig /des smras pa/ bdag ni rab tu mi 'byung gis ge/ khyod kyi bu sdug pa dang bde ba dang ldan par gnas pa gang yin pa de rab tu phyung shig /bu bsod nams kyi dbang thang chen po can gyi ༷ )sems can de la khyod (4)'gran ma tshol cig /yum khyod gang la dgyes pa de bsod nams kyi dbang thang chen po can lags mod/ de ring la cung zad 5)kyang ma bskur dang / ci bsod nams kyi dbang thang chen po lags sam ma lags mngon par 'gyur ro/ /bu de bzhin du byas te yid ches par bya'o/ /des gzeb stong pa rdze'u yis bkang nas kha ras dkar pos dkris 6)te rgya skegs la rgyas btab nas/ bu mo mngag gzhug ma'i lag tu bskur nas bsgo ba/ gal te de na ci yod ces 'dri ba (7dang / ci yang ma mchis so zhes smros shig /des de khyer nas song ba dang / lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi shes pa mthong ba ni 'og tu 'jug pa yin pas/ des bsams pa/ rang sangs rgyas kun shes la bsod snyoms phul ba gang yin pa de deng ci'i phyir zas kyis phangs 90par bya/ de'i zan sbyar (9)bar bya'o zhes des rje'u de rnams sran tshod dang / tshod ma sna tshogs ro dang ldan pa'i zas kyis bkang ngo / /ji tsam na mngag gzhug mas 7der khyer nas ma 'gags pa'i drung du phyin pa dang / des smras pa/ bu mo 'o ni na 37ci yod/ des smras pa/ gzhon nu ci yang ma mchis so/ /ma 'gags pas bsams pa/bdag la ma byams na 'di stong par ci ste bskur 3glegadon mi za bar 'di ci yang ma yin pa zhes bya ba'i zas shig bskur gyis 3nyere zhig blta'o zhes ji tsam na kha phye ba dang / skyed mos tshal de thams cad zas kyi dri zhim pos gang bar gyur te/ de 72—239

bsnams (1 nas ma 'gags pa mchog tu ya mtshan skyes so/ /de ma la gus pa yin pas des ma la zas kyi phud bskur nas spring ba/ yum gdugs re re zhing zas ci yang ma yin zhes bgyi ba 'di lta bu bskur ba'i rigs so/ /des kyang mthong nas mchog tu ya mtshan skyes te/ /des ming chen la bstan nas bu mthong ngam/yum mthong lags so/ /khyod la kho mos sngar bsod nams kyi dbang thang chen po'i (2)sems can mi'i skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa la khyod 'gran ma tshol cig ces ma smras sam/ des smras pa/ yum de bsod nams kyi dbang thang chen po dang ldan ri yang rung / mi ldan yang rung / bdag ni rab tu mi 'byung ngo / /zhes ji ltar ming chen gnas skabs thams cad du rab tu 'byung bar khas len du ma btub bo/ /de nas des ma 'gags pa la smras pa/ bu rgyal pos dril sgrogs su 47bcug pa shākya rnams la khyim re nas re re rab tu byung shig ces bsgo na/khyod ci rab tu byung ngam/ 'on te khyim par 'dug⑤ /des smras pa/ yum rab tu byung ba la phan yon ci mchis/ nyes yidamigs ci mchis/ khyim par mchis pa la phan yon ci mchis/ nyes dmigs ci mchis/ bu rab tu byung bas legs par bsgrubs na mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /legs par ma 5ci//bsgrubs na lha dang mi 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /khyim par 'dug ste legs par bskyangs na lha dang mi 'thob bo/ /ma bskyangs na sems can dmyal ba dang /dud 'gro dang / yi dgas 'thob bo/ /yum rab tu byung ba'i nyes dmigs gang lags pa de ni khyim na gnas pa'i phan yon lags pas de bas na khyim na gnas pa mi 'tshal gyis (sheganang bar mdzod cig dang / rab tu 'byung ngo / /des smras pa/ bu legs kyis 59)de bzhin du gyis shig /ma 'gags pa'i ne'u zla 72—240

shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan yin pas de de'i drung du song ngo / /de'i tshe shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan pi bang len tenyu)/ pi bang ②len pa na rgyun (8)chad nas sgra gzhan du gyur to/ /ma 'gags pa pi bang len pa du skal byang ba yin pas des sgra ci 'dra bar gyur pa'i rtags bzung nas de (7sgor bsdad de sgo srungs kyi mi la smras pa/kye nang rje song la rgyal po bzang ldan la ma 'gags pa lha'i zhal mthong bar 'tshal nas sgo na sdod cing mchis so zhes gsol cig /sgo srungs (67song nas shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan la smras pal/ lha ma 'gags pa lha'i zhal mthong bar 'tshal nas chab sgo na sdod cing mchis so/ /des smras pa/ shes ldan ma 'gags pa la su 'gog /shes ldan ma 'gags pa nang du thong (8)shig /de nang du zhugs pa dang / rgyal pos 'khyud nas 'dug po)tu bcug ste smras pa/ khyod 'ongs nas ci srid lon/ des smras pa/ gang gi tshe khyod pi bang kyilen pa na rgyun (1chad nas sgra gzhan du gyur pa nas so/ /de mchog tu ya mtshan skyes nas des smras pa/ khyod pi bang kyilen pa la byang ba yin no/ /shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis smras pa/gzhon nu don ci zhig la 'ongs/ ma 'gags pas smras pa/ lha rgyal po zas gtsang gis dril sgrogs su bcug pa/ shākya rnams las khyim re nas re re rab tu byung shig par bsgo bas de 0khyod kyis mkhyen par mdzod cig /rab tu 'byung ngo ske/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gal te de lta na kho bo yang rab tu 'byung ste gros bya ba yod kyis 0khyod de ring 'di nyid du gnas thob shig /de de nyid du gnas btab bo/ /mal 'cha' 8bas rims bag gi dri can gyi gos kyis bting zhing me tog gi sil mas bkram pa'i mal du ma 'gags pa nyal ba dang / de'i 'og na me tog gi rtsa ba yod pa'i reg pa de'i nyams su myong nas smras pa/ ci 'di'i tso'og 72—241

tu rdo phre'u yod dam/ de rnams kyis brtag pa brtsams pa na ①me tog gi rtsa ba zhig mthong nas de rnams mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes so/ /ma 'gags pa mtshan mo mi bde zhing nyal nas nam langs so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ ma 'gags pa ci ga bde bar gnyid log gam/ des smras pa lha bde bar gnyid ma log go/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ ci'i phyir ma 'gags pas smras pa/ /lha rims bag gi dri can gyi gos bting bar me tog sil ma bkram pa'i me tog gi rtsa bas lus snad lags so/ /rgyal pos mal 'cha' ba bkug nas khyod kyis rims bag gi dri can gyi gos bting ste ci bya/ mal 'cha' bas smras pa/ lha bdag la dkor ②bas gtad pa (milags so/ /rgyal pos dkor pa bkug nas smras pa/ khyod kyis rims bag gi dri can gyi gos phog ste ci bya/ des smras pa/ lha bdag la tha ga ④pas gtad pa (5)lags so/ /rgyal pos tha ga pa bkug nas smras pa/ khyod kyis ci'i phyir rims bag gi dri can gyi gos 'bul/ tha ga pas smras pa/ lha snam bu 'thag pa'i 'phro cung zhig lus pa na/ bdag rims kyis thebs bzhin bgyis ⑥pa lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gzhon nu khyod kyis ji ltar shes/ des smras pa/ tsha ba'i reg pa nyams su myong bas rims bag gi dri lags ⑦so/ /rgyal po mchog tu ya mtshan skyes te smras pa/ shes ldan ma 'gags pa ni shākya'i skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa yin no/ /de nas shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis smras pa/ gzhon nu gal te kho bo rab tu byung na/ lha sbyin (sheshākya rnams kyi rgyal por 'gyur ①te/de 57shākya rnams la gnod pa byed par 'gyur gyis7/ ma la bdag cag 8thams cad ri ge'adus la lha sbyin 7spro ba bskyed par bya'o zhes shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis de bkug ste de mnas thams cad 'dus nas smras pa/ lha sbyin tsokho bo cag 72—242

thams cad rab tu 'byung na/ khyod ci byed/ lha sbyin zhi)gyis bsams pa/gal te rab tu mi 'byung ngo zhes smras pa dang / shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan (gurab tu byung bar mi 'gyur gyis ③de la thabs zhig bsham par bya ste bslu'o/ /gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gi nyi ma la n+ya gro dha'i ①kun dga' ra bar sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul bstan pa de'i tshe bdag blo skyes pa/ ji ltar 'di'i sgyu mas skye bo'i tshogs chen po dbang du byed pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang dbang du bya'o zhes bsams so snyam nas smras pa/ khyed cag rab tu 'byung na bdag ci ste 'dug /shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis bsams pa/ 'di ni brdzun du smra ba yin gyis (5)dam 'char bcug la 'gro ba mang pos so sor rig par bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal pos tshig de glegs bu la bris nas grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir dril sgrogs su bcug pa/ grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi na gnas pa'i shes ldan dag nyon cig /bzang ldan dang / nam gru dang / ma 'gags pa dang / lha sbyin (6la sogs te shākya lnga brgya rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur gyis ⑦thos par gyis la rab tu dga' ba skyed nicig ces bsgo'o/ / lha sbyin lagyis de thos nas sdug bsngal chen po dang yid mi bde ba skyes yinas/ gal te bdag gis shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan nges par rab tu 'byung bar shes par gyur pa khyadang bdag khas len 32par mi 'gyur ba zhig /de ni gal te rab tu ma byung na brdzun du smra ba yin no zhes rgyal srid kyang thob par mi 'gyur bas thams cad kyi thams cad du dus 'dir zad dam/ci rab tu byung la bdag rab tu byung bzhin du rgyal srid bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 'di snyam du sems te/ shākya rnams kyi tha ma'i 'byor pa la blta'o snyam nas des grong khyer de tsogaseg ma dang gyo mo bsal/ tsan dan gyi 72—243

chus chag chag btab/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan bsgreng / dar gyi chun yo nye'aphyang mang po dpyangs(mi/ shin tu dri zhim po'i pog por ②nye bar bzhag /me tog sna tshogs kyi sil mas dga' dga' ltar byed du bcug go/ /de nas shākya brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor nas grong khyer gyi sgo na seng ge'i khri la 'dug go/ /shākya mo dang / shākya gzhon nu ngo mtshar skyes pa rnams kyang skar khung khol ma can dang ske/ skar khung dang / stegs (4)bu dag la 'dug go/ /shākya rnams kyi 'byor pa la lta bar 'dod pa'i skyes pa'i tshogs yul sna tshogs nas lhags pa dag kyang lam po che dang / tshong 'dus dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su 'dug go/ /shākya las su dag gis ni mnyes par 'gyur/ su dag gis ni thugs byung bar 'gyur (5rabartag pa'i bram ze mtshan mkhan dang / ltas mkhan dag bkug go/ /shākya rnams do shal dang / gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang /rgyan gyis brgyan pa rnams kyis (3)pha dang / ma dag la bltas nas/ so so'i shing rtar zhugs te phyir 'byung bar brtsams pa na/ shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan sna la byung ba mtshan mkhan rnams kyis mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ re zhig 'dis ni mnyes par byed par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du nam gru dang / ma 'gags pa la sogs pa phyir byung rtsib na/ de rnams kyang mtshan mkhan ⑧rnams kyis lung bstan to/ /de nas lha sbyin 5)phyir byung ⑩ste/ de phyir byung ba na bya khras gtsug gi nor bu phrogs 41pa mtshan mkhan rnams kyis mthong nas de rnams kyis smras pa/'di'i rtags dang sbyar na gdon mi za bar ston pa la 8'khus nas dmyal bar gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /ko ka li ka dang / khan dra tidrab bya dang / ka ta mo ra ka dang / rgyal dang / rgya mtshos sbyin rnams phyir byung ba na/ bong bu'i 72—244

skad grag ①nas de dag kyang ②mtshan mkhan rnams kyis lung bstan pa/ 'di dag gis ①kyang nyan thos chen po rnams la tshig ngan pa smras nas dmyal bar gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /nye dga' glang po che la zhon nas phan tshun du lta bar byed pa dun mu tig gi do shal lhung ba dang / de glang po che las babs te blangs so/ /de yang de rnams kyis phyilung bstan pa/ 'di ha cang 'dod chen ches pas sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar yi'agyur ro/ /de nas bzang ldan dang / nam gru dang / ma 'gags pa dang ⑦/ lha ⑧sbyin la sogs pa shākya lnga brgya po de rnams skyed mos tshal du dus ston la 'gro ba bzhin du bzang pos 'gran cing bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/gal te ngas shākya rnams la khyidage slong tshur shog ces bya bas rab tu byung na kha cig gis ni mnyes par byed par 'gyur/ kha cig gis ni mnyes par byed par mi ⑩'gyur te/ mnyes par byed par mi 'gyur ba gang dag yin pa de dag gzhan du sems la/ dge slong tshur shog ces bya ba ni thams cad srid pa tha ma pa yin pas/ma la ngas 7thams cad dge slong rnams kyis gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyis rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs su gzhug go snyam du dgongs nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ser skya'i gzhi'i shākya rnams gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyis rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs par gyis shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 8'tshal zhes dge slong de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das las mnyan to/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis shākya rnams kyi 'dreg mkhan nye bar 'khor zhes bya ba/ de rnams rab tu 'byin tshupa na skra 'breg 8par btang 8nas shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyi 8spa 'breg ⑩pa na/ de ngom zung gnag cing mchi ma 72—245

'dzag cing skad 'dzer thu cing dbugs brtsegs pas skra 'dreg ②par byed do/ /shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis smras pa/ nye bar 'khor ci'i phyir du/ de snying rje rje skad du gcom 5)chung ngur dal bus tshig re re nas smras pa/ lha bdag 'dzam bu'i gling gi skyes bu gtso bo rnams la bsnyen bkur (gebagyid bgyid pa mi phal ba rnams la yang bsnyen bkur bgyid par 'gyur ba lta zhig /khyed kyis spangs te gson pa 55bas na gum mi bsngo'o56)/ /shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis smras pa/ nye bar 'khor khyod kyis jo ri bo la snying nye ba'i mnyes par bya ba bstan zin te chog gis (8)mya ngan ma byed cig /ngas ji ltar mi phal che (9)ba rnams la bsnyen bkur byed par mi 'gyur ba de ltar bya'o zhes smras nas des phyogs gcig tu ras gcig bting nas shākya'i gzhon nu rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan gzhon nu dag nyon cig /'dreg mkhan nye bar 'khor 'dis bdag cag la bkur sti tsobyas la bdag cag kyang slar khyim du mi gnas kyis 67rgyan rnams de'i 'tsho ba'i rkyen du ras kyi steng du zhog shig /de rnams kyi se mo do dang / do shal dang /mgul rgyan dang / gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / rna rgyan la sogs pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i rgyan khyad 1 par can rnams kyis ras kyi steng du phung po chen por spungs so/ /nye bar 'khor gyis de rnams kyi kyisnyemathar gyis skra bregs te de rnams khrus la dong ba dang / des bsams pa/ re zhig gzhon nu thu'adi dag rigs dang 'byor pa dang / lang tsho la bab cing chung ma dang ldan la mdzod dang / bang mdzod kyis rgyas lopa yang spangs nas rab tu byung na bdag rgyan 'di tsam la chags pa ni tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te bdag rigs ngan du ma skyes na bdag kyang legs par gsungs pa'i chos 72—246

'dul ba la rab tu 'byung zhing chu bo las rgal 0)ba dang / sbyor ba las yang dag par 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir btsal (kyeb dang 'bad pa la brtson par bya ba zhig snyam mo/ /'di ni chos nyid yin te/ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs pa de bzhin du nyan thos chen po rnams kyang byed pas/ tshe dang ldan pa sha char dwa ti'i bus 'dreg mkhan nye bar 'khor lhag par skyo ba skyes pa mthong ngo / /mthong nasang kyang 'dreg mkhan nye bar rgya'akhor gang na ba der song ste phyin nas 'dreg mkhan nye bar 'khor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /nye bar 'khor khyod ci'i phyir shin tu mi dga' bas lag pa 'gram pa la gtad nas sems khong du (7chud cing 'dug /nye bar 'khor gyis smras pa/ btsun pa sha (6)ra dwa ti'i bu gang gi phyir da ltar gzhon nu 'di dag rigs dang 'byor pa dang / lang tsho la bab cing chung ma dang ldan la bang mdzod dang / bang mdzod kyis rgyas pa yang spangs nas rab tu 'byung na/ bdag rgyan 'di tsam la chags pa ni tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te bdag rigs ngan du ma skyes na bdag kyang legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung zhing chu bo las rgal 9)ba dang / sbyor ba las yang dag par 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir btsal (8)ba dang /'bad pa la brtson par bgyi ba zhig na bdag ci'i phyir sems khong du 6)chud par mi 'gyur/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ⑩ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ bzhin bzangs (rmithub pa'i dbang po'i gsung rab 'di la ni rigs snying por byed pa ma yin/ rus snying por byed pa ma yin/ rgyud snying por byed pa ma yin/ thos pa snying por byed pa ma yin te/ 'di ltar thub pa'i 8dbang po'i gsung rab 'di la ni sgrub 72—247

pa snying por byed pa yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams rigs dang ni/ /rgyud dang rus la rtog 6)mi mdzad/ /'das nas yun ring lon pa yi③/ /las rnams la ni rtog par mdzad/ /gal te legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po rdzogs par ②'dod na tshur bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dong dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rab tu 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /des khas blangs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha dur dwa ⑤ti'i bus 'dreg mkhan nye bar 'khor khrid de bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong nas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa nye bar 'khor 'di legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po 'tshal lags na thugs brtse bar nye bar bzung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di rab tu dbyung ⑥ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la bka' stsal pa/dge slong tshur shog /tshangs par spyad ⑦pa spyod cig ces bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa'i mod kho nar skra byi ba dang / snam sbyar gyon pa dang / lag pa lhung bzed dang bya ma bum gyis brel 58)ba dang skra dang kha spu skyes nas zhag bdun lon pa tsam dang / dge slong bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa'i spyod lam lta bur gnas par gyur to/ /smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas tshur shog bka' stsal pas/ /skra byi snam sbyar gyon pa'i lus ldan zhing / /mod la dbang po rab zhir sgyuraganas gyur te/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pas lus gzugs bkab par ⑩gyur / /shākya rab tu byung ba'i tu)rnams ni rgan rims ji lta ba bzhin du 'dud pa 72—248

byed pas/ shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan 'dud par byed pa na nye bar 'khor gyi rkang pa yin par shes so/ /de nas des gdong bteg ste gsol pa/ bcom ldan ①'das 'di ni nye bar 'khor lags na ci bdag gis 'di'i rkang pa gnyis la yang gdud ②par bgyi'am/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bu nga rgyal spang ②pa'i phyir rab tu byung ba ④yin te/ 'di rgan gyis (snyeng rgyal gyi dregs pa chog la thud cig /des de'i rkang pa la gtugs pa na sa chen po lan drug tu g.yos par gyur te/ sa chen po 'di g.yos rab tu g.yos/ kun tu rab tu g.yos / ldeg rab tu ldeg /kun tu rab tu ldeg ste/ shar phyogs mtho na nub phyogs dma'/ nub phyogs mtho na shar phyogs dma'/ lho phyogs mtho na 6)byang phyogs dma'/ byang phyogs mtho na lho phyogs dma'/ 9)dbus mtho na mtha' dma' / mtha' mtho na dbus dma' bar gyur te/ de ltar thams cad kyis rim (nyebazhin du gtugs so/ / lha sbyin 99)gyis ma btud pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bu nga rgyal spang ba'i phyir rab tu byung ba yin gyis thud cig /des gsol pa/ bdag gis de'i rkang pa la ma gtugs na khyod la gnod pa ci mchis zhes de 7'dud du ma btub ste der thog mar bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' lha sbyin (7gyis bcag go/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yul ser skya'i gzhi n+ya gro dha'i 8kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas ser skya'i gzhi na gnas pa'i shākya rab tu mang po 'dun khang 'du tshogs shing 'dus nas bar skabs kyi gtam 'di lta bu dag gleng bar byed de/ shes ldan dag shākya rnams ni gang las skyes/ thog ma ni gang yin/ rgyu ni ci zhig yin/ shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud ni gang yin/ gal te bdag cag gi drung du 'ga' 72—249
