zhig 'ongs nas 'di skad 'dri ste/ shes ldan dag shākya rnams ni gang las skyes/thog ma ni gang yin/ rgyu ni ci zhig yin/ shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud ni gang yin zhes de skad du 'dri na/ bdag cag gis ni shākya rnams gang las skyes pa dang / thog ma gang yin pa dang / rgyu ni ci zhig yin pa dang / shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud ni gang yin pa yang mi 0)shes na ji skad du lung bstan/tshur bdag cag bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong la lhags pa dang /bcom ldan 'das la don de nyid zhus nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la ji skad du lung bstan pa de bzhin du gzung bar bya'o/ /de nas ser skya'i gzhi ②na gnas pa'i shākya rab tu mang po bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste lhags nas / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas ser skya'i gzhi'i shākya ①rnams kyis 'di 54)skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa 'dir bdag cag ⑤sor skya'i gzhi'i shākya rab tu mang po 'dun khang du 'tshogs 6)shing 'dus nas bar skabs kyi bka' mchid 'di lta bu dag gleng 5geraste/ shākya rnams ni gang las skyes thog ma ni gang yin / rgyu ni ci zhig yin/ shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud ni gang yin gal te bdag cag gi drung du 'ga' zhig 'ongs nas 'di skad 'dri ste/ shes ldan dag shākya rnams ni gang las skyes/ thog ma ni gang yin/ rgyu ni ci zhig yin/shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud ni gang yin zhes de skad du 'dri na/ bdag cag gis shākya rnams ni gang las skyes/ thog ma ni gang yin/ rgyu ni ci zhig yin / shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud gang yin pa yang mi shes na ji skad du lung bstan/ tshur bdag cag bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong la lhags ⑤72—250

pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la don 'di nyid zhus te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la ji skad du lung bstan pa de bzhin du gzung 0)bar bgyi'o snyam nas de'i slad du bcom ldan 'das la bdag cag don 'di nyid zhu lags na/ bcom ldan 'das shākya rnams ni gang las skyes lags/ thog ma ni gang lags/ rgyu ni ci zhig lags/ shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud ni gang lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ gal te ngas shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud las brtsams nas chos kyi gtam glengs na/ mu stegs can dang /kun tu rgyu gzhan dag 'di skad ces dge slong gi ta ma (7ni ci 'dod pa de lung ston ②pas bdag nyid stod ④par byed do zhes smra ba (5)gang yin pa'i gnas 'di yod pas nga'i nyan thos las shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud las brtsams nas chos kyi yigatam glengs par 9)nus pa su yod snyam mo/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'khor de nyid du 'dus shing 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/mod gal gyi bu nga ro 6)rgyab bsnyung 6)bas re zhig de bobasal gyis (1khyod kyis shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud las brtsams nas dge slong rnams la chos kyi gtam bya bar spobs par gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa mod tshegal gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das la cang mi smra bas khas blangs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos cang mi smra bas khas blangs par thugs su chud nas snam sbyar bltab tunyeste sngas su bcug nas/ glo g.yas pas 1)phab ste/zhabs kyi steng du zhabs bzhag nas snang ba'i 'du shes dang / dran pa dang /shes bzhin dang ldan pa'i 'du shes kho na yid la mdzad pas mnal to/ /de nas 72—251

tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'di snyam du sems te/ ma la bdag gis sems ji ltar mnyam par bzhag na shākya rnams gang las skyes pa dang / thog ma gang yin pa dang / rgyu ni ci yin pa dang / shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud gang yin pa mthong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par ①'jug par bya'o snyam nas/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos sems ji ltar mnyam par bzhag na/ shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud mthong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu ji chen pos shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud shākya rnams gang las skyes ③pa dang / thog ma gang yin pa dang / rgyu ni ④ci zhig yin pa dang / shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud 557ni gang yin pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas ting nge 'dzin de las langs te dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la stan 6)bshams pa nyid la 'dug go / /'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos ser skya'i gzhi'i shākya rnams la smras pa/ gi ta ma tsa)dag 'jig rten 'di 'jig cing 'jig rten zhig nas / sems can phal cher 'od gsal gyi lha'i ris su skye bar 'gyur te/ de rnams de na 58༄yid las byung ba'i gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dbang po ma nyams ⑨shing ma tshang ba med pa yan lag dang / nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa/ kha dog bzang pos gnas pa/ rang gi 'od can/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba/dga' ba za zhing dga' ba'i zas kyis tshe ring zhing yun ring du gnas so/ /de'i tshe sa chen po 'di chu 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur zhing mtsho gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /sa chen po 'di chu 'ba' zhig gi mtsho gcig tu gyur pa'i steng du rlung gis pris ⑩ma chags pa dang / mkhregs pa dang / khebs par byed do/ /dper na 'o ma bskol ba 72—252

grang bar ①gyur pa'i steng du rlung gis pris (nyam chags pa dang / mkhregs pa dang ske/ khebs pa ②de bzhin du sa chen po 'di chu 'ba' zhig gis mtsho gcig tu gyur pa'i steng du rlung gis pris ④ma chags pa dang / mkhregs pa dang /khebs par byed do/ /sa'i bcud de ni (gekha dog phun sum tshogs pa/ dri phun sum tshogs pa ro phun sum tshogs pa (6)yin zhing kha dog ni 'di lta bu yin te/dper na mar sar lta bu'o/ /ro ni 'di lta bu yin te/ dper na sbrang stima'i sbrang rtsi btsir ba lta bu'i dus gang yin pa de (nyayod do/ /sga ta ma dag 'jig rten gang yin pa 'di 'chags shing 'jig rten chags na/ de nas sems can kha cig tshe zad las zad bsod nams zad nas 'od gsal gyi lha'i ris nas shi 'phos nas 'di lta bur mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par 'ong zhing de rnams 'di na ⑨yid las byung ba'i gzugs phun sum tshogs pa/ dbang po ma nyams shing ma tshang ba med pa/ yan lag dang / nying lag thams cad dang 7ldan zhing kha dog bzang pos gnas pa rang gi 'od can/ 9/homakha' la 'gro ba/ dga' ba za ⑫zhing dga' ba'i zas kyis tunyetshe ring zhing yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe nyi ma dang zla ba yang 'jig rten du mi 'byung ste/ rgyu skar rnams kyang med/skad cig 8dang thang cig 8dang yud tsam yang med/ mtshan mo dang nyin mo yang med / zla ba dang / zla ba phyed dang / dus tshigs dang / lo rnams kyang 'jig rten du 'byung ba med do/ /skyes pa dang bud med du mngon pa yang med kyi gzhan du na sems can sems can zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /de nas sems can brkam chags kyi rang bzhin can zhig gis mdzub 7mo'i rtse mos sa'i bcud myong ⑩bar byed de8/ ji lta ji ltar myangs pa de lta de ltar sred do/ /72—253

ji lta ji ltar sred pa de lta de ltar kham gyi 6)zas rim gyis za'o/ /sems can gzhan dag gis kyang sems can de mdzub (mimo'i rtse zhi)mos sa'i bcud myong ④bar byed de/ ji lta ji ltar myangs pa de lta de ltar sred la/ ji lta ji ltar sred pa de lta de ltar kham gyi (5)zas rim gyis za ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de rnams kyis kyang mdzub 56)mo'i rtse mos sa'i bcud myang bar rtsom stiste/ ji lta ji ltar myangs pa de lta de ltar sred do/ /ji lta ji ltar srid pa de lta de ltar kham gyi zas rim gyis 8)za'o/ /gang gi 6)tshe sems can de rnams kyis sa'i bcud la kham gyi zas rim gyis zos pa de'i tshe/ de rnams kyi lus la mkhrang ba dang lci ba zhugs par gyur to/ /de rnams kyi kha dog bzang po'i gsal ba gang yin pa de yang nub par gyur pas 'jig rten du mun pa byung bar gyur to/ /gi ta ma dag chos nyid kyis 'jig rten du mun pa byung ba na nyi ma dang zla ba gnyis 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyu skar dang / skad cig dang / thang cig dang /yud tsam dang / mtshan mo dang / nyin mo dang / zla ba dang / zla ba phyed dang / dus tshigs tshadang / lo 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de rnams de za zhing /1zas su za ba hu la tshe ring zhing yun ring du gnas so/ /de rnams las tu zas la ches nyung zad du za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /kha zas la ches mang du za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog ngan par 'gyur te/ kha zas kyi tshad gnyis byal brten nas kha dog gi rnam 8pa gnyis mngon te/ kha dog rnam pa gnyis yod pas/ kye sems can kho bo ni kha dog dang ldan no/ /khyod ni kha dog ngan pa yin no zhes sems can gyis ⑩sems can la khyad du gsod do/ /kha dog gi mngon pa'i nga rgyal can de rnams sdig pa mi 72—254

dge ba'i chos de dag nyid blangs pa'i rgyus sa'i bcud de nub par gyur to/ /gi ta ma dag sa'i bcud de 6)nub pa na sems can de rnams tshogs shing 'dus nas 'di skad ces/ kyi hud bro ba kyi hud bro ba zhes smra zhing smre sngags 'don la mya ngan dang sdug bsngal bar gyur to/ /dper na da ltar gyi (nami rnams kyis zas zhim po chung ②zad cig zos nas sngon gyi yi ge dang / tshig dang / tshig 'bru 6)de nyid rjes su dran nas 'di skad ces/ kyi hud bro ba kyi hud bro ba zhes smra ba de bzhin du sems can de rnams sa'i bcud de nub pa na tshogs shing 'dus nas 'di skad ces/ kyi hud bro ba kyi hud bro ba zhes smra zhing smre sngags 'don la mya ngan dang / sdug bsngal 95ribar gyur kyang smras pa 'di'i don ni 'di yin/smras pa 'di'i don ni 'di yin no zhes de'i don ni 6)mi shes so/ /gi ta ma 77dag sems can de rnams kyi sa'i bcud de nub pa na/ sa'i zhag kha dog phun sum tshogs pa ro phun sum tshogs pa byung (8)bar 'gyur te/ kha dog ni 'di lta bu yin tel/ dper na dong ma'i me tog lta bu'o/ /ro ni 'di lta bu yin te6)/ dper na sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi btsir 7ba lta bu'o/ /de rnams de za zhing de zas su za ba la tshe ring zhing yun ring du gnas so/ /de rnams las kha zas la ches nyung du za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog dang ldan par gyur to/ 17/kha zas la ches mang du 7za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog ngan par gyur to/ /zas kyi tshad gnyis la brten 1rtenas kha dog rnam pa gnyis mngon te/ kha dog rnam pa gnyis yod pas/ kye sems can kho bo ni kha dog dang ldan la khyod ni kha dog ngan pa yin no zhes sems can gyis ④sems can la khyad du gsod par byed do/ /kha dog gi mngon 7pa'i nga rgyal can de rnams sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos de dag nyid blangs pa'i rgyus sa'i 72—255

gzhan dag gis 0)sems can des rang gi sā (milu yod (5)bzhin du gzhan gyi sā (4)lu ma byin par blangs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas sems can de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kwa'e (gesems can khyod/ rang gi sā (6)lu yod bzhin du gzhan gyi sā (7)lu ma byin par ci'i phyir blang zhes de phar drangs tshur drangs nas ci tsam na 'khor mi'i (kyenang du khrid de/ shes ldan dag sems can 'di rang gi sā 6)lu yod bzhin du lan gsum gyi bar du gzhan gyi sā 7lu ma byin par len to zhes spyos (1so/ /de nas sems can de rnams kyis sems can de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kwa'e (/gesems can khyod/ rang gi sā 12lu yod bzhin du gzhan gyi sā 7lu ma byin par ci'i phyir blang ⑫/ kwa'e tshesems can khyod song la phyin chad de ltar ma byed 1mecig /de nas sems can des sems can de rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shes ldan dag sems can 'dis bdag sā 38lu'i phyir phar drangs tshur drangs nas ji tsam na 'khor gyi nang du yang phyung nas spyos so/ /de nas sems can de rnams kyis sems can de la 'di nyu9smras so/ /kwa'e tshosems can khyod kyis ( 1sems can la sā k+to gelu'i phyir phar drangs tshur drangs nas ji tsam na 'khor gyi nang du yang phyung nas ci'i phyir spyo(snye/ kwa'e 2 sems can khyod song la phyin chad de ltar ma byed cig rige /de nas sems can de rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ shes ldan dag sā 85lu'i phyir phar 'dren tshur 'dren cing ci rmo tshotsam na 'khor gyi nang du spyo ba yang snang bas / ma la bdag cag tshogs shing 'dus la bdag cag gi nang na sems can lhag par gzugs bzang ba/ lhag par blta tsho snyen sdug pa/ lhag par mdzes pa/ lhag par bsod nams che bar grags pa gang yin pa de ni bdag cag gi zhing rnams kyi bdag por bskos dang / des bdag cag ni chad pas 72wa 263

gcad par bya ba rnams ni chad pas gcod par 'gyur/ phan gdags 0)par bya ba rnams la ni phan 'dogs par 'gyur (2)te/ bdag cag gi zhing dag las 'khrungs pa gang yin pa de las de la chos bzhin du thog shas ③sbyin par bya'o snyam nas de rnams tshogs shing 'dus te/ de rnams kyi nang nas lhag par gzugs bzang ba/ lhag par blta ri non sdug pa/ lhag par mdzes pa/ lhag par bsod nams che bar grags pa gang yin pa de zhing rnams kyi bdag por bskos te/'di skad ces kye sems can khyod tshur shog /kho bo cag las chad pas gcad dupar bya ba rnams la ni chad pas chod cig /phan gdags par bya ba rnams la ni phan thogs shig /kho bo cag gi zhing dag la 'khrungs ⑥pa gang yin pa de las khyod la kho bo cag gis ri rachos bzhin du thog shas sbyin no/ /de de rnams la chad pas gcad par bya ba la ni chad pas gcod/ phan gdags par bya ba rnams la ni phan 'dogs par byed cing de la de rnams kyi zhing dag las 'khrungs pa gang yin pa de las ri chos bzhin du thog shas (9༄dbul te/ skye bo'i tshogs chen pos ⑩bkur zhing sna skye bo'i tshogs chen pos bkur bas mang pos bkur ba mang pos bkur ba zhes grags so/ /zhing de rnams kyi bdag por gyur pa na nyams pa las skyob par byed pas rgyal rigs rgyal rigs zhes bya bar grags so/ /chos kyis ⑫skye dgu mgu bar byed cing tshul khrims nyams su blangs te gnas/ shes rab nyams su blangs te gnas pas rgyal po rgyal po zhes bya bar grags so/ /gi ta ma ⑫dag rgyal po mang pos bkur gyi tshe mi rnams kyi ming sems can sems can zhes bya bar gyur to/ /gi ta ma dag rgyal po mang pos bkur ba'i bu 'od mdzes zhes bya ⑫ste / gi ta ma mdag rgyal po 'od mdzes kyi tshe mi rnams kyi ming tshur shog /tshur 72—264

shog ces bya bar gyur to/ /'od mdzes kyi bu dge ba zhes bya ste/ gi ta ma dag rgyal po dge ba'i tshe mi rnams kyi ming sme (1 ba can sme (2ba can zhes bya bar gyur to/ /gi ta ma chadag dge ba'i bu dge mchog ces bya ste/ gi ta ma 4)dag rgyal po dge mchog gi tshe mi rnams kyi ming sprin mgrin sprin mgrin zhes bya bar gyur to/ /dge mchog gi bu gso sbyong 'phags zhes bya ste/ gau ta ma 5ridag rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags kyi tshe mi rnams kyi 56)ming ta la'i rkang ta la'i rkang zhes bya bar gyur to/ /rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags kyi spyi bor sha rmen 7zhig skyes pa 'jam zhing shin tu mnyen te/ dper na shing bal gyi 'da' 98ba'am/ ras bal gyi 'da' 99)ba bzhin du chung 7zad kyang gnod pa mi skyed do/ /de smin nas brtol ba dang /khye'u gzugs bzang ba/ blta /ston sdug pa/ mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i ⑫mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan / pa zhig byung ste/ spyi bo las skyes pas spyi bo skyes zhes bya bar gyur to/ /gzhon nu byung ma thag tu rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags kyi btsun mo drug khri'i nang du bkri skab dang / de thams cad kyi nu ma la 'o ma zag nas re res nga las nu nga las nu zhes smras pas nga las nu nga las nu zhes bya bar grags so/ /gi ta ma tshadag rgyal lapo nga las nu gang gi tshe rgyal srid byed pa de'i tshe mi rnams sems par 1 byed/ 'jal bar byed/ nye bar rtog par byed de/ de rnams bsams gzhal nye bar brtags nas bzo'i 1nyaganas dang ske/ las kyi gnas tha dad pa dag byed du 'jug pas des na/ de rnams yid las 37skyes yid las skyes zhes bya bar grags so/ /gi ta ma ( tshodag rgyal po drug po 'di dag ni tshe tshad med cing tshe dpag tu med pa yin no/ /gi ta ma 31dag rgyal po nga las nu'i brla g.yas par sha rmen zhig skyes pa 'jam zhing shin tu 72—265

mnyen te/ dper na shing bal gyi 'da' ba'am/ ras bal gyi 'da' ba bzhin du chung 51)zad kyang gnod pa mi skyed do/ /de smin nas brtol ba dang / khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa zhig byung ste/ brla g.yas pa las skyes pas ming mdzes pa mdzes pa zhes bya bar gyur to/ /gzhon nu de rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu 2che ba yin pas da dung yang gling bzhi la rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du 'jug go/ /gau ta ma gyidag rgyal po mdzes pa'i brla g.yon par sha rmen zhig skyes pa 'jam zhing shin tu mnyen te/ dper na shing bal gyi 'da' ba'am/ras bal gyi 'da' ba bzhin du chung (4)zad kyang gnod pa mi skyed do/ /de smin nas brtol ba dang / khye'u gzugs bzang ba(ge/ blta (snyan sdug pa/ mdzes pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa zhig byung ste/brla g.yon pa las skyes pas ming nye mdzes nye mdzes zhes bya bar gyur to/ /gzhon nu de rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin pas da dung yang gling gsum la rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du 'jug go/ /gi 6)ta ma (8)dag rgyal po nye ⑨mdzes kyi rkang pa g.yas par sha men zhig skyes pa 'jam zhing shin tu mnyen te/dper na shing bal gyi 'da' ba'am/ ras bal gyi 'da' ba bzhin du chung 0zad kyang gnod pa mi skyed do/ /de smin nas brtol ba dang / khye'u gzugs bzang ba1nye / /blta tsho na sdug pa/ mdzes pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis sna kun nas brgyan pa zhig byung ste/ rkang pa g.yas pa las skyes pas ming mdzes ldan mdzes ldan zhes bya bar gyur to/ /gzhon nu de rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin pas da dung du yang gling gnyis la rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang 72—266

byed du 'jug go/ /gau ta ma dag rgyal po mdzes ldan gyi rkang pa g.yon par sha men zhig skyes pa 'jam zhing shin tu mnyen te/ dper na shing bal gyi 'da' ba'am / ras bal gyi 'da' ba bzhin du chung 1zad kyang gnod pa mi skyed do/ /de smin nas brtol ba dang / khye'u gzugs bzang ba/ blta nan sdug pa/mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan ( risum cu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa zhig byung ste/ rkang pa g.yon pa las skyes pas ming nye mdzes ldan nye mdzes ldan zhes bya bar gyur to/ /gzhon nu de rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin pas da dung du yang gling gcig la rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du 'jug go/ /gi ta ma ④dag de ltar na (5)rgyal po mang pos bkur gyi 'bu 'od mdzes so/ /'od mdzes kyi bu ⑦dge ba'o/ /dge ba'i bu dge mchogan /dge mchog gi bu 99gso sbyong 'phags so/ /gso sbyong 'phags kyi bu nga las nu'o/ /nga las nu'i mdzes pa'o/ /mdzes pa'i nye ⑩mdzes pa'o/ /nye nyunyamadzes kyi mdzes ldan dang / nye mdzes ldan dang —/ bzang po dang / legs bzangs 12dang / btang ba dang / btang bzung (stedang / yan lag dang / yan lag shing rta dang / ngan spong dang /skal ldan shing rta dang / rgya mtsho dang / rgya mtsho'i bu dang / rgya mtsho chen po dang ske/ sha ku ni dang / sha ku ni chen po dang / ku sha dang / nye ba'i ku sha dang —/ ku sha chen po dang / legs mthong dang / legs mthong chen po dang /rab thob dang / rab thob chen po dang / rab tu sgra bsgrags bodang / rab tu sgra bsgrags chen po dang / 'od byed dang / rtul phod pa dang / lhun po ldan dang —/ lhun po yod dang / 'od zer dang /bo 'od zer ldan tshadang /'od zer yod dang / kun nas 'od zer ro/ /gi ta ma dag kun nas 'od 72wa 267

zer gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgya (1stetham pa yul gru 'dzin du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po dgra 'dul zhes bya ba byung ste/ dgra 'dul bar byed pas dgra 'dul dgra 'dul zhes bya bar gyur to/ /go ta ma nadag rgyal po dgra 'dul gyi bu dang / tsha (mibo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po lnga khri bzhi stong yul dmag gis gi)mi tshugs par byung ngo / /de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba (5)zhes bya ba byung ste ri / ma rgyal ba las rgyal bar byed pas (7)na ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba zhes bya bar 8grags so/ /gi ta ma 5)dag rgyal po ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po sum khri drug stong yul bā rā ṇa sīr 7byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha dzinam ni rgyal po bzod dka' zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gau ta ma tshedag rgyal po bzod dka'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong kyim pi la'i grong khyer du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po tshangs hunyebyin ces bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma ngadag rgyal po tshangs byin gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po sum khri nyis stong glang po che'i grong khyer du byung ste / de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po glang pos byin zhes 'bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma tsodag rgyal po glang pos byin gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po lnga stong yul rdo 'jog matu byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po bal bu can zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gau ta ma dag rgyal po bal bu can gyi bu dang /tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po sum khri nyis stong grong khyer brang gis nyal du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po tshan po che tu 'dul zhes 72—268

bya ba byung ngo / /gau ta ma dag rgyal po tshan po che 'dul 91)gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po sum khri nyis stong grong khyer ma rgyal ba las rgyal bar byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po rgyal byin nazhes (5)bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po rgyal byin gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang ske/ sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po sum khri nyis stong grong khyer kun kub dzar 4byung ste/de rnams kyi (getha ma ni rgyal po rgyal sde zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma 67dag rgyal po rgyal sde'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po khri brgyad stong grong khyer tsam par byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po klu'i lha zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gau ta ma 57)dag rgyal po klu'i lha'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po nyi khri lnga stong grong khyer ta la'i phreng du byung ste/de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po mi'i 85lha zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma 9dag rgyal po mi'i ⑩lha'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po khri nyis stong grong khyer ta ma lar /1byung ste/12 de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po rgya (1lhamatsho'i lha zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gau ta ma dag rgyal po rgya mtsho'i lha'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po khri brgyad thustong grong khyer ba so'i 'grong du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po blo gros bzang po zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gau ta ma dag rgyal po blo gros bzang po'i bu dang / tsha bo dang /yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po nyi khri lnga stong grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po mun sel zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma skyadag rgyal po mun sel gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgya tham ⑩pa yang grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr 18byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma 72wa 269

ni rgyal po dbang phyug chen po'i sde zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po dbang phyug chen po'i sde'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong grong khyer rtswa (1)can du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po rgya mcho3re sde zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma (midag rgyal po rgya zhu rimachoXre sde'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po stong yang grong khyer gru 'dzin du byung ste kyi/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po dka' thub spyod ces bya ba byung ngo / /gau ta ma 55)dag rgyal po dka' (6)thub spyod kyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong yang grong khyer rtswa 7 can du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po sa'i gdong zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gau ta ma na dag rgyal po sa'i gdong gi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po 'bum yang grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr 5)byung ste/de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po sa'i bdag po zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma gedag rgyal po sa'i bdag po'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po 'bum yang grong khyer dmag gis 5)mi tshugs par byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po sa 12'dzin zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma tunyedag rgyal po sa 'dzin gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong grong khyer mi thi lar byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po lha chen po zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma gedag rgyal po lha chen po'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong yang grong khyer mi thi lar drang srong gi tshangs par spyod pa la spyad de/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po mu khyud ces bya ba byung ngo / /mu khyud las 'bying ba dang / sra ba'i mu khyud dang / rko ba 72wa 270

dang / nye bar rko ba 1dang rko ba yod dang kun nas rko dang / gya nom snang dang / thos pa'i (nasde dang / chos kyi sde dang / rtogs pa dang / rtogs pa chen po dang / rtogs pa'i sde dang / mya ngan med dang / mya ngan bral dang /brtan pa'i sde dang / rga bas /sbyar dang / glen bsad cadang / skya reng (5)dang / phyogs kyi bdag po dang / rdul 6can dang / bde byed dang / kun dga' dang / me long gdong dang / skyed pa dang / kun nas skyed pa dang /skye bo'i khyu mchog dang / bza' btung can dang / bza' 7btung mang po can dang / mi thub pa dang / gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / gnas pa dang /shin tu gnas pa dang / stobs chen dang / stobs chen zhon 87dang / legs pa'i blo gros dang / brtan pa 9zhen dang / gzhu bcu pa dang / gzhu brgya pa dang / gzhu dgu bcu dang / gzhu rgyal dang / gzhu skabakra dang / gzhu sra dang / shing rta bcu pa dang / shing rta brgya pa dang / shing rta dgu bcu pa dang / shing rta khra (/1bo dang / shing rta rgyal dang / shing rta sra 12ba'o/ /gi ta ma nyunyedag rgyal po shing rta sra ba'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po bdun khri bdun stong grong khyer kun tu snang bar byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha yim ni rgyal po kṛ tī tshazhes bya ba byung ngo / /de'i tshe ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang /zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung 7zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de'i spyan sngar bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' ma 'ongs pa na byang chub par 72—271

bya ba'i phyir smon lam btab nas tshangs par spyod pa spyad ①de/ dga' ldan gyi lha'i rigs rinasu skyes so/ /gi ta ma ri skadag rgyal po kṛ khri'i ④bu legs skyes dzubaso/ /gau ta ma dag rgyal po legs skyes kyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang /sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgya tham ri pa yang grong khyer gru 'dzin du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po rna ba can zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gau ta ma skyodag rgyal po rna ba can la bu gnyis te/ gi ta ma dang / bha ra dudwa dza'o/ /de gnyis las gi ta ma 9)ni mngon par 'byung tabar dga'o/ / bha ra dwa yidza ni rgyal srid la mngon par dga'o/ /de pha chos dang chos ma yin pas rgyal srid byed pa mthong nas des bsams pa/ bdag yab 'das nas rgyal por gyur te/ bdag gis kyang chos dang chos ma yin pas rgyal srid byas nas sems can dmyal bar gzhol bar 'gyur bas 'dir ci'i dus la bab ce na/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung bar bya'o snyam du bsams nas/ rgyal po rna ba can gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te gsol ba btab pa/ yab mkhyen par mdzod cig /bdag ni dad pas khyim nas khyim ma mchis par rab tu 'byung ngo / /des smras pa/ bu gang gi phyir mchod sbyin mchod par byed pa dang sbyin sreg (nyesreg par byed pa dang / dka' thub dka' thub 8spyod pa de dag ni 'di'i ched yin te/ nga r+sha'adas na rgyal srid lag mthil du 'ongs te rgyal po byed par 'gyur na ci'i phyir rab tu 'byung / des smras pa/ yab bdag gis chos dang chos skum yin pas rgyal srid bgyid rngo mi thogs sotso/ /de lta ⑩bas na mkhyen par mdzod cig /rab tu 'byung ngo / /de nas rgyal pos gal gyis 'chu bar shes nas gnang ngo / /de'i tshe bsti gnas zhig na drang srong mdog gnag ces bya 72—272

ba gnas so/ /de nas gzhon nu gau ta ma 1)rgyal pos gnang nas/ dga' zhing mgu la dga' (mib rgya chen po dang yid bde ba skyes nas/ drang srong mdog gnag gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / spyod lam dul bas rkang pa gnyis la phyag byas nas smras pa/ drang srong chen po bdag rab tu 'byung bar 'dod kyis (7bdag rab tu phyung shig /des de rab tu phyung 4ngo / /drang srong mdog gnag (5)ni 'bras bu dang / rtsa ba dang / chu 'thung bas de yang drang srong go ta ma (ne'edrang srong gi ta ma 6)zhes bya bar gyur to/ /ji tsam na dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po rna ba (8)can shi nas gzhon nu bha 9)ra dwa 1 )dza pa'i rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du bcug 6glego/ /ji tsam na dus gzhan zhig na drang srong gi ta mas tshamakhan po la smras pa/ mkhan po dgon pa'i gnas na zas kyis 'tsho bar rngo mi thogs kyis ⑫grong 'dab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /des smras pa/ bu rung gis grong ngam/dgon pa na gnas pa'i drang srong gis ni mdor na dbang po bsrung ba yin gyisayi/khyod song la gru 'dzin gyi nye 'khor du lo ma'i spyil bu byos la 'dug shig /mkhan po bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes smras nas/ drang srong gi ta ma 7gru 'dzin gyi nye 'khor du lo ma'i spyil bu byas te gnas so/ /de'i tshe grong khyer gru 'dzin na smad 'tshong ma bzang mo zhes bya ba dang / skyes bu g.yon can pad ma'i rtsa lag ces bya ba gnas te/ des de la dga' mgur 7spyad pa'i phyir gos dang rgyan dag skur 0ro/ /des gos dang rgyan dag thogs nas chas pa las yang mi gzhan zhig kār ṣā pa ṇa hu)lnga brgya thogs pa zhig 'ongs nas/ bzang mo dga' mgur spyad kyis ()tshur shog /des bsams pa/ gal te bdag song na kār ṣā pa ṇa rdzu )lnga brgya yang mi 'thob la khyim du 'ongs pa spangs te/ gzhan du 'gro ba 72—273

'di ni legs pa ma yin no snyam nas des bu mo mngag gzhug ma la smras pa/ song 91ril pad ma'i rtsa lag la jo mo'i mchid nas re zhig bdag skabs ma mchis te slad kyis mchi'o zhes smros shig /des de'i gan du song nas smras so/ /mi de yang bya ba mang po zhig yin pas de de dang dga' mgur spyad nas thun dang po nyid la song ngo / /des bsams pa/ nam tshod ring du yod pas de'i sems kyang bsrung bar nus so snyam nas des yang bu mo de la bsgo ba pad ma'i rtsa lag gi gan du song la jo mo'i mchid nas sta gon bgyis lags na skyed mos tshal gang du mchi nasazhes smros shig /des de'i gan du song nas smras pa dang / des smras pa/khyod kyi /skad cig la skabs med/ skad cig la skabs yod ce'am6)/ bu mo dude de dang regs 6)mi 'phrod pa zhig pas/ des smras pa rje'i sras skabs ma ⑦mchis pa ni ma lags mod kyi/ de khyod kyi gos dang rgyan dag gis skyes pa gzhan dang lhan 85cig dga' mgur spyad do/ /de'i 'dod chags kyis khakun nas dkris pa gang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur cing gnod sems kyis 7kun nas dkris pa skyes te/ de mi bzod nyu pa skyes nas smras pa/ bu mo song la bzang mo pad ma'i rtsa lag na re skyed mos tshal ga ge mo zhig tu shog shig ces byos shig /des song nas bzang mo la smras nas/ de nas de skyed mos tshal du song ba dang /skyes bu g.yon can pad ma'i 1 rtsa lag gis smras pa/ khyod kho bo'i gos dang rgyan gyis 1 skyes pa gzhan dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod pa rigs sam/ des smras pa / rje'i sras de ni bdag gis nongs te 'on kyang bud med ni rtag tu skyon can lags pas bzod par mdzod cig /de nas de mi bzod pa skyes nas ral gri shubs rmenas phyung ste bsad do/ /de nas bu mo mngag gzhug mas jo mo bsad do//72—274

jo mo bsad do hu)zhes ku co'i sgra chen po bton ( pa skye bo'i tshogs chen po kun gyis thos nas brgyugs pa dang / de ji tsam na bsti gnas de nyid na drang srong gi ta ma zhuganas so/ /de nas skyes bu g.yon can pad ma'i rtsa lag de skrag nas ral gri khrag ④can drang srong gi ta ma'i (5)mdun du bor nas skye bo'i tshogs de nyid kyi nang du zhugs so/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen po des (6)ral gri 7khyag can mthong nas smras pa / rab tu byung ba 'dis bzang mo gsad 98)do zhes de nas drang srong gau ta ma de bskor te/ mi bzod pa bskyed (9)nas smras pa/ kwa'e tsharab tu byung ba 11drang srong gi rgyal mtshan thogs nas 'di 'dra ba'i las byed dam/ des smras pa/ ci byas / de rnams kyis smras pa/ bzang mo dang khyod lhan cig dga' mgur spyad nas de bsad do/ /des smras pa/ kho bo'i sdig pa zhi bas las de mi byed do zhes des zhi bas tu)smras kyang skye bo'i tshogs des lag pa phyin 12ka log tu dam du bcings nas rgyal po la phul te/ lha rab tu byung ba 'dis bzang mo dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad nas de bkum lags so/ /rgyal po rnams ni mi rtog pa yin pas/ des smras pa/ gal te de ltar gyur na rab tu byung ba 'di ngas spangs kyis gsal shing la gshon cig /de rab tu byung ba de me tog ka ra bī tsora'i phreng ba mgul du btags shing skyes pa gos sngon po gyon pa lag na mtshon thogs pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor nas lam po che dang / tshong 'dus dang /bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su bsgrags pa'i sgor bsgrags te/ grong khyer gyi lho phyogs kyi sgor phyung nas gson po nyid du gsal shing la gshon no/ /de'i mkhan po mdog gnag de dus dus gesu de'i bsti tshaganas su 'gro ba yin pas ji tsam du sa gzhan zhig na song ba las ma mthong nas des phan tshun du btsal bar 72—275

brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na de gsal shing la gshon pa mthong nas de skad mi gsal 4)zhing mig mchi mas gang la snying rje ba'i tshig gis dal bu dal bus smras pa/kyi hud bu 'di ci zhig /des kyang skad mi gsal zhing yi (7chad la gnad du bab pa'i gnod pa'i tshor ba skyes shing gdungs pas smras pa/ mkhan po gzhan ci lags las lags mod/ des smras pa/ bu rma phyung ba'am/ gnod pa zhig ma byas grang / mkhan po bdag gi ri lus kyis rma phyung ligi sems kyis ni ma yin no / /bu ji ltar shes/ mkhan po bden pa gsol gyis (gegason cig /bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig gang gis bdag gi lus kyis 6)rma phyung gi sems kyis ma yin na/ bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig des mkhan po'i pags (3)pa'i mdog nag po gang yin pa 'di gser gyi kha dog tu gyur cig /bdag nyid chen po de lhag pa'i bsam 8pa goms pa yin pas tshig smras ma thag tu drang srong mdog nag gi pags 59 pa nag po mi snang zhing gser gyi kha dog tu gyur to/ /kun tu drang srong mdog nag gser gyi kha dog tu gyur to zhes sgra grags 7pas de'i ming gser mdog ces bya bar gyur to 11/ /de ngo mtshar mchog tu gyur to/ /de nas drang srong gau 12ta mas smras pa/ mkhan po bdag 'di nas shi 'phos nas 'gro ba ni gang / skye ba ni gang / tshe phyi ma ni gang zhig lags/ des smras pa/bu bram ze rnams khye'u med pa la 'gro ba med do zhes zer na khyod kyis bu 'ga' bskyed pa lta yod dam/ mkhan po yab kyis rgyal srid kyi slad nyurtedu spro ba bskyed pa na bdag gzhon nu nyid du rab tu byung bas bud med kyi rgyus kyang ma 'tshal na/bdag gi bu skye ba blta ga la mchis/ bu gal te de lta na sngon yul la spyad pa rjes su dran par gyis shig /mkhan po tshor ba drag pos nyen pas tsod ni bdag gi 72—276

gnad rnams chad cing tshigs rnams bye ste/ 'gum pa gcig tu dran par bas zhinan ji ltar sngon gyi yul la spyad pa rjes su dran par 'gyur/ de'i mkhan po mngon par shes pa thob pa yin pas des durdzu 'phrul gyis rdzi char chen po sprul nas char pa'i thigs ②pas de'i lus la phog ④pa dang / de nas char pa dang rlung grang mo reg pas sdug bsngal rnam par mnan nas/ des sngon gyi yul la spyad pa rjes su dran par bya bar brtsams so/ /gang gi tshe des 'khrig pa'i 'dod chags rjes su dran par byas pa las khu ba'i thigs pa gnyis khrag dang lhan cig lhung ngo / /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas ni bzhi ste/ bdag sems pa dang /'jig rten sems pa dang / sems can rnams kyi las kyi rnam par smin pa sems pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi yul sems pa'o/ khu ba'i thigs pa de gnyis sgo nga gnyis su gyur nas nyi ma shar ba'i dus kyi tshe nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis smin nas rdol ba dang / khye'u gnyis shig byung nas de dang ha cang yang mi ring ba'i bu ram shing gi tshal gseb der de gnyis zhugs so/ /de nas nyi ma'i 'od zer shin tu tsha ba byung ste/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis drang srong gi ta ma 95)gdungs nas shi'o/ /de nas drang srong gser mdog 'ongs nas shi ba mthong nas des gsal shing gi nye 'khor du bltas na/ sgo nga rdol ba'i khog pa gnyis shig 'dug nas/ de phan tshun rjes gcod cing bu ram shing gi (6)tshal gseb tu zhugs pa las ji tsam na khye'u gnyis shig mthong ngo / /des 'di gnyis su'i bu yin zhes bsam pa la ༅zhugs pa dang / drang srong gi ta ma'i (8)bu yin par gyur nas/de nas de lhag par sdug pa skyes te/ des de gnyis bsti gnas su khrid nas bsnun gsos te/ de de gnyis kyi ming btags pa nyi ma shar ba'i tshe nyi ma'i 'od 72—277

zer gyis smin par byas pa las 'di gnyis skyes par gyur pas de bas na 5)nyi ma'i rigs yin pas des na nyi ma'i rigs nyi ma'i rigs (mizhes bya bar gyur to/ /drang srong gi ta ma'i ( bu yin pas ming gnyis pa la (4)ni gi ta ma gi ta ma (dezhes bya bar gyur to/ /rang gi yan lag las skyes pas ming gsum pa yan lag skyes yan lag skyes 56)bya bar gyur to/ /bu ram shing gi tshal gseb nas rnyed pas ming bzhi pa bu ram shing pa bu ram shing pa (7zhes bya bar gyur to/ /ji tsam na dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po bha ra dwa 8dza bu med par shi nas/ blon po rnams 'dus nas gros bya bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag su zhig rgyal por dbang bskur bar bya/gzhan dag gis smras pa/ de'i gcen po (9)gi ta ma 7drang srong rnams kyi nang du rab tu byung ste rgyal srid 'di ni de'i rigs rgyud du 'ongs pa yin pas de dbang bskur ro/ /de nas de rnams kyis gros byas nas drang srong gser mdog gi drung du song ste phyin pa dang / rkang pa gnyis la gtugs /rtanas smras pa/ drang srong chen po gau ta ma gang du mchis/ des smras pa/ khyed cag kho nas bsad do/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ drang srong chen po bdag cag gis de mthong bar yang mi dran na ji ltar bsad/ kho bos khyed cag dran 12par bya'o ma nongs so/ /des de rnams dran par byas pa dang / smras pa/ drang srong chen po gal te de lta na sdig pa spyod pa de ming tsam smos pa yang bsgrags pa ma yin gyis 32zhig shig /des sdig pa'i las ci dang 6ci byas/ 'di dang 'di'o/ /skyon med pa gnod pa mi byed pa dese sdig pa'i las ma byas par khyed cag gis bsad do/ /de ltar ci mngon/ des ji ltar gyur pa rgyas par smras pa dang / de rnams yid mi bde ba skyes nas smras pa/ drang srong chen po gal te de lta na des ma legs kyi/72—278

bdag cag gis sdig pa'i las bgyis so zhes de rnams de skad du smra bar byed pa na / khye'u de gnyis kyang drang srong gi drung du 'ongs so/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ drang srong chen po khye'u 'di gnyis su'i lags/ des smras pa/ de kho na'i bu'o/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'di gnyis ji ltar skyes/ 'di gnyis kyi ming ci lags/ des byung ba dang bcas par rgyas par smras pa/ blon po rnams kyis de thos te mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes nas/ de rnams kyis drang srong de la gsol ba btab nas de gnyis las gzhon nu phu bo 6)shos rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur bas dbang bskur ba las de yang bu med par shi'o/ /de nas cig (mishos nu bo dbang bskur ③nas de'i ming rgyal po bu ram shing pa zhes bya bar gyur to / /gi ta ma godag rgyal po bu ram shing pa'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po bu ram shing (5)pa brgya yang grong khyer gru 'dzin du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma 96)dag rgyal po bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po la bu bzhi ste/skar mda' gdong 9)dang / lag rna dang / glang po che 'dul dang / rkang gdub can no/ /dus gzhan zhig na de'i btsun mo dam pa shi nas de lag 98)pa 'gram pa la gtad tsa)de sems khong du 7chud cing 'dug go/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha ci'i slad du phyag la zhal gtad (1nas thugs mi dgyes shing bzhugs / des smras pa/ nga'i btsun mo dam pa shi na ci'i phyir sems khong du yi chud cing mi 'dug /lha gal te de lta na nyi 'og gi rgyal po rnams la bu mo mchis na / ci'i slad du lha'i btsun mo dam pa mi btsal/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gzhon nu 'di dag ni rgyal srid mngon par 'dod pas phyir rgol ba 'di dag yod na nga 72—279

la su zhig bu mo ster bar 'gyur/ lha dgongs shig dang / bdag cag gis btsal lo/ /ji tsam na rgyal po gzhan zhig gi bu mo gzugs bzang ba/ blta ①na sdug pa/ mdzes pa btsun mo dam par 'tsham (mipa yod pa de ②mi rnams kyis brtags te/ rgyal po de'i drung du dong nas/ de rnams kyis gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 4de rgyal po de la rig par byas pa dang rgyal pos bsgo ba/ khug shig /de nas de rnams rgyal po'i spyan sngar dong nas rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te thog mar gtam byas nas 'dug go/ /gtam gyi skabs rnyed cing rgyal po'i zhal mthong nas smras pa/ lha bkra shis par gyur cig /bkra shis par gyur cig /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed (5༄ci gsol/ rgyal po bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po'i btsun mo dam pa gum nas de'i ched du sras mo slang yingo / /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'thab rir bab pa'i mchog yin pas rung na 'on kyang dam zhig bca' ste / gal te nga'i bu mo la khye'u zhig yod par gyur na de gal te rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la gzhag pa lta na sbyin no/ /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal mchis la lha la snyan du gdas par gsol 7 lo zhes de rnams dong nas/ rgyal po bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po la ji ltar gyur pa smras pa dang (8)/ rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag gzhon nu ches phu 9ribor gyur pa rgyal srid la mngon par dga' ba rnams spangs te/ nu bo rgyal srid la 'jog pa de ni 'os pa ma yin no/ /lha don 'di la nges pa ma mchis te/ re zhig btsun mo blangs la lha de dang lhan cig rtsed mo dang / dgyes pa dang / dgyes dgur spyod pa mdzod cig /de la khye'u btsa' bar 'gyur ram/ 'on te bu mor 'gyur ram/ /spyi ma mchis par 'gyur ba sus 'tshal/ rgyal pos gesmras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te de lta na deng la longs ⑩72—280

shig /de rnams dong nas bsu ste/ ji tsam na rgyal po'i dpal gyi 'byor pa chen pos blangs nas de yang rgyal pos mngon par 'dod par 5)gyur te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do//de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las dus gzhan zhig na btsun mo sems can dang ldan par gyur to/ /de zla ba brgyad dam/dgu 'das pa dang / khye'u gzugs bzang ba/ blta (gun sdug pa/ mdzes pa zhig btsas so/ /btsas nas ( )de'i btsas ston rgya cher byas te khye'u 'di'i ming cir gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed do/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/lha 'di ltar ma skyes pa nyid nas rgyal srid la mngon par dga' bas de'i slad du khye'u'i rgyaming rgyal srid dga' zhes bgyi'o/ /khye'u rgyal srid dga' ma ma brgyad la rjes su gtad de zhes bya ba (5sminas rdzing na gnas pa'i pad ma bzhin du myur du skyed drag par byed do zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de rgyal tshab (6)kyi rgyal srid la ma bzhag pa de'i zhang po rgyal pos thos nas/ des de (7)la pho nya btang ste/tshig rtsub po dang chas pa'i spring yig 98)bskur ba/ khyed (17kyis sngon khas blangs shing dam bcas pa bzhin gal te byed na de lta na 1 tsholegs/ gal te de ltar ma byas na khyod kyi mthu dang brtson 'grus kyi yi1pha rol gnon pa gang yin pa des sdod cig /kho bo 'o 7nir 'ongs nas yul 'khor phur tsho/nyamar brlag yigo/ /rgyal po de gemathu chen po dang ldan pas ⑩des thos nas skrag ste/ blon po rnams bsogs nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag nga la rgyal po des 'di skad ces spring na 7de la ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha rgyal srid dga' rgyal tshab 48tu dbang bskur (smulags mod/ des smras pa/ shes ldan dag gzhon nu ches phu 72—281

bor gyur pa rgyal srid la mngon (1par dga' ba rnams spangs te/ nu bo rgyal srid kyis nadabang bskur ba 'di ni 'os pa ma yin no/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/lha rgyal po de ni stobs dang bzhon pa rgya che bas gal te 'dir mchis na gdon mi 'tshal bar yul phur kyi mar rlog sa pa gang lags pa'i gnas de mchis pas rgyal srid dga' rgyal tshab 5)kyi dbang phyug la dbang bgyid par dbang bskur la/gzhon nu de rnams ni spyug tu gsol/ rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag skyon med cing gnod pa ma byas pa'i gzhon nu rnams ji ltar spyug /lha bdag cag ni blon po lags te/ lha la sman par bgyi ba lhur len pa lags pas skyon ma mchis pa dang / nongs pa ma mchis pa yang spyugs la skyon mchis pa dang /nongs pa bgyis pa ni gzhag 96rigo/ /rgyal pos btang snyoms su bzhag ⑦nas cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /blon po rnams tshogs nas phan tshun du gros bya bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag thabs shig bsham par bya ste/ des na rgyal po gzhon nu rnams la thugs byung bar 'gyur ba zhig bya'o zhes de nas de rnams kyis skyed mos tshal byi dor byas pa/ ri mo sna tshogs bris (8)par shin tu dri zhim pa'i pog por 9nye bar bzhags /dar gyi chun 'phyang mang po btags/ me tog sna tshogs kyis dga' dga' ltar byas pa zhig byed du bcug go/ /de nas de rnams kyis blon po rnams kyis skyed mos tshal de'i byi dor byed pa rgyang ring po nas mthong nas gzhon nu rgod bag can de rnams skyed mos tshal gyi phyogs su dong ngo / /blon po rnams skyed mos tshal gyi byi dor byas nas sgor byung ba dang gzhin nu rnams kyis dris pa/ 'di su'i skyed mos tshal de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha'i lags so/ /de rnams slar log par brtsams pa dang blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ gzhon nu 72—282

rnams nang du zhugs shig /ci'i phyir slar ldog /de rnams kyis smras pa/lha'i skyed mos tshal yin na 'dir 'jug tu ga la rung / blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha'am gzhon nu rnams rol pa 'di la 'gal ba ci mchis/ de rnams nang du zhugs te rtse bar brtsams so/ /blon po rnams kyis rgyal po la smras pa/lha skyed mos tshal legs par byi dor bgyis lags kyis 6)lha gzigs pa'i dus la (mibab lags so/ /rgyal po chas (gupa dang skyed mos tshal na ku co'i sgra thos so/ /thos nas kyang blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag skyed mos tshal na ku co'i sgra grag gon 'di na (snyesu zhig 'dug /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha gzhon nu rnams so/ /gal te de lta na ngas gzhon nu rnams spangs so/ /blon po rnams kyis rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ lha bzod par mdzad cing gzhon nu rnams spang bar gsol/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ de bzhin du bya'o zhes gzhon nu de rnams spyug par chad pa dang rgyal po'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs nas smras pa/ lha gal te de lta na bdag cag 'khor gyi skye bo dang lhan cig mchi na de ci nas kyang mi dgag pa de 56)ltar bka' stsal pa'i rigs so/ /rgyal pos bsgo nas / de rnams chas pa na/ de rnams la 577dga' ba'i pho brang 'khor gyi (8)mi skye bo'i tshogs chen po dang de rnams lhan cig chas te zhag bdun du grong khyer gru 'dzin gyi sgo phye nas 6)skye bo'i tshogs rgyus so/ /blon po rnams kyis rgyal po la smras pa / lha gal te grong khyer gyi sgo ma bkum na ring po mi thogs par gru 'dzin stongs par 'gyur ro/ /gal te ⑩de lta na sgo chod cig /de nas gzhon nu de rnams rang gi sring mo khrid nas mthar gyis ri bo gangs ri dang nye ba chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram na/ drang srong ser skya'i bsti gnas dang ha cang yang 67mi ring ba 72—283

zhig tu phyin nas (17de rnams kyis der lo ma'i spyil bu dag byas te/ gnas btab nas ri dgas bsad cing bsad nas 'tsho ba byed cing dus gsum du drang srong ser skya'i bsti gnas su 'dong bar byed do/ /lang tsho dang ②dar la bab pa'i dregs pas zin pas 'dod chags kyis shin tu nyen te/ sha bri changan pa skya 9)bo bseng bseng (57por gyur to/ /ji tsam du sa yigazhan zhig na drang srong ser skyas de lta bu mthong nas dris pa/ khyed cag ci'i phyir skya (7)bo bseng bseng ⑧por gyur/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ drang srong chen po bdag cag 'dod pa'i ⑨'dod chags kyis shin tu nyen pas so/ /des smras pa/ rang rang gi sring mo spongs la mas dbyen gyi sring mo rnams dang lhan cig 'dug shig /drang srong chen po bdag cag gis de lta bu bgyir rung ngamayi/ shes ldan dag 'di ltar ⑪rgyal rigs rgyal srid stor ba 1 rnams kyis rung ngo / /de nas de rnams drang srong gi tshig ni tshad ma yin no snyam nas 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyis nyen pas dga' ba dang mgu ba skyes te/ mas dbyen gyi sring mo rnams dang tu)lhan cig rtse bar byed / dga' bar byed/khu dga' dgur lispyod par byed do/ /de rnams dang de dag dang 7lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' dgur ⑩spyod par byed pa na bu pho dang / bu mo dag btsas te tsode rnams chen por gyur pa dang / bsam gtan gyi tsher ma ni sgra yin pas drang srong ser skya sems rtse gcig pa nyid du ma btub nas shes ldan dag mthong zin gyis yikho bo gzhan du 'gro'o / /drang srong chen po ci'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi tsher ma ni sgra yin pas sems rtse gcig pa nyid du ma btub pas so/ /drang srong chen po khyod 'di nyid na bzhugs shig /bdag cag gzhan du mchi na/ 'on kyang sa'i phyogs shig bdag 72—284

cag la phog ①shig /shes ldan dag rung ngo / /drang srong bdag nyid chen po de rnams ni 'dod pa bzhin yid la re ba 'grub (bapa yin pas des gser gyi bya (5)ma bum blangs te/ chu'i rgyun gyis grong khyer gyi rnam pa dag bris nas de rnams kyis grong khyer brtsigs so/ /drang srong ser skyas de rnams kyi gnas kyi ④phyir gzhi yongs su btang ⑤bas ser skya'i gzhi (6)ser skya'i gzhi zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de rnams der 'phel bar gyur pas skye bo'i tshogs chen por gyur te/ dogs pas 'phel che bar ma ④gyur to/ /lha rnams kyi sems kyis de rnams kyi sems shes nas phyogs gzhan zhig bstan pa dang / de rnams der dong ste grong khyer cig zhu)shos brtsigs nas lhas bstan lhas bstan 9)ces bya bar gyur to/ /de nas de rnams tshogs shing 'dus nas phan tshun gros bya bar 7brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag gang gi phyir bdag cag spyugs pa ni rigs mnyam pa las chung ma ma blangs pa de las gyur gyis (7de lta 8bas na bdag cag 6༄las sus kyang rigs mnyam pa las chung ④ma blang bar mi bya ste gcig kho nas chog shes par bya'o/ /de rnams rigs mnyam pa gcig kho na las chung ma len 8gyi chun tsham ni mi len to/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po 'phags skyes po bu sdug pa rnams rjes su dran nas blon po rnams la smras pa/ kye grong pa dag gzhon nu de rnams da ltar gang na 'dug /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lhas nongs pa 'ga' zhig la spyugs ⑩pa las de rnams rang rang gi sring mo khrid de 'di nas mchis pa na gangs ri dang nye ba chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram drang srong ser skya'i bsti gnas dang ha cang mi ring ba zhig tu gnas btab ste rang rang gi sring mo spangs te/ mas dbyen gyi sring mo rnams dang lhan cig rtse bar bgyid/ dga' bar bgyid/ dga' dgur 3)spyod par 72—285

bgyid nyu)do/ /de rnams rtse bar bgyid/ dga' bar bgyid/ dga' dgur (mispyod par bgyid pa na bu pho dang / bu mo dag btsas so/ /grong pa dag gzhon nu rnams kyis de ltar byed phod dam lha rngo thogs 55)lags so/ /de nas rgyal po bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes pos ro stod bsrangs (4)nas lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste/ched du brjod pas ched du brjod pa/ kye ma gzhon nu rnams ni phod pa yin no/ /kye ma gzhon nu rnams ni shin tu phod pa yin no zhes sems can dbang chen pos tshig tu phyung ste/ kye ma gzhin nu rnams ni phod pa yin no/ /kye ma gzhon nu rnams ni shin tu phod pa yin no zhes byas pas (5)de rnams shākya shākya zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de rnams po)dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po shi nas rgyal srid dga' rgyal srid la dbang bskur ro/ /de yang bu med par shi nas skar mda' gdong 7༄rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du bcug go/ /de yang bu med par shi nas lag rna 58)rgyal por gyur to/ /de yang bu med par shi nas glang po che 'dul rgyal por gyur (9༄to/ spre /de yang bu med par shi nas rkang gdub can rgyal por gyur to/ /de'i bu gnas 'jog go/ /gi ta ma yidag gnas 'jog gi bu sa khyim mo/ /gau ta ma /rtadag rgyal po sa khyim gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po lnga khri lnga stong grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni shing rta bcu pa dang / shing rta brgya pa dang / shing rta dgu bcu dang / shing rta khra bo dang / shing rta rgyal dang /brtan pa'i shing rta dang / gzhu bcu pa dang / gzhu brgya pa dang / gzhu dgu bcu pa 8dang / gzhu rgyal dang / gzhu bkra dang / gzhu brtan no/ /gi ta ma 32dag gzhu brtan la bu gnyis te/ seng ge'i 'gram dang / seng ge'i sgra'o/ /gi 72—286

ta ma 1)dag 'dzam bu'i gling gi gzhu thogs ji snyed yod pa de rnams kyi nang na seng ge'i 'gram mchog tu grags so/ /gi ta ma (5)dag seng ge'i 'gram la bu bzhi ste/zas gtsang (gudang / zas dkar dang / bre bo zas dang / bdud rtsi'i zas so/ /bu mo gtsang ma dang / dkar mo dang / bre mo ma dang / bdud rtsi ma'o/ /zas gtsang la bu gnyis teri bye/ bcom ldan 'das dang / tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo'o/ /zas dkar la bu gnyis te/ tshe dang ldan pa rgyal dang /shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan no/ /bre bo zas la bu gnyis te/ ming chen dang /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa'o/ /bdud rtsi zas kyi bu gnyis te/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / lha sbyin (5no/ /gtsang ma'i bu ni legs par rab sad do / /dkar mo'i bu ni phreng ba can no/ /bre bo ma'i bu ni bzang len yino/ /bdud rtsi ma'i bu ni dge 'phel lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi (7sras ni sgra gcan 'dzin yin te/ gi ta ma 8)dag mang pos bkur gyi rgyud(9)/ tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan 'dzin du rdzogs/ srid pa'i breng rgyud chad/ 'khor ba ⑨zad de da ni yang srid pa med do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i gtam rdzogs par mkhyen nas bzhengs te bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu legs so legs so/ /mod gal gyi bu khyod kyis dge slong rnams kyi mdun du shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud las brtsams nas chos kyi gtam smras pa yang khyod legs so/ /mod gal gyi bu yang khyod kyis shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud las brtsams te chos kyi gtam rtag tu smros shig dang / des ni de rnams la yun ring po'i don dang phan pa dang bde bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 72—287

'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud las brtsams pa'i chos kyi gtam chongs shig / zung shig(1) /lhogs shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong dag shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud las (gebartsams pa'i chos kyi gtam ni don dang ldan chos dang ldan pa nas tshangs par spyod pa'i bar dang ldan pa yin te/ dge slong dag rigs kyi bu dad pas rab tu byung bas shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud las brtsams pa'i chos kyi gtam gzung zhing bklag ①pa'i rigs so/ /de nas ser skya'i gzhi'i 4)shākya rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' ste / rjes su yi rangs ci nonas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi (phyiraspyan snga nas dong ngo / /de'i tshe grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi na rgyal po seng ge 'gram zhes bya ba rgyal srid byed du 'jug ④ste/ 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba zhu)dang / lo legs pa dang 6)/ skye bo dang /mi mang pos gang ba/ 'thab pa dang / thab 0mo dang / rtsod pa dang /'gyed pa dang / chom rkun med cing nad rab tu zhi bar gyur pa/ 'bras dang /spe/ bu ram shing gi phreng yidang / ba lang dang / ma he phun sum tshogs pa na bu gcig pa la sdug pa bzhin du rgyal ()srid skyong bar byed do/ /grong khyer lhas bstan du rgyal tsopo legs par rab sad ces bya ba rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba/ 'thab pa dang / thab tsomo dang / rtsod pa dang /'gyed pa dang / chom rkun med cing nad rab tu zhi bar ⑩gyur pa/ 'bras dang ske/ bu ram shing gi phreng ba dang / ba lang dang / ma he phun sum tshogs pa 72—288

na / bu gcig 6)pa la sdug (snyepa bzhin du rgyal srid skyong bar byed do/ /rgyal po legs par rab sad kyi btsun mo dam pa gzugs bzang ba/ blta ①na sdug pa/mdzes pa/ yul gyi bzang mo lum bi nī (4)zhes bya ba yod do/ /lhas bstan na khyim bdag phyug cing nor mang la (5)longs spyod che ba yongs su bzung ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu la nor gyis 'gran pa zhig gnas pa de'i kun dga' ra ba me tog phun sum tshogs pa dang /'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa dang / chu phun sum tshogs pa dang / bya sna tshogs skad 'byin pas de'i kun dga' ra ba dga' dga' ltar 'dug pa der rgyal po dus dus su btsun mo'i 'khor dang lhan cig lhags nas de na dga' ba'i rtsed yimo nyams su myong bar byed do/ /lum bi nis (7)de mthong nas 'dod pa skyes te(nya/des smras pa/ lha kun dga' ra ba 'di bdag la stsal du gsol/ rgyal pos smras pa/ da (9rikun dga' ra ba 'di khyim bdag gi yin na ji ltar sbyin/gal te khyod la kun dga' ra ba dgos na khyod kyi phyir de bas lhag par bzang ba gzhan zhig bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po legs par rab sad kyis lum bi nī'i 0ched du de bas khyad par du 'phags pa'i kun dga' ra ba zhig byed du bcug (menas/de'i ming lum bi nī'i potshal zhes bya bar gyur to/ /rgyal po seng ge 'gram la ⑫yun ring po nas kye ma'o bdag gi rgyud la 'khor los sgyur ba 8skye bar gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam pa 'di yod do/ /rgyal po legs par rab sad la yang ⑫yun ring po nas kye ma'o bdag ni seng ge 'gram dang lhan cig gnyen du gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam pa 'di yod do/ /ji tsam du dus gzhan zhig na de'i btsun mo dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' dgur 8spyod 72—289

pa las dus gzhan zhig na btsun mo sems can dang ldan par gyur nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das pa na bu mo gzugs bzang ba/ blta 0)na sdug pa/mdzes pa/ yan lag dang / nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig btsas so/ /btsas pa de'i gzugs bzang pos rgyal po legs par rab sad btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa dang lhas bstan na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes te/ the tsom 50du gyur nas ci 'di bu mo yin nam/ 'on te las sna tshogs pas sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul yin snyam mo/ /de'i btsas pa'i btsas ston nyi ma bdun gsum nyi shu gcig tu rgya cher byas nas/ bu mo 'di'i ming cir gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed do/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lhas bstan na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs lam po che dang / tshong 'dus chadang / sum mdo dang / bzhi mdo rnams su gleng ba kha cig gi mchid nas ni 'di bu mo kho na lags 54༄te/ sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pas gzugs bzang zhing kha dog phun sum tshogs par gyur to zhes mchi'o/ /gzhan dag gi mchid nas ni 'di bu mo ma lags kyi 'o na ci zhe na las sna tshogs pas sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul lags so zhes mchi lags pas/ de bas na bu mo'i ming sgyu 'phrul zhes bgyi bar gdags ⑤so zhes btags so/ /bu mo sgyu 'phrul ma ma brgyad la rjes su gtad ⑥de zhes bya ba nas duchen mor gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de la mtshan mkhan rnams kyis lung bstan pa/ mtshan phun sum tshogs pa du ma dang ldan pa zhig btsa' bar 'gyur zhing stobs kyis 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur ro zhes bstan duto//yang de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' dgur ponyespyod par byed pa las bu mo gzugs bzang ba/ blta tshen sdug pa mdzes pa/ kha dog bzang mo tunyergyas 72—290

pa mchog dang ldan pa zhig btsas 6)so/ /de btsas pa na grong khyer de dag thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos snang bar byas te/ sgyu 'phrul la ji lta ba bzhin du dzubade'i gzugs bzang ba rnam pa thams cad du dpyad par mi nus so/ /de'i btsas pa'i btsas ston yang rgya cher byas nas/ bu mo 'di'i ming cir gdags zhes ming 'dogs ①par byed do/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ sgyu 'phrul bas 'di lhag 4)par gzugs bzang bas/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes bgyi bar gdags so zhes btags ⑤so/ /de yang bskyed 6)bsrings nas chen mor gyur pa dang / de la mtshan mkhan rnams kyis lung bstan pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa zhig btsa' bar 'gyur te/ de ni (7'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /rgyal po legs par rab sad kyis (gurgyal po seng ge 'gram la pho nya btang ste/ bdag la bu mo gnyis shig btsas pa ni sgyu 'phrul dang / sgyu 'phrul chen mo lags te/ de la gcig la ni mtshan thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i bu zhig btsa' bar 'gyur zhing 99)/ de ni stobs kyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /cig bishos la ni skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa'i bu zhig btsa' bar 'gyur zhing / de ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan gyis 0'di gnyis las gang bzhed pa/ gzhon nu zas gtsang gi chung mar snoms shig /seng ge 'gram gyis slar spring pa/ gnyis ka yang gzhon nu la dgos mod kyi/ 'on kyang chung ma 'dra ba gnyis gcig la gzhag par mi bya bas/gang la skyes bu chen po'i 12mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa'i bu btsa' bar 'gyur zhing phonye/ de yang 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung 72—291
