ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /skye dang 'jig pa mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /tshor ba zad pa ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson 6)pa gang yin pas/ /tshor ba zad pa mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /zag pa zad pa ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /zag pa zad pa mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /go 'phang mi g.yo ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /go 'phang mi g.yo mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /go 'phang blta dka' ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /go 'phang blta dka' (snyemathong ba dag(mi /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson ④pa rung / /go 'phang mthon po ma (5)mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /go 'phang mthon po 4)mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /go 'phang dam pa ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /go 'phang dam pa ⑦mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung /ni /'chi med go 'phang ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar 6stegason pa gang yin pas/ /'chi med go 'phang mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /bdud rtsi'i go 'phang ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /bdud rtsi'i go 'phang mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /rdul med go 'phang ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /rdul med go 'phang mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /rdul bral go 'phang ma mthong ba/ /lo brgyar gson pa gang yin pas/ /rdul bral go 'phang mthong ba dag /nyin zhag 'ga' zhig gson pa rung / /mi ni lo brgyar nags tshal na/ /me la yongs 72—652

sten gang yin dang / /bdag nyid bsgom 0)la yud tsam zhig /mchod pa byed pa gang yin pa/ /mchod byed de nyid ches ⑤rung gi/ /lo brgyar (misbyin sreg ༅byed mi rung / /zla ba re rer ⑤ku sha'i rtses/ /kha zas za ba gang yin des/ /sangs rgyas la ni dad pa yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod (7do/ /zla ba re rer ⑦ku sha'i rtses / /kha zas za ba gang yin des/ /dam pa'i chos la dad pa yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer ku ②sha'i rtses/ /kha zas za ba gang yin des / /dge 'dun la ni dad pa yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer ku ①sha'i rtses/ /kha zas za ba gang yin des/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer 7ku sha'i rtses/ /kha zas za ba gang yin des/ /srog chags rnams la snying brtse (1ba'i bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer tsoku sha'i rtses/ /kha zas za ba gang yin des/ /'byung po rnams la snying brtse ba'i/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do//zla ba re rer ku 8sha'i rtses/ /kha yizas za ba gang yin des/ /byams par skisems par byed pa yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer ku sha'i rtses / /kha zas za ba gang yin des/ /legs par gsungs pa'i dam chos kyi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ /sangs rgyas la ni dad pa yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ /dam pa'i chos la dad pa yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ /dge 'dun la ni dad pa yi / /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo 72—653

brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ / srog chags 6)rnams la snying brtse ba'i/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ /'byung po rnams la snying brtse ba'i/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ /byams par ②sems par byed pa yi / /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zla ba re rer mchod sbyin stong / /lo brgyar byed pa gang yin des/ /legs par gsungs pa'i dam chos kyi / /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /bsod nams 'dod pa'i mi yis 'jig rten du/ /sbyin sreg tsunamachod sbyin chung zad ci byas des/ /gang zhig drang po'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal ba/ /de yi bzhi char yang ni mi phod do/ /bsgre ba'i tshoms te nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// // ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/ bam po gsum pa/ dad pa med cing 'jungs pa dang / /dbyen byed phra ma can dag dang / /mkhas pas bshes (snyepar mi bya zhing / /sdig can mi dang 'grogs mi bya/ /dad ldan snyan par smra ba dang / /thos mang (6)tshul khrims ldan pa dang / /mkhas pa yis ni mdza' bya zhing / /mi mchog dag dang (pe'agrogs par bya/ /sdig pa'i grogs po mi bsten cing / /skyes bu ngan pa bsten mi bya/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten bya zhing / /skyes bu dam pa bsten par bya/ /de lta bu dag bsten byas na/ /sdig par mi 'gyur legs par 'gyur/ /gang dag thos mang 9sheganas mang po)sems pa dang / /dad 72—654

dang shes rab ldan de mi yis bsten/ /'dir ni de yis legs smras mnyan byas na / /ring po nas kyang khyad par thob par 'gyur/ /dman pa bsten pas mi dag nyams 'gyur zhing / /thad kur bab pa bsten pas so na gnas/ /gtso bo bsten pas dam pa 'thob 'gyur bas07/ /de phyir bdag pas gtsor gyur bsten par bya/ /tshul khrims nye bar zhi ba dang / /shes rab ches mchog ldan pa yi/ /gtso bo gang yin de bsten na/ /gtso bo bas kyang ches gtsor 'gyur/ /mi yis 'di na nya ①rul la/ /ku sha'i gtsang byed bcings pa gang / /ku sha nyid kyang rul 'gyur ba/ /sdig pa bsten pa'ang de bzhin 'gyur/ /mi yis rgya spos pa la sha'i / /lo mar phur ma byas pa gang / /lo ma nyid kyang dri zhim pa/ /dam pa bsten ①pa'ang de bzhin 'gyur/ /gal te sdig pa byed pa dag /sdig mi byed pas bsten na yang / /sdig pa byed par dogs skye zhing / /mi snyan pa yang 'phel bar 'gyur/ /bsten bya ma yin bsten pa'i mi/ /de yi skyon gyis skyon can 'gyur/ /dong par dug bskus mda' bcug pas/ /dug ma bskus (sku)pa'ang gos pa bzhin/ /brten (9pa skyon gos 'jigs pa dag /sdig pa can dang bshes mi bya/ /ji ltar grogs po bsten 96 pa dang / /ji ltar nye bar bsten byas pa/ /bsten bya de ni ci 'dra bar/ /ring po mi thogs de 'drar 'gyur/ /de bas 'bras bu'i snod bzhin du/ /bdag gis bsten pa shes pa yis/ /dam pa ma yin mi bsten cing / /mkhas pas dam pa bsten byas la/ /dge slong de'i lam rjes 'brang na/ /sdug bsngal zad pa thob par na'agyur/ /byis pas ji srid gson bar du/ /gal te mkhas pa bsten byas kyang / /de yis chos shes mi 'gyur te/ /gzar bus tshod ma'i ro bzhin no/ /shes rab ldan pas yud tsam 72—655

zhig /mkhas pa nye bar bsten pas kyang / /de yis chos rnams shes 'gyur te/ /lce yis tshod ma'i ro bzhin no/ /byis pas ji srid gson bar du/ /gal te mkhas pa bsten byas kyang 6)/ /de la mig ni med pa'i phyir/ /chos rnams shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /shes rab ldan pas yud tsam zhig /mkhas pa nye bar bsten pas kyang / /de la mig ni yod pa'i phyir/ /chos rnams rab tu shes par 'gyur / /byis pas ji srid gson bar du/ /gal te mkhas pa bsten byas kyang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis ②bstan pa yi/ /chos rnams de yis shes mi 'gyur / /shes rab ldan pas yud tsam zhig /mkhas pa nye bar bsten pas kyang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis ①bstan pa yi/ /chos rnams de yis shes par 'gyur / /don ldan tshig ni gcig gis kyang / /mkhas pa yi ni bya ba byed/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gis kyang / /byis pa'i bya ba byed mi 'gyur/ /blo dang ldan pa tshig gcig gis/ /tshig brgya dag ni shes par 'gyur/ /byis pa la ni tshig stong gis/ /tshig gcig shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /nyis ④na mkhas dang mi mdza' sla'i⑤/ /byis pa rnams dang mdza' mi rung / /byis pa rnams dang mdza' byed pa/ /sems can dmyal bar khrid par byed/ /byis pa gang zhig byis pa'o zhes/ /shes pa de 'dir mkhas pa yin/ /byis pa gang zhig mkhas sems pa / /de ni byis pa zhes brjod do/ /byis pas bstod pa gang yin dang / /mkhas pas smad pa gang yin las/ /mkhas pas smad pa ches rung gisaX/ /byis pas bstod pa mi rung ngo / /byis pa bsten pa sdug bsngal zhing / /rnam pa kun du dgra 'dra bas/ /byis pa mi thos mi mthong zhing / /ma bsten gyur pa nyid rung ngo / /gnyen dang phrad pa ji ⑦lta bar/ /brtan pa bsten na 72—656

bde bar 'gyur/ /de bas rgyu skar lam du zla ba ltar/ /brtan zhing thos mang mchog 'dren byed pa dang / /tshul khrims ldan dang 'phags pa'i brtul zhugs can / /mi mchog brtse ldan blo bzangs 6)bsten par gyis/ /mdza' bshes kyi tshoms te nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //ru ①sbal rang gi khog par yan lag ltar/ /dge slong yid kyi rnam rtog nang bsdus nas/ /rten pa med cing gzhan la 'tshe med par/ /mya ngan 'das la su yang smod mi byed/ /bzod pa dka' thub mchog ste bzod pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsung / /rab tu byung ba gzhan la 'tshe skyib dang rjo/ /gzhan la gnod pas dge sbyong ma yin no/ /tshig rtsub ci yang smra mi bya / /smras na slar yang smra bar byed/ /'thab gcugs ④tshig gis sdug bsngal zhing ske/ /de la phyir yang chad pas gcod/ /gal te bdag gis phar byas na/ /'khar ⑥ba'i snod la brdungs pa bzhin/ /'khor bar skye dang rga ba dag /yun ring nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis phar ni ma byas dang / /'khar ⑦ba'i snod la ma brdungs ltar/ /'di ltar 'thab (kyemo mi 'byung 6)zhing / /mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur/ /nad med rnyed ⑩pa'i dam pa ste/ /chog shes pa ni nor gyi dbyig /yid gcugs bshes 7pa'i mchog yin te/ /mya ngan 'das pa bde ba'i phul/ /'du byed sdug bsngal ma rungs pa/ /nad kyi nang na bkres mi bzad / /de ltar ji bzhin shes na ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /bde 'gror 'gro ba nyung zad de/ /ngan 'gror 'gro ba bsam 8yas shig /de lta'i nyes dmigs rtogs gyur na/ /myur du mya ngan 'das pa 'thob/ /bde 72—657

'gror 'gro ba rgyu dang bcas/ /ngan 'gror 'gro ba rgyu dang ldan/ /mya ngan 'das 'gro rgyu can te/ /de dag 6)thams cad rgyu (snyedang bcas/ /nags tshal mchog tu ri dgas 55)'gro/ /mkha' la bya rnams 'gro bar byed/ /chos la rnam par bsgoms 'gro ste/ /dgra bcom mya ngan 'das par 'gro/ /'di na brtson 'grus zhan 4)pa dang / /blo chung shes pa med pa yis/ /mdud pa thams cad rab gtubs pa'i/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ /khyod kyis gru 'di'i chu phyags (5 dang / /'di ni yang bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin zhe sdang 'dod chags spongs56ri/ /de nas mya ngan 'das pa 'thob/ /sngon chad byung ba mi 'byung zhing / /ma byung ba dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur la/ /da ltar byung ba'ang yod ma yin/ /blta dka' mtha' med der ⑦mi mthong / /bden pa rab rtogs shes pa dang / /sred dang dga' dub med mthong ba/ /'di 'dra 'di ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /sred (9dpa rnams ni bcad pa dang / /'dod chags rab tu spangs pa dang / /mtsho bskams nas ni mi 'bab pa/ /'di 'dra 'di ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /lus zhig tshor ba bsil bar gyur/ /'du shes 'gags shing tsha'adu byed zhi/ /rnam par shes pa nub gyur pa/ /'di 'dra 'di ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /lta bas mthong bar gyur tsam dang / /nyan pas thos par gyur pa tsam/ /rtogs par byed pas rtogs tsam dang / /rnam par shes pas rnam shes tsam/ /'di 'dra 'di ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /'di dang ma dang gdungs rab gdungs/ /'di 'dra 'di ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /ma re ma dga' rab zhi dang / /kun du 'dod chags bral gyur pa7/ /'di 'dra 'di ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /rten pa yod pas spyod par 'gyur ro/ /spyod pa 72—658

yod pas gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhol ba yod pas shin tu ma sbyangs par 'gyur ro/ /shin tu ma sbyangs pa yod pas 'gro ba dang 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba dang 'ong ba yod pas gzhan du shi 'pho len par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan du shi 'pho blangs pas 'di ltar gzhan du skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang /'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang /yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa 'byung zhing 'di ltar sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig 6)po 'di 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rten pa med pas spyod pa med par 'gyur ro/ /spyod pa med pas gzhol bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhol bar ma gyur pas shin tu sbyangs par 'gyur ro/ /shin tu sbyangs pas 'gro ba dang 'ong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba dang 'ong ba med pas gzhan du 'chi 'pho len pa med par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan du 'chi 'pho len pa med pas 'di ltar gzhan du skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug (57pa rnams 'gag par 'gyur zhing / 'di ltar sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig ①po 'di 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag ma skyes pa dang / ma byung ba dang / ma bcos pa dang / 'dus ma byas pa dang / mi 'byung ba yod do/ /skye ba dang / 'byung ba dang / bcos ma dang / sems pas byas pa dang /'dus byas dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yod do/ /dge slong dag gal te ma skyes pa dang / ma byung ba dang / ma bcos pa dang / 'dus ma byas pa dang / mi 'byung ba med du zin na0/ skye ba dang / 'byung ba dang /bcos ma dang / 'dus byas dang / sems pas byas pa dang / rten cing 72—659

'brel bar 'byung ba'i nges par 'byung ba yod do zhes nga mi smra'o/ /dge slong dag gang gi phyir 'di na ma skyes pa dang / ma byung ba dang / ma bcos pa dang /'dus ma byas pa dang / mi 'byung ba yod pa de'i phyir/ skye ba dang / 'byung ba dang / bcos ma dang / 'dus byas dang / sems pas byas pa dang /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i nges par 'byung ba yod do zhes nga smra'o/ /skyes dang byung dang 'byung ba dang / /bcos dang 'dus byas mi brtan 0)zhing / /rga dang 'chi dang rmongs pa yi/ /chos can rab tu 'jig 'gyur ba/ /zas kyi rgyud las byung ba yi/ /'jig 'gyur 'di la dga' mi bya/ /de yi nges par 'byung ②ba'i gzhi/ /rtog dang dpyod nidang zhi ba dang / /sdug bsngal chos rnams 'gags ④pa ste/ /'du byed nye bar zhi ba bde/ /dge slong dag de ni gang du yang ⑤gnas par mi 'gyur te/ sa la gnas par mi 'gyuradu/ chu la ma yin/me la ma yin/ rlung la ma yin/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la ma yin/rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la ma yin/ ci yang tshumed pa'i skye mched la ma yin / 'du shes yod min med min skye mched la ma yin/ 'jig rten 'di la ma yin/ 'jig rten pha rol la ma yin/ nyi ma dang zla ba gnyis la gnas pa ma yin te/ 'di la dmigs pa med par ngas mngon par shes so/ /dge slong dag de la 'gro ba dang 'ong ba yod par nga mi smra ste/ gnas par ma yin no/ /'chi 'pho yod par nga mi smra ste/ skye bar ma yin/ 'di lta bu 'di ni sdug bsngal gyi mtha' yin no/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /gang la'ang gnas pa ma yin pa/ /de la dkar pos gsal mi byed/ /de la mun pa'ang yod ma yin/ /de la zla bas snang mi byed/ /de la nyi mas mngon mi byed/ /thub pa bram ze gang 72—660

yin pa/ /des ni rang gis ①rig pa yin/ /de ni gzugs dang gzugs med dang —/ /sdug bsngal kun las rab tu grol/ /mthar phyin 'jigs pa med pa ste//rlom med ②'gyod pa med pa yin/ /srid pa'i zug rngu gtubs ①pa ste/ /lus kyi tha mar gyur pa yin/ /'di ni mthar phyin rnams kyi mchog /zhi ba'i go 'phang bla med pa/ /mtshan ma thams cad zad pa ste/ /byang grol go 'phang 'chi med yin / /mtshungs dang mi mtshungs 'byung ba yi/ /'du byed thub pas rab tu spangs / /nang du mnyam bzhag ④dga' ba yis/ /sgo nga'i sbubs ni dral nas byung ske/ /sbyin kun chos kyi sbyin pas thub/ /dga' kun chos kyi dga' bas thub//stobs kun bzod pa'i stobs kyis thub/ /bde kun srid ⑤pa zad ⑥pas thub/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshoms te nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //bdag las gzhan pa'i skyon dag ⑦ni/ /phub ⑧ma gtor ba ji bzhin du/ /gzhan gyi skyon mthong sla ba stekhyi/ /rang gi skyon ni mthong bar dka'/ /g.yo ⑩can cho lo 'jo ba ltar/ /rang gi de ni sbed pa dang / /gzhan gyi skyon la lta byed cing ske/ /rtag tu 'phyas lang ⑩'du shes can/ /de yis ring du chos mi mthong / /g.yon phyogs chos ni rab tu 'phel/ /spyi rdol byed cing 'phrog rlom can/ /mi gtsang las ldan khwa lta bur8/ /shin tu nyon mongs 'tsho ba can/ /ngo tsha med pa'i 'tsho ba sla/ /rtag tu gtsang ma tshol ba dang / /thub chod 8mi byed 'dzem bag can/ /'tsho ba dag pa lta ba yi/ /ngo tsha shes pa'i 'tsho ba dka'/ /'jig rten mun par gyur 'di ste/ /de las lhag mthong ldan pa nyung / /rgya las shor ba'i bya lta bur/ /mtho ris la dga' shas tsam zhig /byis pa lus kyis 72—661

bcings gyur pa6)/ /mun pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba yin/ /'jig rten nor la chags pa dag /gzhan rdzas lta bur lta bar byed/ /bdag gis skye dgu 'di phyung zhing / /gzhan gyis byas so snyam sems pa/ /bden pa min la bden lta bas / /ci yang mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ / de ni phyi'ags kyang ①mi mthong zhing //zug rngu mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yul sred gang la skye bo chags pa yi/ /zug rngu de dag sngon chad mthong ba dag /de ni bdag gis byas snyam mi 'dzin cing / /de ni gzhan gyis byas ④snyam mi 'dzin to/ /skye dgu 'di dag nga rgyal ldan/ /nga rgyal la chags nga rgyal bcings/ /rtsod par gyur pa'i lta ba can/ /'khor ba ldog par mi 'gyur ro/ /thob par gyur pa gang yin dang / /thob par bya ba gang yin pa/ /de dag gnyi ga (5)rdul gyis yog /rjes su nad ①pa slob par byed / /gang zhig tshul khrims dang / bslab pa dang / brtul zhugs dang /tshangs par spyod pa dang / dka' thub dang / nye bar gnas pa snying por byed pa de ni mtha' gcig go/ /gang zhig de ltar lta zhing 'di skad ces 'dod pa ni gtsang ba'o/ /'dod pa ni bsod nyams can no/ /'dod pa ni longs spyad par bya ba'o/ /'dod pa ni skyon med pa yin no zhes smra zhing de dag lhag par 'dod pa rnams su lhung bar byed pa'i brtul zhugs len pa 'di yang ⑦mtha' gcig go/ /mtha' gnyis po 'di dag ni dur khrod 'phel bar byed pa ste/'di dag gis dur khrod 'phel bar byas so/ /mtha' gnyis po 'di dag ma mthong ba kha cig zhen par byed cing / kha cig mngon par rgyug par byed la/de dag lhag par zhen par byed cing lhag par rgyug par byed pa dag mig dang ldan pas mthong ngo / /mtha' gnyis po 'di dag mthong ba na zhen par mi byed rgyug 72—662

par mi byed la/ de dag lhag par zhen par mi byed cing lhag par rgyug par mi byed pa yang ①mig dang ldan pas mthong ngo / /de dag de ltar mi byed cing de dag de ltar mi sems na/ de dag gi lam du mi gdags pa 'di lta ste ②'di ni sdug bsngal gyi mtha' yin nino/ /ji ltar chu bur mthong ba dang / /ji ltar smig ④rgyu mthong ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'jig rten lta byed pa/ /'chi bdag rgyal pos mthong mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar chu bur mthong ba dang / /ji ltar smig rgyu mthong ba ltar / /de bzhin lus la lta byed pa/ /'chi bdag rgyal pos mthong mi 'gyur/ /gang la byis pa mngon chags pa/ /de la mkhas pa chags mi 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i shing rta bkra ba ltar⑤/ /lus 'di rtag tu blta bar gyis/ /gang la byis pa rmongs 'gyur ba/ /de la mkhas pa rmongs mi 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i shing rta bkra ba ltar / /lus 'di rtag tu blta bar gyis/ /gang du byis pa nyams gyur pa/ /glang rgan rdzab tu chud pa bzhin/ /rgyal po'i shing rta bkra ba ltar⑥/ /lus 'di rtag tu blta bar gyis/ /nad ⑦pa lta bur 'jig chos can/ /rma byung ba dang 'dra ba ste/ /gang yang brtan (nyapar mi gnas pa/ /lus 'di rtag tu blta bar gyis / /nad pa 'jig pa'i chos can ltar/ /gang 6)yang brtan par mi gnas par / /nor bu'i rna cha gdub 'khor gyis/ /brgyan pa'i lus la blta bar gyis/ /skra ni lan bu brgyad byas shing / /mig sman gyis ni bskus pa'i mig /byis pa lhag par rmongs byed kyang / /pha rol tshol bar mi byed do/ /mig sman gyis ni gsar bris shing / /rnag can lus ni brgyan pa yis/ /byis pa lhag par rmongs byed kyang / /pha rol tshol bar mi byed do/ /lus ni ⑨dri zhim gyis bskus nas/ /rkang pa btsag gis byugs pa dag /byis pa lhag par rmongs byed kyang / /pha 72—663

rol tshol bar mi byed do/ /gang zhig 'dod par kun sbyor 'brel chags shing / /kun du sbyor ba'i skyon rnams ma mthong ba/ /'dod par 'brel la chags pa'i mi de yis/ /chu bo mtha' yas yangs pa rgal mi 'gyur/ /chags bral mchog dang tha ma thams cad dag /'di la bdag dang bdag gir mi lta zhing / /de ltar rnam grol sngon chad ma rgal 0)ba'i/ /chu bo rab rgal ②yang srid med par 'gyur/ /gang zhig tshal spangs tshal med pa/ /nags tshal spangs nas nags su rgyug /grol ba 'ching bar gcen pa yin/ /gang zag 'di la ltos shig tshur/ /shing rta 'thun ①pa'i rtsibs ldan pa/ /yan lag yid 'ong gos dkar g.yogs/ /sdig med 'gro ba la ltos la/ /ching ④ma'i rgyun rnams bcad ⑤par gyis/ /'jigs pas skrag pa'i mi dag ni/ /phal cher ri dang skyonags tshal dang / /skyed ⑦mos tshal dang mchod gnas dang / /ljon shing rnams la skyabs su 'gro/ /skyabs de gtso bo ma yin zhing / /skyabs de mchog tu gyur pa min/ /de la skyabs su song ba yis/ /sdug bsngal kun las grol mi 'gyur/ /gang —zhig sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun la ni skyabs song zhing / /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal kun 'byung dang / /sdug bsngal yang dag 'das pa dang / /bde ba mya ngan 'das 'gro ba'i/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad pa ste/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag /gang tshe shes rab kyis mthong ba/ /de ni skyabs kyi mchog yin zhing / /de ni skyabs kyi dam pa yin/ /de la skyabs su song ba yis/ /sdug bsngal kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /mthong bas mthong zhing mthong bas ma mthong mthong / /ma mthong mi mthong mthong bya mthong mi 'gyur/ /'dra mthong lhag mthong tha dad dngos por brjod/ /nyin mtshan nam yang lhan cig mi gnas bzhin/ /'dra ba 72—664

mthong bas mthong mi 'gyur/ /gal te mthong na 'dra mi mthong mthong 'dis 'dra ba mi mthong ste/ /'dra mthong mi yis mthong ba med/ /mi yis ci ma mthong na 'dra ba mthong / /ci zhig mthong na 'dra ba mthong mi 'gyur①/ /ji ltar 'di na ②'dra ba mthong ba dag /gang zhig med na 'dra bar mthong dang bral / /gang tshe 'di yis sdug bsngal ma mthong ba/ /de yi tshe na bdag tu mthong bar 'gyur/ / ji lta ②ji ltar sdug bsngal rtogs gyur pa/ /des ni bdag 'di 'dra ba mthong mi 'gyur/ /gang gis so so'i skye bsgribs na/ /'du byed sdug bsngal ma mthong ba/ /de phyir 'di na 'dra mthong ste/ /de med 'dra ba mi mthong ngo ske/ /mthong ba'i tshoms te nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //sdig pa thams cad mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par bya rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /sbyin pas bsod nams rab tu 'phel/ /legs bsdams dgra sogs ④mi 'gyur ro/ /dge dang ldan pas sdig pa spong / /nyon mongs zad pas (nyemya ngan 'da'/ /mkhas dang 'dre dang byis pa'i skye bo dang / /lhan cig spyod dang gcig pu ⑥gnas kyang rung / /ngang pas chu la ⑦'o ma 'thung ba ltar/ /mkhas pas sdig pa can rnams rab tu spang ⑧/ /'jig rten nyes dmigs mthong ba dang / /'gog par 'gyur ba'i chos mthong bas/ /'phags pa sdig la dga' khyimi byed/ /sdig can dge la dga' mi 'gyur/ /legs par nyer zhi'i ro dang ni/ /rab tu dben pa'i ro shes pa/ /rims nad med cing sdig med la/ /chos la dga' ba'i ro dag 'thung / /sems kyi zag pa med pa dang / /sems ni 'ching bas 72—665

ma bcom hu)la/ /dge dang sdig pa rab spangs pa/ /ngan 'gro rnams kyis 'jigs pa med/ /gnas min zlog dang legs smra dang / /nyes dmigs ston par byed pa dang / /mkhas pas tshar gcod smra byed pa/ /de lta'i skye dgu bsten par bya/ /de lta bu dag bsten byas na/ /sdig par mi 'gyur legs par 'gyur//nye bar zhi zhing rab zhi la/ /dal bus smra zhing khengs med pa/ /sdig pa'i chos rnams sprug byed de/ /rlung gis ljon shing lo ma bzhin/ /gang zhig ②skyes bu dag cing nyon mongs med/ /rab tu sdang med mi la khro byed pa'i/ /byis pa de la sdig pa phyir 'gog ste/ /rdzi phyogs su ni rdul rnams gtor ba bzhin/ /dge ba byed pas dge ba dang / /sdig pa byed pas sdig pa ste/ /mi yis gang dang gang byas pa/ /de de rang gis mthong bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis sdig pa byas na ni / /de bdag (kyikho na kun nyon mongs/ /bdag gis sdig pa ma byas na/ /bdag nyid kho na rnam par dag /gzhan gyis gzhan spyod mi byed kyi/ /dag dang ma dag rang rang byed/ /bdag nyid kyis ni sdig pa dag /byas shing nye bar bsags pa yis/ /bsam brlag mngone du 'joms par byed/ /rdo rjes nor bu 'bigs pa bzhin/ /mig ldan 'gro bar byed pa yis/ /nyam nga'i lam dag ji lta bar/ /mkhas pas 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /sdig pa dag ni yongs su spang / /nor chen gyis ni grogs nyung dang / /tshong pas 'jigs bcas ④lam dang ni/ /gson par 'dod pas dug lta bur/ /mkhas pas sdig can yongs su spang / /gal te lag mthil rma med na/ /lag pas dug ni bzung byas kyang / /rma med dug ni mi 'jen ⑤ltar/ /ma byas pa la sdig pa med/ /bdag la mi phan bya ba dang / /legs pa (5)ma yin bya bar sla/ /gang dag phan 72—666

zhing bder 'gyur ba/ /de ni mchog tu bya bar dka'0)/ /dam pas legs pa bya sla yi/ /dam pas sdig pa bya bar dka'/ /ngan pas sdig pa bya sla yi/ /'phags pas sdig pa bya bar dka'/ /ji srid sdig pa ma smin pa/ /de srid byis pa mngar bar sems/ /gang tshe sdig pa smin gyur pa/ /de tshe de ni tsha bar sems / /ji srid sdig pa ma smin pa/ /de srid sdig pa (mirung bar lta/ /gang tshe sdig pa smin gyur pa/ /de tshe sdig pa ①mthong bar 'gyur/ /ji srid bzang po ma smin pa/ /de srid bzang po sdig par mthong / /gang tshe bzang po smin gyur pa/ /de tshe bzang por mthong bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa sdug bsngal sogs ④pas na/ /de la dga' bar mi bya'o/ /brgya la sdig pa byas na yang / /yang dang yang du de mi byal/ /bsod nams bde ba sogs (9pas na/ /de nyid la ni dga' bar bya/ /gal te bsod nams byas na yang / /de ni yang dang yang du bya/ /sdig la yid ni mngon dga' ba/ /bsod nams dal bus byed 'gyur bas/ /sdig pa las ni sems bzlog yicing / /bsod nams mngon par sgyur te bya/ /sdig pa chung ngu byas pas kyang / /'jig rten pha rol 'jig chen stidang / /phung khrol chen po byed 'gyur te/ /khong par song ba'i dug bzhin no/ /bsod nams chung ngu byas pas kyang / /'jig rten pha rol bde bar (nya'adren/ /don chen dag kyang byed 'gyur te/ /'bru rnams phun sum 'byor ba bzhin/ /gang zhig nyes med chad pas gcod/ /sdang ba min la rab sdang ba/ /gnas gzhan gang yang rung ba bcu/ /myur du thob pa kho nar 'gyur/ /tshor ba mi bzad 6)pa dag gam/ /yang na lus ⑩ni 'dral ba'am/ /gnod pa'i tshor ba tsha ba'ang rung / /yang na sems 'khrugs thob par 'gyur/ /gnyen 'dun rnams dang bral ba 'am /72—667

longs spyod zad par 'gyur ba 'am/ /rgyal po'i gnod pa ①'byung ba 'am/ /mi snyan shin tu mi bzad ②dam/ /yang na khyim ni me chen pos②/ /nges par sreg rjopar byed par 'gyur/ /shes rab 'chal ba lus zhig nas/ /bcu pa ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa byas pas bag dbab mi bya ste/ /ring byas rgyang mar byas kyang bag mi dbab/ /dben par byas kyang bag dbab mi bya ste/ /de yi rnam smin yod pas bag mi dbab/ /bsod nams byas pas bag ni dbab ⑤bya steyi/ /ring byas rgyang ring byas kyang bag dbab cing / /dben par byas kyang bag ni dbab par bya/ /de yi rnam smin yod pas bag dbab bo/ /bdag gis sdig pa byas pas rtsimya ngan byed/ /ring dang rgyang ring byas pas mya ngan byed//bdag gis dben par byas pas mya ngan byed/ /de yi rnam smin yod pas mya ngan byed / /bdag nyid nag po'i las dang ldan mthong nas/ /'dir yang mya ngan gzhan du'ang mya ngan byed/ /sdig pa byas pas gnyi gar ②mya ngan byed/ /de ni mya ngan de rab mya ngan byed/ /bdag gis bsod nams byas pas dga' bar 'gyur / /ring dang rgyang ring byas pas dga' bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis dben par byas pas dga' bar 'gyur/ /de yi rnam smin yod pas dga' bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid rnam dag las dang ldan mthong nas/ /'di na dga' 'gyur gzhan du'ang dga' bar 'gyur/ /bsod nams byas pas gnyi gar khyadaga' 'gyur zhing ske/ /de ni dga' 'gyur de rab dga' bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis sdig pa byas pas gdung 'gyur zhing / /ring byas rgyang ring byas pas gdung bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis dben par byas pas gdung 'gyur zhing / /de yi rnam smin yod pas gdung bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid nag po'i las dngo ldan mthong nas/ /'di na 72—668

gdung 'gyur pha rol gdung bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa byas pas gnyi gar ①gdung 'gyur zhing / /de ni gdung 'gyur de rab gdung bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis bsod nams byas pas dga' 'gyur zhing / /ring byas rgyang ring byas pas dga' bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis dben par byas pas dga' 'gyur zhing / /de yi rnam smin yod pas dga' bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid dkar ①po'i las dang ldan mthong nas/ /'di na dga' 'gyur pha rol dga' bar 'gyur/ /bsod nams byas pas gnyi gar sridaga' 'gyur zhing / /de ni dga' 'gyur de rab dga' bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa byas shing bsod nams ma byas la/ /chos dang gol zhing chos min thob pa'i mi/ /sdig pa'i las can 'chi bas 'jigs 'gyur te/ /chu chen nang du gru ngan zhig pa bzhin/ /bsod nams byas shing sdig pa ma byas la / /dam pa rnams kyi sngon gyi chos spyod ④pas/ /nga ni nams kyang (nya'achi bas 'jigs med de/ / brtan pa'i ⑨gru yis pha rol 'gro ba bzhin/ /sdig pa'i tshoms te nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //ji srid nyi ma ma shar ba/ /de srid srin bu me khyer snang / /nyi ma shar bar gyur pa na/ /snang ba med cing sngon por 'gyur/ /ji srid de bzhin gshegs ma shar / /de srid rtog ge pa rnams snang / /'jig rten rdzogs sangs rgyas shar ba//rtog can nyan thos bcas mi snang / /gces min gces par blos 'dzin cing / /gces la gces pa min rtog pa/ /log par kun rtog tshuspyod yul can/ /des ni gces pa thob mi 'gyur/ /gces pa min la gces min dang / /gces la gces par 'du shes pa/ /legs par kun rtog spyod yul can/ /des ni 72—669

gces pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /'di na lta dang nyan la mngon zhen ①pa'i/ /chings tshim gsar dang gsar du 'phel ba dag /'khor bar rgyug cing 'gro dang sdod 'gyur te/ /me nang lhung ba'i phye ma leb dang 'dra/ /'di la myong 'gyur gzhan la myong 'gyur ba'am/ /'di na the tshom tha dad ji snyed pa/ /de dag tshangs par spyad spyod 'bad pa dang / /sems par byed pas rab tu rnam par spong ske/ /gang zhig snyigs ma yod bzhin du/ /ngur smrig gos ni gyon byed pa/ /dul dang des pa med pa de/ /ngur smrig gyon pa'i 'os ma yin/ /gang zhig snyigs ma rnams ②spangs nas/ /tshul khrims legs par mnyam bzhag ④pa/ /dul dang des par ldan pa de/ /ngur smrig gyon pa'i 'os yin no/ /g.yo sgyu 'jungs dang ldan pa'i mi/ /kha dog dang ni gzugs ldan pa'am/ /yang na smra bar byed tsam gyis/ /pho mchog yin par mi chud do/ /gang zhig chos gsum de dag rnams/ /ta dula'i mgo bo bzhin bcad nas/ /blo ldan skyon ni dubasal ba de / /pho mchog yin par brjod par bya/ /'jig rten 'di na legs par ma bsdams pa/ /phal cher legs bsdams rtags kyis rgyu byed pas/ /legs par ma brtags bar du mi dag gi/ /mdog gzugs lan 'ga' mthong bas yid ⑦ma rton / /ra gan kha bsgyur zhu)lta bur mi 'tsham zhing / /lcags phyed gser gyis g.yogs pa ji lta bur/ /khong pa rab gdug phyi rol 'phags tshul gyis/ /'jig rten 'di na 'khor dang bcas par rgyu/ /gang zhig rde 6)'gengs gnyid ni log pa dang / /nyin dang mtshan du 'gre 0ldog nyal byed pa/ /rdzab nang phag chen lus rgyas 0ji lta bar/ /yang dang yang du smad pa'i mngal du 'jug /mi ni rtag tu dran pa ldan pa dang / /rtag tu kha zas kyi ni tshod shes pa/ /de yi 72—670

sdug bsngal chung bar 'gyur ba dang / /dal bus 'ju bas tshe 6)yang ring bar byed / /gang zhig dbang po ma bsdams shing / /zas kyi tshod ni mi shes la/ /dran pa nyams dang le lo can/ /gtsang bar lta zhing gnas byed pa/ /de ni 'dod chags rnams kyis bcom/ /rlung gis mi brtan ljon shing bzhin/ /gang zhig dbang po legs bsdams shing / /zas kyi tshod ni shes pa dang / /so sor dran zhing brtson 'grus ldan/ /mi gtsang lta bas gnas byed pa/ /de ni 'dod chags kyis mi choms②/ /rlung gis ri bo mi g.yos bzhin/ /dgon pa dga' bar bya 'os pa/ /de la skye bo mi dga' yang / /de la 'dod chags bral ba dga'acha/ /'dod pa tshol bar byed rnams min/ /dgon pa'am yang na grong dag gam / /gshang sringam thang bu dag kyang rung / /gang na 'phags pa bzhugs pa yi / /sa de yid du 'ong ba yin/ /dam pa ring nas snang gyur te/ /gangs can gyi ni ri bo bzhin/ /ngan pa nye yang mi snang ste/ /mun khrod mda' ni 'phangs pa bzhin/ /mkhas pa don sems byed pa yi/ /dam pa nyid dang 'grogs na ni//don chen 'gyur zhing zab mo yi/ /shes rab so sor rtogs par 'gyur/ /gzhu yis mda' 'phangs bsnun pa yi/ /g.yul ngo'i (geglang chen ji bzhin du/ /tshul 'chal skye bo mang po yis/ /mi snyan ⑤smras pa bzod par bya/ /mi gang khyim 'bigs byed pa dang / /dad pa med cing byas mi gzo/ /go skabs bcom dang skyugs pa za/ /de ni skyes bu dam pa yin/ /pha ma dag ni bsad yibyas shing / /rgyal po gtsang sbra can gnyis dang / /yul 'khor 'khor dang bcas bcom na/ /mi ni dag par 'gyur zhes bya/ /gang dag kun tu sogs ④med cing / /gang dag kha zas yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /dben pa nyid 72—671

kyi spyod yul can/ /de dag 'gro ba rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin / /gang dag kun du sogs ①med cing / /gang dag kha zas yongs shes pa / /stong dang ②mtshan ma med pa dang / /dben pa nyid kyi spyod yul can/ /de dag rjes ni rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes ①bzhin/ /gang dag kun du sogs dumed cing / /gang dag kha zas yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /rtag tu bsam gtan spyod yul can/ /de dag 'gro ba rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag kun du sogs dhimed cing / /gang dag kha zas yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang ske/ /rtag tu bsam gtan spyod yul can/ /de dag rjes ni rtogs dka' ste//nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag kun tu sogs dumed cing / /gang dag kha zas yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /dben pa nyid kyi spyod yul can/ /de dag 'gro ba rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin / /gang dag kun du sogs ⑨med cing / /gang dag kha zas yongs shes pa / /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /dben pa nyid kyi spyod yul can/ /de dag rjes ni rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag pha mthar rten med cing / /gang gis zag zad yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /dben pa nyid kyi spyod yul can/ /de dag 'gro ba rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag pha mthar rten med cing ske/ /gang gis zag zad yongs shes pa/ /stong nidang mtshan ma med pa dang //dben pa nyid kyi spyod yul can/ /de dag rjes ni rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag pha mthar rten med cing / /gang gis 72—672

zag zad yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /rtag tu bsam gtan spyod yul can/ /de dag 'gro ba rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag pha mthar rten med cing / /gang gis zag zad yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /rtag tu bsam gtan spyod yul can / /de dag rjes ni rtogs ①dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag pha mthar rten med cing / /gang gis zag zad yongs shes pa/ /stong ②dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /rtag tu bsam gtan spyod yul can/ /de dag 'gro ba rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /gang dag pha mthar rten med cing / /gang gis zag zad yongs shes pa/ /stong dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /rtag tu bsam gtan spyod yul canani/ /de dag rjes ni rtogs dka' ste/ /nam mkha' la ni bya rjes bzhin/ /skye dgu phal pa 'di dag ni / /pha mtha' nyid du rgyug byed pas/ /gang dag pha rol 'gro byed pa'i/ /mi yi skye bo de dag nyung / /gang dag legs par gsungs pa yi/ chos la chos kyi rjes lta bas/ /skye bo ④de dag skye shi yi/ /mtsho chen rgal dka'i pha rol 'gro/ /skyob pa rab tu rnam grol zhing / /dus 'das mya ngan bral ba dang / /mdud pa thams cad spangs pa ⑤la/ /yongs su gdung ba yod mi 'gyur/ /'jigs dang bcas pa'i lam rgal ducing / /g.yang sa yongs su spongs ⑦pa dang / /sbyor dang mdud pa las grol bas/ /'dod chags kyi ni dug kun bcom/ /'dod pa lta bu'i 'dam rdzob med/ /zhe sdang lta bu'i gnod med do/ /gti mug lta bu'i rgya med de/ /sred pa lta bu'i chu klung med/ /nam mkha' la ni rjes lta bur/ /phyi rol pa la dge sbyong med/ /byis pa spros la mngon par dga'/ /de bzhin 72—673

gshegs la (1)spros mi mnga'/ /sbyor bas byis pa khrid pa'i phyir/ /mkhas pa ⑤sbyor ba 'joms par byed/ /mkhas pa lha dang mi dag gi①/ /sbyor ba gang yin 'joms byed pa/ /sbyor ba kun dang bral ba'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /sbyor ba las ni srid pa 'byung ④/ /sbyor ba med pas srid pa zad / /srid pa dang ni srid med pa'i/ /lam 'di gnyis ni shes gyis la/ /sbyor las (5)rab tu 'da' bya'i phyir/ /mkhas pas de la bslab par gyis/ /nyes par spyad pa byas pas gdung 'gyur zhing / /ngan 'gror song ba'i 'og tu'ang gdung bar 'gyur/ /legs par spyad pa byas pas dga' 'gyur zhing / /bde 'gror song ba'i 'og tu'ang dga' bar 'gyur/ /phyi nas gdung 'gyur de byed pas / /gnyis (6)na nyes spyad ma byas bsti/ /gdung bar mi 'gyur de bya ste/ /legs par spyad pa byas na rung / /mkhas dang byis pa 'dres pa las/ /ma smras shes par mi 'gyur bas/ /zhi ba'i go 'phang smros shig dang / /smras pa yis ni shes par 'gyur/ /legs bshad drang srong rgyal mtshan te(nya/ /drang srong rgyal mtshan chos yin pas/ /chos ni bshad pas gsal bya zhing / /drang srong rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar gyis/ /ma smras na yang smod byed cing / /mang du smras na smod par byed/ /dal bus smras kyang smod byed de/ /'jig rten na ni mi smad med/ /gcig tu smad par bya ba dang / /gcig tu bstod par bya ba'i mi/ /da ①ltar yod pa ma yin te/ /byung tshubar ma gyur 'byung mi 'gyur/ /gang dag la ni gnas pa'i spros med cing / /gang dag kun sbyor gdung las rab log pa/ /thub pa srid 47bral de dag rgyu mdzad kyang / /lhar bcas 'jig rten rnams kyis mi shes so/ /gang gis dad 8dang tshul khrims dang / /blo la phan ⑩ni ma byung 72—674

bar / /ji lta ji ltar rtogs gyur pa'i/ /shes pa can dag stod 6)byed de/ /de dag sus kyang smad 'os min/ / 'dzam bu'i (7gling gi gser rgyan bzhin/ /ji ltar ri dang brag dag ni/ /rlung gis g.yos par mi 'gyur ltar/ /de bzhin bstod dang smad pa yis/ /mkhas pa rab tu g.yo ba med/ /sa la gang gi rtswa med pa/ /lo med lcug phran ga la yod/ /'ching ba las grol brtan pa de'i/ /ji ga sus kyang smad 'os min/ /gang zhig rgyal las mi nyams shing / /'jig rten ma rgyal chung ⑧zad med/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul mtha' yas de/ /'gro med gom pa gang gis bkridhi/ /gang zhig rgyal las mi nyams shing / /'jig rten ma rgyal chung ⑧zad med/ /sangs rgyas mthu rtsal mtha' yas de/ /'gro med gom pa gang gis bkridhi/ /gang la 'khrid ⑦byed srid 6)pa ni/ /yul sred 'dra ba 'ga' pomed pa/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul mtha' yas de/ /'gro med gom pa gang gis bkri0la/ /gang la 'khrid 0byed srid 7pa ni/ /yul srid 'dra ba 'ga' 4)med pa//sangs rgyas mthu rtsal mtha' yas de/ /'gro med gom pa gang gis bkrim/ /gang zhig rnam par rtog pa rnam bsal cing / /nang gi kun la rnam par rtog med pa/ /kun du sbyor dang gzugs dang 'du shes 'das/ /rnal 'byor bzhi dang bral la ⑫skye ba med/ /sngon bral phyi ma dang bral zhing / /dbus bral srid pa'i pha rol phyin / /rnam pa kun las sems grol ba/ /skye rga phyi ma 'dren mi 'gyur/ /phrugs kyi tshoms te nyi shu yidagu pa'o// //rgyal ba las ni 'khon 'byung ⑩zhing / /pha rol pham pa sdug bsngal 'thob/ /rgyal dang pha rol pham spangs na/ /nye bar zhi ba'i bde ba 'thob/ /gzhan la 72—675

sdug bsngal bskyed pa yis/ /gang zhig bdag ni bde 'dod pa/ /dgra dang mi 'bral 'grogs pa dang / /de ni sdug bsngal las mi 'grol/ /bde ba 'dod phyir 'byung po la/ /gang zhig 'tshe zhing chad pas gcod/ /bdag gi bde ba 'dod pa de/ /pha rol du ni bde mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig bde ba 'dod pa dag /'byung po la ni mi 'tshe zhing / /chad pas mi gcod ①bde 'dod pa/ /de dag pha rol bde ba 'thob/ /chos spyod legs par spyad bya zhing / /nyes par spyad pa de mi spyad②/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /chos spyad pas ni bde ba 'thob/ /chos la legs spyad ①bde skyed pas/ /chos spyod chos kyis bsrung bar bya/ /chos spyod ngan 'gror mi 'gro ba/ /chos la legs spyod phan yon ④de'o/ /yangs pa'i gdugs kyis dbyar ka ⑤ltar/ /chos spyod chos kyis bsrung bar ⑥bya/ /chos spyod ngan 'gror mi 'gro ba/ /chos la legs spyod phan yon ⑦de'o/ /bag med mi yis chos min spyad na ni/ /'gro ba gang yang rung ba ngan 'gror 'gro/ /'di na sbrul nag rked nas bzung ba ltar/ /chos min spyod pa de dag rlag ⑧par 'gyur / /chos dang chos min gnyi ga yipo)/ /rnam smin 'dra bar mi 'gyur te/ /chos ma yin pas dmyal bar 'gro/ /chos kyis bde 'gro thob par byed/ /sbyin pa byed pa'i dus dang g.yul 'gyed dus/ /rgyu yis yongs su bzung bar 'dra bas na/ /sbyin pa byed dang g.yul 'gyed 'dra zhes gsungs/ /yon tan de gnyis mi ngan rten mi byed/ /shin tu legs par chas ⑩pa gcig pus kyang / /legs par ma chas 'phyes ⑩las rgyal byed ltar/ /gal te dad tsobaskyed 8chung ngu byin pas kyang / /des ni de dag gzhan du bde bar 'gyur/ /'di na lan brgyar g.yul zlog dpa' bo bas/ /ser sna dgrar gyur zil gyis mnan nas su/ /72—676

gang zhig chags med sems kyis sbyin byed pa/ /de dag ches dpa' yin par ngas gsungs so/ /bsod nams rnam smin bde ba ste/ /mngon par bsams pa 'byor bar byed/ /myur du zhi ba dam pa yi/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur / /bsod nams byed pa rnams la ni/ /gzhan las byung ba'i gnod pa dang ske/ /lha dang bdud kyi ris rnams kyis/ /bar chad bya bar mi nus so/ /gal te sdug bsngal zad bya'i phyir/ /'phags dang shes rab gtong ldan la/ /de yis 'bad rtsol ①byas na ni/ /lhag mthong gis ni reg par 'gyur/ /sems ni rab tu rnam dang bas/ /chos la dga' byed bde ba 'thob/ /'phags pas gsungs pa'i chos dag la/ /mkhas pa rtag tu dga' bar byed/ /gang dag sems ni bsam gtan dga'/ /gang zhig skye med dga' ba dang / /dran pa nye bar gzhag bzhi dang / /byang chub yan lag bdun dag dang / /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi rnams dang / /yan lag brgyad lam gang dga' ba/ /de dag chos gos 'chang ba dang / /bsod snyoms bde bar za bar byed/ /de dag ri dang nags tshal na/ /bde bar 'chag par byed pa dang / /de dag bde 'thob bde bar ni / /mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan 'da'/ /'khon sridang 'jigs pa kun 'das shing ③/ /'jig rten yul gyi srid ④las rgal/ /chos thos pa dang mthong ba dang —/ /dben par dga' ba bde ba ste/ /'jig rten srog chags 'byung po la//'tshe med yang dag sdom pa bde/ /'dod pa rnams las rab 'das shing / /'jig rten 'dod chags bral ba bde/ /nga'o snyam pa'i rgyang rgyal dag /btul ba de dag mchog tu bde/ /rgas khar tshul khrims ldan pa bde/ /dad la rab tu gnas pa bde/ /don ldan tshig la dga' ba bde/ /sdig pa mi byed pa dag 72—677

bde / /'jig rten na ni phar 'dzin bde/ /de bzhin mar yang 'dzin pa bde/ /'jig rten dge sbyong 'dzin pa bde/ /de bzhin bram zer 'dzin pa bde/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni 'byung ba bde/ /de bzhin chos rnams bstan pa bde/ /dge 'dun rnams ni 'thun 6)pa bde/ /'thun ②pa rnams kyi dka' thub bde/ /tshul khrims ldan pa mthong ba bde/ /mang du thos pa mthong ba bde/ /yang srid rnam par grol ba yi/ /dgra bcom pa dag mthong ba bde/ /'jug ngogs bde ba'i chu klung bde/ /chos kyis rgyal ba'i skye bo bde/ /shes rab thob par gyur pa ①bde / /nga 'o nga rgyal zad pa bde/ /'phags pa rnams ni mthong ba bde/ /dam pa dag dang 'grogs pa bde/ /byis pa rnams ni ma mthong na/ /rtag tu bde ba nyid du 'gyur/ /rnam pa kun du dgra 'dra ba'i/ /byis dang 'grogs pa sdug bsngal zhing / /byis pa dag dang 'grogs byed pa/ /yun ring rjes su 'gyod par 'gyur/ /skyes bu cang shes dkon pa ste/ /de dag kun du 'byung ma yin / /brtan pa rnams dang 'grogs pa dag /gnyen dang phrad ④pa lta bur bde(snyel/ /gang du brtan pa de skyes pa/ /de yi rigs kyis bde ba 'thob/ /bram ze mya ngan 'das pa dag /rnam pa kun du bde bar 'jug /gang zhig 'dod pas ma gos shing / /zag med rab tu rnam grol ba/ /sred ⑥pa thams cad gtubs pe dag /snying las rims nad rnam par bsal/ /sems kyis zhi ba thob pa rnams/ /nye bar zhi zhing bde bar 'jug /gang zhig bde ba yangs 'dod cing / /bde ba chung ngu gtong 'dod pa'i/ /brtan pas bde chung spang byas na/ /bde ba yangs pa legs par mthong / /'jig rten 'dod bde gang yin dang / /lha yul bde ba gang yin pas/ /sred pa zad pa'i bde ba de'i/ /72—678

bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /khur gyis sdug bsngal blangs pas na/ /khur bor na ni bde bar 'gyur/ /lci ba'i khur dag nges bor na/ /phyi nas gzhan dag len mi 'gyur/ /kun sbyor thams cad zad bya'i 6)phyir/ /srid pa thams cad rab tu spongs/ /phung po thams cad yongs shes na/ /srid pa phyi mar 'gro ba med/ /don rnams bkun ②pa la ni grogs ldan bde/ /srog dag rab tu gtugs la bsod nams bde/ /ngan ngon tsam gyis legs par chog shes bde/ /sdug bsngal thams cad nges par nub pa bde/ /'di na me ni 'bar ba la/ /lcags kyi tho bas brgyab pa yis/ /rim gyis nye bar zhi 'gyur te/ /ji ltar song ba mi shes ltar/ /'dod pa'i 'dam rdzab chu rgal ①cing / /go 'phang mi g.yo thob pa dang / /legs par rnam par grol rnams kyi/ /'gro ba gdags su med pa yin/ /gang zhig khong na 'khrug pa med pa dang / /gang zhig sred dang sred min las log pa/ /de dag 'jigs bral bde zhing mya ngan med/ /lhas kyang blta zhing bsam du med par 'gyur/ /'di na gang dag chos mang thos pa dang / /rtogs shing ci yang med pa kye re bde/ /skye bo skye bo'i lus skyil rab chags shing / /chung duzad yod pa brlag par gyur la ltos/ /'di na gang dag chos 6)mang thos pa dang / /rtogs shing ci yang med pa kye re bde/ /skye bo skye bo'i lus la rab chags shing / /chung 0zad yod pa brlag par gyur la ltos/ /skye bo ci med yon tan rtogs pa dang / /skye bo ci yang med par gyur pa bde/ /skye bo skye bo'i sems ⑧la rab chags shing / /chung 6)zad yod pa brlag par gyur la ltos/ /skye bo ci med yon tan rtogs pa dang ⑩/ /skye bo ci yang med par gyur pa bde/ /skye bo skye bo'i lus la rab chags shing / /chung 7zad yod pa brlag par gyur la 72—679

ltos / /gzhan gyi dbang gyur kun sdug ste/ /rang dbang yod pa thams cad bde / /sbyor ba shin tu spang dka' ba/ /thun mong gyur pas brlag par zad/ /zhen par gyur pa'i mi nang na/ /zhen pa med par gnas pa dang / /zhen pa'i nang na ma zhen pa/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tsho/ /nad kyis thebs pa'i mi nang na/ /nad med par ni gnas pa dang / /nad pa'i nang na nad med pa/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tsho/ /'tshe ba can gyi mi nang na/ /'tshe ba med par gnas pa dang / /'tshe ba'i nang na 'tshe med pa/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tsho / /gnod sems can gyi mi nang na/ /gnod sems med par gnas pa dang —/ /gnod sems can nang gnod med pa/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tshol/ /sha khon can gyi mi nang na/ /sha khon med par gnas pa dang / /sha khon can nang 'khon hu)med pa/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tsho/ /mi thi la dag rab bsregs kyang / /nga la ci yang tshig pa med/ /nga la gang dag ci med pas / /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tsho/ /nga la ci yang med mod kyi/ /dga' ba za bar byed pas na/ /'od gsal gyi ni lha bzhin du/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tsho/ /'jig tshogs la ni mi rten pas/ /nga la ci yang med mod kyis②/ /dga' ba za bar byed pas na/ /kye ma'o shin tu bde bar 'tsho/ /len pa'i rkyen gyis phrad cing reg 'gyur gyi/ /len med ci dang phrad cing reg med pas/ /bdag dang gzhan gyis bskyed pa'i bde sdug gis/ /dgon pa'am grong du reg par mi 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten 'di na bde dang sdug bsngal gyis/ /skyes bu dam pa mtho ①dman mi 'gyur zhing / /brtan rnams 'dod pa'i rgyu yis mi 'khyal bar/ /skyes bu dam pa kun du 'gro bar byed/ /bde ba'i tshoms te 72—680

ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/ bam po bzhi pa ste tha ma/ gzung bar dka' zhing yang ba dang / /gang du dga' bar 'gro ba yi③/ /sems dul ba ni legs pa ste/ /sems dul ba yis bde ba 'dren/ /bdud kyi gzhi dag spong ba na①/ /chu bo'i gnas nas rab bton te/ /thang la bor ba'i nya lta bur/ /bdag gi sems ni yongs su g.yo/ /nyi ma las ni 'od zer ltar/ /bdag gi sems ni so sor rgyug /de dag mkhas pas nges bzlog ste/ /lcags kyu yis ni glang chen bzhin / /nga la don med spyod pa dang / /bltar med snying po med pa de/ /rtag tu gdul bar bya ba'i phyir/ /sems de la ni nga smra'o/ /sems 'di sngon chad ji ltar 'dod pa dang / /dga' dgur spyod cing rgyu bar 0byed pa (snyedag /glang chen myos la mi yis lcags kyu ltar/ /de ⑥ni tshul bzhin bya bas de bzung ngo / /khang khyim byed pa 'di yis ni/ /yang yang skye ba'i sdug bsngal can/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba du ma zhig /da ltar phan cad khyod kyis laphyung / /khang khyim byed pa khyod mthong bas/ /khyim gyi gdung chen rnam ⑧bcom la/ /phyam ⑨rnams thams cad bcag nas su/ /phyin cad tshukhyim byed mi gzhug go/ /sems ni 'du byed dang phral ⑩nas/ /'di nyid la ni zad par 'dod/ /sems ni g.yo zhing brdzun ⑫pa ste/ /ring du 'gro zhing bzlog dka' ba/ /mda' mkhan me yis srong ba ltar//yid gzhungs pa yis bsrang bar bya/ /gang zhig lus med phug na gnas/ /gcig pu rgyu zhing ring 'gro ba'i/ /sems de 'dul bar byed pa ni/ /'jigs pa che las thar bar 'gyur/ /log pa'i smon ldan sems gang gis/ /bdag 72—681

nyid sdug bsngal byed 'gyur ba'i/ /de ltar 'khon gyis 'khon ①can dang / /dgra bos dgra la'ang ②byed mi 'gyur/ /yang dag smon ldan sems gang gis/ /bdag nyid bde bar byed 'gyur ba/ /de ②ltar pha dang ma dag dang / /gnyen gzhan gyis kyang byed mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar khong steng g.yogs ④nyes na/ /char pa yongs su 'dzag ⑤pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems ni ma bsgoms pa/ /'dod chags rnams kyis yongs su bcom/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs dulegs na/ /char pa rnam par mi 'dzag pa/ /de bzhin legs par bsgoms pa'i sems/ /'dod chags rnams kyis yong 9)mi choms/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs ninyes na/ /char pa yongs su 'dzag 6)pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems ni ma bsgoms pa/ /zhe sdang rnams kyis yongs su bcom/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs ⑩legs na/ / char pa ⑩rnam par mi 'dzag pa/ /de bzhin legs par bsgoms ⑩pa'i sems zhe sdang rnams kyis yong mi choms/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs 8nyes na/ /char pa yongs su 'dzag pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems ni ma bsgoms pa/ /gti mug rnams kyis yongs su bcom/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs ④legs na/ /char pa rnam par mi 'dzag patso/ /de bzhin legs par bsgoms pa'i sems/ /gti mug rnams kyis yong ⑩mi choms/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs 0nyes na/ /char pa yongs su 'dzag pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems ni ma bsgoms pa/ /nga rgyal rnams kyis yongs su bcom/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs tsolegs na/ /char pa rnam par mi 'dzag 4)pa/ /de bzhin legs par bsgoms pa'i sems/ /nga rgyal rnams kyis yong zhu mi choms/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs nyes na0/ /char pa yongs su 'dzag pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems ni ma bsgoms pa/ /chags pa 72—682

rnams kyis yongs su bcom/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs 6)legs na/ /char pa rnam par mi 'dzag pa/ /de bzhin legs par bsgoms pa'i sems/ /chags pa rnams kyis yong ②mi choms/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs gnyes na/ /char pa yongs su 'dzag pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems ni ma bsgoms pa/ /srid pa rnams kyis yongs su bcom/ /ji ltar khang steng g.yogs gi)legs na/ /char pa rnam par mi 'dzag ⑤pa/ /de bzhin legs par bsgoms pa'i sems/ /sred pa rnams kyis yong ⑥mi choms/ /chos kyi sngon du yid 'gro ste/ /yid mgyogs (/7yid ni gtso bo yin/ /gal te yid rab gdug pa yis/ /smras sam yang na byas kyang rung / /de yis de ni sdug bsngal 'thob/ /'khor los mgo bo bcad pa bzhin / /chos kyi sngon du yid 'gro ste/ /yid mgyogs 6)yid ni gtso bo yin/ /gal te yid rab dang ba yis/ /smras sam yang na byas kyang rung / /de yis 6)de ni bde ba 'thob/ /grib ma rjes su 'brang ba bzhin/ /brtsad ⑩pa ched cher 'dzin pa dang / /sems ni nyon mongs gyur pa yis/ /glags skabs tshol bar byed pa yisahu/ /legs bshad legs par mi shes so/ /sdang ba'am yang na 'khrug pa'am/ /dad pa med pa'i sems dag gis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis ⑫bstan pa yi/ /dam chos kun shes mi nus so/ /gang gis bag med sems dang ni / /khro ba rnam par btul ba dang / /'di na gnod sems rab spangs pa/ /des ni legs par bshad pa shes/ /sems kyi brtan pa med pa yis/ /dam chos rnam par shes mi 'gyur/ /dad pa 'gyur ldog byed pa yi/ /shes rab yongs su rdzogs mi 'gyur/ /kun rtog la chums rten pa yi/ /lta ngan sum cu ⑫rtsa drug gi/ /chu bo'i rgyun ni gang yin pa/ /yid kyi rgyun las rab tu 'bab/ /72—683

dga' sems dbang ①po phal pa dang / /sems kyi rjes 'brang zhan pa yi/ /mi de'i grags 'grib 'bras lhags pa'i/ /ljon shing la ni bya bzhin no/ /sems khyod ②phung khrol 'dod dul dga' stim byed/ /brtson sems bag yod pa la gnas par gyis/ /bag med byas pas dmyal bar btsos 0pa dang ①/ /lcags gong mid pas khyod ⑦ni ma ngu shig⑧ /ldang ba'i dus tshe 'dug par byed pa dang / /lang tsho ⑨stobs ldan mi 'bad khyim 'dug dang ⑩/ /bsam pa rdzogs tshe le lo byed pa yi/ /mi yi shes rab lam rtogs mi ⑩'gyur ro/ /phran tshegs rnam rtogs 8zhib mor rnam rtog pas/ /nang na gnas pa'i yid ni g.yen yang spyotso/ /yid kyi rnam rtog de dag ma shes na/ /'khrul sems yang dang yang du rgyug par byed / /gang zhig dran ldan rnam 'byed brtson pa dang / /rnam par rtog la mkhas pas de shes na/ /nang na gnas pa'i ④yid ni g.yen 8spyo ba/ /thams cad ma lus blo yis rab tu spong / /lus 'di bum pa 'dra bar rtogs byas shing //grong khyer 'dra ba'i sems kyis sran btsugs nas/ /shes rab mtshon gyis bdud dang g.yul sprad de/ /btul nas gnas med par ni bsrung bar bya/ /'jig rten 'di dag bum pa 'drar rtogs shing / /de bzhin chos rnams smig 8rgyu 'drar shes nas/ /shes rab mtshon gyis bdud dang g.yul sprad de/ /btul nas gnas med par ni bsrung bar bya/ /lus 'di dbu ba 'dra bar rtogs byas shing / /grong khyer 'dra ba'i sems kyis sran btsugs nas/ /shes rab mtshon gyis bdud dang g.yul sprad de/ /btul nas gnas med par ni bsrung bar bya /'jig rten 'di dag dbu ba 'drar rtogs shing / /grong khyer 'dra ba'i sems kyis sran btsugs nas/ /shes rab mtshon gyis bdud ⑩dang g.yul sprad de/ /72—684

btul nas gnas med par ni bsrung bar bya/ /gang gis byang chub yan lag bdun① / /sems kyis legs par bsgoms pa dang / /gang zhig len la mi dga' zhing / /len pa rab tu spangs pa ②dang / /zag zad skyon rnams bsal ba de/ /'jig rten dag na mya ngan 'das/ /gang zhig g.yag rnga'i rtse mo ltar/ /rang gi sems ni rjes sung zhing / /'byung po rnams la brtser ldan pa/ /de yi bde ba yong nimi nyams/ /gang phyir glang po'i glang dupo che mche ba bzang po'i glang chen dang / /sems dang sems ni mnyam ⑤pas na/ /de phyir gcig pu nags su dgyes/ /gang gi yid la gnod med cing / /'byung po kun la brtse ba dang ske/ /'byung po rnams la byams dubyed pa/ /de la nams kyang 'khon ⑦mi 'byung —/ /gang la gnod pa'i sems med cing / /'byung po kun la brtse ba dang ske/ /srog chags kun la byams byed pa/ /de la nams kyang 'khon ⑧mi 'byung ske/ /gang la gnod pa'i sems med cing / /'byung po rnams la brtse ba dang ske/ /sems can kun la byams byed pa/ /de la nams kyang 'khon ①mi 'gyur⑩ / /mdza' bshes kun dang grogs kun dang / /'byung po kun la brtse ba dang ske/ /byams pa'i sems ni bsgoms ⑩byas na/ /bde ba shin tu 'phel bar 'gyur / /gal te gang zhig srog chags 'ga' la'ang sdang med sems/ /byams par byed na de yis de ni dge ba yin/ /sems can thams cad la ni yid kyis brtse byas na/ /bsod nams phal chen 8'phags pas rab tu bsgrub 0par 'gyur / /mi gang dga' ba'i sems dang ni/ /zhum pa med pa'i yid kyis bu8/ /dge ba'i chos la sgom 8byed pa/ /grub pa dang ni bde ba 'thob/ /yang dag shes pas rnam grol zhing / / skyo ba 8nye bar zhi gyur pa/ /de yis 7yid ni zhi 72—685

gyur cing / /lus dang ngag gi las kyang zhi/ /ji ltar rtse gcig sems kyis ni/ /chos rnams legs par mthong ba ltar/ /sil snyan yan lag lnga pas kyang / /de ltar dga' bar ①byed mi 'gyur/ /gang yid ting 'dzin la dga' ba/ /de dag 'dod pas rtse mi byed/ /gang zhig cung ②zad gdung med pa'i/ /skyob pa bde bar nyal bar 'gyur/ /gang yid ting 'dzin la dga' ba/ /de dag 'dod pas rtsen mi byed/ /gang zhig cung ②zad gdung med pa'i/ /thub pa kye ma'o dga' bar 'gyur/ /gang gi sems ni brag lta bur/ /rab tu g.yo ba med 'dug pa/ /chags pa'i gnas la mi chags te/ /khro ba'i gnas la 'khrug med par / /gang yid de ltar gyur pa de/ /sdug bsngal thob par ga la 'gyur/ /skur pa mi gdab gnod mi bya/ /so sor thar pas bsdam par bya/ /zas kyi tshod kyang shes par bya/ /bas mtha' dgon par gnas bya zhing du/ /lhag pa'i sems la rnal 'byor bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /sems kyi rtags la mkhas pa dang / /rab tu dben pa'i ro rnyed dang / /rab drang rjosems pa'i 'grus skyong can/ /zang zing med pa'i dga' ba myong / /gang zhig yid gzhungs dben dga' dben gnas pas/ /rtag tu rang gi lus kyis spyod ⑥lam dang / /smra dang yid ni srung ⑦bar byed pa de/ /mya ngan spong zhing sdug bsngal 'thob mi 'gyur/ /ma bsrungs pa (kyeyi sems dag ①ni/ /log par lta ⑩bas bcom pa dang / /gnyid dang rmugs pas zil non pa/ /bdud kyi dbang du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de bas sems ni bsrung byas te/ /yang dag lta bas mdun bdar cing / /yang dag kun rtog spyod yul can/ /yang dag skye dang 'jig 7pa shes/ /gnyid dang rmugs ⑩pa zil gnon pa'i/ /dge slong sdug 72—686

bsngal zad pa 'thob/ /bag yod sems ni bsrung 6)ba dang / /sems dul yang dag sdom pa bde/ /skye dgu sems kyis bslus pa dag /gcig tu sems can dmyal bar 'tshed/ /bag yod ②sems ni bsrung ②ba dang / /sems dul yang dag sdom pa bde/ /skye dgu sems kyis bslus pa dag /gcig tu dud 'gro rnams su 'tshed/ /bag yod sems ni bsrung 4)ba dang / /sems dul yang dag sdom pa bde/ /skye dgu sems kyis bslus pa dag /gcig tu yi dgas ⑤rnams su 'tshed/ /bag yod sems ni bsrung ⑥ba dang / /sems dul yang dag sdom ⑦pa bde/ /skye dgu sems ni bsrung ba nidag /gcig tu mi yi nang du dga'/ /bag yod sems ni bsrung ⑨ba dang tre/ /sems dul yang dag sdom ⑩pa bde/ /skye dgu sems ni bsrung ba ⑩dag /gcig tu mtho ris rnams su dga'/ /bag yod sems ni bsrung ⑩ba dang / /sems dul yang dag sdom pa bdekyi/ /skye dgu sems ni bsrung ba 8dag /gcig tu mya ngan 'das pa 'thob sems kyi tshoms te sum cu 8rtsa gcig pa'o// //dge slong bsod snyoms byed pa bdag rang tsam/ /'grangs ⑩par byed kyi ⑩gzhan dag mi gso ba/ /rtag tu nyer zhi dran dang ldan pa yi/ /skyob pa de la lha rnams dga' bar byed/ /dge slong bsod snyoms byed pa bdag rang tsam/ /'grangs 8par byed kyi yigazhan dag mi gso ba/ /skyob pa de la lha rnams dga' byed kyi/ /bkur sti nor dang grags 'dod rnams la min/ /dge slong 'dod pa kun spangs shing / /mdun na gnas pa'i rdul bsal ba/ /bdag med thub pa brten ( )pa yis/ /gzhan la smra bar bya mi dgos/ /skye bo ma bsdams 0tshig 72—687

gis ①gnod byed pa/ /mi bzad rjod ②pa'i tshig de thos gyur kyang / /dge slong snang sems bral la ci ③mi snyam/ /g.yul ngor glang chen mda' yis bsnun pa bzhin/ /skye bo ma bsdams tshig gis gnod byed pa/ /mi bzad rjod 0pa'i tshig de thos gyur kyang / /dge slong yid legs bzhag la ji mi snyam/ /g.yul ngor glang chen mda' yis bsnun pa bzhin/ /bzo yis mi 'tsho yang zhing bdag la dga'/ /dbang po dul zhing kun las rnam grol zhing / /khyim la ma chags bag med 'dod sred spangs/ /gcig pu spyod byed de ni dge slong yin/ /'tsho gtsang ①snyom las med pa yi/ /grogs po 'thun ①pa bsten bya zhing / /so sor bgo ⑦bsha' bya ba dang / /spyod yul cho ga mkhas par bya/ /lag pa legs bsdams rkang pa legs bsdams dang / /tshig rnams legs bsdams dbang po legs bsdams shing / /gcig pu nang du mnyam par 'jog la dga'/ /chog shes de ni dge slong yin zhes gsung / /dge slong chos la kun dga' zhing / /chos dga' chos la sems pa (kyedang / /chos la rjes su dran pa dag /chos las ⑨yongs su nyams mi 'gyur/ /dge slong khang stong zhugs nas su/ /nang la lta bar byed pa dang / /chos rnams legs par mthong ba dag /lha yi dga' dang ldan par 'gyur/ /ji lta ji ltar phung po la/ /skye dang 'jig par legs rtogs kyipal/ /de lta de ltar de yis ni⑩/ /dga' dang mgu ba nyid kyang 'thob/ /dge slong dga' ba mang po yis/ /sdug bsngal zad pa thob par 'gyur/ /ji ltar brag gi ri bo dag /rlung gis rab tu mi g.yos ltar/ /de bzhin dge slong 'dod chags dag /zad pa kun tu rab mi g.yo/ /ji ltar brag gi ri bo dag /rlung gis rab tu mi g.yos ltar/ /de bzhin dge slong zhe sdang dag /zad pa 72—688

kun tu rab mi g.yo/ /ji ltar brag gi ri bo dag /rlung gis rab tu mi g.yos ltar / /de bzhin dge slong gti mug dag /zad pa kun tu rab mi g.yo/ /ji ltar brag gi ri bo dag /rlung gis rab tu mi g.yos ltar/ /de bzhin dge slong nga rgyal dag /zad pa kun tu rab mi g.yo/ /ji ltar brag gi ri bo dag /rlung gis ①rab tu mi g.yos ltar/ /de bzhin dge slong chags pa dag /zad pa kun tu rab mi g.yo/ /ji ltar brag gi ri bo dag /rlung gis rab tu mi g.yos ltar/ /de bzhin dge slong sred pa dag /zad pa kun du rab mi g.yo/ /gang la kun du sogs ②med cing / /gang la bdag gir byed med pa/ /gang dag med na'ang mi gdung ba/ /de ni dge slong zhes brjod do/ /re zhig ②gzhan la slong ba tsam//ji ga dge slong min pa snyam/ /grong ba'i chos ni 'dzin byed pa/ /ji ga dge slong min pa snyam/ /gang zhig dge dang sdig pa dag /rab spangs tshangs par spyod ldan zhing / /sde tshogs spangs nas spyod byed pa/ /de ni dge slong zhes brjod do/ /dge slong gang zhig byams gnas shing / /sangs rgyas bstan la rab dang bdu/ /des ni blta bas mi ngoms pa'i/ /zhi ba'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur / /dge slong gang zhig byams gnas shing / /sangs rgyas bstan la rab dang desaX/ /'du byed nyer zhi zhi ba yi/ /zhi ba'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /dge slong gang zhig byams gnas shing / /sangs rgyas bstan la rab dang bsti/ /des ni kun sbyor kun zad pa/ /rim gyis mngon sum byed par 'gyur/ /dge slong gang zhig byams gnas shing / /sangs rgyas bstan la rab dang bsal/ /bdag nyid ngan 'gro las 'dren te/ /'dam rdzab las ni glang chen bzhin/ /dge slong gang zhig byams gnas shing / /sangs rgyas bstan la rab dang bsal/ /72—689

sdig pa'i chos rnams sprug byed de/ /rlung gis ljon shing lo ma bzhin/ /dge slong gang zhig byams gnas shing / /sangs rgyas bstan la rab dang bas①/ /mya ngan 'das dang nye ba'i phyir/ /yongs su nyams 'gyur mi srid do/ /sems dga' yid ni bzang ba dang / /dga' dang mi dga' zil gnon pa'i/ /dge slong dga' ba ②mang po yis/ /sdug bsngal zad pa thob par 'gyur/ /lus zhi ngag ni zhi ba dang / /sems zhi ①legs par mnyam bzhag ④cing / /'jig rten zang zing spangs pa yi/ /dge slong nyer zhi yin zhes brjod/ /ting 'dzin med la shes rab med/ /shes rab med la ting 'dzin med/ /shes rab ting 'dzin ldan pa de/ /dge slong yin zhes brjod par bya/ /de bas ting 'dzin shes rab la / /mkhas pa rnams kyis 'jug bya ste/ /de bzhin shes rab dge slong de'i/ /dang por bya ba 'di yin no/ /chog shes dbang po bsdam bya zhing / /so sor thar pas bsdam par bya/ /zas kyi tshod ④kyang shes par bya/ /bas mtha' dgon par gnas bya zhing / /lhag pa'i sems la rnal 'byor bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /gang gi (7lus dang ngag dang ni/ /yid la nyes byas med gyur pa / /de ni dge ba'i tshul khrims can/ /ngo tsha'i yid ldan dge slong yin/ /gang gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi/ /phyogs kyi chos bdun legs bsgoms ⑦pa/ /de ni dge ba'i chos can de/ /mnyam bzhag ⑧dge slong yin zhes gsung / /'di na gang zhig bdag nyid kyi/ /sdug bsngal zad pa rab shes la/ /dge zhing shes rab ldan pa de/ /zag med dge slong yin ⑨zhes gsung ⑩/ /zag pa zad pa ma thob na/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs tsam dag gam/ /yang na thos pa mang po 'am/ /dben pa dag tu gnas kyang rung / /ting 'dzin thob par gyur kyang 72—690

ngal / /deng drod chod pa'i dge slong min/ /phung po la ni bdag zer ba'i/ /'jig rten 'di dag gdung ba skyel/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bde ba ni/ /'phags pas bstan ②pa mngon du bya/ /ji lta ji ltar bsam byas pa/ /de lta de ltar gzhan du 'gyur/ /gzhan du 'gyur ba'i 'jig rten 'di/ /srid ③pa la chags srid la rjodaga'/ /srid la mngon (9chags srid dul dga'aphya/ /srid pa nyid la mngon par dga'/ /dga' bya gang yin de sdug bsngal/ /skyi g.ya' gang yin de bde bas/ /srid pa rab tu spang ba'i duphyir/ /'di na tshangs par spyod pa stekhya/ /dge sbyong bram ze ji snyed pa/ /srid pas srid las nges 'byung zer / /de dag thams cad srid pa las/ /nges 'byung min zhes brjod par bya/ /dge sbyong bram ze ji snyed pa/ /srid pas srid las nges 'byung 0zer/ /de dag thams cad srid pa las/ /rnam grol min zhes brjod par bya/ /len pa'i rkyen las 0sdug bsngal byung ⑫/ /sdug bsngal las ni len pa byung / /len pa thams cad yongs zad na/ /sdug bsngal rab tu 'byung ba med/ /len pa thams cad na 0srid pa'i rnam pa ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad ni mi rtag pa/ sdug bsngal ba/ yongs su 'gyur ba'i chos can yin no zhes de ltar de dag la yang dge ba'i 8shes rab kyis ji lta ba 8bzhin du mthong na/ srid ⑩pa'i sred pa rab tu spong bar 'gyur zhing / srid pa med pas mngon par mi dga' bar 'gyur ro//de ltar mya ngan las 'das pa'i dge slong skyob pa ni gzhan du len pa med cing yang srid 8med par 'gyur te/ bdud zil gyis non pa dang / g.yul las rgyal ba dang / srid pa thams cad las rab tu 'das pa 'di lta bu 'di ni sdug bsngal gyi mtha' yin no/ /dge slong dngos po bcad pa dang / /nye bar zhi zhing 72—691

sems zhi ba/ /de ni yang srid med par 'gyur/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rnam par spangs / /dge slong dngos po bcad pa dang / /nye bar zhi zhing sems zhi ba/ /de ni bdud kyi 'ching las grol/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rnam par spangs/ /dge slong dngos po bcad pa dang / /sems ni zag pa med gyur pa/ /de ni yang srid med pa ste/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rnam par spangs/ /dge slong dngos po bcad pa dang / /sems ni zag pa med gyur pa/ /de ni bdud kyi 'ching las grolam/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rnam par spangs/ /dge slong dngos po bcad pa dang //srid pa'i sred pa gtubs gyur pa/ /de ni yang srid med par 'gyur/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rnam par spangs/ /dge slong dngos po bcad pa dang / /srid pa'i sred pa bcad gyur pa/ /de ni bdud kyi 'ching las grol/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rnam par spangs/ /gang zhig 'dam ①phab legs rgal ②cing / /grong gi tsher ma dkrugs ②pa dang / /'dod chags zad pa rjes thob pa/ /de ni dge slong yin zhes brjod/ /gang zhig 'dam rdzab legs rgal ④cing / /grong gi tsher ma dkrugs ⑤pa dang / /zhe sdang zad pa rjes thob pa/ /de ni dge slong yin zhes brjod / /gang zhig 'dam rdzab legs rgal 0cing / /grong gi tsher ma dkrugs ⑦pa dang / /gti mug zad pa rjes thob pa/ /de ni dge slong yin zhes brjod/ /gang zhig 'dam rdzab legs rgal gcing / /grong gi tsher ma dkrugs ⑨pa dang / /nga rgyal zad ⑩pa rjes thob pa/ /de ni dge slong yin zhes brjod/ /gang zhig 'dam 7rdzob legs rgal ⑩cing / /grong gi tsher ma dkrugs 8pa dang / /chags pa zad pa rjes thob pa/ /de ni dge slong yin zhes brjod/ /gang zhig 'dam ⑫rdzab legs rgal 8cing / /grong gi tsher ma dkrugs ⑩pa dang / /sred pa zad pa 72—692

rjes thob pa/ /de ni dge slong yin zhes brjod/ /gang zhig gshe ba dang ni gsod pa dang / /'ching dang grong gi tsher ma thul ba dang / /gang zhig ri bo bzhin gnas mi bkri zhing / /sdug bdes mi g.yo ①de ni dge slong yin/ /skur pa mi 'debs sgro ②'dogs mi byed cing / /'jig rten 'di kun brdzun ①rtogs dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /sbrul gyis dug btang ba la sman bzhin du/ /'dod chags langs pa 'dul ba'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /sbrul gyis dug btang ba la sman bzhin du/ /zhe snang langs pa 'dul ba'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /sbrul gyis dug btang ba la sman bzhin du/ /gti mug langs pa 'dul ba'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /sbrul gyis dug btang ba la sman bzhin du/ /nga rgyal langs pa 'dul ba'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /sbrul gyis dug btang ba la sman bzhin du/ /chags pa langs pa 'dul ba'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /sbrul gyis dug btang ba la sman bzhin du/ /khro ba langs pa 'dul ba'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying ④rje ba bzhin/ /sbrul gyis dug btang ba la sman bzhin du/ /sred pa langs pa 'dul ba'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying durje ba bzhin/ /mthu chung 72—693

'dam bu'i rags la klung chen ltar/ /'dod chags ma lus drungs ①'byin dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying ②rje ba bzhin/ /mthu chung 'dam bu'i rags la klung chen ltar/ /zhe snang ma lus drungs ③'byin dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /mthu chung 'dam bu'i rags la klung chen ltar/ /gti mug ma lus drungs du'abyin dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /mthu chung 'dam bu'i rags la klung chen ltar/ /nga rgyal ma lus drungs (ge'abyin dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /mthu chung 'dam bu'i rags la klung chen ltar/ /chags pa ma lus drungs ⑥'byin dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /mthu chung 'dam bu'i rags la klung chen ltar / /sred pa ma lus drungs ⑦'byin dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad spong byed cing / /'dod sbyor 'ching ba rnam (nyebasal dge slong gang —/ /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin / /sgrib pa thams cad spangs shing sdig med pa/ /yid gnyis zug rngu bcad pa'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /rtog pa rnam bsal nang gi ma lus la/ /rnam par rtog pa med pa'i dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /nags sbyor byed pa 'ga' med mi 72—694

dge ba'i/ /rtsa ba legs par drungs hu)phyung dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /rims nad bcas pa 'ga' med mi dge ba'i/ /rtsa ba legs par drungs chaphyung dge slong gang ske/ /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin / /bag ①la nyal ba 'ga' med mi dge ba'i/ /rtsa ④ba legs par drungs (5)phyung dge slong gang / /de ni pha rol min pa'i pha rol po/ /spong ste sbrul rgas pags rnying rje ba bzhin/ /khrims ldan gang yin dge slong de/ /stong nyid gang ldan bsam gtan de/ /rtag tu byed gang rnal 'byor deyi/ /mya ngan 'das gang bde ba de/ /dge slong dga' dang mi dgas mi brjod cing / /bas mtha'i gnas mal dag tu sten ⑦pa dang / /de ni (nyabag yod gnas shing sred yonyepa yi/ /'dod chags phra rgyas legs par 'byin par byed/ /dge slong gi tshoms te sum cu ⑩gnyis pa'o// //gang zhig brgyan kyang chos spyod dul ba dang / /zhi zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod/ /'byung po kun la chad pas mi gcod de/ /bram ze dge sbyong de yin dge slong de/ /gcer bur 7spyod pas ma yin ral 8pas ma yin rdzab kyis min/ /kha zas mi za ba yis ma yin thang la nyal ba 'am/ /rdul dang dri mas ma yin cog tipur 'dug la 'bad pa yis/ /mi rnams dag par mi 'gyur som nyi rnams las rgal mi 'gyur/ /dge sbyong bram ze gang yang rung / /de dag nyid la chags byed pa/ /zag pa zad pa ma thob par/ /bar ma dor ni rnam par nyams/ /dge sbyong bram ze gang yang rung / /de dag nyid la chags byed 72—695

pa / /tshor ba zad pa ma thob par/ /bar ma dor ni rnam par nyams/ /dge sbyong bram ze gang yang rung / /de dag nyid la chags byed cing / /byis pa mtha' gcig la lta ba/ /bar ma dor ni rnam par nyams/ /dge sbyong bram ze gang yang rung / /de dag nyid la chags byed pa/ /byis pa'i ②skye bo blo ngan rnams / /bar ma dor ni rnam par nyams/ /dge sbyong bram ze gang yang rung / /de dag nyid la chags byed pa/ /go 'phang dam pa ma thob par/ /bar ma dor ni rnam par nyams/ /blo ngan khyod kyi ral pa ci/ /khyod kyi ②g.yang gzhi gyon pa ci / /khyod nang thibs por 'dug bzhin du/ /phyi rol legs par byi dor byed/ /blo ngan khyod kyi ral pa ci/ /khyod kyi dugayang gzhi gyon pa ci/ /khyod nang dri ma ldan bzhin du/ /phyi rol legs par byi dor byed/ /rigs kyis bram zer 'gyur ma yin/ /ral pas ma yin rus kyis min/ /gang zhig bden pa'i chos ldan pa/ /gtsang ma de yin bram ze yin/ /rigs kyis bram zer 'gyur ma yin//ral pas ma yin rus kyis min/ /gang zhig sdig pa che ༷chung rnams/ /thams cad spong bar byed pa dag /sdig pa rnams ni spangs phyir de/ /bram ze yin zhes nges par brjod/ /mgo bo bregs 0tsam dge sbyong min/ /o zhes zer ba bram ze ⑥min/ /gang zhig dge ba'i chos ldan pa/ /gtsang ma de yin bram ze de//mgo bo bregs tsam dge sbyong min/ /o zhes zer ba bram ze min/ /gang zhig sdig pa che chung rnams/ /thams cad spong bar byed pa dag⑦ /sdig pa rnams ni spangs phyir deni/ /dge sbyong bram ze de yin no/ /skye bo phal cher 'dir 'khru ba//chu yis dag par mi 'gyur te/ /gang zhig sdig pa che chung rnams/ /thams cad spong po)bar byed pa dag /sdig pa rnams ni spangs phyir de⑩/ /dge sbyong bram ze 72—696

de yin no/ /gang zhig sdig ①chos rab spangs shing / /rtag tu dran ldan spyod ②byed pa/ /kun sbyor zad pa'i sangs rgyas de/ /'jig rten dag na bram ze yin//bram ze gang zhig sdig pa'i chos spangs shing / /bdag nyid tshul 'chos med cing rnyog med gnas/ /rig byed mthar phyin tshangs par spyod pa spyad/ /dus su smra byed de ni tshangs pa smra/ /gang zhig sgyu ③la mi gnas nga rgyal med/ /gang zhig chags med bdag med re ba med/ /'khrug bcom bdag nyid mya ngan 'das phyogs dedu/ /bram ze dge sbyong de yin dge slong de/ /gang zhig ma ⑤yi mngal skyes nas/ /gal te 'dzin pa dang bcas nadu/ /de ming bu ⑦zhes smra bar bstan / /bram ze yin par nga mi smra/ /yongs su 'dzin med len med de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig lus dang ngag dang ni/ /yid kyis nyes byas mi byed cing / /gang zhig gnas gsum legs bsdams te/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang gi tshig ngag mi rtsub cing / /go byed ⑧yid 'ong smra ba dang / /gang gis nyon mongs mi skyed de①/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig gsod 'ching gshe ba dang / /sdang ba'i mi kyil bzod byed de/ /bzod pa'i brtul zhugs stobs tshogs can/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /khro ba med cing tshul khrims can/ /brtul zhugs ldan zhing sems khral 7med/ /dul zhing lus mthar gnas pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig rab byung khyim pa dang / /de bzhin gnyis kur ⑫mi 'dre zhing / /'dod chung khyim nas ma byung de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /ma 'ongs pa la mngon mi dga'/ /'das pa rnams la gdung med pa/ /'khrig pa'i sbyor bral g.yul rgyal de/ /bram ze yin par ngas 72—697

gsungs so/ /ma 'ongs pa la mngon mi dga'/ /'das la gdung med rdul bral zhing / /zhi ba mya ngan med pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig 'dod chung gzhan mi gso/ /dul zhing snying por rab gnas la/ /zag zad skyon rnams bsal ba de0)/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig pha rol tshu rol dang / /pha rol tshu rol gnyis med cing / /chos rnams kun gyi mthar phyin te(snye/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig pha rol tshu rol dang / /pha rol tshu rol gnyis med cing / /gang zhig gnas gsum ma chags de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig thung dang ③ring ba dang / /phra sbom dge dang mi dge dang / /'jig rten cung duzad mi len de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig 'di nyid rab shes shing / /rang gi sdug bsngal zad pa dang / /'dod chags bral zhing mi ldan de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig dge dang sdig pa dang / / gnyi ga ⑤yis kyang mi gos pa/ /gos med rdul bral zhi ba de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig dge dang sdig pa'i las/ /chags gang yin de durab 'das shing / /chags las rab 'das rnam grol de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig sngon dang phyi ⑦ma dang / /dbus kyang yod pa ma yin pa/ /rdul bral ⑧'ching ba las grol de6)/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /pad ma'i 'dab la chu ltar dang / /smyung bu'i rtse la yungs kur ⑩ltar/ /gang zhig sdig la ⑩mi gnas de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /pad ma'i 'dab tsol chu ltar dang —/ /sgyung bu'i tunyertse la yungs kur ④ltar/ /gang zhig 'dod la mi gnas de8 / /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /pad ma'i 'dab tshul chu ltar dang / /72—698

smyung bu'i rtse la yungs kur ①ltar/ /srid la ②dga' ba yongs spangs de / /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /zla ba dag cing dri med la/ /skyon bral rab tu dang ba ༷ltar/ /gang zhig sdig pas mi gos de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ / zla ba dag cing dri med la/ /0skyon bral rab tu dang ba ⑥ltar/ /gang zhig 'dod pas mi gos deX/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /zla ba dag cing dri med la/ /skyon bral rab tu dang ba niltar/ /srid khyal dga' ba yongs spangs de⑩/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /'dam rdzab kyis ni mkha' ltar dang ⑫/ /rdul gyis zla ba ji lta bar/ /gang zhig sdig pas mi gos de / /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /'dam rdzab kyis ni mkha' ltar dang ⑫/ /rdul gyis zla ba ji lta bar/ /gang zhig 'dod pas mi gos de⑩/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /'dam rdzab kyis ni mkha' ltar dang ⑫/ /rdul gyis zla ba ji lta bar/ /srid la dga' ba yongs spangs de8/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig 'dug nas rdul bral ba/ /sems shing zag zad bya ba byas/ /dul zhing lus mthar gnas pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /shes rab zab cing yid gzhungs la/ /lam dang lam min rnams la mkhas/ /gang zhig don mchog rjes thob de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /mi ni gang yang rung ba dag /slongs 8mo tsam gyis 'tsho ba dang / /bdag med su la'ang gnod mi byed/ /brtan ldan tshangs par spyod pa can/ /kun shes spyad phyir chos ston de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig 'dod pa legs spangs shing / /khyim med par ni rab byung ste/ /'dod pa'i zag pa yongs zad de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /'gro ba dang 72—699

ni gnas pa yi/ /'byung po chad pas mi gcod cing / / gsod med gsod ①du mi 'jug de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig mi 'thun 'thun ②byed cing / /chad pas gcod pa dang du len/ /'byung po ①rnams la brtse phan de / /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /smyung bu'i rtse la yungs kur ༷ltar/ /gang zhig 'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /nga rgyal 'chab pa ⑤'joms pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig sred pa'i rdzong 'di dang / /'khor ba'i klung las rab rgal 0cing / /brgal ⑦nas pha rol 'gro bar sems/ /yid nyid kyis ni mi bkri zhing / /gang zhig len pa las log de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig 'jig rten 'di dang ni/ /pha rol na yang sred med cing / /srid pa'i sred pa yongs zad de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig 'jig rten 'di dang ni/ /pha rol la yangs ⑤chags med cing 6)/ /chags med rnam par bral ba de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /dga' dang mi dga' spangs pa dang / /bsil bar gyur cing zag pa med/ /'jig rten kun zil gnon brtan de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /mi yi sbyor ba spangs nas su/ /lha yi sbyor ba rab 'das shing / /sbyor ba kun dang rnam bral de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig lha dang dri za dang / /mi yi 'gro ba mi shes shing / /zhi ba 'gro ba mi shes de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang gis chos rnams mi shes pa'am/ /ma mthong ba ni med gyur la0/ /shes bya mtha' yas lta ba de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang gis sngon gyi gnas rtogs shing / /mtho ris ngan song mthong ba dang / /de nas skye ba zad thob pa'i/ /thub pa mngon yishes la brtson 72—700

pa / /sdug bsngal tha mar ①rab shes de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /sems kyi rnam grol shes pa dang / /'dod chags kun las grol ba dang / /rig pa gsum dang ldan pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang gis sems can 'chi 'pho dang / /skye ba thams cad rtogs gyur pa/ /thogs med spyan ldan sangs rgyas de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig kun sbyor kun 'das shing / /yongs su gdung ba med pa dang / /dga' med dran ldan ston pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /thub pa rnam rgyal drang srong che/ /khyu mchog rab mchog laglang po che/ /bkrir ①med khrus byas sangs rgyas de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig srid 'das kun zil gnon / /chu bo las rgal durnam par 'dren/ /rnam grol ⑤pa rol phyin pa de/ /bram ze yin par dungs gsungs so/ /sdig can rnam par mi sems shing / /mi sgom smra bar mi byed par/ /'dug nas rdul bral sems pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig phyag dar khrod 'chang zhing / /ngo tsha shes shing 'dod mi lta/ /shing drung dag tu gnas pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs sol/ /gang zhig sdug bsngal kun spangs phyir/ /zhi ba 'phags lam yan lag brgyad / /drang po sgom ⑦par byed pa de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang la chung ⑧zad gnas med cing / /'du 0shes yid gnyis zug rngu med/ /'chi med go 'phang thob pa ⑩de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig lus med phug na gnas/ /gcig pu rgyu zhing ring du 'gro/ /gdul bar dka' ba'i sems 'dul de/ /bram ze yin par ngas gsungs so/ /gang zhig gzugs med bltar med mtha' yas la/ /shin tu bltar med phra zhing gzhi mngon 72—701
